Title: Data Analyst (Ads & Sponsorships)
Description:
Description & Requirements

Electronic Arts creates next-level entertainment experiences that inspire players and fans around the world. Here, everyone is part of the story. Part of a community that connects across the globe. A place where creativity thrives, new perspectives are invited, and ideas matter. A team where everyone makes play happen.

Data Analyst (Ads & Sponsorships)

Locations: Kirkland, Los Angeles (Hybrid)

Reports to: Director, Advertising & Sponsorships Insights & Innovations

As the Advertising Intelligence Analyst, you will manage monthly reporting deliverables for in-game advertising inventory as well as develop scalable data models and construct essential dashboards for the Ads & Sponsorships (A&S) team. You will partner with AdOps, AdTech, Product Management, and game analytics groups across game studios to ensure reporting data remains precise, documented, and streamlined through automation.

Operating on assignments of moderate complexity, you will independently handle the standard reporting rhythm while collaborating on new projects. You will report directly to the Director of Advertising Intelligence, and collaborate daily with the Data Solutions Analyst. Your contributions will provide foundational insights relied upon by the entire A&S Team.

Responsibilities


Align with the AdOps team each month on which campaigns are included in reporting, then create and consistently publish reports for all custom A&S inventory across EA titles.
Act as the A&S business lead with AdTech on report automation — define requirements, validate output, and cut manual steps out of the monthly cycle.
Collaborate with the Product Management team to ensure new inventory is included in standardized reporting.
Maintain documentation of reporting queries and KPI calculations so results are reproducible and auditable.
Bridge the reporting gap for A&S inventory in mobile titles and work towards automation.
Build and maintain the A&S team dashboards, to support the Sales, AdOps, Product Management, and Revenue Strategy functions.
Manage access and permissions for A&S dashboards.
Apply working knowledge of data engineering concepts to design and maintain internal A&S data models and databases as well as provide inputs and guidance to AdTech partners on data pipeline migration.
Build partnerships with studio analytics teams to understand each team's data taxonomy.
Fulfill ad hoc telemetry and data requests across the A&S team.


Qualifications


1+ years of experience in analytics, reporting, or business intelligence; internship experience counts.
Bachelor, MBA or Master's degree in Statistics or related field with knowledge in the application of statistics using analytics software.
Database knowledge including table structures, views, queries, and SQL statements including window/analytic functions.
Competent with at least one analytics software package (Python, R, SAS, or SPSS) and comfortable working in Excel (can write advanced macros).
Hands-on experience building and maintaining dashboards in a BI tool (e.g., Tableau, Power BI, or Looker), and generating graphs and visuals that make an insight easy to understand.
Summarize data using the right statistical terms and explain those concepts to non-statistical audiences in plain language.
Familiar with core data engineering concepts — pipelines, schemas, ETL, and telemetry — enough to be a useful partner to engineering teams.
Clear documentation habits, and prioritization recommendations, give effort estimates, and flag scheduling conflicts early.
An interest in games: you play EA titles across platforms and follow industry and tech news.
Exposure to digital advertising metrics (impressions, reach and frequency, viewability) or game telemetry data.
Familiar with cloud data warehouses (e.g., Snowflake, BigQuery, Redshift).


Pay Transparency - North America

Compensation And Benefits

The ranges listed below are what EA in good faith expects to pay applicants for this role in these locations at the time of this posting. If you reside in a different location, a recruiter will advise on the applicable range and benefits. Pay offered will be determined based on a number of relevant business and candidate factors (e.g. education, qualifications, certifications, experience, skills, geographic location, or business needs).

PAY RANGES


California (depending on location e.g. Los Angeles vs. San Francisco) *$98,200 - $155,200 USD
Washington (depending on location e.g. Seattle vs. Spokane) *$93,800 - $122,000 USD


Pay is just one part of the overall compensation at EA.

In the US, we offer a package of benefits including paid time off (3 weeks per year to start), 80 hours per year of sick time, 16 paid company holidays per year, 10 weeks paid time off to bond with baby, medical/dental/vision insurance, life insurance, disability insurance, and 401(k) to regular full-time employees. Certain roles may also be eligible for bonus and other incentive programs.

About Electronic Arts

We’re proud to have an extensive portfolio of games and experiences, locations around the world, and opportunities across EA. We value adaptability, resilience, creativity, and curiosity. From leadership that brings out your potential, to creating space for learning and experimenting, we empower you to do great work and pursue opportunities for growth.

We adopt a holistic approach to our benefits programs, emphasizing physical, emotional, financial, career, and community wellness to support a balanced life. Our packages are tailored to meet local needs and may include healthcare coverage, mental well-being support, retirement savings, paid time off, family leaves, complimentary games, and more. We nurture environments where our teams can always bring their best to what they do.

Electronic Arts is an equal opportunity employer. All employment decisions are made without regard to race, color, national origin, ancestry, sex, gender, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, age, genetic information, religion, disability, medical condition, pregnancy, marital status, family status, veteran status, or any other characteristic protected by law. We will also consider employment qualified applicants with criminal records in accordance with applicable law. EA also makes workplace accommodations for qualified individuals with disabilities as required by applicable law.

Title: Data Analyst Sr - Quality and Safety
Description:
Work Location: Downtown Seattle (Hybrid – 3 days/week on-site)

Supports the Hospital and Enterprise Analytics' vision, mission, and strategic initiatives by using technical expertise to design, create and develop analytical solutions and by providing internal consultation and project management. The incumbent provides leadership in the facilitating and gathering business requirements, and provides knowledge in business/clinical processes, analytical expertise, technical programming skills, and substantial leadership skills in working with key stakeholders, end users and project team members. This position identifies and resolves issues throughout the development of analytical solutions, and is accountable for identifying opportunities for continuous improvement in workflow processes in the implementation of these solutions. Primary responsibility is the design, creation and deployment of analytical solutions for Executive leadership and other key stakeholders within the SCH organization. The incumbent is responsible for frequently taking a formal or an informal lead on project tasks, and leads efforts to design and implement analytic solutions, including reports, dashboards, and views from a wide range of existing data sources, and provides leadership in evaluating and optimizing these solutions. The incumbent also assures integrity of the data for current and future use in strategic initiatives, continuous quality improvement efforts and hospital goals, and for insuring the sustainability and adaptability of all developed solutions.

Required Education And Experience

Bachelor's Degree in Health Science, Computer Science, Math, Business or related field, or equivalent combination of education and experience/technical training that demonstrates analytical and technical competency.

Minimum five (5) years experience in progressively more responsible work as a data analyst, developer or equivalent.

Experience in data extraction/integration/aggregation using SQL, R or python.

Expert in use of data visualization for non-technical audiences.

Experience with at least one notable BI reporting tool (e.g., Tableau, QlikView, PowerBI, Business Objects, html/d3).

Experience working with source control tools and version management.

Required Credentials

N/A.

Preferred

Experience working with senior and executive leaders.

Experience with EHR Data (Epic)

Quality and safety related experience.

Experience working as a data analyst within a healthcare setting.

Experience with clinical, hospital and/or financial applications and/or systems.

Experience as a member of a delivery team supporting integrated analytics products and solutions for a wide range of customer groups.

Uses reasonable and basic statistical analyses to make comparisons and detect trends, communicate insights.

Utilizes established data analysis models and tools for analyzing qualitative or quantitative data.

Compensation Range

$121,134.00 - $181,700.00 per year

Salary Information

This compensation range was calculated based on full-time employment (2080 hours worked per calendar year). Offers are determined by multiple factors including equity, skills, experience, and expertise, and may vary within the range provided.

Disclaimer for Out of State Applicants

This compensation range is specific to Seattle, positions located outside of Seattle may be compensated differently depending on various factors.

Benefits Information

Seattle Children’s offers a generous benefit package, including medical, dental, and vision plans, 403(b), life insurance, paid time off, tuition reimbursement, and more. Additional details on our benefits can be found on our website www.seattlechildrens.org/careers/benefits.

About Us

Hope. Care. Cure. These three simple words capture what we do at Seattle Children’s – to help every child live the healthiest and most fulfilling life possible. Are you ready to engage with a mission-driven organization that is life-changing to many, and touches the hearts of all? #HOPECARECURE

Our founding promise to the community is as valid today as it was over a century ago: we will care for all children in our region, regardless of the families’ ability to pay. Together, we deliver superior patient care, advance new discoveries and treatments through pediatric research, and serve as the pediatric and adolescent, academic medical center for Washington, Alaska, Montana and Idaho – the largest region of any children’s hospital in the country.

U.S. News & World Report consistently ranks Seattle Children’s among the nation’s best children’s hospitals. For more than a decade, Seattle Children’s has been nationally recognized in key specialty areas. We are honored to be one of the nation’s very best places to care for children and the top-ranked pediatric hospital in Washington and the Pacific Northwest.

As a Magnet designated institution, we recognize the importance of hiring and developing great talent to provide best-in-class care to the patients and families we serve. Our organizational DNA takes form in our core values: Compassion, Excellence, Integrity, Collaboration, Equity and Innovation. Whether it’s delivering frontline care to our patients in a kind and caring manner, practicing the highest standards of quality and safety, or being relentlessly curious as we work towards eradicating childhood diseases, these values are the fabric of our culture and community. The future starts here.

Our Commitment

Seattle Children’s welcomes people of all experiences, backgrounds, and thoughts as this is what drives our spirit of inquiry and allows us to better connect with our patients and families. Our organization recruits, employs, trains, compensates, and promotes based on merit without regard to race, religion, color, national origin, gender (including pregnancy, childbirth, or related medical conditions), sexual orientation, gender identity, gender expression, age, status as a protected veteran, status as an individual with a disability, or other applicable legally protected characteristics.

The people who work at Seattle Children’s are members of a community that seeks to respect and celebrate all the qualities that make each of us unique. Each of us is empowered to be ourselves.

Seattle Children’s is proud to be an Equal Opportunity Workplace and Affirmative Action Employer.

Title: Senior Data Analyst, Lives Covered
Description:
About Us

Grow was born to tackle a critical challenge: making mental health care more effective and accessible for everyone. Since launching in 2020, 15 million sessions have started on Grow, and we've barely scratched the surface. We do it through a three-sided marketplace that empowers providers, augments insurance payors, and serves patients. Every solution we build reveals ten more waiting to be delivered, and that's just what gets us going. We've backed that ambition with more than $328M in funding, including our Series D at a $3B valuation from Sequoia Capital, Transformation Capital, TCV, SignalFire, Menlo Ventures, Goldman Sachs Alternatives, and others.

At Grow, the work you do can literally change someone's life. Your work here doesn't stay on a screen; it impacts whether someone can find, afford, and access quality care. That ambition sets us apart, and offers you an endless runway to impact one of the world's most urgent issues. We don’t have passenger seats here. Everyone is driving something that matters.

This work deserves real commitment. So if you thrive on meeting problems head on, untangling serious complexity, and working at pace with the sharpest yet kindest people around, you've come to the right place.

The Opportunity

We are looking for a Sr. Data Analyst to help us drive data-driven insights and reporting in Product at Grow Therapy, and who will work on a variety of reporting, analytics and experimentation projects. You’ll join a broader data organization of analysts, data scientists, and data engineers, and be part of an Analytics team reporting into an Analytics Manager. This role will support our Lives Covered product group, focused on Billing & Payments features.

What You’ll Be Doing


Partner with Product and other technical stakeholders to prioritize analytical needs and support product launches, decision-making, and ad hoc requests through clear, data-driven insights.
Develop, maintain, and evolve core product and performance reporting, including business-critical dashboards built on scalable, reliable datasets.
Support experimentation and A/B testing through thoughtful design, execution, analysis, and clear, actionable conclusions.
Create compelling data visualizations and storytelling assets to effectively communicate insights to diverse audiences.
Collaborate with stakeholders on complex, high-impact analytical projects, including data modeling and OKR development.
Work closely with data scientists and data engineers to improve data availability, integrity, accuracy, reliability, and logging/pipeline quality.
Identify business-critical opportunities to improve claims collection and reduce billing friction.


You’ll Be a Good Fit If


You have 5+ years proven experience in using analytics to tackle business problems that cross multiple product/project areas and teams, ideally in a high-growth, fast-paced environment.
You have strong SQL skills and intermediate understanding of experimental design (such as A/B experiments).
You are a wizard at building business critical dashboards/data visualizations (ideally within Hex).
You have experience with data modeling (dbt) or are eager to learn.
You love data storytelling, creating a compelling narrative by extracting insights from data, and summarizing learnings / takeaways for executives.
You have prior experience analyzing healthcare data, particularly across the claims lifecycle and patient billing processes.
You enjoy communicating effectively and building relationships with both technical and non-technical stakeholders.
You deeply value the importance of expanding access to mental health care.


Full Time Employee Benefits


Health Benefits: Comprehensive medical, dental, vision, life, and disability coverage.
Grow for Grow: No cost access to therapy through the Grow platform (available to US employees)
Financial Wellness: Retirement savings programs and equity opportunities to help you invest in your future.
Flexible Time Off, Paid Holidays & Winter Break: Flexible time off, company paid holidays (which vary by country), and a full company wide Winter Break to rest and recharge
Parental Leave: Up to 18 weeks of paid parental leave to support you and your growing family and a new child stipend.
Mental Health Mornings/Afternoons: Dedicated weekly flexible time for self care, whether that's therapy, exercise, journaling, time with family, or simply taking a break.
Wellness & Development Stipend: Annual stipend to support your personal wellbeing and professional growth, from fitness and education to books and learning resources.
Commuter Benefits: Pre tax commuter benefits to support teammates working from one of our hub locations.
Home Office & Meals: Support for your home workspace plus meal benefits, with offerings tailored to both remote and hub based employees.
Additional Perks: A variety of wellbeing benefits, including wellness memberships, virtual care, pet insurance discounts (where available), and global travel assistance.


Research shows that some groups hesitate to apply unless they meet every qualification. If you’re excited about this role but don’t check every box, we encourage you to apply. At Grow, we value diverse experiences, transferable skills, and the unique strengths each person brings.

Grow Therapy is proud to be an equal opportunity workplace and is an affirmative action employer. We are committed to equal employment opportunity regardless of race, color, ancestry, religion, sex, national origin, sexual orientation, age, citizenship, marital status, disability, gender identity or Veteran status. We also consider qualified applicants regardless of criminal histories, consistent with legal requirements.

Use of AI Tools: We use certain AI and automated tools to support recruitment. These tools help our team review applications, organize interviews, detect potential application integrity issues, and maintain interview records; they do not make final hiring decisions.

Application Review: Ashby's AI-Assisted Application Review helps review application materials against role-specific criteria and may flag potential fraud or integrity issues for recruiter review. All advancement decisions are made by our human recruiting team after independent review. See Ashby's AI Bias Audit Report.

Interview Recording: We use BrightHire to record interviews, supporting note-taking and consistency across candidates. Learn more. Interviews are confidential; you may ask your interviewer to stop recording anytime, or opt out in advance. Choosing not to be recorded will not, by itself, affect your candidacy.

AI-Assisted Recruiter Screen: For select roles, BrightHire's AI features may help structure initial recruiter screens and organize interview notes. All responses are reviewed by our recruiting team; no hiring decisions are made by AI alone.

State-specific notices: Depending on your location, you may have additional rights. Illinois: If AI analyzes a video interview, we'll provide notice, explain how it works and what it evaluates, and obtain consent beforehand. New York City: Where required, we'll provide at least 10 business days’ notice before using an automated employment decision tool and explain how to request an alternative process. Maryland: We do not use facial recognition to create facial templates during interviews unless required notice and written consent are obtained.

Questions, accommodation requests, requests for an alternative selection process, objections to recording, or concerns about AI use? Contact talentops@growtherapy.com. We’re happy to help or offer an alternative way to participate.

Job Description

Data Analyst – RFQ, Proposal & Business Performance Analytics

________________________________________

Position Overview

We are seeking a detail-oriented and analytical Data Analyst to support customer’s Program Management and Business Development organization. This role will be responsible for tracking and analyzing the end-to-end opportunity pipeline from RFQ receipt through quote submission, negotiation, contract award, and program kickoff.

The analyst will transform business development, estimating, proposal, and program data into actionable insights that improve bid management, enhance forecasting accuracy, increase win rates, and provide leadership visibility into opportunity conversion performance.

The ideal candidate will have strong analytical skills, experience managing large datasets, and the ability to develop executive scorecards, dashboards, and business performance analytics.

Industry Experience


Bachelor’s degree in data Analytics, Statistics, Engineering, Business Analytics, Information Systems, or a related discipline, with 3–7 years of experience in data analytics, business intelligence, reporting, or performance analytics roles.
Proven experience working with large datasets and developing executive dashboards, scorecards, and business performance reports using tools such as Power BI, Tableau, Excel, and SQL.
Prior experience supporting Program Management, Business Development, Estimating, Proposal Management, Sales Operations, or RFQ-to-Award processes is highly desirable.
Preference will be given to candidates with experience in the aerospace, manufacturing, defense, or industrial sectors, including exposure to opportunity pipeline management, win-rate analysis, forecasting, and KPI framework development.
Strong analytical, communication, and stakeholder management skills, with the ability to transform complex business data into actionable insights and leadership-ready recommendations.


Key Responsibilities: Summary of Responsibilities & Skills


Track and manage the complete RFQ-to-Award lifecycle, including RFQ receipt, quote submission, negotiations, award decisions, and program handoff.
Collect, consolidate, validate, and maintain opportunity, proposal, and award data from multiple business systems.
Develop and maintain dashboards, scorecards, and reporting tools that provide visibility into pipeline health and business performance.
Analyze RFQ volumes, proposal activity, quote turnaround times, award rates, win/loss performance, and revenue opportunities.
Perform month-over-month, quarter-over-quarter, and year-over-year trend analysis to identify business growth patterns and performance gaps.
Generate actionable insights on customer activity, opportunity conversion rates, business segment performance, and program trends.
Create executive-level reports and visualizations using Power BI, Tableau, Excel, and PowerPoint for leadership reviews.
Monitor and report key performance indicators (KPIs) such as RFQs received, quotes submitted, proposals pending, awards won, pipeline value, and forecasted revenue.
Conduct comparative analysis across customers, product lines, business sectors, manufacturing sites, and program portfolios.
Support forecasting activities by providing visibility into near-term awards, future revenue potential, and business growth opportunities.
Collaborate closely with Program Management, Estimating, Sales, Engineering, and Business Development teams to improve data quality and reporting effectiveness.
Identify bottlenecks in the proposal and quotation process and recommend process improvements to enhance responsiveness and win rates.
Standardize KPI definitions, reporting methodologies, and dashboard formats to enable consistent reporting across the organization.
Drive continuous improvement through automation of reports, enhancement of analytics capabilities, and development of scalable business intelligence solutions.
Present data-driven insights and recommendations to management to support strategic decision-making and business growth initiatives.


Technical Skills


Strong proficiency in Excel (advanced), SQL, Power BI, Tableau, and PowerPoint for data analysis, dashboard development, executive reporting, and business performance monitoring.
Experience working with large, complex datasets, including data extraction, cleansing, transformation, validation, and trend analysis.
Ability to develop and maintain RFQ-to-Award dashboards, KPI scorecards, pipeline reports, and revenue forecasting models.
Strong analytical and problem-solving skills with the ability to identify trends, conversion drivers, business risks, and growth opportunities.
Experience performing win/loss analysis, opportunity pipeline tracking, proposal performance measurement, and business forecasting.
Effective data storytelling and executive communication skills, capable of translating complex data into actionable insights and leadership recommendations.
Strong stakeholder management and collaboration skills, with the ability to work across Program Management, Business Development, Estimating, Engineering, and Operations teams.
Continuous improvement mindset with experience standardizing reporting processes, automating analytics, improving data quality, and implementing scalable business intelligence solutions.

Description:
Job Description

Nordstrom is committed to being the leader in Omnichannel retailing. We have long recognized the importance of having strong capabilities in both Physical and Digital retailing and we continue to innovate on how we can help our customers Feel Good and Look Their Best.

The Data Analyst 3 is an individual contributor on the Merchandising Insights & Strategic Operations (MISO) team within Inventory. MISO sits at the center of how inventory moves through Nordstrom, supporting Merch Ops, Inbound Flow, RP, and Supplier Compliance. You'll build the analytics that help those teams see what's happening, spot problems early, and make faster, better calls on how product flows from suppliers to our stores and customers.

The work is a mix of keeping the core reporting reliable and modernizing it. Our teams are moving dashboards and data sources onto Looker and BigQuery, and replacing legacy tools and servers with newer platforms, so you'll help make sure the numbers people rely on carry over accurately and get easier to use. You'll also help bring practical AI into the day-to-day, whether that's speeding up analysis, automating repetitive workflows, or showing partners what's possible with tools like Claude.

A day in the life…


Build, maintain, and evolve Looker dashboards and self-service tools that Merch Ops, Inbound Flow, RP, and Supplier Compliance rely on to run the business
Partner with business stakeholders to understand their analytics needs, and turn open-ended questions into clear, reliable answers
Own the data models and BigQuery queries behind inventory reporting, with a focus on accuracy, scalability, and reuse
Build and maintain Python and Airflow pipelines that keep key data fresh, validated, and monitored
Support the move from legacy reporting and data sources to Looker, BigQuery, and newer platform tools, making sure numbers carry over accurately
Use AI-assisted tools like Claude Code and Claude Desktop to speed up analysis, automate repetitive workflows, and raise the quality of your output
Dig into ad hoc analysis to explain inventory, inbound, replenishment, and supplier trends, and present findings to business partners and leadership
Work with Data Engineering, Insights, and Technology teams on data dependencies and platform changes
Share what you learn with the team, help set standards for how we build and document analytics, and help others get more out of the tools


You own this if you have…


Degree in Finance, Statistics, Mathematics, Analytics, Computer Science, or related field required
4+ years of data analytics experience; demonstrated ability to deliver business-critical analytics independently and raise analytical standards across a team
Hands-on experience with AI-assisted development and productivity tools (e.g., Claude Code, Claude Desktop) to accelerate analysis, automate data workflows, and produce higher-quality output faster
Advanced SQL skills with hands-on BigQuery experience; strong understanding of data warehousing, dimensional modeling, and query construction
Demonstrated ability to build and maintain data pipelines and lightweight automation in Python, including validation, monitoring, and workflow scripts, with hands-on Airflow experience for scheduling and orchestration
Proficiency with at least one leading visualization tool (Looker preferred) and best practices for operational dashboarding
Strong operational business understanding, including the downstream effects of inventory flow, supplier performance, and replenishment decisions on cost and service
Supply chain expertise in retail or consumer goods preferred, with familiarity in inbound operations, inventory, replenishment, or supplier compliance
Strong written and verbal communication skills; comfortable presenting findings to business stakeholders and operational leadership

Pay offers are dependent on the location, as well as job-related knowledge, skills, and experience.

Medical/Vision, Dental, Retirement and Paid Time Away

Merchandise Discount and EAP Resources


This position may be eligible for performance-based incentives/bonuses. Benefits include 401k, medical/vision/dental/life/disability insurance options, PTO accruals, Holidays, and more. Work Mode: On-Site / Hybrid

Work Authorization

At this time, we are only able to consider candidates who are authorized to work in the United States without sponsorship.

Why This Role?

The grid is going digital — smart meters, renewables, and AMI data have made utilities one of the most data-hungry industries in America. Get in early on an analytics niche with huge demand and surprisingly little competition.

Job Summary

Aaratech Inc. is seeking a Data Analyst – Utilities & Energy to turn smart-meter, outage, asset, and customer data into insight. You will build reliability and load reporting, support demand forecasting and grid-modernization analytics, and deliver findings that improve operations and customer programs.

Key Responsibilities

Collect, clean, and analyze AMI/smart-meter, SCADA, outage, asset, and customer datasets using SQL and Python.
Design and maintain dashboards in Power BI or Tableau for load, reliability metrics (SAIDI/SAIFI/CAIDI), and asset performance.
Support demand forecasting, load research, and energy-efficiency/demand-response program analytics.
Analyze outage and asset-health data to support predictive maintenance and grid-modernization initiatives.
Prepare data for regulatory reporting and rate-case filings to public utility commissions.
Ensure data accuracy, consistency, and reporting quality across platforms.
Present analytical findings and recommendations to operations, planning, and regulatory stakeholders.

Qualifications

Bachelor's degree in Data Science, Computer Science, Information Technology, Business Analytics, or a related field.
2–4 years of experience as a Data Analyst, preferably in utilities, energy, or another asset-intensive industry.
Strong, hands-on SQL skills — complex joins, window functions, CTEs, and query optimization.
Proficiency with Power BI or Tableau, plus advanced Microsoft Excel (Power Query, pivot tables, advanced formulas).
Hands-on experience with operational, sensor/meter, time-series, or customer data at scale.
Strong analytical, data-storytelling, and stakeholder-communication skills.

Tools & Technologies You Will Use

Analytics & querying: SQL (Oracle, SQL Server, PostgreSQL), Python (pandas, NumPy) including time-series analysis.
BI & visualization: Power BI (DAX, Power Query), Tableau, Excel.
Utility data & systems: AMI/MDM platforms, SCADA/OT historians (OSIsoft PI exposure a plus), CIS/billing data.
Geospatial & cloud: Esri ArcGIS, Snowflake, Databricks, Azure or AWS data services.

Preferred Skills

Knowledge of energy markets, demand response, load forecasting, or renewable-integration concepts.
Familiarity with reliability metrics (SAIDI, SAIFI, CAIDI) and regulatory reporting.
Exposure to predictive maintenance or asset-analytics use cases.
Certifications such as Microsoft PL-300, Tableau Desktop Specialist, or Google Data Analytics Professional Certificate are a plus.

About Aaratech Inc.

Aaratech Inc. is a technology-driven organization delivering innovative solutions across cybersecurity, data & analytics, healthcare, and enterprise domains. We are committed to helping organizations transform data into actionable insights through advanced analytics, modern technologies, and data-driven innovation.

Title: Data Analyst II
Description:
Radar Reinvented.

Echodyne offers the world's first compact solid-state true beam-steering radar for a wide range of industries and applications. Our high-performance radars work in all weather and are designed for autonomous vehicles, uncrewed aircraft & drones, and security of borders, critical infrastructure, and smart cities. The company combines the patented technology of metamaterials with powerful software to create a radar sensor with unprecedented performance at commercial price points. Echodyne offers its radars to companies working in Automotive, Transportation, Critical Infrastructure Protection, Border Security, Smart Cities, Uncrewed Aircraft Systems (UAS), and Airspace Management including Urban Air Mobility (UTM).

Echodyne is seeking a Data Analyst II to join our fast-growing team.

ROLE OVERVIEW

In this role, you'll ingest, label, and analyze data collected from test activities and field deployments to evaluate Echodyne radar system performance. You'll be responsible for identifying potential issues, generating actionable insights in a timely manner, and collaborating with cross-functional teams to improve product performance and customer outcomes.

RESPONSIBILITIES


Clean, format, transform, and validate data collected from field tests and customer deployments. Ingest datasets into databases for analysis.
Label targets of opportunity to enhance datasets used for classification model development.
Apply statistical analysis and data science methodologies to evaluate and characterize radar system performance across key metrics. Identify anomalies, performance degradations, and areas of concern.
Generate clear, well-structured written reports and visualizations summarizing analytical findings for both internal and external consumption.
Present analysis reports to stakeholders, decision makers, and other interested parties.
Assist in developing and maintaining Python-based data processing and analysis pipelines to improve automation and scalability.
Support root cause investigations by analyzing datasets to diagnose system-level and algorithmic issues.
Assist in maintaining machine learning models for target classification.


REQUIRED SKILLS / EXPERIENCE


Strong written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to understand analysis requirements and clearly communicate conclusions to technical and non-technical audiences.
Demonstrated technical writing and data visualization skills, with the ability to present complex findings in an interpretable and actionable manner.
Solid background in statistics and experience analyzing structured and unstructured datasets.
Proficiency in Python and SQL, including experience with data processing, analysis, and visualization libraries and tools.
Strong spatial reasoning skills and the ability to work with multidimensional data, including 3D geometry concepts (vectors, rotations, coordinate transformations).


Desired Skills / Experience

(Looking for one or more as a complement to the core skills)


Proficiency in Linux environments.
Demonstrated ability to quickly learn new tools, technologies, and domain concepts.
Familiarity with sensor systems (e.g. camera, lidar, radar, scientific instruments), signal processing, state estimation, and machine learning techniques.


QUALIFICATIONS


BS with 3+ years' work experience, MS, or PhD in statistics, math, data science, engineering, or physics.
U.S. citizen. This role may require handling export controlled (ITAR, EAR) data.


Echodyne's technology is export controlled by the U.S. Government and we must evaluate an applicant's eligibility to handle export-controlled information or obtain required Government authorizations.  Therefore, we will ask you as part of the application process to identify whether you are a U.S. Citizen or green card holder, or have asylum/refugee status in the U.S.

Amazon is seeking an exemplary (Senior) Business Analyst with broad technical skills to develop in-depth business understanding, perform deep-dives, develop data visualizations and build automation solutions that drive business decision making and process improvement. This role will directly be responsible for maintaining front end code using Python, SQL and/or other similar coding languages. Proficiency in the aforementioned languages is not required, but an ability to be a quick learner and gain proficiency is required for a successfully candidate. This role will have high level visibility due to the nature of the toolsets being maintained, built, and the network impact of analysis conducted. This role has great exposure to a broad scope that can really help shape the future of operational fulfillment and promotes career progression.

Use quantitative analysis and the presentation of data to see beyond the numbers and understand what drives our business
Work with large and complex data sets to solve a wide array of challenging problems using different data management tools and analytical approaches
Partner with Product, Program, Engineering, and cross-functional teams to understand data requirements and design scalable and user-friendly BI solutions influencing product and program strategy

Description:
Description

DSHS DVR Management Analyst 4- Performance Analyst

Division of Vocational Rehabilitation (DVR) has an exciting opportunity for a Performance Analyst also known as a Management Analyst to join our team. In this role, you'll support the division’s ongoing commitment to data-driven decision-making, continuous improvement, and modernization. Reporting to the Performance & Evaluation Analyst, this position serves as a senior-level resource for analyzing complex data, improving business processes, and developing meaningful insights that support DVR staff, management, leadership, and stakeholders.

As a Performance Analyst, you’ll be the go-to expert for turning complex data into clear, actionable information. You’ll develop and maintain reports, dashboards, and business intelligence solutions using tools such as Power BI, while supporting data mapping, visualization, and enterprise analytics initiatives. You’ll track issues, research solutions for staff inquirie, identify opportunities to improve data usability and service delivery, and provide recommendations that help DVR make informed operational and strategic decisions. This role offers the opportunity to work across programs and with diverse stakeholders to improve processes, evaluate the impact of changes, and ensure data is accurate, accessible, and meaningful. Every project brings a new opportunity to solve problems, uncover insights, and help modernize the way DVR uses data to serve its customers.

Please Note

This opportunity is primarily teleworking with one in-office day a week.

Some Of What You'll Do


Collects, organizes, and validates performance data used to measure program results and support management reporting.
Creates reports, presentations, and data visualizations that make complex information easier to understand for different audiences.
Reviews and cleans data from case management and other systems to ensure information is accurate and ready for reporting.
Develops and documents clear procedures and workflows to ensure data is collected consistently, accurately, and on time.
Reviews reports and performance data to identify trends, errors, gaps, and areas that may need additional review.
Builds strong working relationships with subject matter experts, managers, and Executive Leadership to support ongoing performance reporting.
Analyzes data to identify trends, challenges, and opportunities for improvement and provides recommendations to support program performance and strategic planning.
Monitors data and system use and recommends ways to improve data accuracy, validation, staff engagement, and alignment with division goals.
Supports Quality Assurance and Compliance teams with data and process improvement related to audits, corrective action plans, and strategic planning activities.
Facilitates workgroups to collect and analyze information, identify current and future needs, and support strategic and state planning.
Conducts special or ad hoc data analyses as requested by the Planning and Evaluation Analyst.
Provides guidance to staff across the division on how to interpret data and determine which information best demonstrates progress toward program goals.
Participates in and facilitates internal and external workgroups focused on process improvement, data analysis, reporting requirements, and system testing.
Collaborates with DVR staff and partner agencies to provide expert guidance on performance management, data interpretation, reporting, and data-driven decision-making.


Who should apply? We are looking for professionals with:

A bachelor’s degree* in business administration, public administration, law, public health, health administration, or a related field.

AND

Four years of experience** conducting research, evaluating performance, and analyzing policies, laws, rules, or regulations.


Relevant experience may be substituted, year for year, for required education.
Relevant graduate education may be substituted, year for year, for the required experience.


Additional skills, knowledge and abilities that we are looking for:


Ability to conduct a variety of methods for data analysis.
Ability to collect, analyze and interpret data from a variety of sources, and to differentiate meaningful data from non-significant or irrelevant data.
Knowledge and use of MS Office products and Adobe Pro.
Expertise in Excel, data visualization tools Power BI or Tableau, and familiarity with statistical analysis applications such as SQL, Python or R.
Ability to produce accurate written reports and other work products that are understandable and useful to others who are not proficient in statistical methods including data visualization.
Ability work collaboratively with stakeholders, staff, and others.
Excellent interpersonal skills.
Ability to learn and apply new technical skills.
Ability to apply Lean practices and methodologies, and other models of continuous quality improvement.
Strong organizational skills with proven ability to manage multiple tasks concurrently.
This position's specialty and expertise are in the use of performance management and quality assurance methods, analytical tools, enterprise performance management principles, and measures and practices to support the division’s overall performance on an ongoing basis.

Read About Our Benefits

The following information describes typical benefits available for full-time employees who are expected to work more than six months. Employees and their families are covered by medical (including vision), dental and basic life insurance. There are multiple medical plans with affordable monthly premiums that offer coverage throughout the state.

Part-time employees who are in pay status during the month of the holiday qualify for the holiday on a pro-rata basis. Compensation for holidays (including personal holiday) will be proportionate to the number of hours in pay status in the month to that required for full-time employment, excluding all holiday hours. Pay status includes hours worked and time on paid leave.

Sick Leave

Full-time employees earn eight hours of sick leave per month. Overtime eligible employees who are in pay status for less than 80 hours per month, earn a monthly proportionate to the number of hours in pay status, in the month to that required for full-time employment. Part-time employees accrue vacation leave hours in accordance with WAC 357-31-165(1) or the applicable collective bargaining agreement (CBA) on a pro rata basis. Vacation leave accrual will be proportionate to the number of hours in pay status, in the month to that required for full-time employment.

Pay status includes hours worked, time on paid leave and paid holiday.

As provided in WAC 357-58-175, an employer may authorize a lump-sum accrual of vacation leave or accelerate the vacation leave accrual rate to support the recruitment and/or retention of a candidate or employee for a Washington Management Service position. Vacation leave accrual rates may only be accelerated using the rates established WAC 357-31-165.

DSHS DVR Management Analyst 4- Performance Analyst

Division of Vocational Rehabilitation (DVR) has an exciting opportunity for a Performance Analyst also known as a Management Analyst to join our team. In this role, you'll support the division’s ongoing commitment to data-driven decision-making, continuous improvement, and modernization. Reporting to the Performance & Evaluation Analyst, this position serves as a senior-level resource for analyzing complex data, improving business processes, and developing meaningful insights that support DVR staff, management, leadership, and stakeholders.

As a Performance Analyst, you’ll be the go-to expert for turning complex data into clear, actionable information. You’ll develop and maintain reports, dashboards, and business intelligence solutions using tools such as Power BI, while supporting data mapping, visualization, and enterprise analytics initiatives. You’ll track issues, research solutions for staff inquirie, identify opportunities to improve data usability and service delivery, and provide recommendations that help DVR make informed operational and strategic decisions. This role offers the opportunity to work across programs and with diverse stakeholders to improve processes, evaluate the impact of changes, and ensure data is accurate, accessible, and meaningful. Every project brings a new opportunity to solve problems, uncover insights, and help modernize the way DVR uses data to serve its customers.

Please Note

This opportunity is primarily teleworking with one in-office day a week.

Some Of What You'll Do


Collects, organizes, and validates performance data used to measure program results and support management reporting.
Creates reports, presentations, and data visualizations that make complex information easier to understand for different audiences.
Reviews and cleans data from case management and other systems to ensure information is accurate and ready for reporting.
Develops and documents clear procedures and workflows to ensure data is collected consistently, accurately, and on time.

Collaborates with DVR staff and partner agencies to provide expert guidance on performance management, data interpretation, reporting, and data-driven decision-making.

Title: Data Analyst - IT
Description:
Amity Foundation, an internationally acclaimed Teaching, and Therapeutic Community is seeking compassionate and enthusiastic individuals with a desire to teach, learn and join our community as a Data Analyst (IT). This groundbreaking opportunity will allow you to work with our prison and re-entry programs helping the community and will also enhance your training and experience in the field. About Amity: Amity Foundation is a safe place where people can change in an environment that fosters trust; where new values can be formed; responsibility developed, and lasting relationships built. Amity is dedicated to the inclusion and habilitation of people marginalized by addiction, homelessness, trauma, criminality, incarceration, poverty, racism, sexism, and violence. Amity is committed to research, development implementation, and dissemination of information regarding community building. Remembrance, Resolution, Reconciliation, Restoration, Renewal Job Summary About the Position: As a Data Analyst, you will be responsible for the efficient extraction, transformation, and loading (ETL) of data from various sources, creating and maintaining documentation of all data sources, and developing insightful data visualizations using business intelligence tools such as Power Bi. Your role is essential in ensuring that data is accurate, accessible, and actionable for informed decision-making for all key stakeholders. About The Position

Essential Duties


ETL (Extract, Transform, Load):
Design and implement ETL processes to extract data from diverse sources, transform it into a usable format, and load it into databases or data warehouses.
Collaborate with data engineers to optimize ETL pipelines for scalability, reliability, and performance.
Monitor and troubleshoot ETL processes to ensure data quality and consistency.
Automate ETL workflows to streamline data integration and reduce manual intervention.
Data Visualizations:
Create interactive and visually appealing dashboards, reports, and data visualizations using Power BI, or other relevant software.
Connect Power BI to various data sources, including databases, APIs, and online services.
Transform raw data into meaningful insights, trends, and actionable information.
Collaborate with stakeholders to understand their reporting needs and provide tailored Power BI
Data Governance:
Implement and enforce data governance practices, including data quality standards, data lineage, and metadata management.
Ensure compliance with data security and privacy regulations, including access controls and encryption.
Establish data retention policies and manage data archiving and purging processes.
Provide data-driven strategies that enhance operational efficiency and drive improvements.
Documentation and Training:
Document ETL processes, API endpoints, and Power BI reports for knowledge sharing and troubleshooting.
Collaborate with department Data Manager to provide training and support to end-users and stakeholders on data access, API usage, and Power BI reporting.
Continuous Learning and Innovation:
Stay updated with the latest industry trends, tools, and techniques in data analysis and visualization.
Identify opportunities for process improvement and automation to enhance data analysis efficiency.
Performs other related duties as assigned.

Required

Education and Experience:


2-5 years experience or related work and/or Bachelor’s degree in a technical or other applicable discipline.
Proven experience as a Data Analyst or similar role, with a track record of successfully delivering data-driven insights.
Proven experience in data visualization tools such as Tableau, Power BI, or similar (non-Excel) software.
Proven experience in ETL development, including proficiency with ETL tools (e.g., Apache NiFi, Python)
Understanding of data governance principles, data security, and compliance regulations.
Strong problem-solving skills and attention to detail.
Excellent communication and collaboration skills to work with cross-functional teams and stakeholders.
Ability to adapt to evolving data technologies and industry best practices.


Preferred


Programming skills, including knowledge of scripting languages (e.g., Python, PowerShell) for automation.
Expertise in API development and management, with knowledge of RESTful API design principles.
Demonstrated experience with one or more of the following modern data management concepts - data lakes, nonrelational databases (NoSQL), cloud hosting (AWS), serverless storage or automated database recovery
Project management.


Certifications Or Licenses


Required: None
Preferred: None


ADA Information

Physical Requirements:


Occasionally adjusts or moves objects up to 50lbs. in all directions.
Constantly remains in a stationary position often standing or sitting for prolonged periods.
Repeats motions that may include the wrists, hands and / or fingers.
Constantly moves from one work yard to another daily.
Frequently walks on hard or uneven surfaces.
Required to communicate verbally and in written form.
Uses all types of vision, such as close vision, distance vision, color vision, peripheral vision, and depth perception, to complete daily tasks.

Occasionally required to climb, bend, stretch, reach, or stoop.
Required to wear comfortable and location appropriate clothing and shoes.


Mental Demands


Ability to change directions as a priorities shift.
Ability to thrive in environment that require the ability to adapt to changing circumstances,
Ability to cope with occasionally difficult or temperamental students and faculty.
Ability to cope with mental and emotional stress related to the position.


Work Conditions


Generally, in an indoor setting.
Occasionally works in outdoor elements such as precipitation, snow, and wind.
Work is in an incarcerated setting.


Environmental Conditions


The noise level in the work environment is usually moderate but can be loud.
The temperature in the work environment is generally moderate, however can range from hot to cold seasonally.
Seldom may be exposed to non-lethal chemical agents as administered in necessary use of force security instances.


Travel


Occasionally travels locally and operates motor vehicles.

This role will require you to invent new ways of looking at the many dimensions of our business. This individual will collaborate effectively with internal end-users and cross-functional data teams to solve problems, implement new reporting solutions, and deliver successfully against high standards. A successful individual is a person that has a proven work ethic that drives the desired results. This is a hands-on position - the ideal candidate must be willing to “roll up the sleeves”.

This position will work with several stakeholders supporting the extended AWS Global Sales organization including Business Development, Marketing, Professional Services, Enterprise Support, Training and Certification and the Partner team. The individual must have the ability to communicate effectively across multiple technical and non-technical business units, as well as across other geographies. This role will focus on developing analytics around WW Mechanisms for Sales, Ops, and Leadership audiences.

Key job responsibilities

Include, But Are Not Limited To

Support data analytics activities to develop actionable insights on pipeline, usage, and revenue data

Develop new ways to define and measure programs effectiveness and organizational productivity

Define the key sales support systems/processes required to meet the rapid growth of the business and achieve revenue attainment and market development objectives

Develop relationships and processes with sales, support, partner, finance, HR, sales operations, and other stakeholders to identify and address reporting requirements and develop new business insights

Identify data issues, gaps in processes, and drive timely resolution

Support ad hoc analysis & participate on projects as needed

Be an expert in AI & analytics tools required to support the team

About The Team

IDEAS — Insights, Data Engineering, Econometrics, Analytics & Science — is the organization within AWS SMGS Ops responsible for turning data into insight for the AWS Sales and Marketing business. The team builds and operates the data infrastructure, analytics, and data science capabilities that help leaders across AWS understand their business, make better decisions, and serve customers more effectively at global scale.

We build with both native AWS technology — including state-of-the-art Generative AI — and industry-standard products, pairing the best of each to move faster, work smarter, and continually raise the bar on what our data and insights can do.

It is a collaborative, intellectually curious, and fast-moving group that partners closely with stakeholders across the company. As Analytics & Insights Lead you will be a trusted member of this team — helping leaders drive performance and improve rhythm of business by supporting WW mechanisms through actionable insights. Experience in working with high volume and velocity of data in partnership with engineering, data science and business stakeholders will help you partner effectively with the leaders and teams you serve.

About AWS

Diverse Experiences

AWS values diverse experiences. Even if you do not meet all of the qualifications and skills listed in the job description, we encourage candidates to apply. Why AWS?

Amazon Web Services (AWS) is the world’s most comprehensive and broadly adopted cloud platform. We’re continuously raising our performance bar as we strive to become Earth’s Best Employer. That’s why you’ll find endless knowledge-sharing, mentorship and other career-advancing resources here to help you develop into a better-rounded professional.

Work/Life Balance

We value work-life harmony. Achieving success at work should never come at the expense of sacrifices at home, which is why we strive for flexibility as part of our working culture. When we feel supported in the workplace and at home, there’s nothing we can’t achieve in the cloud.

AWS Support also partners with a global list of customers that are building mission-critical applications on top of AWS services.

5+ years of SQL experience
5+ years of as a Data Analyst, Data Engineer, Business Intelligence Analyst, or a related occupation experience
Bachelor's degree or foreign equivalent in Computer Science, Engineering, Mathematics, Statistics, Economics, or a related field
Experience with AWS technologies
Experience in scripting for automation (e.g. Python) and advanced SQL skills.


Preferred Qualifications


Experience working directly with business stakeholders to translate between data and business needs
Experience managing, analyzing and communicating results to senior leadership
Experience with AI/ML technologies

Description:
Alaska Marine Lines is seeking a Business Data Analyst who enjoys solving problems, exploring data, and finding better ways to work. In this role, you’ll combine analytics, process improvement, and technology to help our teams make informed decisions and turn everyday challenges into measurable results.

What You’ll Do


Understand the business: Meet with employees and managers, observe workflows, and identify inefficiencies, bottlenecks, and opportunities for improvement.
Turn challenges into plans: Gather business requirements, document current and proposed processes, and guide discussions to evaluate options and recommend practical solutions.
Make data useful: Analyze operational and business data to uncover trends, investigate exceptions, and identify opportunities. Develop reports, dashboards, and scorecards that support decision-making.
Build better tools: Design, test, implement, and maintain automated workflows, reports, notifications, and other solutions that improve efficiency, accuracy, and visibility.
Connect people and technology: Collaborate with Information Technology, Business Intelligence, and business teams to ensure solutions meet operational needs and improve data quality and accessibility.
Help projects move forward: Coordinate improvement initiatives from discovery through implementation, track milestones and risks, and keep stakeholders informed.
Support lasting change: Develop documentation, provide training, support user testing and adoption, and measure whether improvements deliver the intended results.


What You Bring

You’re analytical, organized, and comfortable asking questions, learning new systems, and explaining technical information in everyday language.


Relevant experience in business analysis, operations, logistics, reporting, process improvement, or analytics.
Strong Excel skills; experience with Power BI, Tableau, Microsoft Fabric, Power Automate, SQL, or Python is a plus.
The ability to build relationships, manage competing priorities, and follow through on projects independently and collaboratively.
A related bachelor’s degree is preferred; an equivalent combination of education and experience is welcome.

Health Insurance - medical, dental, and vision with low employee contributions
Health Insurance for your family – we also contribute to medical, dental and vision for your family
Paid Time off – start with 17 days paid time off a year (PTO) + additional extended leave paid time

401(k) with company match + additional annual retirement contribution
Health and Wellness Program - FitOn
Tuition Reimbursement
Employee Assistance Program
Life Insurance and AD&D – we pay for at no cost to you
Long term disability – we pay for at no cost to you
Opportunities for internal promotions/career advancement
Family friendly work hours (closed on weekends and paid holidays)
Discretionary Bonus Program
Competitive wages with annual performance and wage reviews

Our extensive learning programs and mentorship opportunities help us create a culture of curiosity that pushes us to always find new solutions and better ways of doing things. The combination of a rapidly evolving industry and our high ambitions means there’s going to be some ambiguity along the way, but we excel when we challenge ourselves. We’re willing to take risks, fail fast, and do it all over again in the pursuit of excellence.

If you have a good attitude and are willing to roll up your sleeves to get things done, PitchBook is the place for you.

About The Role

The Revenue Operations team sits at the center of PitchBook’s go-to-market engine, translating data into the insights that power strategic decisions across Sales, Marketing, Customer Success, and Finance. We are a collaborative, detail-oriented team that takes ownership of the full analytical lifecycle, from raw data to executive dashboards, and we hold ourselves to a high standard of rigor and clarity. If you care deeply about getting the numbers right and communicating them well, you will fit right in.

The Revenue Operations Analyst, Analytics & Insights, owns performance reporting, business review cadences, and funnel and lifecycle analytics across PitchBook's go-to-market organization. This role partners closely with Sales, Marketing, Customer Success, and Finance to translate data into meaningful insights that inform strategy and accelerate business growth. The ideal candidate is an intellectually curious, insights-driven analyst who enjoys asking questions, challenging assumptions, and uncovering opportunities within complex datasets. Bringing strong SQL skills, experience working with large datasets, and an enthusiasm for leveraging AI and automation to enhance analytics and decision-making.

Primary Job Responsibilities


Significant experience writing SQL queries to connect and clean large datasets, define KPIs, and provide leadership with accurate data to make informed decisions
Own weekly and monthly sales performance reporting covering pipeline, attainment, and pacing; run and maintain the WBR/MBR/QBR process end-to-end, including narrative framing and exec-ready dashboards
Build and maintain executive OKR and revenue dashboards across the full GTM funnel and post-sale lifecycle, ensuring consistent KPI definitions and reporting standards
Conduct marketing funnel analytics, campaign ROI measurement, lead routing and distribution analysis, and territory design and capacity planning analytics across global offices
Partner with Customer Success on customer lifecycle, retention, and expansion analytics; build and interpret reporting from Salesforce, Marketo, and Gong to surface clear, actionable insights
Facilitate the forecasting process across Sales, Marketing, Customer Success, and Finance, owning cadence, inputs, scenario reviews, and translation into the business narrative
Proactively generate insights indexed to business impact, surfacing what the business should be asking before it thinks to ask
Validate hypotheses raised by operational, field, or finance leaders, delivering rigorous analysis that confirms, challenges, or reframes the original question
Champion data quality, governance, and KPI consistency across revenue systems; identify opportunities for automation and advanced analytics in partnership with data science counterparts
Collaborate cross-functionally with RevOps, GTM Operations, Marketing Ops, and business stakeholders to align analytics work to commercial priorities
Support the vision and values of the company through role modeling and encouraging desired behaviors
Participate in various company initiatives and projects as requested


Basic Qualifications


3+ years of experience in revenue operations, sales operations, marketing operations, or finance operations
2+ years of hands-on experience writing SQL to query and analyze large datasets (Snowflake, BigQuery, or similar)
1+ year of hands-on experience building dashboards and data visualizations in Tableau/PowerBI/Looker
Must be authorized to work in the United States without the need for visa sponsorship now or in the future


Preferred Qualifications


Knowledge of Python (e.g., pandas) for data analysis, automation, or advanced analytics
Solid understanding of B2B GTM and revenue metrics including pipeline health, funnel conversion, retention, expansion, and forecasting; familiarity with Salesforce reporting required, experience with Marketo or Gong is a plus
Demonstrated ability to build intuitive dashboards and compelling visualizations that help business leaders understand performance, identify opportunities, and make confident, data-driven decisions across a variety of analytics platforms
Strong command of SQL and hands-on experience querying large datasets in modern data platforms (e.g., Snowflake, BigQuery); comfort navigating messy, high-volume data is essential
Clear, confident communicator who can translate complex data into plain language for senior stakeholders, with strong cross-functional instincts and comfort working across Sales, Marketing, Customer Success, Finance, and technical teams
Familiarity with Salesforce
Genuine curiosity about AI-assisted analytics and intelligent automation, and willingness to actively adopt emerging tools


Benefits + Compensation at PitchBook:

Physical Health


Comprehensive health benefits
Additional medical wellness incentives
STD, LTD, AD&D, and life insurance


Emotional Health


Paid sabbatical program after four years
Paid family and paternity leave
Annual educational stipend
Ability to apply for tuition reimbursement
CFA exam stipend
Robust training programs on industry and soft skills
Employee assistance program
Generous allotment of vacation days, sick days, and volunteer days


Social Health


Matching gifts program
Employee resource groups
Subsidized emergency childcare
Dependent Care FSA
Company-wide events
Employee referral bonus program
Quarterly team building events


Financial Health


401k match
Shared ownership employee stock program
Monthly transportation stipend
Please be aware the above PitchBook benefit and perk offerings are subject to corresponding plan and policy documents and may change during the course of your employment.


Compensation


Annual base salary: $115,000-$130,000
Target annual bonus percentage: 10%


Working Conditions

At the heart of our company is a belief in the power of in-person collaboration. Being together in the office fuels our creativity, strengthens our connections, and drives the innovation that sets us apart. Our culture is built on spontaneous moments—those hallway conversations, whiteboard brainstorms, and shared celebrations in each of our global offices—that simply can’t be replicated remotely. This role is expected to be in the office 5 days a week.

The job conditions for this position are in a standard office setting. Employees in this position use PC and phone on an on-going basis throughout the day. Limited corporate travel may be required to remote offices or other business meetings and events.

We are excited to get to know you and your background. Concerned that you might not meet every requirement? We encourage you to still apply as you might be the right candidate for the role or other roles at PitchBook.

Title: Business Analyst (Customer Success)
Description:
SpaceX was founded under the belief that a future where humanity is out exploring the stars is fundamentally more exciting than one where we are not. Today SpaceX is actively developing the technologies to make this possible, with the ultimate goal of enabling human life on Mars.

BUSINESS ANALYST (CUSTOMER SUCCESS)

Starlink, our revolutionary satellite constellation, delivers low-latency broadband internet worldwide, connecting consumers in remote and underserved areas. This role will focus on consumer metrics and insights, conducting research and reporting to support data-driven decisions that accelerate subscriber growth and enhance user value. Our ideal candidate is a proactive analyst with a blend of quantitative skills and curiosity for market dynamics, capable of turning complex data into actionable strategies for consumer retention.

Responsibilities


Perform in-depth analyses of consumer metrics, including Lifetime Value (LTV), Customer Acquisition Cost (CAC), churn rates, and cohort performance, using SQL queries and statistical methods to uncover trends and opportunities
Develop forecasting models for subscriber growth, revenue projections, and market penetration, incorporating external factors like competitive landscapes and economic indicators
Create and maintain reporting dashboards and visualizations (e.g., using Tableau, Power BI, or Looker) to track key performance indicators (KPIs) for consumer acquisition, retention, and engagement
Conduct market research and price analysis, evaluating elasticity, competitive pricing, and promotional impacts to recommend optimizations that drive revenue and affordability
Collaborate cross-functionally with marketing, product, and sales teams to integrate insights into growth strategies, including A/B testing support and scenario planning
Identify data gaps and work with engineering teams to improve data collection for consumer use cases, ensuring robust datasets for ongoing analysis
Deliver presentations and reports to stakeholders, translating technical findings into clear, business-oriented recommendations that influence decision-making
Support ad-hoc research projects, such as regional market assessments or emerging trends in broadband adoption, blending qualitative insights with quantitative rigor


Basic Qualifications


Bachelor's degree
2+ years of professional experience in business analytics, consulting, market research, or growth operations
1+ years of experience with SQL and creating/managing dashboards using data visualization tools (e.g. Tableau, Power BI, Looker)


Preferred Skills And Experience


Bachelor's degree in business, economics, statistics, computer science, or a related quantitative field
Advanced SQL skills, including complex joins, window functions, and query optimization
Experience with forecasting, financial metrics (e.g., LTV, CAC), or pricing analysis
Proficiency in statistical modeling and forecasting techniques (e.g., time-series analysis, regression in Python or R)
Experience with ETL processes, data pipelines, or automation scripting (e.g., Python, VBA)
Background in high-growth consumer tech environments, startups, or consulting firms with a focus on customer acquisition and retention
Strong research skills, including familiarity with market intelligence tools (e.g., surveys, competitive analysis platforms)
Excellent communication abilities, with a track record of presenting insights to non-technical audiences and influencing cross-functional teams
Project management experience, including prioritizing tasks in fast-paced settings and collaborating with diverse stakeholders


Additional Requirements


Position may involve extended hours and weekend work as needed
This position may require travel between various SpaceX sites


COMPENSATION AND BENEFITS:

Pay Range

Level 1: $85,000.00 - $115,000.00

Level 2: $100,000.00 - $140,000.00

Your actual level and base salary will be determined on a case-by-case basis and may vary based on the following considerations: job-related knowledge and skills, education, and experience.

Base salary is just one part of your total rewards package at SpaceX. You may also be eligible for long-term incentives, in the form of company stock or long-term cash awards, as well as potential discretionary bonuses and the ability to purchase additional stock at a discount through an Employee Stock Purchase Plan. You will also receive access to comprehensive medical, vision, and dental coverage, access to a 401(k) retirement plan, short and long-term disability insurance, life insurance, paid parental leave, and various other discounts and perks. You may also accrue 3 weeks of paid vacation and will be eligible for 10 or more paid holidays per year. Employees in Washington State accrue paid sick time in compliance with state and federal law. Company shuttles are offered to employees for roundtrip travel from select Seattle locations to the SpaceX Redmond office Monday to Friday.

Itar Requirements


To conform to U.S. Government export regulations, applicant must be a (i) U.S. citizen or national, (ii) U.S. lawful, permanent resident (aka green card holder), (iii) Refugee under 8 U.S.C.
1157, or (iv) Asylee under 8 U.S.C.
1158, or be eligible to obtain the required authorizations from the U.S. Department of State. Learn more about the ITAR here.


SpaceX is an Equal Opportunity Employer; employment with SpaceX is governed on the basis of merit, competence and qualifications and will not be influenced in any manner by race, color, religion, gender, national origin/ethnicity, veteran status, disability status, age, sexual orientation, gender identity, marital status, mental or physical disability or any other legally protected status.

Title: Program Data Analyst
Description:
Tesla Laboratories is a Service-Disabled Veteran Owned Small Business (SDVOSB) providing Cyber Security, Intelligence Analysis, Financial Management, Facilities Engineering Services, and Program Management support to the Intelligence Community (IC), the Department of Defense (DoD), and other federal government customers. We take pride in fostering a culture that values family, professional growth, and long-term career development—setting us apart from other services companies.

Requirements

Tesla Laboratories is seeking a Program/Data Analyst to support Design Technical Support (DTS) services for the Naval Facilities Engineering Systems Command Northwest (NAVFAC NW), Planning Design and Construction Directorate, Design Division (PDC4). This position supports the existing NAVFAC workforce and provides increased capability for Design-Bid-Build and Design-Build projects and associated efforts undertaken by NAVFAC Northwest customers within the NAVFAC Northwest Area of Responsibility (Puget Sound area).

Perform program/data analysis tasks, including:


Data analytics related to tracking Key Performance Indicators (KPIs)
Tracking financial metrics of success for construction and engineering-related projects
Budget tracking and execution metric presentation


In addition, the Program/Data Analyst will:


Coordinate with team members to execute project scope, create/manage schedules, and track/brief budget execution in conformance with project and customer requirements
Create project technical dashboard reports via Microsoft software (Power BI, Project, Excel, etc.)
Facilitate the minimization of project delays by providing technical reviews and recommendations within predetermined timeframes
Research codes, guidance, policies, procedures, processes, criteria, and federal laws/regulations, and provide sound technical recommendations both verbally and in writing
Apply innovative technical principles, practices, and theories to the resolution of technical issues
Coordinate with the Government client, NAVFAC team members, leadership, project stakeholders, and various regulatory agencies
Coordinate and facilitate meetings, make recommendations based on project requirements, coordinate workflow processes, schedule/coordinate Plans of Action and Milestones (POAMs), and effectively communicate findings to project personnel; provide written minutes for all meetings
Review technical reports, RFIs, designs, design changes (design-build and design-bid-build), project deliverables, submittals, and cost proposals from contractors to ensure compliance with customer and RFP requirements
Provide technical support for review of the commissioning plan, design and construction submittals, and field inspections
Provide technical support for construction field activities
Provide a summary of accomplishments during weekly meetings and in a prepared monthly status report
Provide weekly reports documenting technical engineering support and quality assurance on each assigned project, including status, issues, costs, schedule, and findings/observations/recommendations/data collected
Prepare reports, Requests for Proposals, and/or scopes of work in the required format, including applicable attachments, and participate in briefings/conferences
Prepare and deliver briefs supported by necessary project documentation to project team members, base personnel, and senior management
Ensure timely submission of submittals, reviews, and recommendations


Minimum of 5 years of financial management experience in a field related to the tasks described above.

Benefits

Tesla Laboratories offers a comprehensive benefits package designed to support the well-being and long-term success of our employees, including:

Competitive compensation

Health, dental, and vision insurance

Retirement plan with company contribution

Paid time off and federal holidays

Professional development and training opportunities

Supportive, family-focused company culture

Opportunities for long-term career growth within a growing SDVOSB
