Title: WW Content Strat. & Analytics, Prime Video Licensing, Analytics, Operations, and Strategy (LASO)
Description:
Description

Prime Video is seeking a creative, savvy and analytically-minded digital content executive to join the content acquisition team as a Content Insight Analyst. This Analyst will perform quantitative and qualitative analyses in support of our SVOD, TVOD, AVOD content licensing activities with major studios and major TV network groups for Prime Video and Prime Video Direct in US and in international locales. The ideal candidate will be a critical thinker who has strong analytical skills and strong attention to detail, an ability to juggle multiple competing priorities, is cool under pressure and is able to analyze large data sets to discover insights from data. S/he must be able to clearly and concisely communicate thoughts and ideas, both written and verbally, operate in a fast-paced environment and think outside of his/her direct sphere of responsibility.

Key job responsibilities


Strong experience in writing SQL queries, building Quicksight dashboards, and superior excel skills.
Write high-quality, detailed and data-supported content strategy documents which are presented to senior executives
Audit business metrics, perform deep dive analysis on problems to understand root causes and making decisions based on data
Partner with internal Finance/Content Analytics teams to help continuously improve the internal tools, and models that are used to assess and to predict the customer engagement value of different types of content
Perform analysis which quantifies the impact that different TV series and/or movies will have on customer engagement
AI-Driven Enhancements for Prime Video & Prime Video Direct: Develop and implement AI-powered strategies to enhance content moderation, rights management, and policy enforcement for self-submitted content.
AI Integration in Content Review Process: Leverage AI and machine learning to streamline and improve the efficiency of content review processes for Prime Video & Prime Video Direct submissions.
Prompt Engineering for Content Analysis: Design and optimize AI prompts specifically for analyzing and categorizing self-submitted content, ensuring compliance with platform policies and industry standards.
Maintain a can-do attitude and willingness and flexibility to solve problems at short notice, using any tools necessary


About The Team

This team sits at the heart of Prime Video's licensing business and has ownership/insights across all of Prime Video's business lines (SVOD, TVOD, AVOD, etc) and all territories. You will be joining a team with high visibility to Prime Video leadership and high impact to the business.

Basic Qualifications


Experience with SQL
Experience with Excel or Tableau (data manipulation, macros, charts and pivot tables)
Experience experience using data and metrics to measure impact and determine improvements


Preferred Qualifications


5+ years of account management, business development, content licensing or finance experience


Amazon is an equal opportunity employer and does not discriminate on the basis of protected veteran status, disability, or other legally protected status.

Position Summary

The Information Analyst III, Workforce Management is responsible for transforming complex data into actionable insights that support workforce planning, operational performance, business decision-making, and regulatory compliance. This role partners closely with leaders and stakeholders across the organization to identify reporting needs, analyze trends, improve data quality, and develop scalable analytics solutions.

The Information Analyst III serves as a trusted advisor for workforce analytics and business intelligence needs across multiple functional areas.

What You'll Do


Partner with business stakeholders to understand complex business challenges, define reporting requirements, and deliver data-driven solutions that improve operational performance, reduce costs, support compliance, and enhance workforce effectiveness.

Create and maintain technical documentation, reporting standards, data definitions, and process documentation.
Provide mentorship, guidance, and training to analysts and business partners on reporting tools, methodologies, and best practices.

Minimum Qualifications


Bachelor's degree in Mathematics, Statistics, Computer Science, Management Information Systems, Business Analytics, Healthcare Administration, or a related field; or four (4) years of equivalent work experience.

Experience working with large datasets, data validation, and analytical problem-solving.
Experience designing and developing reports, dashboards, and analytical solutions that support business decision-making.


Preferred Qualifications


Three (3) or more years of experience in healthcare, health insurance, workforce management, or a related industry.
Advanced SQL skills and experience working with relational databases and large-scale data environments.
Experience with business intelligence and visualization tools such as Power BI, Tableau, or similar platforms.
Experience with cloud-based data platforms, data warehouses, or modern analytics environments.
Experience developing workforce analytics, staffing models, forecasting solutions, scheduling analytics, or operational performance reporting.
Knowledge of contact center operations, workforce planning, or healthcare operational analytics.

Advanced knowledge of SQL, reporting tools, business intelligence platforms, and data analytics methodologies.
Strong understanding of relational databases, data structures, data governance, and reporting best practices.
Excellent analytical, critical thinking, problem-solving, and technical documentation skills.
Ability to communicate complex technical concepts and analytical findings to technical and non-technical audiences.
Strong written and verbal communication skills with the ability to influence and collaborate effectively across all organizational levels.
Demonstrated ability to lead analytical initiatives, manage competing priorities, and work independently in a fast-paced environment.
Proven ability to mentor analysts and promote best practices in reporting, analytics, and data management.
Knowledge of healthcare operations, healthcare data, health insurance concepts, and workforce management principles.
Ability to translate business needs into scalable analytical and reporting solutions that drive measurable results.

Job Description

Tesla Laboratories is seeking a Program/Data Analyst to support Design Technical Support (DTS) services for the Naval Facilities Engineering Systems Command Northwest (NAVFAC NW), Planning Design and Construction Directorate, Design Division (PDC4). This position supports the existing NAVFAC workforce and provides increased capability for Design-Bid-Build and Design-Build projects and associated efforts undertaken by NAVFAC Northwest customers within the NAVFAC Northwest Area of Responsibility (Puget Sound area).

Perform Program/data Analysis Tasks, Including


Data analytics related to tracking Key Performance Indicators (KPIs).
Tracking financial metrics of success for construction and engineering-related projects.
Budget tracking and execution metric presentation.


In Addition, The Program/Data Analyst Will


Coordinate with team members to execute project scope, create/manage schedules, and track/brief budget execution in conformance with project and customer requirements.
Create project technical dashboard reports via Microsoft software (Power BI, Project, Excel, etc.).
Facilitate the minimization of project delays by providing technical reviews and recommendations within predetermined timeframes.
Research codes, guidance, policies, procedures, processes, criteria, and federal laws/regulations, and provide sound technical recommendations both verbally and in writing.
Apply innovative technical principles, practices, and theories to the resolution of technical issues.
Coordinate with the Government client, NAVFAC team members, leadership, project stakeholders, and various regulatory agencies.

Provide technical support for construction field activities.
Provide a summary of accomplishments during weekly meetings and in a prepared monthly status report.

Prepare reports, Requests for Proposals, and/or scopes of work in the required format, including applicable attachments, and participate in briefings/conferences.

Ensure timely submission of submittals, reviews, and recommendations.

Competitive compensation

Retirement plan with company contribution

Paid time off and federal holidays

Professional development and training opportunities

Supportive, family-focused company culture

Opportunities for long-term career growth within a growing SDVOSB

Requirements


Experience: Minimum of 5 years of financial management experience in a field related to the tasks described above.

Strong hands-on experience with database querying and large datasets.
Experience developing inventory KPIs, operational metrics, reports, and dashboards.
Proficiency in data analysis and reporting tools such as SQL, Excel, and Power BI or similar platforms.
Experience with data automation and process improvement initiatives.
Understanding of supplier pricing, inventory tracking, and excess inventory analysis.
Strong analytical, problem-solving, and data-validation skills.
Excellent communication skills and experience collaborating with cross-functional stakeholders.
Ability to gather business requirements and translate them into actionable technical requirements.
Strong organizational and project management skills, with the ability to manage multiple initiatives simultaneously.
Preferred Qualifications
Experience with ERP systems, database management platforms, and supply chain applications.
Familiarity with supplier data management, pricing operations, and inventory control processes.
Experience with automation tools for reporting and data processing.
Experience supporting business and finance teams in technology-driven environments.

The Private Pricing Analytics and Insights team is a critical part of enabling the AWS Private Pricing business to achieve the highest standards of excellence for WW Commercial Operations. Lead business discussions to share insights, challenge status quo, and provide forward looking recommendations to enable strategic decision making and growth of Private Pricing.

Create new mechanisms and business processes that simplifies, standardizes and enables operational excellence.

Description:
The Data Analyst supports the business by partnering closely with Sales Operations, Sales, Product, Marketing, and R&D teams to deliver insights, reporting, and process improvements. Our team operates as an internal service organization — we exist to make our partner departments faster, smarter, and more data-informed. This role is a great fit for someone who takes ownership of their work, holds themselves accountable for delivering results, and is energized by reducing manual work across the business — someone who celebrates wins with the team and treats setbacks as opportunities to learn.

Success in this role comes from pairing the right applications with the right processes, used in unison. Strong tools without disciplined process produce one-off answers that don’t scale; strong process without the right tools slows the business down. The analysts who thrive here do both — picking the right system for the question (Tableau, Excel, Oracle, Salesforce, Eloqua, GA4, Qualtrics), then wrapping it in clear scoping, documentation, stakeholder review, and automation so the work compounds over time.

This role is a great fit for someone who takes ownership of their work, holds themselves accountable for delivering results, and is energized by reducing manual work across the business — someone who celebrates wins with the team and treats setbacks as opportunities to learn.

Company Overview

At FUJIFILM Sonosite, we reinvent how healthcare is delivered with point-of-care ultrasound technology. As the leader in bedside ultrasound systems, our innovations save lives—from premature babies in NICUs to trauma patients in emergency rooms.

We’re looking for purpose-driven team members ready to build technology that impacts real-world scenarios, including natural disasters and even war zones. By joining FUJIFILM Sonosite, you’ll be part of a team that thrives on collaboration, out-of-the-box thinking, and a passion for life-saving innovations. Let’s make a difference together.

Our headquarters in Bothell, Washington, blends riverside charm with urban amenities, quality schools, and an ever-evolving downtown—all part of the vibrant Seattle metro area.

Fujifilm is globally headquartered in Tokyo with over 70,000 employees across four key business segments of healthcare, electronics, business innovation, and imaging. We are guided and united by our Group Purpose of “giving our world more smiles.” Visit: https://www.fujifilm.com/us/en/about/region/careers

Job Description

Essential Job Functions:


Build and maintain dashboards and reports in Tableau Server to support decision-making across Product, Sales, Marketing, and R&D.
Partner with stakeholders to understand reporting needs, ask clarifying questions, and translate business questions into actionable analyses.
Build and maintain forecast models and own the forecasting process end-to-end — consolidating inputs from Sales, Product, and Marketing into a clear view of performance by product category and geography and applying historical trend analysis to improve forecast accuracy over time.

About The Job

The Google.org Tech for Social Impact (TSI) team helps nonprofits and civic entities achieve sustained social impact at scale by providing data infrastructure, visualization tools, and technology. Our team serves as the central hub for Google.org’s data, unifying global giving information into a source of truth to help leadership track and maximize the organization’s philanthropic impact.

In this role, you will serve as a strategic partner and internal consultant to Google.org leadership. You will leverage data analytics, research, and business acumen to shape philanthropic strategy, optimize resource allocation, and inform executive decision-making across our global pillars. You will act as a bridge between pillar leadership and technical teams, translating complex social impact challenges into analytical frameworks. You will generate data-driven hypotheses and conduct quantitative and qualitative analyses to deliver actionable insights. You will partner with analysts and researchers to ensure findings are both intellectually robust and operationally implementable, driving a culture of data-informed strategy. You will also critically evaluate and evolve our impact measurement frameworks against ecosystem benchmarks. Working closely with pillar leads and operations teams, you will translate strategic outlook into tangible changes in funding models, budget allocation, and operational capabilities. Through regular engagement with Google.org executives, you will build consensus around high-stakes decisions and mobilize cross-functional teams to execute on key initiatives.

Individual pay is determined by factors including job-related skills, experience, and relevant education or training.

US: $148000 - $214000 (USD) + 15% bonus target + equity + benefits

Title: Business Analyst, Finance Analytics
Description:
Who we are:
At Rover, pets and their people are at the heart of everything we do. We connect pet parents with trusted pet care across the U.S., Canada, Europe, and Australia.

Headquartered in Seattle and Barcelona, we’re a values driven, fast-growing tech company focused on building safe and personalized experiences tailored to the needs of each unique pet. We’re investing in AI as a business accelerator and provide every team member access to AI tools in service of creating better experiences for our community.

We are proud to be recognized as a great place to work, having been named among the 100 Best Companies to Work For in Seattle Business Magazine and Washington’s Best Workplaces in the Puget Sound Business Journal. At Rover we’re committed to creating an accessible, inclusive, and welcoming community, which starts with our employees.

Want to make an impact? Join our pack and come work (and play!) with us.

Who we're looking for:
We are seeking a Business Analyst on the Finance Analytics team that will be the go-to person for financial metric decomposition and narration, ultimately directly influencing business outcomes and strategic priorities, and forward-looking modeling of our repeat customers, partnering with Finance to both maintain the models and narrate performance against forecast.

As a Business Analyst on the Finance Analytics team, you will work with the broader Finance organization and Product Analytics team to analyze and narrate our marketplace. You are proactive about identifying positive and negative changes in financial metrics while also working with the team to hypothesize, investigate, and identify the underlying root cause of fluctuations in our metrics. This position requires a professional in data storytelling: we are looking for someone who is capable of presenting trends and overarching narratives of business performance to the broader organization, including senior leadership.

As a Business Analyst, you will also partner with Accounting, Tax and Product to maintain current reporting on various areas of the business, and are also encouraged to identify opportunities to improve reporting to better meet the teams’ needs. When there are changes across the business that impact Finance, including product feature experiments, new business lines, and regulatory changes, you will partner with stakeholders, both technical and non-technical, to find the right solution.

This is a hybrid position that has the minimum expectation to work out of our Downtown Seattle Office two days per week on Mondays and Thursdays. For this reason, candidates must be based in the Greater Seattle Area.
Additionally, applicants must be currently authorized to work in the United States on a full-time basis, without the need for current or future employer sponsorship for an employment-based visa status.
Your Responsibilities:


Become a subject matter expert on database queries related to all payments and finance tables, cohort modeling, and integrated third-party vendor data.
Monitor existing metrics and build new metrics that will drive business impact.
Regularly present to senior leadership and the finance organization on the trends and insights into changes in the business. This includes the decomposition of the drivers of those changes as well as recommendations on actions to improve marketplace performance.
Provide leverage for the finance, accounting, and tax teams through insights, narratives and increased automation/simplification. Be a thought partner for business owners, getting to the question behind the question and distilling the underlying need to analyze data.
Demonstrate flexibility and a collaborative mindset by stepping in to support teammates and cross-functional partners as needed.




Your Qualifications:


3+ years business experience in Analytics.
Background in data-informed decision-making and partnering with multi-functional teams.
Track record of strong written and verbal communication to construct clear data narratives to technical and non-technical stakeholders, including senior leadership.
Familiarly with finance and accounting principles, including financial statements.
Fluent with SQL and data visualization tools (e.g. Tableau, Looker, etc.) to independently conduct root cause analyses.
Experience working with data infrastructure / engineering teams to build and optimize data models.
Experience working with Python, R, or a similar computational language.




Nice to have:


Experience in a two-sided marketplace.




Benefits of working for Rover:


Competitive compensation
401k match
Flexible PTO
Competitive benefits package, including medical, dental, and vision insurance
Commuter benefits
Bring your dog to work (and unlimited puppy time)
Doggy benefits, including $1000 toward adopting your first dog
Stocked fridges, coffee, soda, and lots of treats (for humans and dogs) and free catered lunches semi-monthly
Regular team activities performed in-person and virtually




Compensation:


In the greater Seattle area the first-year salary range is $83,931-$108,167. Additionally, Rover offers benefits to full-time employees
The cash compensation offered for this role will be dependent on the candidate's experience, qualifications, skills, and abilities as demonstrated in the interview and hiring process




At Rover, we’re driven by seeing our people succeed and grow, while doing our jobs better than ever before. We believe the best business outcomes come from a diverse set of perspectives and we’re committed to promoting an inclusive, inventive, and fun environment with amazing employees. We welcome and encourage applicants from all backgrounds to apply.

Rover is an equal opportunity employer. We consider all qualified applicants without regard to age, race, color, ancestry, national origin, religion, disability, military or veteran status, sex, pregnancy, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, marital or partnership status, genetic predisposition, or any other protected status in accordance with applicable federal, state and local laws.

We are committed to work with you to look for reasonable accommodation to participate in the job application or interview process, to perform essential job functions, and to receive other benefits and privileges of employment. Please contact us to request accommodation.

Title: Data & Dashboards Specialist (Data Centers)
Description:
At Jacobs, we're challenging today to reinvent tomorrow by solving the world's most critical problems for thriving cities, resilient environments, mission-critical outcomes, operational advancement, scientific discovery and cutting-edge manufacturing, turning abstract ideas into realities that transform the world for good.

Your impact

This job opportunity is available at ANY location in the United States. Ideally, selected candidates will be near a JACOBS U.S. based office, but we intend to hire the "best" candidates.

We are looking for a Data & Dashboards Specialist (Power BI) to transform design, construction, and model data into clear, action-oriented insights for our data center portfolio.

You will sit inside the Digital Delivery / BIM team, working closely with BIM managers, project managers, construction managers, and automation/AI specialists. Your focus is not on “filling in” data, but on connecting to it, structuring it, and visualizing it—from early design through construction and closeout.

If you enjoy turning messy AEC data (models, RFIs, submittals, P6 schedules, financials, procurement feeds) into dashboards that teams actually rely on, this role is for you.

Key Responsibilities

Dashboard Design & Delivery


Design, build, and maintain Power BI dashboards that support
Design and coordination progress
Model health and quality indicators
Issue/clash metrics and remediation
Program- and project-level KPIs across a multi-site portfolio
Create construction administration dashboards that track
Submittals (status, cycle times, responsible parties, bottlenecks)
RFIs (volume, response times, trends by discipline/location)
Daily reports / field reports (labor, quantities, weather impacts, safety, key events)
Translate stakeholder questions into clear visuals, metrics, and layouts that support real decisions
Support project teams during setup and key milestones, iterating dashboards based on feedback


Data Connections, APIs & Modeling


Connect Power BI to a range of systems and data sources, such as
ACC / CDEs, Revit model exports and schedules, Navisworks/coordination outputs
Construction administration systems (for RFIs, submittals, daily reports, field data)
Scheduling tools – especially Primavera P6 (planned vs. actual, critical path views, look-ahead dashboards)
Financial and procurement systems – including Unifier and Hexagon Smart Materials for
Commitments, invoices, and change orders
Procurement status, material tracking, and delivery milestones
Use APIs or automated data pipelines (where available) to enable
Direct connections from these platforms into Power BI
Automatic refreshes with minimal manual intervention
Develop and maintain data models, relationships, and DAX measures, and troubleshoot data quality and refresh issues


Standards, Templates & Reuse


Develop standard dashboard templates for recurring use cases, including
Construction admin dashboards (RFIs, submittals, daily reports)
Scheduling dashboards (P6 integration)
Financial/procurement dashboards (Unifier, Smart Materials)
Define and document standard measures, naming conventions, and visual patterns to ensure consistent reporting across programs and clients
Maintain lightweight documentation and handover guides so dashboards can be adopted and scaled


Collaboration with BIM, Construction, Automation & AI


Partner with
BIM managers to consume model and coordination data into dashboards
Construction and project managers to align dashboards with CA workflows, P6 updates, and financial/procurement processes
Provide data/visualization support for internal pilots, R&D initiatives, and executive reporting related to digital delivery, automation, and AI
Run short walkthroughs, demos, and quick reference sessions for project and construction teams on how to use dashboards


 

Here's what you'll need


Proven experience building Power BI dashboards, including
Data modeling, relationships, and DAX
Designing intuitive, user-friendly report pages
Experience working with AEC / BIM / construction data, such as
ACC or similar CDEs
Revit schedules or model exports
RFI/submittal logs, daily reports, or other CA data
Experience integrating or reporting on at least one of
Scheduling data (e.g., Primavera P6)
Construction financial or procurement data (e.g., Unifier, Hexagon Smart Materials, or comparable tools)
Comfort working with APIs or ETL tools to connect external systems to Power BI, and to configure automated data refresh
Strong analytical and problem-solving skills; ability to deal with imperfect, fragmented data and improve it over time
Clear, concise communication skills and the ability to work with both technical and non-technical stakeholders


Ideally, you'll have


Experience with Revit, Navisworks, Civil 3D, or other BIM/coordination tools (conceptual understanding is sufficient)
Ability to work within the United States without visa sponsorship at anytime in the future



Our health and welfare benefits are designed to invest in you, and in the things you care about. Your health. Your well-being. Your security. Your future. Employees have access to medical, dental, vision, and basic life insurance, a 401(k) plan, and the ability to purchase company stock at a discount. Eligible employees may also enroll in a deferred compensation plan or the Executive Deferral Plan. Jacobs has an unlimited U.S. Personalized Paid Time Off (PPTO) policy for full-time salaried/exempt employees, seven paid holidays, and caregiver leave. And certain roles may be eligible for additional rewards, including merit increases, performance discretionary bonus, and stock.

The base salary range for this position is $75,300.00 to $103,500.00. Within the range, individual pay is determined by work location and additional factors, including job-related skills, experience, and relevant education or training.

Title: Clinical Data Analyst, Spotfire
Description:
SystImmune is a leading and well-funded clinical-stage biopharmaceutical company located in Bothell, WA and Princeton, NJ. It specializes in developing innovative cancer treatments using its established drug development platforms, focusing on bi-specific, multi-specific antibodies, and antibody-drug conjugates (ADCs). SystImmune has multiple assets in various stages of clinical trials for solid tumor and hematologic indications. Alongside ongoing clinical trials. Title: Senior Government Healthcare Data Consultant
Description:
We are seeking a talented individual to join our Government Healthcare Consulting - Informatics team at Marsh. This role can be based in Phoenix, Minneapolis, Atlanta, or Seattle and offers a hybrid work arrangement, requiring a minimum of three days per week in the office.

Medicaid is a government-sponsored health insurance program in the United States designed to provide healthcare coverage to low-income individuals and families. As a consulting firm specializing in Medicaid, Marsh’s Government Healthcare Consulting team assists state governments in optimizing their Medicaid programs. Our team plays a vital role in managing and analyzing Medicaid claims data to enhance patient access to care, improve cost efficiency, and elevate the quality of services provided to these individuals.

As a Sr.Government Healthcare Data Consultant, you will have the opportunity to collaborate with experienced programmers, actuaries, and clinicians, contributing to meaningful projects that aim to positively impact the lives of individuals and families in need. Join us in making a difference!

We will count on you to:


Utilize SAS programming software to interpret, validate and analyze large health care data sets
Participate in initial meetings with clients or project leads to define the scope of the project and provide insight and expertise including knowledge of the capabilities and flexibility of various approaches
Define the data process based on project scope, insight from the project lead and direction from the project's senior actuarial staff
Understand the reasons and impacts of data anomalies and exceptions on the analysis, formulate solutions, and communicate to client teams
Thrive and be motivated by an environment that embraces AI and technology-enabled tools
Perform technical peer review for data analysis projects
Act as a mentor for junior staff


What you need to have:


BA/BS or equivalent experience required
Minimum 5 years’ experience using SAS (desired), SQL, or equivalent programming language
Experience with healthcare claims data
Strong analytical and mathematical skills
Ability to prioritize and handle multiple tasks in a demanding work environment
Strong critical thinking and analytical problem-solving skills


What makes you stand out?


Experience with Medicaid programs and associated health care data, preferably in a consulting environment
Excellent interpersonal skills; strong oral and written communication skills


Why join our team:


We help you be your best through professional development opportunities, interesting work and supportive leaders.
We foster a vibrant and inclusive culture where you can work with talented colleagues to create new solutions and have an impact on colleagues, clients, and communities.
Our scale enables us to provide a range of career opportunities, as well as benefits and rewards to enhance your well-being.


Marsh (NYSE: MRSH) is a global leader in risk, reinsurance and capital, people and investments, and management consulting, advising clients in 130 countries. With annual revenue of over $27 billion and more than 95,000 colleagues, Marsh helps build the confidence to thrive through the power of perspective. For more information, visit marsh.com, or follow us on LinkedIn and X.

Marsh is committed to embracing a diverse, inclusive and flexible work environment. We aim to attract and retain the best people and embrace diversity of age background, disability, ethnic origin, family duties, gender orientation or expression, marital status, nationality, parental status, personal or social status, political affiliation, race, religion and beliefs, sex/gender, sexual orientation or expression, skin color, veteran status (including protected veterans), or any other characteristic protected by applicable law. If you have a need that requires accommodation, please let us know by contacting reasonableaccommodations@marsh.com.

Marsh is committed to hybrid work, which includes the flexibility of working remotely and the collaboration, connections and professional development benefits of working together in the office. All Marsh colleagues are expected to be in their local office or working onsite with clients at least three days per week. Office-based teams will identify at least one “anchor day” per week on which their full team will be together in person.

The applicable base salary range for this role is $88,000 to $176,000.

The base pay offered will be determined on factors such as experience, skills, training, location, certifications, education, and any applicable minimum wage requirements. Title: Marketing Analytics Manager
Description:
About Impact.com

impact.com is the world’s leading commerce partnership marketing platform, transforming the way businesses grow by enabling them to discover, manage, and scale partnerships across the entire customer journey. From affiliates and influencers to content publishers, brand ambassadors, and customer advocates, impact.com empowers brands to drive trusted, performance-based growth through authentic relationships. Its award-winning products - Performance (affiliate), Creator (influencer), and Advocate (customer referral) - unify every type of partner into one integrated platform. As consumers increasingly rely on recommendations from people and communities they trust, impact.com helps brands show up where it matters most. Today, over 5,000 global brands - including Walmart, Uber, Shopify, Lenovo, L’Oréal, and Fanatics - rely on impact.com to power more than 350,000 partnerships that deliver measurable business results.

Your Role at impact.com:

Impact.com powers the partnership economy, helping brands and partners grow revenue through a modern SaaS platform used by thousands of companies globally. We're investing heavily in our growth, and this role sits at the centre of how data powers our go-to-market strategy and sales enablement. We're looking for an Analytics Manager to scale our marketing function. This is a senior individual contributor role - we need someone who’s comfortable owning a domain of the marketing analytics portfolio with light oversight.

As Marketing Analytics Manager, you'll own the quality, consistency, and strategic impact of the core reporting used by our GTM teams to shape and prioritize multimillion dollar investment decisions. You'll work on a modern cloud stack (BigQuery, dbt, Looker) with strong support from Marketing and Sales teams - who will be your chief internal customers, and Analytics Engineering, who own the data platform and semantic layer you work with and on.

What You'll Do:


Own the process for the weekly, monthly, and quarterly business reviews that marketing and sales leaders use to track campaign performance and business trends — and improve them over time so they drive decisions rather than descriptions.
Translate vague business questions ("why is pipeline soft in EMEA?") into workable analyses, sell a solution, and manage the delivery process efficiently.
Partner with internal customers and engineers to move recurring manual reporting into useful tools that drive decisions which save time and money.
Work directly with stakeholders across marketing, sales, finance, product, and customer success to scope what they actually need and design a plan to get them that information efficiently and with the right level of accuracy.
Contribute to data collection and modeling conversations where marketing's needs intersect with the broader company data model.


What You Bring:


5+ years of business analytics experience in a software or information business.
A strong understanding of SQL and working proficiency with Python — enough to do your own analysis end-to-end without needing outside help.
A track record of designing dashboards and reports that people use to actually make decisions, and a sense of taste on what makes the difference between decisive reporting and vague reporting.
Ability to explain an analysis or technical concept to colleagues in a way that drives action.
Comfortable owning a workstream end-to-end with light oversight: you'll get direction on weekly priorities and outcomes, but will be trusted to set your own week and say no to the right things.


Nice to Have:


Experience with attribution modeling — multi-touch, time decay, incrementality
Experience with lead scoring
Experience with integration of sales and marketing data and a full-funnel perspective
Experience with dbt, databricks, Looker, or another data management tool
Experience in partnership marketing, digital marketing, or performance marketing


Salary Range: $80,000 - $100,000 per year, plus an additional 5% variable annual bonus contingent on Company performance and eligible to receive a Restricted Stock Unit (RSU) grant.


This is the pay range the Company believes is equitable for this position at the time of this posting. Consistent with applicable law, compensation will be determined based on the skills, qualifications, and experience of the applicant along with the requirements of the position, and the Company reserves the right to modify this pay range at any time.


Benefits and Perks:

At impact.com, we believe that when you’re happy and fulfilled, you do your best work. That’s why we’ve built a benefits package that supports your well-being, growth, and work-life balance.


Medical, Dental, and Vision insurance
Office-only catered lunch every Thursday, a healthy snack bar, and great coffee to keep you fueled
Flexible spending accounts and 401(k)
Flexible Working: Our Responsible PTO policy means you can take the time off you need to rest and recharge. We're committed to a positive work-life balance and provide a flexible environment that allows you to be happy and fulfilled in both your career and your personal life.
Health and Wellness: Your well-being is a priority. Our mental health and wellness benefit includes up to 12 fully covered therapy/coaching sessions per year, with additional dependent coverage. We also offer a monthly gym reimbursement policy to support your physical health.
A Stake in Our Growth: We offer Restricted Stock Units (RSUs) as part of our total compensation, giving you a stake in the company's growth with a 3-year vesting schedule, pending Board approval.
Investing in Your Growth: We’re committed to your continuous learning. Take advantage of our free Coursera subscription and our PXA courses.
Parental Support: We offer a generous parental leave policy, 26 weeks of fully paid leave for the primary caregiver and 13 weeks fully paid leave for the secondary caregiver.
Technology Financial Support: We provide a technology stipend to help you set up your home office and a monthly allowance to cover your internet expenses.

All employees and applicants for employment shall be given fair treatment and equal employment opportunity regardless of their race, ethnicity or ancestry, color or caste, religion or belief, age, sex (including gender identity, gender reassignment, sexual orientation, pregnancy/maternity), national origin, weight, neurodivergence, disability, marital and civil partnership status, caregiving status, veteran status, genetic information, political affiliation, or other prohibited non-merit factors.

Position Overview:

As the largest food & beverage company in the world, we sell over a billion products every day. Nestle’s sales team is the driving force behind every unit sold, focused on building strong categories by delighting our consumers while representing Nestle’s iconic brands with our retail partners.

The Sales Analytics team is the analytical intelligence engine that powers our Divisional sales & headquarter teams. The insights, data, and analytical expertise that our Sr Sales Analysts provide shape our strategic business decisions and equip our sales team to meet our consumer needs and drive category growth. The Sr. Analyst supports the division sales & CDCE team by leading strategic analytical initiatives and retailer/division-centric reporting that span across divisional categories.

Key Responsibilities:

The Sr. Analyst designs and deploys custom analytical solutions and team specific scorecards/dashboards to meet the unique needs of their Division Team. They serve as the analytical expert by leading multi-category requests and by providing insights and support to field sales leaders. The Sr. Analyst also plays a lead role on the Sales Analytics team, responsible for coaching, training, and onboarding Analysts.


Utilize multiple data sources to compile analysis and provide recommendations that drive positive ROI for the sales organization focusing on the so what, now what.
Strategize, advise and provide ad hoc support for VP/Director/Sr. Managers on opportunities for profitable growth
Identify team priorities and goals and develop trackers
Champion the use and application of standard sales analytics reports to meet the organization’s needs
Collaborate with the Business Intelligence Analysts to deliver best-in-class dashboards and scorecards for stakeholders
Provide superior customer service, being the point of contact for all faucets of sales analytics support


Division/Retailer Focused Insights & Reporting: Lead and provide retail/division-focused analytical support.


Translate complex business needs into actionable reporting, analytics, and insights that drive informed decision-making.
Maintain a holistic understanding of the wholesaler/retailer, category, and business landscape to proactively identify opportunities and improve selling capabilities.
Deliver actionable customer, category, and retail insights that support commercial planning, business planning, and sales execution.
Conduct root-cause, post-event, and benchmark analyses to evaluate performance, address business challenges, and identify growth opportunities.
Leverage internal, retail POS & movement data to provide fact-based recommendations, customer-facing selling tools, and category insights.
Support business performance through forecast accuracy, sales target attainment, segmentation, resource allocation, and customer service improvement.
Partner with CIH to transform 4Ps analytics and insights into business actions that drive growth.
Ensure timely and effective communication of customer, category, and forecast information to key stakeholders.


Elevate & Expand Sales Analytics Partnerships: Responsible for driving continuous improvement within the broader sales analytics tam through executing key projects and demonstrating peer-to-peer leadership. The Sr. Analyst will demonstrate role model behaviors within the sales analytics team by upskilling the analyst community through coaching and onboarding.


Owns and executes key sales analytics processes and provides sales analytics leadership with assistance on complex projects/initiatives.
Lead onboarding, provide continuous development, and fosters team collaboration for the Analysts on their respective sales analytics team
Own the deployment and training of sales analytics resources


Requirements:


3+ years of experience in sales analytics and reporting
Proficiency with Circana, Nielsen and other syndicated data, Excel, PowerPoint and PowerBi data management and data visualization.
Experience manipulating, managing, and drawing insights from large amounts of data
Experience driving insights and storytelling through the use of data.
Proven ability to routinely lead and foster collaboration among teammates
Ability to take initiative and drive improvement across the organization
Strong customer service and stakeholder management skills.
Strong verbal and written communication and presentation skills.
Organization and accuracy skills with excellent attention to detail
Demonstrates a thorough understanding of the sales fundamentals
Strong judgement in decision making, good problem-solving skills, and thinks strategically
Doesn’t hesitate to act and takes the initiative to execute with minimal supervision
Takes immediate action to resolve issues or potential issues, ensuring stakeholders are properly communicated to about the potential impact


Preferred:


Bachelor’s Degree from an accredited institution preferred.
Project Management skills or experience

Bonus Eligibility: Yes

Description:
Brief Description

Position: Data Scientist I

Location: JBLM, WA

Work Environment: Onsite

Clearance Required: Secret

Status: Funded

Salary Range: $80,000 - $90,000

Knowesis is looking for a Data Scientist I to support the United States Special Operations Command Preservation of the Force and Family (USSOCOM POTFF) program in identifying and implementing innovative, valuable solutions across the Special Operations Forces (SOF) enterprise aimed at improving the short and long-term well-being of SOF warriors and their families. The Data Scientist I will support all POTFF domains, providing consultation and assistance to supported units and POTFF staff to identify opportunities and methods for capturing data relating to POTFF programs and initiatives.

To be eligible for this position, candidates must have or have the ability to obtain a SECRET clearance and possess U.S. Citizenship without the need for sponsorship, both now and in the future. Applicants without proof of U.S. Citizenship will not be considered due to the position’s security requirements.

This position requires on-site work for all or a portion of the work being performed. The successful candidate will reside in the local area or relocate within 15 days of the start date. No relocation is authorized.

The Job Duties and Responsibilities include but are not limited to the following:


Conducts data analytics, data manipulation, data mining, exploratory analysis, predictive analysis, and statistical analysis, and uses scientific techniques to correlate data into graphical, written, visual, and verbal narrative products, enabling more informed analytic decisions.
Enter and analyze data within government systems. Aggregate data sets across numerous applications and develop trend analysis. Create products demonstrating these trends.
Modify and update existing data sources to provide relevant program related outcome metrics.
Maintain dashboards to automate data analysis, identifying, interpreting, and presenting trends, designed to record POTFF-related programmatic data.
Assist the POTFF staff with survey design. Create, analyze, and report survey data.
Provide consultation and assistance to supported units and POTFF staff to identify opportunities and methods for capturing data related to POTFF programs and initiatives.
Work in consultation with POTFF program staff and the Government’s POTFF biostatistician.
Provide subject matter expertise in the areas of program evaluation, research methodologies, and data analysis.
Be able to use statistics/modeling tools and data visualization techniques to provide an accessible way to see and understand trends, outliers, and patterns in data to produce reports and presentations that accurately convey data trends supporting the mission.


Required Qualifications


Bachelor's degree in quantitative science, social science, or a related discipline.
Basic proficiency with the suite of Microsoft Office programs, including Word, Excel, and Access.
Basic proficiency with commonly used statistical software applications such as SPSS, SAS, Python, and R-Shiny.
Be able to read, write, and speak English fluently and clearly to effectively communicate with all personnel they will interact with.
Possess excellent verbal, written, interpersonal communication, presentation skills, and shall be highly detail oriented.
Possess sufficient initiative, interpersonal relationship skills, and social sensitivity such that they can relate constructively to a variety of contacts from diverse backgrounds.


Preferred Qualifications


Certification or documented experience with Human Performance.
Experience working with Special Operations, athletics/sports, or other military settings.
Strong technical and analytical skills in the following:
SQL Server, Databricks, Apache Spark (PySpark), Python, Power BI, Power Apps, and Power Automate
Knowledge of ETL/ELT development, dimensional data modeling, data governance, machine learning, statistical analysis, NLP, large language models (LLMs), retrieval-augmented workflows, and data pipeline orchestration.
Experience supporting enterprise analytics, dashboard development, predictive modeling, and low-code automation solutions in Microsoft and cloud-based data environments preferred.

Benefits


Health (PPO & HDHP) Insurance, Dental, Vision, STD & LTD, Basic Life Insurance, 401k Company Match, & Voluntary Products.

We prohibit discrimination in all aspects of employment as required by Title VII of the Civil Rights Act and other applicable federal laws. Our company values all applicants and employees and fosters a work environment where everyone is treated with respect and dignity.

Title: Data Analyst
Description:
This position can be based in the Washington D.C or Chicago, IL office.




Position Summary

NAR is seeking a Data Analyst to help deliver data-driven insights, analytics solutions, and AI-enabled products that support decision-making across the organization. This role focuses on working directly with business stakeholders to understand analytical requirements, transform complex and fragmented data into actionable information, and build scalable solutions that provide measurable business value.




The Data Analyst will design and implement data preparation processes, perform advanced analysis, and develop applications and visualizations. They will make data and analysis accessible to non-technical audiences. The role works extensively within the Microsoft Azure and Microsoft Fabric ecosystems and involves close collaboration with data scientists, and business stakeholders in different parts of the organization.




The successful candidate will contribute to data quality initiatives, AI-assisted analytics workflows, and the development of new solutions that leverage both traditional analytics and AI technologies. The ideal candidate is comfortable working across analytics, visualization, and application development disciplines, with a practical focus on delivering solutions that are reliable, scalable, and widely adopted by the business.




Duties And Responsibilities

Partner with business stakeholders and non-technical teams to gather requirements, identify opportunities, and deliver data-driven solutions
Extract, transform, clean, and validate data from multiple internal and external sources to support analytics, reporting, and operational decision-making
Develop and maintain Python notebooks using SQL, Spark, and related technologies for data analysis, exploration, and reporting
Create dashboards that effectively communicate insights to business audiences using technologies such as Power BI, Streamlit, Django, and other frameworks
Collaborate with Data Scientists on data quality initiatives, statistical analyses, AI-assisted testing frameworks, and machine learning-related projects
Participate in source control, deployment, and project management processes using tools such as Git and Jira
Other duties, as assigned




Qualifications

Bachelor's degree in Computer Science or a closely related field.
Minimum of 2+ years of professional experience in data analytics or a related technical role.
Strong proficiency in SQL, including experience writing complex queries.
Strong Python development skills, including working with notebooks, expertise with data analysis libraries (e.g., Pandas, NumPy, SciPy), and use of visualization libraries (e.g., Plotly, Matplotlib).
Experience building dashboards using tools such as Power BI, Streamlit, or Django.
Experience working with cloud-based platforms and services; Microsoft Azure and Microsoft Fabric experience preferred.
Use of Git and use of project management systems such as Jira.
Good grasp of basic statistical concepts.
Ability to communicate complex technical concepts clearly and effectively to non-technical audiences.
Ability to work independently with minimal supervision while managing multiple priorities and deadlines.
Experience with AI, such as the use of AI-code generation, is a positive.
Advanced Microsoft Excel skills for data analysis and reporting are preferred




Compensation: $75,000 - $95,000 depending on office location

NAR provides comprehensive benefits including health/dental/vision insurance.

NAR is on a hybrid schedule and in the office 3 days a week.




Organizational Overview

The National Association of REALTORS® (NAR) is a team of professionals dedicated to providing world-class service to approximately 1.5 million REALTORS® working in the United States and around the world. The real estate industry is fast-paced and fast-changing--each year, our members participate in the sale, lease, and management of real estate. As in every industry, our members’ value proposition is constantly being challenged by innovation.




It is our mission to empower REALTORS® as they preserve, protect and advance the right to real property for all. We cannot do that without the ideas, passion, and commitment from our talented employees. As our greatest assets, employees are offered their pick of competitive benefits/perks and flexible work options.

(25%)

Title: Senior Data Analyst
Description:
Established in 2021, Independence Pet Holdings is a corporate holding company that manages a diverse and broad portfolio of modern pet health brands and services, including insurance, pet education, lost recovery services, and more throughout North America.

We believe pet insurance is more than a financial product and build solutions to simplify the pet parenting journey and help improve the well-being of pets. As a leading authority in the pet category, we operate with a full stack of resources, capital, and services to support pet parents. Our multi-brand and omni-channel approach include our own insurance carrier, insurance brands and partner brands.

Clarus is a subsidiary of Doubtless, formerly known as Independence Pet Holdings, Inc. Clarus is a pioneering pet health technology company transforming the future of pet healthcare. We develop connected solutions across the pet health landscape, helping veterinary teams and pet owners make more informed care and financial decisions. Together, we are reducing complexity and helping more pets receive the care they need.

Job Summary

Clarus is seeking an experienced, hands-on Senior Data Analyst to join the Analytics team. This individual will serve as a strategic analytical partner to Sales, Customer Success, Product, Finance, and teams across the organization to deliver analytical solutions.

The Senior Data Analyst will bring together sales, CRM, customer, campaign, product usage, and engagement data to create reliable forecasts, dashboards, recurring reports, and actionable insights. The role will help Clarus improve pipeline visibility, commercial performance, customer retention, product adoption, and partner outcomes.

This is an individual-contributor role with defined ownership and visibility. The successful candidate will be comfortable moving between detailed data analysis and high-level business recommendations. They will bring structure to ambiguous questions, identify opportunities without waiting to be asked, and communicate insights in a way that drives action.

Job Location: Remote – USA. Candidates in EST/CST time zones are strongly preferred. US travel required.

Main Responsibilities


Gather reporting requirements and translate business questions into dashboards, reports, datasets, queries, metrics, and analytical models.
Build, maintain, and improve dashboards and recurring reports using Power BI, Tableau, Excel, Zoho Analytics, or similar platforms.
Create reusable datasets, SQL queries, and data models that improve consistency and reduce manual reporting.
Establish and document KPI definitions, calculation logic, reporting assumptions, and data sources.
Design reporting assets that are accurate, intuitive, scalable, and appropriate for both operational and executive audiences.
Partner with Sales, Customer Success, Marketing, Product, Finance, and leadership to define analytical needs and improve decision-making.
Balance recurring reporting responsibilities with ad hoc analysis and strategic initiatives.
Evaluate lead management performance, including lead sources, routing, follow-up activity, aging, conversion, and pipeline leakage.
Monitor sales activity, account performance, customer engagement, revenue trends, renewals, expansion, and churn.
Analyze Sales performance drivers, growth trends, and areas of underperformance across accounts, customer segments, cohorts, channels, and external partners.
Build and maintain customer health scoring methodologies, including risk signals, adoption indicators, monitoring engagement behavior, and recommended calls to action.
Analyze the customer lifecycle across acquisition, activation, engagement, adoption, retention, renewal, expansion, and churn.
Analyze user activity and product engagement to support Product decisions, Customer Success planning, and customer or partner reporting.
Develop customer performance scorecards for account reviews, renewal planning, and internal and external QBRs.
Analyze marketing campaign performance, including reach, engagement, lead quality, conversion, cohort performance, attribution, and downstream pipeline impact.
Prepare executive-ready summaries, presentations, scorecards, and reporting packages for leadership meetings, QBRs, partner reviews, and planning sessions.
Proactively identify gaps in data quality, reporting visibility, customer segmentation, and metric definitions.
Drive adoption of dashboards, KPIs, scorecards, and reporting processes through documentation, training, and stakeholder engagement


Basic Qualifications


Bachelor’s degree or higher in analytics, business, economics, statistics, finance, information systems, marketing, or a related discipline, or equivalent professional experience.
A strong record of success in sales analytics, revenue analytics, business intelligence, customer analytics, marketing analytics, or a related analytical role.
5+ years of relevant experience is preferred; with demonstrated industry knowledge, analytical ability, initiative, and business impact.
Strong SQL and Python skills.
Experience building business dashboards and reporting solutions in Power BI or Tableau.
Experience with Zoho Analytics or another CRM-connected analytics platform.
Experience analyzing CRM data, sales pipelines, funnels, customer activity, and commercial performance.
Strong understanding of forecasting, segmentation, conversion, retention, renewal, churn, and customer lifecycle metrics.
Ability to gather business requirements and translate them into clear analytical deliverables.
Excellent written and verbal communication skills, including experience presenting findings to senior leaders and non-technical audiences.
High attention to detail and a strong commitment to data accuracy, consistency, documentation, and reporting quality.


Preferred Qualifications


Relevant experience in animal health, veterinary services, pet insurance, insurance, SaaS, fintech, health technology, or similar environment highly desired.
Intellectually curious, resourceful, and motivated to understand how the business works.
Takes initiative, identify needs early, and move work forward without waiting for detailed instructions.
Comfortable operating in an evolving, high-growth environment.
Can move easily between hands-on analysis, stakeholder conversations, and executive-level communication.
Able to manage deliverables while continuing to improve the underlying processes.
Able to build trust by producing accurate work, communicating clearly, and following through on commitments.


Compensation


Chicago Base pay range: $100,458 – $125,574 per year
New York Base pay range: $109,509 - $136,990 per year
Nationwide Base pay range: $91,325 - $114,158 per year


This is the range we reasonably expect to pay at hire. Placement within the range depends on job-related factors such as experience, skills, and certifications. This position is not eligible for an annual bonus. Base pay is one part of a total rewards package that includes the benefits listed below.

Title: Senior Data Analyst
Description:
Senior Data Analyst




Who We Are




Teranet is Canada’s leader in the delivery and transformation of statutory registry services with extensive expertise in land and commercial registries. We also market insightful property and data solutions, as well as practice management automation to thousands of customers in the real estate, financial services, government, utilities, and legal markets. Founded in 1991, Teranet operates the Electronic Registration System for the Province of Ontario and Teranet Manitoba is the service provider to the Province of Manitoba.




Connect. Grow. Thrive Together.




To learn more about who we are, visit our website: www.teranet.ca




About the Role




We are seeking a Senior Data Analyst to join our Commercial Solutions Product Management team, where data and analytics play a key role in shaping product strategy and client solutions. While part of Product Management, this is a hands-on data and analytics role focused on delivering high-quality analysis and data-driven solutions.




This role combines data analysis, business & product analysis, and client-focused solution delivery. You will work across Product, Sales, Technology, and clients to understand problems, shape the right approach, and deliver actionable outputs. You will operate as a thought partner, helping define problems, clarify requirements, and translate them into effective data solutions, while owning delivery end-to-end.




A critical part of this role is protecting and strengthening our core data offerings. This includes ownership of recurring and ad hoc data deliverables, ensuring consistent quality, reliability, and continuous improvement. You will also contribute to revenue growth by supporting custom data solutions, enabling product initiatives, and providing analytical input into new data-driven offerings.




What You’ll Be Doing




This role focuses on analysis, data delivery, mentorship, and stakeholder collaboration across both ongoing operations and new initiatives. You will…

Analyze data to generate insights that support product, client, and business decisions
Translate business needs into analytical approaches (requirements, use cases, impacts)
Design and deliver data solutions (queries, datasets, reports - recurring and ad hoc)
Own outputs end-to-end, ensuring accuracy, quality, and usability
Maintain and improve recurring data deliverables, protecting core revenue streams
Partner with Product and Sales on custom data solutions, business cases, and new offerings
Support research and analysis that informs product strategy and market insights
Collaborate across Product, Sales, Technology, and clients to align on priorities and outcomes
Communicate insights clearly through presentations, dashboards, and reports
Improve and optimize workflows using modern tools, automation, and AI-assisted approaches
Provide ongoing guidance, mentorship, and quality oversight to junior team members, helping elevate team output and consistency




About You




You are an experienced analyst who brings together strong technical skills, sound business judgment, and clear communication.




Technical Qualifications:

Bachelor’s degree in quantitative fields (E.g., Statistics, Mathematics, Computer Science, Engineering)
5+ years of experience in data, analytics, or business/data roles
Experience working with both business and technical stakeholders
Strong proficiency in SQL, Python, and Excel is required.
Experience with visualization tools (Tableau, Power BI)
Experience working with large datasets and data modelling
Familiarity with modern data platforms and tools
Experience using automation or AI-assisted tools to improve workflows, efficiency, and output quality
Understanding of real estate and mortgage lending data, land registration concepts, and property-related datasets is considered an asset.
Knowledge of GIS concepts and experience using spatial analysis tools such as ArcGIS is considered an asset.




Core Capabilities:

Strong analytical thinking across data, business, and product problems
Ability to break down problems, gather requirements, and assess impacts
Hands-on experience delivering end-to-end data solutions
Clear communication of insights and recommendations
Ability to manage priorities and deliver high-quality work independently
Strong problem-solving and critical thinking, with a solution-oriented mindset
Demonstrates ownership, accountability, and initiative in driving outcomes
A natural inclination to mentor and support others, taking responsibility for team quality and development without needing direction
Curiosity and willingness to explore and adopt new tools and approaches, including AI-assisted capabilities.




What Success Looks Like




You bring clarity and structure to complex problems
You ask the right questions and help refine requirements
You deliver high-quality, reliable outputs that are clear, accurate, and ready for use
You maintain momentum and alignment across stakeholders
You translate data into clear, actionable insights
You build trust with both internal teams and clients
You take ownership of recurring and ad hoc data deliverables, ensuring consistency and continuous improvement
You actively support and mentor junior team members, helping raise the quality and consistency of team outputs
You are proactive and self-directed, taking initiative to move work forward without needing close guidance or constant follow-up
You are comfortable taking ownership of problems and moving them forward, even when there isn’t a clearly defined path and the work involves ambiguity




Let’s Talk Pay




We believe in being upfront about pay and helping you make informed decisions about your career. The annual pay range for this role is $106,040 - $114,400 CAD, inclusive of base salary and target incentive pay. We understand that great talent comes in many forms, each with unique skills, experience, and potential. Your salary will be tailored to reflect the experience you bring and the impact you’re ready to have on this role.




At Teranet, we also know that compensation extends far beyond a pay cheque. Along with your cash compensation, we offer a comprehensive package which includes the following:




100% Employer Paid Health Benefit Plan
Employer Matching Retirement Savings Plan
Paid Vacation, Floater Days & Sick Leaves
Maternity, Parental and/or Adoption Leave Top-Up Programs
Corporate Discounts & GoodLife Group Rate Membership
Employee Assistance Program – for you and your loved ones!




Our Human Approach to Hiring




At Teranet, we use smart technology to make hiring faster and more efficient. Artificial Intelligence (AI) tools help us review applications and identify strong matches—but the real decisions? Those are made by our awesome people.




Every interaction you’ll have, and every decision we make, is led by humans. AI may support us, but it’s human connection that drives every hire.




At Teranet, we are committed to fostering an inclusive, accessible environment, where all employees and customers feel valued, respected, and supported. We are dedicated to building a workforce that reflects the diversity of our customers and the communities in which we live and serve. If you require accommodation during the recruitment and selection process, please let us know and we will work with you to meet your needs.




Come As You Are. We Like You That Way!

Learn more at tradercorporation.com.

Design, build, and own core analytical data models supporting consistent measurement across fintech products, including fraud prevention, transaction flows, and customer journeys

Act as an analytical partner to Fintech product teams supporting Dealertrack and CMS, generating insights that enable data-informed product development, optimization, and prioritization

5+ years of experience in data analytics with strong hands-on experience in analytical data modelling, ideally supporting financial, saas or platform-based products
Strong proficiency in SQL and BI tools such as power bi, tableau or quicksight
Demonstrated regular use of GenAI tools to accelerate sql development, analytical modelling, documentation and problem-solving with measurable impact on efficiency or quality
Experience working with financial, transactional or operational datasets
Ability to work autonomously and partner closely with fintech product and engineering teams to identify analytical needs and translate them into actionable insights
Strong communication skills and ability to present complex data and financial concepts to non-technical stakeholders
Proven ability to gather, analyze and synthesize data from multiple systems while ensuring accuracy, consistency and trust in reported metrics

Gym discounts

Conferences & training budget

Competitive salary
Annual bonus structure

Title: Data Analyst
Description:
At Talkspace, we are committed to fostering a diverse, equitable, inclusive, and belonging-centered workplace where everyone can thrive while making a difference in mental health. Want to help over two million people receive quality mental healthcare? Come join our mission of getting therapy in the hands of everyone!

We are looking for an experienced Data Analyst to join our Data Science team. The Data Analyst is a key contributor to the product development of Sentia’s agentic behavioral health platform, utilizing a strong data-driven approach. This role involves seamlessly collaborating with various technical and non-technical stakeholders to translate data insights into actionable strategies and communicating the underlying data narrative to non-technical audiences. This analyst will be crucial in the initial setup and architecture of the data warehouse, establishing the foundation for all data operations.

Key responsibilities include collecting requirements, querying databases, and developing dashboards and reports for both internal business stakeholders and external partners. The analyst excels in both qualitative and quantitative data analysis, identifying trends and surfacing crucial insights that lead to informed decision-making, and also excels in consumer product analysis.To work at Talkspace, you need to be as passionate as we are about our work, and excited to partner with us on delivering quality mental healthcare.

This is a remote position based in Eastern Hours. Talkspace Headquarters in NYC.

What You’ll Do


Data Visualization and Reporting
Develop and refine data visualizations that clearly communicate outcomes, network performance, and user engagement trends to stakeholders.
Create automated quality reports and network performance dashboards using Looker and other tools.
Deeply understand and analyze user pathways, business outcomes, and the dynamics of our provider/partner network.
Quantitative Analysis
Conduct thorough quantitative analyses to support business strategies.
Utilize your expertise in SQL and Python to manage business and provider data effectively.
Strategic Insights
Collaborate with business, finance, marketing and cross-functional teams to provide data-driven insights supporting product development and provider network operations.
Navigate the intricacies of a multi-sided marketplace, understanding different stakeholder needs and market drivers.
Communication and Collaboration
Engage with both technical and non-technical stakeholders to transform complex data insights into understandable and actionable strategies for enhancing customer service and provider engagement.
Work closely with a seasoned Data Science team to leverage advanced analytics in shaping business and network intelligence strategies.
Create and present easily digestible and actionable recommendations to senior leadership, influencing key decision-making processes.
Data Modeling and Pipeline Management Design
Build, and maintain robust, documented, and scalable data models (e.g., using dbt) within the data warehouse to support downstream reporting and analytical needs.
Collaborate with engineering teams to optimize data ingestion processes (ETL/ELT) and ensure the timely availability of high-quality data.
Analyze agentic platform performance metrics
Metrics include model accuracy, latency, conversation depth, and user adherence to behavioral protocols.

About You


3-5 years of experience in an analytical role, experience with healthcare data (patient outcomes, capacity planning, etc.) a plus.
BA/BS in a quantitative field like statistics, applied mathematics, economics, computer science, or equivalent experience.
Proficiency in SQL, python, and Excel / Google Sheets.
Comfortable with statistics and data manipulation.
Advanced skills in data visualization tools like Looker or Tableau are essential.
Experience with product analytics tools like Mixpanel.
Experience with leveraging GenAI tools is a plus.


Benefits


Comprehensive Medical, Dental and Vision plans coverage
Pre-tax benefits: HSA/ FSA
401k Retirement Savings Program with matching up to 3%
Voluntary benefits including disability, basic life or pet insurance, etc.
Monthly Wellness Stipend to promote mental and physical self-care
Flexible PTO and Remote First Environment
Regular team events, including Wellness Workshops and Team Building Events
Free access to Talkspace products for you and one household member, as well as access to a friends and family discount!


Compensation

At Talkspace, we believe that pay transparency during the interview process is a critical part of diversity, equity, and inclusion. Our salary bands are based on internal and external compensation benchmarks, which we regularly evaluate to ensure we pay competitively.

The base salary range for this role is between $110,000 and $130,000. Within the salary bands, leveling corresponds to each candidate’s relevant experience, skills as assessed during the interview process, education, and applicable certifications.

Why Talkspace?

Talkspace is the world’s leading online therapy company, serving over 2 million users looking to begin their wellness journey through tele-health. According to the World Health Organization, close to 1 billion people worldwide live with a mental disorder, and on average more than 75% with mental, neurological, and substance use disorders receive no treatment for their condition at all. Additionally, one-third of the world’s population – 2 billion people – live in countries that spend less than 1% of their health budgets on mental health. Therapy is an universal need and it's our mission here to change the world by cultivating an intentional space for people to feel supported through quality care that is simple and accessible.

Combining our passion for innovation along with our desire to help others overcome the stigma behind “getting help,” we are transforming the way patients find the right care provider, making an otherwise impossible feat easily conquerable. Our network of licensed, accredited, and board-certified clinicians are increasing access to mental health for our members through a myriad of high quality therapy services: anytime and for a fraction of the price. Dedicated to our mission, we are looking for candidates that want to bring their talents into a diverse “for purpose” space. If you’re equally as passionate about making quality mental healthcare accessible to all then Talkspace is the right place for you!

EQUAL OPPORTUNITY EMPLOYER

Talkspace welcomes and celebrates talent from all backgrounds, perspectives, and walks of life to foster an innovative and diverse workforce. We encourage you to apply, even if you don’t meet every qualification or if your path has been nontraditional — such as not completing a formal degree program, taking a career break, or having a prior criminal record — if you believe you could make a great addition to this team. Come as you are and learn about the exciting opportunities on our team.

Individuals seeking employment at Talkspace are considered without regard to race, color, religious creed, sex, national origin, citizenship status, age, physical or mental disability, sexual orientation, marital, parental, veteran or military status, unfavorable military discharge, or any other status protected by applicable federal, state or local law.

How do we define Diversity, Equity, Inclusion, and Belonging at Talkspace?

Diversity

Diversity encompasses the unique attributes of our employees as individuals. We value and embrace the richness arising from their varied backgrounds, perspectives, and experiences, which include, but are not limited to, age, ability, ethnicity, gender, race, and cultural background.

Equity

Equity refers to a fair and impartial workplace, aiming to ensure equal growth and advancement opportunities for all employees. This involves amplifying underrepresented voices, addressing unconscious biases, and providing inclusive, culturally competent mental health care.

Inclusion

Inclusion signifies the practice of granting equal access to opportunities and resources for all employees, particularly those who might otherwise be excluded or marginalized. It ensures that everyone feels a sense of belonging, value, support, and respect as an individual.

Belonging

Belonging reflects the affinity and positive relationships that develop among employees from diverse backgrounds when businesses actively promote diversity, equity, and inclusion in the workplace.
