About The Team

The SevenRooms Data & Analytics team is the foundational data hub powering go-to-market, product, finance, and operational decisions across the In-Store business. We design and maintain the pipelines, models, and infrastructure that connect SevenRooms' systems with the broader DoorDash data ecosystem — and we're investing aggressively in making our datasets ready for both human and AI consumption. Within the team, our product-focused analytics work owns the funnels, personas, and feature-adoption insights that inform what products and features get built, how it's launched, and how it performs in the market.

About The Role

We're hiring a Data Analyst to be the data partner for our Product Management, Product Marketing, and executive teams at SevenRooms. You will own the building of data products, feature launch analytics, and the PLG instrumentation that connects product usage signals back into Salesforce, Gainsight, and our outbound motions.

You will report into the Manager, Data & Analytics on our Data & Analytics team in our SevenRooms organization.

You're Excited About This Opportunity Because You Will…


Own product analytics end-to-end — funnels, adoption, retention, and ROI for every major feature launch on the SevenRooms platform.
Build net new data products aimed at improving analytic and reporting capabilities
Partner with Product Managers and Product Marketers on pre-launch hypotheses , beta testing results, post-launch measurement, and ongoing optimization.
Design and ship PLG automations that translate product behavior into opportunity tagging, expansion signals, and CSM workflows.
Apply GenAI and ML techniques — partnering with our GTM Engineer — to product analytics use cases like web-sourced feature adoption opportunities, transactions predictive modeling, and Add-On ICP scoring.
Communicate closely in support of multiple PM’s with reporting and ad-hoc analysis


We're Excited About You Because…


A degree in Math, Physics, Statistics, Economics, Computer Science, or a similar domain
2+ years of experience analyzing product data and partnering with Product Management teams in a SaaS environment.
Expert SQL skills and proficiency with a cloud BI tool such as Looker, Tableau, or Mode.
Hands-on experience with product instrumentation and analytics platforms such as Pendo, Amplitude, Mixpanel, or Heap.

Strong written and verbal communication skills, including comfort presenting to product and executive audiences.

Title: Senior Data Analyst, Hardware & Supply Chain
Description:
Our mission at Oura is to empower every person to own their inner potential. Our award-winning products help our global community gain a deeper knowledge of their readiness, activity, and sleep quality by using their Oura Ring and its connected app. We've helped millions of people understand and improve their health by providing daily insights and practical steps to inspire healthy lifestyles.

Empowering the world starts with living our values and empowering our team. As a quickly growing company focused on helping people live healthier and happier lives, we ensure that our team members have what they need to do their best work — both in and out of the office.

We are looking for a Senior Data Analyst — Hardware & Supply Chain to join our Data Analytics team in North America. You’ll be the analytics lead on the data that runs Oura’s physical business—how rings are built, sourced, manufactured, shipped, sold, activated, and serviced. This is the data behind hardware manufacturing, supply chain, revenue, units sold, COGS, margin, inventory, and the warranty and returns metrics that show up in board and S-1 reporting.

As Oura matures into a scalable consumer-hardware business and migrates to a unified data platform on Databricks, this role exists to make sure the numbers that leadership and external auditors steer by—units sold, sell-through, activation rate, on-hand inventory, landed cost, and warranty rate—are defined once, computed correctly, traceable end-to-end from ERP and the manufacturing floor to the executive dashboard, and audit-ready. You will partner with Operations, Supply Chain, Hardware Engineering, Finance, and Data Engineering to build the governed hardware /supply chain data foundation.

What You Will Do

Hardware & Supply Chain KPI Ownership


Own the analytics layer for the hardware and supply chain scorecard — partner with Operations, Supply Chain, and Finance to define, document, and deliver the KPIs that show up in board and S-1 reporting (hardware revenue, units sold, sell-through, COGS, landed cost, gross margin, on-hand and in-transit inventory, warranty rate, return/RMA rate, and activation rate).
Establish each hardware/SC KPI as a governed, audit-grade data product — locked definitions, single owner, data build tool (dbt) tests, full lineage from source systems, formal sign-off, and a documented change-management process.
Build and own the hardware data contract and hardware — the canonical dimension that ties SKUs, components, ring generations, sizes, and finishes to every downstream sales, inventory, and activation metric.
Be the analytics representative in external audit cycles — produce documentation, walk auditors through lineage, and ensure controls and traceability are reflected in how hardware and supply chain metrics are produced.


Platform Migration & Data Engineering


Migrate hardware and supply chain reporting from legacy stacks (Snowflake + Tableau + Sheets) to our Databricks-based platform, with dbt-modeled metrics, Unity Catalog lineage, and Databricks SQL / Genie as the executive-facing surface.
Coordinate with source-system owners across ERP, manufacturing, logistics, and e-commerce (NetSuite, contract-manufacturer feeds, 3PL/logistics data, Zuora) and the Data Engineering team to ensure clean ingestion, correct dimensional modeling, and clear lineage from purchase orders and factory output through to sell-through and activation.
Resolve systems data quality issue to ensure that reporting is trustworthy end to end.
Build and maintain the Hardware/SC domain’s data products in Databricks, mentoring analysts on dimensional modeling, dbt practices, and the Golden Path for publishing governed metrics for reporting and for MCP/agentic AI consumption.


Operations & Supply Chain Partnership


Partner deeply with Supply Chain and Operations on demand/supply planning data — own the Databricks-side data layer that feeds planning, and ensure planned, reported, and warehouse numbers reconcile across regions.
Deliver inventory, fulfillment, and supplier analytics — days of supply, fill rate, on-time delivery, yield, scrap, and cost-to-serve — that give Operations leadership a single trusted view.
Drive adoption of self-service reporting by Operations and business partners — using Genie, Databricks SQL dashboards, and clear documentation to reduce one-off reporting and free up analyst time for analysis.


Tooling & Innovation


Continuously evaluate emerging tools (Unity Catalog, Databricks Genie, AI-assisted SQL/modeling via Cursor and Claude Code, semantic-layer technologies) to improve productivity and accuracy in hardware and supply chain reporting.


We Would Love to Have You on Our Team, If You Have


7+ years in analytics, business intelligence, or a related data-focused role, with at least 3+ years specifically supporting Hardware, Supply Chain, Operations, Manufacturing, or Logistics.
Demonstrated experience building executive-level reporting for a physical-product business that is trusted by leadership and survives external scrutiny (Board, auditors, investors).
Deep working knowledge of hardware and supply chain data domains: units sold and sell-through, COGS and landed cost, BOM and component costing, inventory (on-hand, in-transit, days of supply), warranty and RMA/returns, manufacturing yield, and how transactional systems (NetSuite/ERP, contract-manufacturer and 3PL feeds, e-commerce platforms) flow into reported numbers.
Hands-on experience with demand/supply planning data and a real understanding of where the planning system ends and the data lake begins.
Highly fluent in SQL with experience writing complex queries for operational and financial data extraction, reconciliation, and modeling.
Expertise in dimensional modeling for hardware/operations reporting (conformed dimensions across SKU, product generation, channel, geo, supplier; slowly-changing dimensions for product and cost hierarchies; period-over-period comparisons).
Experience with dbt — including tests, documentation, exposures, and contracts.
Experience with Databricks strongly preferred (Unity Catalog, Databricks SQL, Lakeflow, Genie); deep Snowflake experience acceptable with willingness to migrate.
Experience with modern BI tools (Tableau, Looker, Databricks SQL Dashboards, Power BI) and a clear point of view on when each is the right fit.
Track record of working alongside external auditors (PwC, Deloitte, EY, KPMG) and building documentation that withstands audit review.
Excellent verbal and written communication skills — able to brief an operations or finance leader on a number, then explain to an analyst how the data behind it works.
Thrive in a fast-paced, highly collaborative global work environment that spans factories, warehouses, and offices across time zones.


What Makes You Stand Out


Familiarity with adjacent tooling and sources: AWS, GitHub, NetSuite/ERP, Fivetran, Python, semantic layers, EDI/3PL logistics feeds, and contract-manufacturer (CM) data integrations.
Experience standing up a hardware data contract and product/SKU dimension (dim_hardware) from scratch in a high-growth consumer hardware company.
Experience building governed KPI programs through a formal external audit (e.g., PwC, Big 4), including COGS, inventory, and units-sold reconciliation.
Expertise in data visualization theory — you understand how to choose the right chart for the right operational message and why exec dashboards fail when they don’t.

Competitive salary and equity packages

20 days of paid time off plus 13 paid holidays plus 8 days of flexible wellness time off
Paid sick leave and parental leave

  • Coordinate with source-system owners across ERP, manufacturing, logistics, and e-commerce (NetSuite, contract-manufacturer feeds, 3PL/logistics data, Zuora) and the Data Engineering team to ensure clean ingestion, correct dimensional modeling, and clear lineage from purchase orders and factory output through to sell-through and activation.
  • Resolve systems data quality issue to ensure that reporting is trustworthy end to end.
  • Build and maintain the Hardware/SC domain’s data products in Databricks, mentoring analysts on dimensional modeling, dbt practices, and the Golden Path for publishing governed metrics for reporting and for MCP/agentic AI consumption.

Tooling & Innovation

  • Continuously evaluate emerging tools (Unity Catalog, Databricks Genie, AI-assisted SQL/modeling via Cursor and Claude Code, semantic-layer technologies) to improve productivity and accuracy in hardware and supply chain reporting.

  • 7+ years in analytics, business intelligence, or a related data-focused role, with at least 3+ years specifically supporting Hardware, Supply Chain, Operations, Manufacturing, or Logistics.

  • Deep working knowledge of hardware and supply chain data domains: units sold and sell-through, COGS and landed cost, BOM and component costing, inventory (on-hand, in-transit, days of supply), warranty and RMA/returns, manufacturing yield, and how transactional systems (NetSuite/ERP, contract-manufacturer and 3PL feeds, e-commerce platforms) flow into reported numbers.
  • Hands-on experience with demand/supply planning data and a real understanding of where the planning system ends and the data lake begins.
  • Highly fluent in SQL with experience writing complex queries for operational and financial data extraction, reconciliation, and modeling.
  • Expertise in dimensional modeling for hardware/operations reporting (conformed dimensions across SKU, product generation, channel, geo, supplier; slowly-changing dimensions for product and cost hierarchies; period-over-period comparisons).
  • Experience with dbt — including tests, documentation, exposures, and contracts.
  • Experience with Databricks strongly preferred (Unity Catalog, Databricks SQL, Lakeflow, Genie); deep Snowflake experience acceptable with willingness to migrate.
  • Experience with modern BI tools (Tableau, Looker, Databricks SQL Dashboards, Power BI) and a clear point of view on when each is the right fit.
  • Track record of working alongside external auditors (PwC, Deloitte, EY, KPMG) and building documentation that withstands audit review.
  • Excellent verbal and written communication skills — able to brief an operations or finance leader on a number, then explain to an analyst how the data behind it works.
  • Thrive in a fast-paced, highly collaborative global work environment that spans factories, warehouses, and offices across time zones.

What Makes You Stand Out

  • Familiarity with adjacent tooling and sources: AWS, GitHub, NetSuite/ERP, Fivetran, Python, semantic layers, EDI/3PL logistics feeds, and contract-manufacturer (CM) data integrations.
  • Experience standing up a hardware data contract and product/SKU dimension (dim_hardware) from scratch in a high-growth consumer hardware company.
  • Experience building governed KPI programs through a formal external audit (e.g., PwC, Big 4), including COGS, inventory, and units-sold reconciliation.
  • Expertise in data visualization theory — you understand how to choose the right chart for the right operational message and why exec dashboards fail when they don’t.

Title: Data Analyst, In-Store
Description:
About The Team

The SevenRooms Data & Analytics team is the foundational data hub powering go-to-market, product, finance, and operational decisions across the In-Store business. We design and maintain the pipelines, models, and infrastructure that connect SevenRooms' systems with the broader DoorDash data ecosystem — and we're investing aggressively in making our datasets ready for both human and AI consumption. Within the team, our product-focused analytics work owns the funnels, personas, and feature-adoption insights that inform what products and features get built, how it's launched, and how it performs in the market.

About The Role

We're hiring a Data Analyst to be the data partner for our Product Management, Product Marketing, and executive teams at SevenRooms. You will own the building of data products, feature launch analytics, and the PLG instrumentation that connects product usage signals back into Salesforce, Gainsight, and our outbound motions.

You will report into the Manager, Data & Analytics on our Data & Analytics team in our SevenRooms organization.

You're Excited About This Opportunity Because You Will…


Own product analytics end-to-end — funnels, adoption, retention, and ROI for every major feature launch on the SevenRooms platform.
Build net new data products aimed at improving analytic and reporting capabilities
Partner with Product Managers and Product Marketers on pre-launch hypotheses , beta testing results, post-launch measurement, and ongoing optimization.
Design and ship PLG automations that translate product behavior into opportunity tagging, expansion signals, and CSM workflows.
Apply GenAI and ML techniques — partnering with our GTM Engineer — to product analytics use cases like web-sourced feature adoption opportunities, transactions predictive modeling, and Add-On ICP scoring.
Communicate closely in support of multiple PM’s with reporting and ad-hoc analysis


We're Excited About You Because…


A degree in Math, Physics, Statistics, Economics, Computer Science, or a similar domain
2+ years of experience analyzing product data and partnering with Product Management teams in a SaaS environment.
Expert SQL skills and proficiency with a cloud BI tool such as Looker, Tableau, or Mode.
Hands-on experience with product instrumentation and analytics platforms such as Pendo, Amplitude, Mixpanel, or Heap.
Demonstrated ability to translate ambiguous product questions into rigorous, scoped analyses that ship recommendations — not just dashboards.
Strong written and verbal communication skills, including comfort presenting to product and executive audiences.


Compensation

The successful candidate’s starting pay will fall within the pay range listed below and is determined based on job-related factors including, but not limited to, skills, experience, qualifications, work location, and market conditions. Base salary is localized according to an employee’s work location. Ranges are market-dependent and may be modified in the future.

In addition to base salary, the compensation for this role includes opportunities for equity grants. Talk to your recruiter for more information.

Title: CX Data Analyst
Description:
Why Harvey

At Harvey, we’re transforming how legal and professional services operate. By combining frontier agentic AI, an enterprise-grade platform, and deep domain expertise, we’re reshaping how critical knowledge work gets done for decades to come.

This is a rare chance to help build a generational company at a true inflection point. We have strong product-market fit and world-class investor support. We’re scaling fast and defining a new category in real time. The work is ambitious, the bar is high, and the opportunity for growth — personal, professional, and financial — is unmatched.

Our team moves fast, takes ownership, and is deeply committed to the mission — operating with intensity, staying close to our customers, and pushing each other for excellence. We live by three values: Decisiveness, Simplicity, and Job's Not Finished. We act quickly on clear judgment over perfect information, we believe simplicity is what scales, and we're never satisfied with where we are. If you want to do the best work of your career alongside people who share that drive, we'd love to build with you.

At Harvey, the future of professional services is being written today — and we’re just getting started.

Role Overview

Customer Experience runs on data — but right now, that data lives in too many places, speaks too many languages, and reaches the wrong people too late. This role exists to fix that.

As Harvey's first Support Operations Data Analyst, you'll own the analytics function for the Customer Experience org. You'll build and maintain the dashboards, reports, and feedback loops that tell us whether we're hitting our north stars — cSAT, TTR, QA scores, escalation rates — and surface the signal underneath the numbers so we can act on it. You'll sit within the Support Operations team, reporting to the Support Operations Manager, and work closely with Customer Experience leadership and Harvey's central data team to ensure the org is equipped with the right instrumentation as we scale.

This is a solo role. You won't have a team beneath you. You will need to be fluent enough in support analytics to hold the function independently, confident enough to push back on how metrics are framed, and fast enough to operate at Harvey's pace.

What You'll Do


Own recurring reporting for Customer Experience — weekly, monthly, and QBR-ready — tailored to ops, leadership, and cross-functional audiences
Translate support data into clear narratives: what's happening, why, and what to do about it
Track and maintain north star metrics: cSAT, TTR by tier, QA scores, bug escalation rate to EPD, and First Response Time
Build and maintain self-serve dashboards that give the ops team and leadership real-time visibility into support performance
Partner with Support Systems to ensure Zendesk is instrumented to capture the data we need
Work with Harvey's central data team to connect support data to broader product and customer data sources
Identify and close data collection gaps — if we can't measure it, help define how we should
Design feedback loops that connect support signals to Product, Engineering, and Customer Success
Quantify the operational cost of product bugs, feature gaps, and onboarding failures
Contribute to QA analytics as the QA program matures
Track ticket deflection, AI/chatbot performance, and self-service effectiveness
Measure the impact of AI-driven support — containment rate, escalation rate from AI interactions, resolution quality — and surface findings that drive how we tune and invest in those tools
Support ad hoc analytical requests from the Support Operations Manager, Customer Experience leadership, and senior stakeholders


Required

What You Have


3–5 years of experience in analytics, with at least 2 years directly in support operations, customer success operations, or a closely adjacent function
Fluency in support platform data — you know how Zendesk (or equivalent) is structured, what data it produces, and what it doesn't
SQL proficiency — you can write complex queries against large datasets without hand-holding (CTEs, window functions, joins across schemas)
Dashboard experience — you've built and maintained operational dashboards in Looker, Tableau, Sigma, Omni, or equivalent
Reporting for multiple audiences — you know the difference between what a frontline manager needs and what a CFO needs, and you build accordingly
Strong data storytelling — you don't just present numbers, you write the narrative
Comfort operating solo — you don't need a team around you to deliver, and you don't need a ticket to tell you what to look at


Strong Plus


Experience with Python for data manipulation or automation
Familiarity with dbt or similar data transformation tooling
Experience building or contributing to QA analytics programs
Background supporting enterprise SaaS or AI-native products
Experience working with Zendesk APIs or extracting data beyond standard reporting


Key Attributes


AI-native: you use AI tooling actively in your analytical workflows — not as a novelty, but as a force multiplier
Pace: you move in hours and days, not weeks. You surface findings before anyone has to ask
Judgment: you know which metrics matter and which are vanity. You push back when framing is wrong
Clarity: your outputs are direct, jargon-free, and actionable. You write for the reader, not yourself
Ownership: you treat Customer Experience analytics as your problem to solve, not a ticket queue to process


Compensation

$112,000 - $168,000 USD

Depending on your location, an Applicant Privacy Notice may apply to you. You can find all of our Applicant Privacy Notices [here].

Harvey is an equal opportunity employer and does not discriminate on the basis of race, gender, sexual orientation, gender identity/expression, national origin, disability, age, genetic information, veteran status, marital status, pregnancy or related condition, or any other basis protected by law.

We are committed to providing reasonable accommodations to applicants with disabilities, and requests can be made by emailing accommodations@harvey.ai

Title: Data Analyst
Description:
Company: Aaratech Inc.

Employment Type: Full-Time, W2 (deployed to client projects)

Experience: 2–4 years

Compensation: $65,000 – $75,000 per year

Work Mode: On-Site / Hybrid

Work Authorization

At this time, we are only able to consider candidates who are authorized to work in the United States without sponsorship.

Why This Role?

Your dashboards can improve patient outcomes. Healthcare analytics is one of the most stable, fastest-growing corners of data — and analysts who know claims, clinical, and quality data are in constant demand across payers and providers.

Job Summary

Aaratech Inc. is seeking a Data Analyst – Healthcare to transform clinical, claims, and operational data into insight. You will build quality and utilization reporting, support value-based care analytics, and deliver findings that improve patient outcomes and operational efficiency — always within HIPAA compliance.

Key Responsibilities

Gather, clean, and analyze clinical, claims, and operational healthcare datasets using SQL and Python.
Design and maintain dashboards in Power BI or Tableau for utilization, cost of care, and quality measures.
Support quality reporting programs — HEDIS, CMS Stars, and value-based care metrics.
Analyze claims (837/835), eligibility, and EHR/EMR data to identify cost drivers and care gaps.
Ensure all data handling complies with HIPAA and organizational privacy/security requirements.
Collaborate with clinical, operations, and IT teams to support data-driven decisions.
Present analytical findings and recommendations to stakeholders.

Qualifications

Bachelor's degree in Data Science, Computer Science, Information Technology, Business Analytics, or a related field.
2–4 years of experience as a Data Analyst, preferably in healthcare (provider, payer, or health-tech).
Strong, hands-on SQL skills — complex joins, window functions, CTEs, and query optimization.
Proficiency with Power BI or Tableau, plus advanced Microsoft Excel (Power Query, pivot tables, advanced formulas).
Hands-on experience with healthcare data — claims, clinical, EHR/EMR, or quality reporting.
Strong analytical, data-storytelling, and stakeholder-communication skills.

Tools & Technologies You Will Use

Analytics & querying: SQL (SQL Server, Oracle), Python (pandas, NumPy) or R.
BI & visualization: Power BI (DAX, Power Query), Tableau, Excel.
Healthcare data & standards: HL7, FHIR, ICD-10, CPT/HCPCS, 837/835 claims formats.
Domain systems: Epic (Clarity/Caboodle), Cerner, or other EHR reporting environments; cloud platforms such as Snowflake or Azure health data services.

Preferred Skills

Knowledge of HEDIS, CMS Stars, risk adjustment (HCC), or population-health analytics.
Experience with SSRS or automated reporting pipelines.
Familiarity with statistical analysis for outcomes or utilization studies.
Certifications such as Microsoft PL-300, Tableau Desktop Specialist, CHDA, or Google Data Analytics Professional Certificate are a plus.

About Aaratech Inc.

Aaratech Inc. is a technology-driven organization delivering innovative solutions across cybersecurity, data & analytics, healthcare, and enterprise domains. We are committed to helping organizations transform data into actionable insights through advanced analytics, modern technologies, and data-driven innovation.

Title: Research Data Analyst 2 (Hybrid Opportunity)
Description:
Job Description

Stanford’s Division of Computational Medicine brings together expertise in biomedical informatics, data science, and medicine to tackle complex questions about human health. We develop computational and statistical methods that help researchers make sense of health data and generate evidence for clinical and translational research.

We are seeking a Research Data Analyst 2 to help reveal how rare diseases emerge in patients’ medical histories. Working with electronic health records from Stanford patients with confirmed diagnoses, you will develop methods to identify patient cohorts and reconstruct diagnostic journeys across 10 rare diseases. Your work will connect information from clinical notes, diagnoses, procedures, medications, and laboratory results to support research on disease recognition and risk modeling.

In this role, you will contribute throughout the research process, from translating clinical questions into computational methods to evaluating results and sharing findings in publications and presentations. You will write Python and SQL code, build tools that bring clinical expertise into method development, and work closely with faculty, clinicians, and technical researchers. This is an opportunity to apply your programming and analytical skills to clinically meaningful questions while deepening your experience in biomedical data science.

Primary Responsibilities


Develop and evaluate methods to identify rare-disease cohorts using structured EHR data and clinical text.
Build reproducible pipelines that organize clinical events into patient diagnostic timelines.
Create annotation and review tools that help clinicians validate extracted information and guide improvements.
Investigate data-quality issues and extraction errors, using clinical feedback to refine computational methods.
Develop performance metrics and automated tests for timeline extraction and downstream disease-risk models.
Translate analyses into clear datasets, figures, reports, presentations, and manuscript contributions.
Document methods, validation results, and limitations so research findings can be understood and reproduced.
Collaborate with clinical and technical colleagues to shape methods, interpret results, and advance the research.


This position offers a hybrid schedule, with onsite work three days per week, subject to operational needs. Please submit a resume and cover letter describing your relevant experience and interest in computational approaches to rare-disease research.

Responsibilities

Core Duties:


Prioritize and extract data from a variety of sources such as notes, survey results, medical reports, and laboratory data, and maintain its accuracy and completeness.
Determine additional data collection and reporting requirements.
Design and customize reports based upon data in the database. Oversee and monitor regulatory compliance for utilization of the data.
Use system reports and analyses to identify potentially problematic data, make corrections, and eliminate root cause for data problems or justify solutions to be implemented by others.
Create complex charts and databases, perform statistical analyses, and develop graphs and tables for publication and presentation.
Serve as a resource for non-routine inquiries such as requests for statistics or surveys.
Test prototype software and participate in approval and release process for new software.
Provide documentation based on audit and reporting criteria to investigators and research staff.


Minimum Education

Bachelor's degree and three years of relevant experience or combination of education and relevant experience.

Minimum Experience

Experience in a quantitative discipline such as economics, finance, statistics or engineering.

Knowledge, Skills And Abilities


Substantial experience with MS Office and analytical programs.
Excellent writing and analytical skills.
Ability to prioritize workload.

Title: Sr. Marketing Data Analyst
Description:
The Role

Pilot is hiring a Senior Marketing Data Analyst to own our marketing analytics and uplevel our data-driven decision-making as we embark on the fastest-growing and quickest-evolving time in our company’s history.

Pilot has spent years providing reliable back office services to over 3,000 businesses so they can focus on running their business. This year we announced our AI accounting platform, Meridian, and it has quickly become an industry leader because it was built with the nearly a decade of experience Pilot has building a platform for accountants and providing high quality accounting services. While this new product is exciting, it comes with a plethora of new complexity as we strive to grow our current back office services while also rapidly growing our AI platform clientele.

Marketing is the biggest single driver of our revenue and is our largest spend line. With Meridian, our marketing motion is rapidly changing: more events, more brand investment, and more channels. With this, attribution, tracking, and reporting get harder and harder but more and more important. We need someone experienced and knowledgeable in the domain to lead our analytics to where it needs to go.

As a Senior Marketing Data Analyst, you will work closely with the marketing team and company leadership to own marketing analytics across attribution, channel economics, experimentation, and incrementality. You will identify which channel dollars are paying off and how we should reallocate our budget to maximize revenue efficiency. Most importantly, you will own closing the gap between us being data-informed and having a data-driven marketing engine.

This is a strong fit for someone who strives to turn data and analytics into actionable insights and tangible impact, and who works with high-level leaders not just as a consumer of their data asks, but as a partner in finding the right data solutions.

Pilot’s data stack is Snowflake, dbt, and Looker, with Marketo, Marketo Measure, and Salesforce on the marketing side. We are active users of Claude Code to make our processes more efficient and our output more prolific.

Location: San Francisco, CA (3 days/week in office—Mondays, Tuesdays, and Thursdays).

Key Responsibilities


Own attribution: make campaign-level multi-touch attribution usable and move marketers off Salesforce campaign influence reporting
Own channel efficiency at the top of the funnel: cost per lead, per SQL, and per pipeline dollar by channel and campaign group, and recommendations on where to allocate the next dollar
Design, run, and report on incrementality tests, including holdout and geo tests
Measure brand and event channels: podcast and conference sponsorships, advertorial, webinars, and brand spend. Group channels where a channel-by-channel read is not possible, and use observed lift where a controlled test is not available
Own marketing unit economics: LTV, CAC, and CAC payback by segment, cost to serve, and the ideal customer profile for our direct business
Build GTM analytics for our new product line as deal volume arrives: lead scoring, closed-lost analysis, and engagement depth
Support lifecycle and nurture marketing: measurement for a team that does not source its own leads, and driver analysis on re-engagement
Define the marketing data model: the sources, metrics, and models the work depends on. Build them in dbt where you can, and partner with our analytics engineer on ingestion and the heavier platform work
Build reporting that marketers can run on their own for campaign and channel performance
Partner with marketing leadership in their planning and budget cycles, and take on work outside marketing when the business needs it


About You

Even if you don’t have experience with the specific technologies in our stack, we’d love to talk to you!


5+ years in analytics, including owning a business domain and the stakeholder relationships in it
Deep marketing analytics experience: channel performance across paid and organic, the funnel from lead through closed-won, and the unit economics on top of it
Has built or replaced an attribution model, and can explain where it breaks down
Experience designing and reading out incrementality tests, whether geo, holdout, or comparable, including the statistical work in Python or R
Designs the comparisons and controls a finding needs, and states plainly what the data does and does not support
Strong SQL, and builds reporting in Looker or a comparable BI tool that non-analysts use on their own. Comfortable building and extending models in dbt, or able to pick it up quickly
Works directly with executives, including reframing a request that will not answer the underlying question


Working Style


Values diversity and fosters inclusion on a team with a wide range of identities and experiences
Partners with the teams they support on what the right question is, rather than taking the request as given
Drives to find new tools and ways of working, and spreads them to uplevel the team and the partners they work with
Takes pride in end-to-end ownership. Cares that the numbers are trusted and used, with a point of view about where the domain should go


Nice-to-Haves


Media mix modeling or other top-down measurement experience
Marketo and Marketo Measure, or comparable marketing automation and attribution tools
Salesforce, including campaign influence reporting
Ad platform APIs, PartnerStack, GA, or other spend and engagement sources
Brand or offline measurement experience
ABM account funnel work
Production dbt experience
B2B SaaS with both sales-led and self-serve motions
Fintech, accounting software, or professional services background


About Pilot

Pilot launched in 2017 to bring the back office into the modern era. Pilot provides small businesses with dedicated finance experts - which Pilot hires as full-time, U.S.-based employees - who learn the ins-and-outs of their business. Pilot integrates directly with the billing, banking, expense, and payroll systems customers already use. With a special blend of custom software and expert bookkeepers, Pilot delivers accurate, consistent bookkeeping and financial management and tax services that give entrepreneurs the freedom to focus on their business.

Pilot has over 3,000 customers and has raised over $170 million in financing from Sequoia, Index Ventures, Stripe, Bezos Expeditions, and Whale Rock. Our investors also include a long list of world-class entrepreneurs, including Patrick and John Collison, Drew Houston, and Diane Greene. Our most recent funding round doubled our valuation to $1.2 billion – Meet Fintech’s Newest Unicorn.

Why Pilot?


We invest in our employees’ development and happiness because our employees are the keys to our success and ensuring happy customers
The opportunity to join a seasoned founding team that has led companies through two prior successful startups and acquisitions (by Oracle and Dropbox).
Flexible vacation/time-off policy
All federal holidays are observed
Competitive benefits package including additional wellness benefits
Parental leave for birthing or non-birthing parents – 100% pay for 12 weeks
401(k) plan


The base pay range target for the role seniority described in this job description is $126,000 - $170,000 in San Francisco, CA. Final offer amounts depend on multiple factors such as candidate experience and expertise, geographic location, total compensation, and market data. In addition to cash pay, full-time regular positions are eligible for equity, 401(k), health benefits, and other benefits; some of these benefits may be available for part-time or temporary positions.

The Opportunity

Lingo, Abbott's consumer wearable division, brings continuous glucose monitoring (CGM) technology to everyday consumers, combining biosensor data, real-time analytics, and personalized insights to help people live fuller, healthier lives. The Lingo team embodies a start-up culture and mindset with the backing of Abbott, a company with a rich history of healthcare innovation.

We're looking for a Data Analyst to serve as a critical analytical partner across customer service, operations, and direct-to-consumer (DTC) channels. This role sits at the center of data, insights, and decision-making, providing visibility into customer behavior, operational performance, and ecommerce trends to help drive better business outcomes.

Reporting to the Director, DTC, Operations, Customer Service & PMO, this individual will own the development and maintenance of key reporting, dashboards, and performance metrics that enable teams to identify opportunities, solve problems, and improve the customer experience.

You will work cross-functionally with Customer Service, Operations, Ecommerce, Marketing, Supply Chain, and external partners to transform data into actionable insights. The ideal candidate is highly analytical, comfortable working across multiple datasets and systems, and passionate about building scalable reporting solutions that improve visibility and decision making.

If you're motivated by turning complex data into meaningful business insights and enjoy influencing outcomes through analytics, this role provides significant ownership and impact.

This is an onsite opportunity in Alameda, CA.

What You’ll Work On


Own customer service analytics and reporting, delivering insights into performance, customer behavior, and operational effectiveness.
Analyze key customer service metrics including contact volume, case resolution, escalations, response times, customer satisfaction, and root causes of customer issues.
Partner with Customer Service leadership to identify process improvement opportunities and enhance the customer experience.
Develop and maintain dashboards, scorecards, and reporting packages that provide actionable business insights and support decision-making.
Monitor and report on operational performance metrics, including OTIF, order fulfillment, inventory health, backorders, and shipping performance.
Identify trends, risks, and opportunities impacting customer experience, inventory position, and operational efficiency.
Collaborate cross-functionally with Customer Service, Operations, Supply Chain, Ecommerce, Marketing, and fulfillment teams to improve reporting visibility and data integrity.
Build automated, scalable reporting solutions and establish consistent metric definitions and reporting standards.
Support website and DTC analytics by analyzing traffic, customer journeys, conversion rates, engagement, funnel performance, and retention trends.
Provide ad hoc analysis and data-driven recommendations to support growth initiatives, business reviews, and strategic projects.
Investigate data issues, reporting discrepancies, and business questions to ensure data accuracy and confidence.
Champion data governance, business intelligence, and a data-driven culture by making insights accessible and actionable across the organization.


Required Qualifications


Bachelor's degree required; Business Analytics, Statistics, Supply Chain, Economics, Information Systems, or related field preferred.
5+ years of experience in business analytics, operations analytics, customer service analytics, ecommerce analytics, or related fields.
Experience building dashboards, scorecards, and executive-level reporting.
Strong experience analyzing operational, customer, and commercial performance data.
Experience partnering with cross-functional teams to translate business needs into reporting and analytical solutions.
Experience managing large datasets and working with multiple data sources.
Tableau experience required.


Preferred Qualifications


Experience supporting DTC or Ecommerce business models.
Experience analyzing customer service performance metrics and consumer behavior.
Experience with inventory management, fulfillment, or supply chain reporting.
Experience developing executive dashboards and KPI frameworks.
Experience supporting customer experience improvement initiatives through analytics.
Experience working with data visualization and business intelligence platforms.
Experience in healthcare, medical device, wellness, or consumer products industries.
Experience working in fast-paced, high-growth environments.


The base pay for this position is $90,000.00 – $180,000.00. In specific locations, the pay range may vary from the range posted.

Description:
Innovate with purpose

By replacing outdated financial processes with innovative tools, we help businesses—from startups to established brands—make smarter decisions and gain control of their operations. And we don’t stop there: we’re creating the future of financial automation so businesses can spend more time on what matters.

Working here means you become part of a vision-driven team that’s ready to tackle challenges and build cutting-edge solutions. We value purpose, drive, and curiosity—and we thrive in a fast-paced, ever-changing environment. We're remote-first, with office spaces in San Jose, CA and Draper, UT — and opportunities to connect in person when it counts. We’d love to hear from you—you might be just what we’re looking for, whether in this role or another.

Make Your Impact Within a Rapidly Growing Fintech Company

As part of the Product Analytics team, you will be the analytics owner for our Accounts Payable product. Not a role that runs the analyses Product hands you but one that finds the analysis Product did not know to ask for: the metric that is quietly wrong, the automation nobody noticed, the deep dive that changes a roadmap call. You will work directly with Product, Engineering, and AP leadership, with real ownership and executive visibility from day one.

Responsibilities


Set the analytics agenda for AP. Find product opportunities, data gaps, and automation candidates, and bring them to Product as recommendations that shape the roadmap.
Own the AP analytics relationship: metric and OKR definition, a standing review cadence with Product, and a deep-dive practice you drive.
Run experiments and apply causal inference, so recommendations rest on what moved a metric, not on correlation.
Build and maintain production-grade data models in dbt with tests, documentation, and version-controlled workflows.
Build with AI-assisted workflows by default, and automate recurring reporting to free your time for higher-value work.
Drive executive reporting and its adoption across leadership and Product.
Present with confidence to senior stakeholders, and hold your ground when a metric is contested.
Partner with data engineering to validate data quality and metric definitions, and fix documentation-to-logic drift when you find it.


We would love to chat if you have


5+ years in product analytics, data science or a related quantitative field, owning a domain end to end.
A track record of self-directed work: finding high-impact problems and shipping the fix.
Advanced SQL and strong Python.
Production experience with dbt or similar: models, tests, documentation, version-controlled review.
Fluency in experimentation and causal inference, and the judgment to know when an experiment is the right tool.
Genuine AI-native fluency. You build with agentic coding tools already, and you know from experience where their output can and cannot be trusted.
The judgment to turn an ambiguous question into a metrics framework, and the spine to defend it.
Data storytelling that turns a complex finding into a decision a product team acts on.

Title: Sales Operations Data Analyst
Description:
Cytek Biosciences is a leading life sciences technology company advancing the next generation of cell analysis solutions for biomedical research, drug discovery, and clinical research. The company develops innovative flow cytometry and cell analysis technologies designed to provide researchers with high-resolution, high-content, and high-sensitivity data to better understand complex biological systems.

Cytek is recognized for its patented Full Spectrum Profiling™ (FSP®) technology, which captures the full fluorescence spectrum from multiple lasers to enable highly multiplexed and sensitive single-cell analysis. Its portfolio includes advanced flow cytometry platforms such as the Cytek Aurora®, Northern Lights™, Aurora CS, Aurora Evo, and Borealis™, along with reagents, software, and services that provide integrated solutions for researchers.

Headquartered in Fremont, California, Cytek serves pharmaceutical and biotechnology companies, contract research organizations, and leading academic research institutions worldwide. The company’s mission is to enable scientists to obtain deeper biological insights and accelerate scientific innovation through powerful, accessible cell-analysis technologies.

The Sales Operations Data Analyst will drive forecasting excellence, process optimization, and advanced analytics initiatives across our global sales organization. In this role, the candidate supports forecast accuracy improvements, leads sophisticated projects to streamline operational efficiency, and contributes to data-driven initiatives by applying advanced data processing techniques to extract, combine, and analyze data from multiple CRM and ERP sources. This role will focus on collaborating with Global Sales Leadership, Finance, Operations, and IT teams.

Essential Duties And Responsibilities

To perform this job successfully, an individual must be able to perform essential duties and responsibilities satisfactorily.


Improve forecast reliability and accuracy for enterprise products, focusing on forecasting support and providing actionable insights for strategic accounts.
Incorporate data insights to guide sales strategies, inform business decisions, and align with forecasting objectives.
Assist with global data reconciliation across CRM, financial, and forecasting systems to validate data, resolve discrepancies, and ensure consistent, reliable reporting.
Ensure data hygiene in Salesforce and forecasting platforms by managing product updates, system configurations, pricing analysis and conducting regular pipeline reviews.
Establish metrics to measure forecasting performance, pipeline health, and data quality, and pinpoint areas for process improvement.
Provide hands-on support to the sales team by managing pipeline data, sales attainment dashboards, troubleshooting system issues, and delivering training and tools to enable efficient forecasting workflows.
Support forecasting projects, process automation, and analytics improvements to improve sales projections and operational scalability.
Perform exploratory data analysis to identify data inconsistencies, patterns, trends, and correlations in large data sets.
Support the identification and resolution of data anomalies, working closely with stakeholders to address issues promptly.
Extract reliable data from various sources to identify key insights and opportunities and challenges our clients should act on.
Conduct ad hoc analyses to answer specific business questions and provide accurate and actionable recommendations.


Requirements & Qualifications

The requirements listed below are representative of the knowledge, skill, and/or ability required.


Bachelor’s degree in a related discipline.
5+ years of data analytics experience; leading multiple projects of various scope/complexity from initiation to closeout, with data quality as a focus.
Exceptional data expertise in all aspects of data analysis, insights creation, and visualization.
Advanced CRM and ERP data processing skills, including building advanced reports and queries.
Strong flexibility to work with a variety of application development applications.
Exceptional organizational skills, detail-oriented, adaptive, and strong client-focused mindset.
Advanced Excel skills and proficiency in Salesforce, SAP, and Integrated Business Planning (IBP), experience with Python, SQL, or other data tools is a plus.
Background in supporting instrument manufacturing and life science products in forecasting or revenue planning is highly preferred.
Ability to manage a variety of tasks with tight timelines.
Excellent quantitative, analytical, written, and oral communication skills.
Comfortable navigating through ambiguity and crafting solutions without a defined guideline.
Strong work ethic and highly developed problem-solving skills.
Enjoy working under time constraints and can excel under pressure.


PHYSICAL DEMANDS AND WORK ENVIRONMENT:  

The physical demands described here are representative of those that an employee must meet to perform the essential functions of this job successfully. Reasonable accommodations may be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform essential functions. 


The role is on-site in the Fremont, CA office.
Individuals may be required to travel to and from Cytek offices and other locations, as needed.
Prolonged periods of sitting and working on a computer.


Cytek is an equal-opportunity employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, age, religion, sex, gender identity, sexual orientation, national origin, genetic information, disability status, veteran status, or any other characteristic protected by law.

Title: Vice President, Senior Data Analyst - SMA Solutions
Description:
About This Role

Team Overview

BlackRock SMA Solutions helps clients customize portfolios for unique tax, values-alignment, or investment exposures across direct indexing, fixed income, active equity, and multi-asset. We deliver world-class service to all of our clients, from wealth advisors to family offices to endowments and foundations.

About This Role

The Senior SMA Data Analyst is responsible for ensuring the integrity, accuracy, and operational reliability of client and account data across Salesforce and Entity Master platforms supporting SMA Solutions.

This role sits at the intersection of business operations and technology, requiring a combination of hands-on data analysis, technical proficiency, and strong business judgment. The data analyst will play a critical role in resolving daily data discrepancies that impact account onboarding, servicing, and client workflows, while contributing to long-term data quality and automation initiatives.

The need for this role is driven by a continuous volume of data reconciliation issues that require dedicated ownership to maintain day-to-day business continuity.

The successful candidate will combine strong analytical and technical skills with business context to support account onboarding, client servicing, operational workflows, and strategic data quality initiatives across SMA Solutions.

Key Responsibilities


Perform manual reconciliation of data discrepancies between CRM and Master Data Management across various client defining objects
Resolve data breaks that impact operational workflows, including onboarding blockers and sync failures
Support the development of automated reconciliation capabilities as part of the broader data quality roadmap
Investigate recurring data issues, including:
Record merges originating from Data Operations Team
Duplicate records and conflicting attributes across systems
Missing or incomplete MDM records
Operationally significant contact conflicts
Conduct root cause analysis and recommend scalable, systemic solutions
Track and monitor ongoing data reconciliation issues and patterns
Develop reporting to quantify issue volume, trends, and business impact
Escalate high-frequency or systemic issues to Salesforce Engineering, Data Engineering, or Data Operations teams for resolution
Utilize SQL, SOQL, and Excel to query, analyze, and remediate data across Salesforce and MDM datasets
Perform validation and reconciliation across multiple data sources, including Snowflake where applicable
Develop a strong understanding of business processes, including:
Account onboarding and servicing workflows
Client hierarchy and relationship models
Operationally significant records and dependencies
Apply business context to inform reconciliation decisions and prioritization
Maintain clear documentation of reconciliation processes, issue types, and resolution steps
Build process guides, playbooks, and onboarding materials
Identify opportunities to streamline workflows and reduce manual effort
Partner cross-functionally across business, data operations, and IT Engineering teams
Act as a bridge between business users and technical teams to drive resolution of data issues


Required Qualifications


Bachelor's degree or equivalent experience in Data Analytics, Information Systems, Computer Science, Finance, or a related field
Strong proficiency in SQL, SOQL, Excel, and data analysis techniques
Experience working with Salesforce or similar CRM and enterprise data platforms
Familiarity with Snowflake, Power BI, Python, or similar analytical and reporting tools
Strong understanding of data governance, data quality, and reconciliation processes
Deep familiarity with relational data models, master data concepts, and complex entity relationships
Ability to investigate data issues, perform root cause analysis, and implement scalable solutions
Strong analytical, problem-solving, communication, and stakeholder management skills


Preferred Qualifications


Experience within the financial services, wealth management, asset management, banking, or brokerage industry
Understanding of advisor, client, account, and corporate hierarchy structures, including intermediary and end-investor relationships
Experience supporting client data, master data, data quality, or reference data management functions
Experience designing or validating automated reconciliation processes and data quality controls

Title: Senior Finance Data Analyst
Description:
NVIDIA has been transforming computer graphics, PC gaming, and accelerated computing for more than 25 years. It’s a unique legacy of innovation that’s fueled by great technology—and amazing people. Today, we’re tapping into the unlimited potential of AI to define the next era of computing. An era in which our GPU acts as the brains of computers, robots, and self-driving cars that can understand the world. Doing what’s never been done before takes vision, innovation, and the world’s best talent. As an NVIDIAN, you’ll be immersed in a diverse, supportive environment where everyone is inspired to do their best work. Come join the team and see how you can make a lasting impact on the world.

We are seeking an exceptional Senior Finance Data Analyst to join our Corporate Finance Investments team based out of our Santa Clara campus. As an integral member of the team, our organization’s overarching responsibilities are to provide the highest caliber of relevant financial and business information that is both informative and measurable, enabling effective decision-making at all levels of the Company and improving our financial performance. This is a critical position within the Finance organization, requiring deep finance analytics experience, advanced automation and data skills, attention to detail, and ability to deliver to Company’s timelines. We are looking for an upbeat individual who thrives in a collaborative, fast-paced and execution-oriented environment passionate about achieving goals, and with good communication skills.

What You’ll Be Doing


Act as a translator and steward of operating expense, capital, headcount and purchase order data, guiding users to understand and properly leverage data sources / solutions.
Develop, prototype, build and maintain data solutions by using SQL, AI and BI Tools, financial reporting standards, and database management experience.
Develop AI agents that automate finance processes, collect and transform data, and produce reporting/analysis while maintaining high quality.
Manage multiple workstreams, assess risks/issues and deliver solutions on time.
Ensure solutions are scalable, reliable, secure and meet performance requirements. Support solutions through monitoring data quality, enhancing solutions, resolving issues and training end-users.
Collaborate with multi-functional teams to find opportunities for process optimization, building consensus, automation, and cost reduction.


What We Need To See


5+ years of experience in FP&A, working closely with business partners from multiple departments. Proficiency in Excel, SQL, Python, AI Tools (Claude, Cursor and/or ChatGPT Work), Tableau or Power BI. Strong data modeling skills in SQL is essential.
Bachelor's degree or equivalent experience in Finance, Economics, Business Administration, Business Analytics, Data Science, Information Systems, Computer Science or Engineering. MBA or equivalent experience is a plus.
End-user focused and experienced in delivering game-changing AI and data solutions.
Highly motivated self-starter with the ability to work independently in a fast-paced and ambiguous environment, simultaneously manage several priorities, and challenge the status quo to drive change and operational improvement.
Superb communication and interpersonal skills demonstrating ability to build successful relationships.


Ways To Stand Out From The Crowd


Experience with operating expense, capital, headcount or purchase order data.
Strong ownership ethic and intense focus on accuracy and accountability; take pride of work quality, strive for improvements; operate with strong team-work spirit..
Experience automating finance workflows beyond Excel by developing agents and skills using Claude Code, ChatGPT Work, Cursor, Python and SQL.
Knowledge or experience in SAP S4, SAP BPC, SAP HANA and Databricks.


Widely considered to be one of the technology world’s most desirable employers, NVIDIA offers highly competitive salaries and a comprehensive benefits package. As you plan your future, see what we can offer to you and your family www.nvidiabenefits.com/

Your base salary will be determined based on your location, experience, and the pay of employees in similar positions. The base salary range is 124,000 USD - 195,500 USD for Level 3, and 144,000 USD - 230,000 USD for Level 4.

You will also be eligible for equity and benefits.

Title: Associate Data Scientist
Description:
Why We Exist

Your car and your home are your most important assets, yet the experience of owning them is stuck in the 90s. Every part of the journey — buy/sell, insurance, maintenance, repairs — is fragmented, complicated, and expensive.

Jerry.ai is building the first app to manage it all. We started with car insurance in 2019, became one of the top 3 brokers in the U.S., then added driving insights, diagnostics, and a repair marketplace.

We've reached 5M+ customers, raised $240M+, scaled revenue 70X, and became profitable in early 2024. We're now expanding into adjacent verticals (e.g. home, motorcycle, RV, etc) to become the one-stop-shop for all your physical assets.

Why We’re Hiring

Our Data Science & Analytics team has been a force multiplier and accelerant to our business that has helped us reach these pivotal milestones in spite of headwinds and within a highly competitive market. They are a team of former McKinsey, BCG and Bain consultants who drive data & insights, and inform decision-making across every corner of our business. They are analytical powerhouses and first principles problem solvers who push forward our most important initiatives across product, growth, tech, and operations.

Every business unit has a Data Science team member embedded within it — someone who doesn't just run analyses and build dashboards, but shapes what questions we should ask, what data to pull, what conclusions to draw, what decisions to make, and then drives our teams towards our next goal: go from 5M to 50M customers and become a $10B business in the next 4 years.

As Our Business Continues To Expand, There Is Growing Demand For More Data Science Team Members. We Are Hiring 2-3 People To Drive Impact In These Areas


Growth Marketing
Product Development
AI & Automation
Strategic Partnerships


On leveling: You may see job ads for this role at different job levels. Our priority is finding the right people, we can be flexible with job title/leveling.

Why You Will (Or Won't) Like Working Here


No slides: If you've worked in consulting, you know what it feels like to be up at 3am reformatting a deck. That doesn't exist here. The only work that gets done at Jerry is work that will materially change the trajectory of our business — an important product, a new growth channel, a key metric, a critical partner relationship, etc.
No corporate fluff: The Data Science & Analytics team is 14 insatiable learners who care deeply about solving difficult problems and making a tangible impact. Every person owns a critical domain. There is no bloat, unnecessary meetings, or waiting for approvals.

Title: Lead Workforce Visualization Analyst
Description:
Job Description

Certain terms and conditions of employment for this position, including the rate of pay, benefits, etc., are currently subject to negotiation with the appropriate union.

As part of the People Analytics team, the Lead Workforce Visualization Analyst supports workforce reporting, analytics, and metric development activities that inform operational and strategic decision-making across UCSF. Working under the direction of the Director of People Analytics, the incumbent partners with analysts, engineers, and business stakeholders to investigate workforce questions, develop workforce metrics, conduct analyses, and deliver reporting solutions that support organizational priorities. Working under the direction of the Director of People Analytics, the technically oriented workforce analyst will support leadership requests, develop metrics, conduct analyses, and operationalize business questions into reporting and analytics products.

This role will touch upon the broad portfolio of People Analytics domains, including workforce demographics, workforce movement, human resources operational analytics, occupational health, learning and compliance, engagement, and other workforce-related initiatives.

The incumbent serves as the team's subject matter expert for dashboard user experience, information design, and analytic presentation. In addition to leading visualization design, the incumbent performs workforce analyses, develops metrics, writes SQL and analytical logic, validates results, and partners with engineering to operationalize reporting solutions. The role combines business analysis, technical analytics, and front-end analytics development to deliver enterprise-quality reporting products.

Working closely with data architects, analysts, engineers, and business stakeholders, the incumbent establishes visualization standards, promotes consistency across reporting products, and contributes to the overall user experience of the People Analytics portfolio while independently executing complex assignments and escalating architectural or governance decisions when appropriate.

Department Overview

The mission of the Enterprise Information and Analytics (EIA) department is to advance UCSF’s institutional priorities by enhancing access to and the use of data and analytics, including appropriate data platforms and data governance, in a manner that meets the unique needs across the education, research, and care mission areas. The department achieves its goals by working with clinical, research, education, and business partners to organize, integrate, govern, and transform UCSF’s data assets into actionable insight and information.

People Analytics owns enterprise-wide assets for UCSF as a whole, used for both operational and analytical purposes, as well as departmental and business assets to drive business insights and decisions.

Qualifications

REQUIRED QUALIFICATIONS


Bachelor's degree in a related area and/or equivalent experience/training.
At least 2 years of experience working with structured data using SQL and modern analytics platforms (e.g., Tableau, Power BI, Databricks). Ability to develop analytical logic, reusable metrics, and reporting solutions from enterprise data models.
At least 2 years of experience developing dashboards, reports, or analytical applications from large enterprise data sets using modern business intelligence tools (Power BI, Tableau preferred)
Experience translating business questions into analytic approaches and actionable recommendations. 2 years’ experience developing and maintaining report specifications in collaboration with business owners.
Demonstrated experience using data to solve business problems and support decision-making.
Experience developing dashboards or interactive reporting solutions using established visualization standards, approved templates, and user-centered design principles.
Strong problem-solving, critical thinking, and communication skills.
Proficiency in MS 365 Office Suite, especially Excel.
Excellent communication, escalation, time management, collaboration, and change management skills. Ability to work both independently and in teams.
Experienced in setting priorities across competing demands, clarifying expectations, and sustaining a positive and productive attitude despite swiftly changing priorities and a high level of activity. Ability to complete project and achieve results in a fast-paced work environment.
Ability to balance analytical accuracy, usability, and visual communication when presenting complex workforce information to technical and non-technical audiences.


Preferred Qualifications


Experience working with workforce, HR, healthcare, operational, or compliance-related data.
Experience developing metrics and KPIs.
Familiarity with workforce analytics concepts, including turnover, mobility, staffing, compliance, and organizational effectiveness.
Experience translating business questions into analytical solutions, dashboard requirements, and actionable recommendations in collaboration with business stakeholders.
Experience developing dashboards using Tableau, Power BI, Tableau Pulse, Databricks, or similar analytics platforms, including implementation of interactive dashboards, KPI scorecards, and executive reporting.


About Us

About UCSF

The University of California, San Francisco (UCSF) is a leading university dedicated to promoting health worldwide through advanced biomedical research, graduate-level education in the life sciences and health professions, and excellence in patient care. It is the only campus in the 10-campus UC system dedicated exclusively to the health sciences. We bring together the world’s leading experts in nearly every area of health. We are home to five Nobel laureates who have advanced the understanding of cancer, neurodegenerative diseases, aging and stem cells.

Pride Values

UCSF is a diverse community made of people with many skills and talents. We seek candidates whose work experience or community service has prepared them to contribute to our commitment to professionalism, respect, integrity, diversity and excellence – also known as our PRIDE values .

In addition to our PRIDE values, UCSF is committed to equity – both in how we deliver care as well as our workforce. We are committed to building a broadly diverse community, nurturing a culture that is welcoming and supportive, and engaging diverse ideas for the provision of culturally competent education, discovery, and patient care. Additional information about UCSF is available here .

Join us to find a rewarding career contributing to improving healthcare worldwide.

Equal Employment Opportunity

The University of California is an Equal Opportunity Employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, disability, age, protected veteran status, or other protected status under state or federal law.

Salary Information

The final salary and offer components are subject to additional approvals based on UC policy.

Your placement within the salary range is dependent on a number of factors including your work experience and internal equity within this position classification at UCSF. For positions that are represented by a labor union, placement within the salary range will be guided by the rules in the collective bargaining agreement.

To learn more about the benefits of working at UCSF, including total compensation, please visit: https://ucnet.universityofcalifornia.edu/compensation-and-benefits/index.html

Excellent analytical, problem ‑ solving, and communication skills.

About The Role And Team

At Uber, People Analytics drives business performance by translating employee insights into action. We partner with senior leaders to improve organizational effectiveness, employee engagement, and workforce outcomes across the full talent lifecycle-from hiring to retention.

We are looking for a senior data analyst who is passionate about using data to answer business questions and influence decisions. This role sits at the intersection of business analytics consulting and employee listening, supporting company-wide decisions through data analysis, survey insights, and people metrics.

What You'll Do

Act as an analytics consultant to the business

Title: Data Analyst
Description:
This position can be based in the Washington D.C or Chicago, IL office.




Position Summary

NAR is seeking a Data Analyst to help deliver data-driven insights, analytics solutions, and AI-enabled products that support decision-making across the organization. This role focuses on working directly with business stakeholders to understand analytical requirements, transform complex and fragmented data into actionable information, and build scalable solutions that provide measurable business value.




The Data Analyst will design and implement data preparation processes, perform advanced analysis, and develop applications and visualizations. They will make data and analysis accessible to non-technical audiences. The role works extensively within the Microsoft Azure and Microsoft Fabric ecosystems and involves close collaboration with data scientists, and business stakeholders in different parts of the organization.




The successful candidate will contribute to data quality initiatives, AI-assisted analytics workflows, and the development of new solutions that leverage both traditional analytics and AI technologies. The ideal candidate is comfortable working across analytics, visualization, and application development disciplines, with a practical focus on delivering solutions that are reliable, scalable, and widely adopted by the business.




Duties And Responsibilities

Partner with business stakeholders and non-technical teams to gather requirements, identify opportunities, and deliver data-driven solutions
Extract, transform, clean, and validate data from multiple internal and external sources to support analytics, reporting, and operational decision-making
Develop and maintain Python notebooks using SQL, Spark, and related technologies for data analysis, exploration, and reporting
Create dashboards that effectively communicate insights to business audiences using technologies such as Power BI, Streamlit, Django, and other frameworks
Collaborate with Data Scientists on data quality initiatives, statistical analyses, AI-assisted testing frameworks, and machine learning-related projects
Participate in source control, deployment, and project management processes using tools such as Git and Jira
Other duties, as assigned




Qualifications

Bachelor's degree in Computer Science or a closely related field.
Minimum of 2+ years of professional experience in data analytics or a related technical role.
Strong proficiency in SQL, including experience writing complex queries.
Strong Python development skills, including working with notebooks, expertise with data analysis libraries (e.g., Pandas, NumPy, SciPy), and use of visualization libraries (e.g., Plotly, Matplotlib).
Experience building dashboards using tools such as Power BI, Streamlit, or Django.
Experience working with cloud-based platforms and services; Microsoft Azure and Microsoft Fabric experience preferred.
Use of Git and use of project management systems such as Jira.
Good grasp of basic statistical concepts.
Ability to communicate complex technical concepts clearly and effectively to non-technical audiences.
Ability to work independently with minimal supervision while managing multiple priorities and deadlines.
Experience with AI, such as the use of AI-code generation, is a positive.
Advanced Microsoft Excel skills for data analysis and reporting are preferred




Compensation: $75,000 - $95,000 depending on office location

NAR provides comprehensive benefits including health/dental/vision insurance.

NAR is on a hybrid schedule and in the office 3 days a week.




Organizational Overview

The National Association of REALTORS® (NAR) is a team of professionals dedicated to providing world-class service to approximately 1.5 million REALTORS® working in the United States and around the world. The real estate industry is fast-paced and fast-changing--each year, our members participate in the sale, lease, and management of real estate. As in every industry, our members’ value proposition is constantly being challenged by innovation.




It is our mission to empower REALTORS® as they preserve, protect and advance the right to real property for all. We cannot do that without the ideas, passion, and commitment from our talented employees. As our greatest assets, employees are offered their pick of competitive benefits/perks and flexible work options.

Description:
Sonatype is the software supply chain security company. We provide the world’s best end-to-end software supply chain security solution, combining the only proactive protection against malicious open source, the only enterprise grade SBOM management and the leading open source dependency management platform. This empowers enterprises to create and maintain secure, quality, and innovative software at scale.

As founders of Nexus Repository and stewards of Maven Central, the world’s largest repository of Java open-source software, we are software pioneers and our open source expertise is unmatched. We empower innovation with an unparalleled commitment to build faster, safer software and harness AI and data intelligence to mitigate risk, maximize efficiencies, and drive powerful software development.

Trusted by thousands of organizations, including Fortune 500 companies, we are pioneers in software supply chain management, open source security, and DevSecOps.

What You’ll Do


Product Analytics & Telemetry: Analyze product usage, feature adoption, and telemetry data alongside financial metrics to optimize user experience and support product strategy.

Stakeholder Collaboration: Partner directly with cross-functional business stakeholders, managing requirements and delivering precise insights on tight turnarounds.
Mentorship: Serve as a technical guide to coach and mentor the team’s cohort of associate-level analysts.
Execution Metrics: Maintain high standards for ticket throughput, speed of delivery, and on-time completion rates for analytics tasks.


What You'll Bring


Experience: 5+ years in data analysis, BI, or product analytics—specifically within a SaaS or tech company. Experience working with product telemetry/usage data is strictly required.
Location: Must be based in Canada (excluding Quebec; Ontario or Eastern time zone preferred).
Technical Stack:
Advanced SQL and Python skills.
Strong expertise in Databricks (PySpark, notebooks, data lakehouses/medallion architecture, AWS S3).
Hands-on experience with visualization tools—Looker is heavily preferred (or ability to quickly adapt from Power BI/Tableau).
Familiarity with APIs, structured data formats (JSON, DataFrames), and version control via GitHub.
Qualitative Traits: Strong curiosity, meticulous attention to detail, proactive problem-solving, and clear communication skills.
Nice to Have: Knowledge of business systems (Salesforce, HubSpot, Jira, Amplitude, Gainsight).

2025 Best DevSecOps Solution by DevOps Dozen
