Title: Data Analyst (Nutricia + Kate Farms)
Description:
About The Job

Job Summary

The Data Analyst on the Enterprise Data Intelligence team turns data from across North America Medical Nutrition into trusted, actionable insights. In this role, you will partner with Commercial, Supply Chain, Finance, Marketing, Patient Services, and Medical/Regulatory teams to build reporting, analyze performance, and answer business questions that shape decisions. You will help make data accessible, consistent, and easier to use across the organization.

Key Responsibilities

As a key member of our team, you will play an important role in driving our mission forward. The following responsibilities outline the core expectations and contributions for this position


Develop, maintain, and enhance dashboards and reports in tools such as Power BI or Tableau, giving stakeholders clear visibility into sales, demand, patient and channel trends, and operational performance.
Analyze large, multi-source datasets, including sales, claims, syndicated, CRM, supply chain, and patient services data, to identify trends, drivers, risks, and opportunities.
Translate business questions into clear analytical requirements and communicate findings in concise, non-technical language.
Write and optimize SQL queries to extract, transform, and validate data from enterprise data platforms such as Snowflake or Databricks.
Partner with data engineers and data stewards to improve data pipelines, data models, and data quality.
Perform data validation, reconciliation, and root-cause analysis to improve accuracy and consistency across reports.
Support data governance practices, including metric definitions, documentation, data lineage, and a single source of truth for key performance indicators.
Handle sensitive data responsibly and follow applicable privacy, security, and compliance requirements.
Support ad hoc analysis and executive requests, prioritizing work based on business impact and urgency.
Identify opportunities to automate manual reporting and contribute to team documentation, best practices, and continuous improvement.


Physical Demands & Work Environment


This role is primarily performed in a remote office setting and requires the ability to remain in a stationary position (e.g., seated or standing) for extended periods.
The employee may be required to travel to Danone corporate offices as needed.


The salary range for this position is $76,000-133,000K USD. The exact salary offered will depend on several factors, including the candidate’s relevant experience, geographic location, internal equity, and market conditions. Danone USA additionally offers a performance-based bonus and has a strong benefits package including Medical, Dental, Vision, Prescription Drug Coverage, 401k Plan, Wellness Program, Life Insurance, Tuition Reimbursement, Flexible Time Off, and Paid Parental Bonding Leave, among other benefit plan options. To give our employees flexibility, Danone is a hybrid work environment.

About You

The ideal candidate will bring a combination of education, experience, and skills that enable them to excel in this position. The following qualifications outline what we’re looking for, including both required and preferred criteria

Education & Experience


Bachelor’s degree in Data Science, Statistics, Mathematics, Economics, Business Analytics, Information Systems, or related field/equivalent experience.
2–4 years of experience in a data analyst, business intelligence, or analytics role.
Experience in healthcare, pharmaceutical, medical nutrition, consumer packaged goods, or another regulated industry is preferred.
Experience with healthcare or commercial data sources, such as claims, syndicated data, CRM, specialty pharmacy, or distributor data, is preferred.


Knowledge, Skills & Abilities


Strong SQL skills, including joins, window functions, data validation, and query optimization.
Hands-on experience with a business intelligence or visualization tool such as Power BI or Tableau.
Experience with cloud data platforms such as Snowflake, Databricks, or a comparable platform.
Strong analytical and problem-solving skills with close attention to detail.
Ability to explain complex findings clearly to technical and non-technical audiences.
Ability to manage multiple priorities and work effectively with cross-functional partners.
Working knowledge of Python or R for analysis and automation is preferred.
Understanding data modeling, ETL/ELT concepts, data governance, and advanced Excel is preferred.
Demonstrates curiosity and ownership, business partnership, collaboration, clear communication, and integrity with data.


About us

Danone North America Medical Nutrition brings together a growing portfolio of mission-driven brands, including Kate Farms, Nutricia, Neocate, Pepticate, Functional Formularies, and Real Food Blends. Together, we deliver science-backed nutrition solutions for infants, children, and adults with complex nutritional needs, whether they consume nutrition orally or through a feeding tube.

Our ambition is clear to improve health outcomes, expand access to high-quality nutrition, help reduce healthcare costs, and build sustainable growth. We combine trusted, consumer-loved brands with strong scientific and medical expertise to create nutrition solutions that make a meaningful difference in people’s lives.

By joining our approximately 450-person North America Medical Nutrition organization, you will become part of Danone’s broader North American and global network. You will have the opportunity to contribute to a growing business, collaborate across brands and functions, and help shape the future of medical nutrition in the US.

You will also join one of the world’s largest Certified B Corporations, working for a company committed to creating lasting value for people and the planet.

Danone North America is proud to be an Equal Opportunity employer. It is our policy to give equal employment opportunities to all qualified persons without regard to legally protected characteristics, or any other consideration made unlawful by applicable federal, state/provincial and/or local law. Title: Senior Data Analyst
Description:
Established in 2021, Independence Pet Holdings is a corporate holding company that manages a diverse and broad portfolio of modern pet health brands and services, including insurance, pet education, lost recovery services, and more throughout North America.

We believe pet insurance is more than a financial product and build solutions to simplify the pet parenting journey and help improve the well-being of pets. As a leading authority in the pet category, we operate with a full stack of resources, capital, and services to support pet parents. Our multi-brand and omni-channel approach include our own insurance carrier, insurance brands and partner brands.

Clarus is a subsidiary of Doubtless, formerly known as Independence Pet Holdings, Inc. Clarus is a pioneering pet health technology company transforming the future of pet healthcare. We develop connected solutions across the pet health landscape, helping veterinary teams and pet owners make more informed care and financial decisions. Together, we are reducing complexity and helping more pets receive the care they need.

Job Summary

Clarus is seeking an experienced, hands-on Senior Data Analyst to join the Analytics team. This individual will serve as a strategic analytical partner to Sales, Customer Success, Product, Finance, and teams across the organization to deliver analytical solutions.

The Senior Data Analyst will bring together sales, CRM, customer, campaign, product usage, and engagement data to create reliable forecasts, dashboards, recurring reports, and actionable insights. The role will help Clarus improve pipeline visibility, commercial performance, customer retention, product adoption, and partner outcomes.

This is an individual-contributor role with defined ownership and visibility. The successful candidate will be comfortable moving between detailed data analysis and high-level business recommendations. They will bring structure to ambiguous questions, identify opportunities without waiting to be asked, and communicate insights in a way that drives action.

Job Location: Remote – USA. Candidates in EST/CST time zones are strongly preferred. US travel required.

Main Responsibilities


Gather reporting requirements and translate business questions into dashboards, reports, datasets, queries, metrics, and analytical models.
Build, maintain, and improve dashboards and recurring reports using Power BI, Tableau, Excel, Zoho Analytics, or similar platforms.
Create reusable datasets, SQL queries, and data models that improve consistency and reduce manual reporting.
Establish and document KPI definitions, calculation logic, reporting assumptions, and data sources.
Design reporting assets that are accurate, intuitive, scalable, and appropriate for both operational and executive audiences.
Partner with Sales, Customer Success, Marketing, Product, Finance, and leadership to define analytical needs and improve decision-making.
Balance recurring reporting responsibilities with ad hoc analysis and strategic initiatives.
Evaluate lead management performance, including lead sources, routing, follow-up activity, aging, conversion, and pipeline leakage.
Monitor sales activity, account performance, customer engagement, revenue trends, renewals, expansion, and churn.
Analyze Sales performance drivers, growth trends, and areas of underperformance across accounts, customer segments, cohorts, channels, and external partners.
Build and maintain customer health scoring methodologies, including risk signals, adoption indicators, monitoring engagement behavior, and recommended calls to action.
Analyze the customer lifecycle across acquisition, activation, engagement, adoption, retention, renewal, expansion, and churn.
Analyze user activity and product engagement to support Product decisions, Customer Success planning, and customer or partner reporting.
Develop customer performance scorecards for account reviews, renewal planning, and internal and external QBRs.
Analyze marketing campaign performance, including reach, engagement, lead quality, conversion, cohort performance, attribution, and downstream pipeline impact.
Prepare executive-ready summaries, presentations, scorecards, and reporting packages for leadership meetings, QBRs, partner reviews, and planning sessions.
Proactively identify gaps in data quality, reporting visibility, customer segmentation, and metric definitions.
Drive adoption of dashboards, KPIs, scorecards, and reporting processes through documentation, training, and stakeholder engagement


Basic Qualifications


Bachelor’s degree or higher in analytics, business, economics, statistics, finance, information systems, marketing, or a related discipline, or equivalent professional experience.
A strong record of success in sales analytics, revenue analytics, business intelligence, customer analytics, marketing analytics, or a related analytical role.
5+ years of relevant experience is preferred; with demonstrated industry knowledge, analytical ability, initiative, and business impact.
Strong SQL and Python skills.
Experience building business dashboards and reporting solutions in Power BI or Tableau.
Experience with Zoho Analytics or another CRM-connected analytics platform.
Experience analyzing CRM data, sales pipelines, funnels, customer activity, and commercial performance.
Strong understanding of forecasting, segmentation, conversion, retention, renewal, churn, and customer lifecycle metrics.
Ability to gather business requirements and translate them into clear analytical deliverables.
Excellent written and verbal communication skills, including experience presenting findings to senior leaders and non-technical audiences.
High attention to detail and a strong commitment to data accuracy, consistency, documentation, and reporting quality.


Preferred Qualifications


Relevant experience in animal health, veterinary services, pet insurance, insurance, SaaS, fintech, health technology, or similar environment highly desired.
Intellectually curious, resourceful, and motivated to understand how the business works.
Takes initiative, identify needs early, and move work forward without waiting for detailed instructions.
Comfortable operating in an evolving, high-growth environment.
Can move easily between hands-on analysis, stakeholder conversations, and executive-level communication.
Able to manage deliverables while continuing to improve the underlying processes.
Able to build trust by producing accurate work, communicating clearly, and following through on commitments.


Compensation


Chicago Base pay range: $100,458 – $125,574 per year
New York Base pay range: $109,509 - $136,990 per year
Nationwide Base pay range: $91,325 - $114,158 per year


This is the range we reasonably expect to pay at hire. Placement within the range depends on job-related factors such as experience, skills, and certifications. This position is not eligible for an annual bonus. Base pay is one part of a total rewards package that includes the benefits listed below.

Title: Senior Data Analyst, GTM Operations
Description:
7shifts is an HR platform designed to help restaurant teams thrive. With an easy-to-use app and industry-specific solutions, 7shifts saves time, reduces errors, and helps keep costs in check for over 55,000 restaurants. Our mission is to simplify team management and improve performance for restaurants, with a long-term vision of creating a thriving restaurant industry through the power of connected & engaged teams.

As the Senior Data Analyst at 7shifts, you’ll be the analytical partner to our Go-to-Market and Finance teams. Reporting to our Manager, Data & Analytics, you’ll work alongside analysts, data engineers, and analytics engineers, partnering closely with GTM Operations and Finance. Your role is to ensure the teams driving revenue and managing our finances have data they can trust and the insight to act on it. Most of your time will go toward strategic projects that improve how GTM and Finance operate - reducing manual work, creating clearer definitions, and making it faster to get answers. You’ll also build and maintain the data assets these teams rely on and help them self-serve, so simple questions don’t become tickets. You’re a consultant to the business, not a request queue: you bring the context, recommend the approach, and drive cross-functional work forward.

What You'll Do


Own GTM and Finance analytics end-to-end, from scoping the question to pulling data from Snowflake, Stripe, Salesforce, and FinQore, and landing on a recommendation leaders can act on
Lead strategic projects that improve how GTM and Finance operate, coordinating across analysts, engineers, and business partners
Build and maintain the dashboards, reports, and metric definitions teams rely on as a source of truth, ensuring data stays consistent across the company
Enable self-serve by making data and tooling easier for GTM and Finance to use independently
Use AI as part of your daily workflow to accelerate analysis, leverage the semantic layer for faster insights, and find new ways to make the team more efficient
Mentor teammates and contribute to shared standards for how the team scopes, builds, and validates its work
Help shape the analytics roadmap by bringing GTM and Finance needs back to the Data team


What You Bring


5+ years in data analytics or business intelligence, with strong experience in financial or go-to-market reporting
Experience owning complex, ambiguous analysis end to end and translating it into business decisions
Strong SQL in a modern warehouse (Snowflake or equivalent) and comfort with a BI tool (ThoughtSpot or equivalent); able to work across multiple systems and learn new ones quickly
Experience working with the systems behind the numbers, such as Stripe, Salesforce, FinQore, or equivalent platforms
Fluency in SaaS metrics like ARR, retention, and pipeline, with the judgment to connect analysis to revenue, cost, and operating outcomes
Active use of AI in analytical work, with a clear understanding of where it adds value and where its output needs to be checked
Strong cross-functional skills and the ability to influence decisions without owning them; people come to you for the recommendation, not just the query
Experience mentoring other analysts on analytical methods, SQL, or AI, formally or informally


It'd be even cooler if you had


Experience building AI agents or enabling AI adoption at a previous company
Experience in the restaurant or hospitality industry
An interest in growing into people leadership


Our Commitment To Our Shifties


Opportunity: Our product is evolving in exciting ways, and we’re focused on delivering even more value to restaurants. This momentum creates real opportunities to learn and grow. Whether you’re honing your craft or exploring new paths, you’ll be supported and empowered to own your growth and impact a product shaping the future of the restaurant industry.
Challenge: We’re tackling real problems in a fast-moving, complex industry. The work is scrappy and ambiguous, but meaningful. You’ll think critically, act with intention, and shape solutions that make a real difference for restaurant teams.
Culture: We’re proud to be recognized among the best workplaces in North America. Guided by our mission and values, we move fast to solve meaningful problems and celebrate wins together. Whether through in-office and remote events, team offsites like Sparks, or everyday moments of connection, we create space for shared growth, collaboration, and fun.
Equity: We’re a Series C, VC-backed SaaS company, and we believe everyone should share in the success they help create. When we build together, we grow together.
Health and Wellness: We support Shifties in and outside of work, knowing that what people need can change over time. From day one, you’ll have access to benefits like health and dental, lifestyle spending accounts to a parental leave program built with flexibility in mind, to help you bring your best self to work.
Flexibility: Our team is intentional around how and where we work, whether remotely, in person, or a mix of both. We prioritize candidates who thrive in a hybrid work environment with offices in Saskatoon and Toronto, ensuring in-person collaboration and connection when possible. Plus, we offer a flexible vacation policy to encourage everyone to recharge when needed. Oh, and our ‘90 Day Shift’ program lets Shift work from (almost) anywhere because who wouldn’t want to trade their desk for a beach view once in a while?
Support: We set Shifties up for success with the tools they need, like the latest Apple tech, a home office setup, and some 7shifts swag to make it official. But support goes beyond day one. We’re serious about professional growth, offering coaching, feedback, development planning, and opportunities to grow from within.


We know you might not check every box, and that’s okay. If you’re excited about this role, inspired to contribute to a meaningful product, and eager to share ideas that drive real change, we’d love to hear from you. We’re building an inclusive team that reflects the diverse industry we serve, and we welcome applicants from all backgrounds.

We thank you for your interest in joining the 7shifts team!

Our privacy policy can be found here.

Compensation Range: CA$100K - CA$150K

Title: Senior Data Analyst
Description:
Welcome!

‎

We are seeking a highly skilled Senior Data Analyst with at least 2 years of hands‑on analytics experience supported by a Master’s degree in Analytics, Data Science, Statistics, or a related quantitative discipline to join our team.

This role sits at the intersection of data, strategy, and business performance. The Senior Analyst will partner closely with business leaders to interpret data, track performance, and tell clear stories that support strategic decision-making.

The ideal candidate can analyze complex business problems, identify meaningful trends and performance drivers, and translate analytical findings into practical recommendations that support business decision-making.

‎

Key Responsibilities

Advanced Analytics (~60% of Time)


Strategy & Insight Generation: Apply advanced analytical methodologies to evaluate business performance, identify risks and opportunities, uncover root causes, and provide actionable recommendations that support operational and strategic objectives.
Business Consulting & Strategic Partnership: Partner with business leaders to define key business questions, evaluate strategic initiatives, and prioritize analytical opportunities.
Data Discovery & Innovation: Evaluate and recommend enhancements to data assets, metrics, and analytical capabilities that strengthen business insights, decision-making, and organizational performance.
Analytics Enablement: Define KPI frameworks, reporting requirements, and dashboard design to enable consistent, data-driven decision-making.
Analytical Review & Validation: Apply a high level of attention to detail to evaluate analytical outputs, identify discrepancies, validate data integrity, assess calculation logic, and recommend corrective actions to improve reliability.


Communication & Influence (~40% of Time)


Communication & Storytelling: Develop compelling presentations, reports, and narrative documents that translate complex analytical results and model outputs into clear, actionable business stories for diverse audiences from frontline teams to executive leadership.
Organizational Influence: Drive adoption of data-driven decision-making across the organization, advocating for best practices in model consumption, insights application, and analytical rigor.
Collaboration: Work closely with the Data Operations team to translate business needs into reporting solutions, providing guidance on metric definitions, data requirements, dashboard functionality, and user adoption.


Technical Skills


Advanced proficiency in SQL for data querying, transformation, and manipulation.
Proficiency in Python for data analysis.
Proficiency in Excel and PowerBI for reporting/visualization.
Experience with Databricks or similar distributed computing/cloud platform.


Analytical Skills


Deep expertise in statistical analysis, trend and variance analysis, segmentation, and translating data into actionable business recommendations.


Communication


Excellent verbal and written communication skills with the ability to present complex data and model concepts clearly to executive leadership.


Meticulousness


Ability to thoroughly validate data, analyses, and reporting outputs; identify discrepancies and gaps; and ensure accurate, reliable business insights.


Stakeholder Management


Demonstrated ability to manage relationships with multiple stakeholders, navigate competing priorities, and align analytical work to business objectives.


‎


Minimum Experience: 4+ years of professional experience in advanced data analysis, machine learning, or a related analytics role.
Minimum Education: Master's Degree in Data Science, Analytics, Statistics, or a related quantitative field required.

Title: Data Analyst (Databricks) REMOTE
Description:
EnableComp provides Specialty Revenue Cycle Management solutions for healthcare organizations, leveraging over 24 years of industry-leading expertise and its unified E360 RCM™ intelligent automation platform to improve financial sustainability for hospitals, health systems, and ambulatory surgery centers (ASCs) nationwide. Powered by proprietary algorithms, iterative intelligence from 10M+ processed claims, and expert human-in-the-loop integration, EnableComp provides solutions across the revenue lifecycle for Veterans Administration, Workers’ Compensation, Motor Vehicle Accidents, and Out-of-State Medicaid claims as well as denials for all payer classes. By partnering with clients to supercharge the reimbursement process, EnableComp removes the burden of payment from patients and provider organizations while enabling accelerated cash, higher and more accurate yield, clean AR management, reduced denials, and data-rich performance management. EnableComp is a multi-year recipient the Top Workplaces award and was recognized as Black Book's #1 Specialty Revenue Cycle Management Solution provider in 2024 and is among the top one percent of companies to make the Inc. 5000 list of the fastest-growing private companies in the United States for the last eleven years. 







POSITION SUMMARY




 




The Data Analyst is responsible for analyzing complex healthcare data to generate actionable insights that support operational and strategic decision-making. This role leverages quantitative analysis, reporting, and data modeling techniques to identify trends, measure performance, and drive process improvements. The Data Analyst collaborates with cross-functional partners to translate business needs into analytical solutions and delivers clear, data-driven recommendations to stakeholders.







THE JOB RESPONSIBILITIES INCLUDE



Analyze large, complex datasets to identify trends, patterns, and actionable insights that support business decisions


Develop, maintain, and optimize reports, dashboards, and analytical models to measure operational and financial performance


Translate analytical findings into clear, concise, and executive-ready summaries and presentations


Partner with stakeholders to understand business needs, define requirements, and deliver data-driven solutions


Query and manipulate data using SQL and other tools to extract, transform, and prepare datasets for analysis


Build and maintain structured datasets, including joining tables and validating data integrity


Partner with Operations, Account Management, Product, IT, and Data management teams to align data solutions with business needs


Apply critical thinking to identify root causes of issues and recommend practical, data-backed solutions


Ensure accuracy and reliability of all analyses through thorough validation and quality checks


Document methodologies, assumptions, and processes to support transparency and repeatability


Manage multiple projects and priorities in a fast-paced, deadline-driven environment


Communicate effectively with both technical and non-technical audiences to drive understanding and alignment


Support continuous improvement initiatives through data analysis and performance monitoring


Stay current on analytics tools, methodologies, and industry trends to enhance capabilities


Other duties as required









REQUIREMENTS AND QUALIFICATIONS



Bachelor’s degree in Analytics, Finance, Business, Computer Science, Healthcare Administration or other related field required


5+ years of experience in data analysis, reporting, or working with relational databases required


3-5 years of experience in healthcare, revenue cycle, or SaaS environment strongly preferred


Familiarity with healthcare terminology (e.g., CPT codes, DRG, claims, inpatient/outpatient)


Experience with BI tools such as Power BI, Tableau, or Qlik preferred


Experience with Databricks Data Intelligence Platform


3 years of integrating Databricks, Power BI, and Claude Code


Experience in statistical analysis or predictive modeling techniques


Proficiency in Microsoft Excel, PowerPoint, and experience writing SQL queries


Timely and regular attendance


Equivalent combination of education and experience will be considered


To perform this job successfully, an individual must be able to perform each essential duty satisfactorily. Reasonable accommodations may be made to enable qualified individuals with disabilities to perform the essential functions.









SPECIAL CONSIDERATIONS & PREREQUISITES



Practices and adheres to EnableComp’s Core Values, Vision and Mission


Strong ability to communicate complex data insights clearly to audiences with varying levels of technical expertise


High attention to detail with a focus on accuracy, validation, and quality of work


Strong organizational and time management skills with the ability to manage competing priorities


Demonstrated problem-solving mindset with the ability to independently drive work to completion


Ability to collaborate effectively across teams while also working independently when needed


Ownership mindset with accountability for deliverables and outcomes

Title: Data Analyst IV - Herbert Wertheim College of Medicine
Description:
About FIU

Florida International University is a Top 50, preeminent public research university with 55,000 students from all 50 states and more than 140 countries, as well as an alumni network of more than 340,000. Located in the global city of Miami, the university offers more than 200 degree programs at the undergraduate, graduate and professional levels, including medicine and law. FIU faculty are leaders in their fields and include National Academy members, Fulbright Scholars and MacArthur Genius Fellows. A Carnegie R1 institution, FIU drives impactful research in environmental resilience, health and technology and innovation. Home to the Wall of Wind and Institute of Environment, FIU stands at the forefront of discovery and innovation. With a focus on student success, economic mobility and community engagement, FIU is redefining what it means to be a public research university.

Job Summary

The Herbert Wertheim College of Medicine is currently seeking a Data Analyst IV to join our team of professionals.

Duties Include:


Provides support to the quantitative and qualitative data analysis of learner data to support excellence in education.
Makes recommendations regarding design and data collection methodology for clinical assessments and simulation/performance-based assessments in collaboration with key leaders for the Herbert Wertheim College of Medicine (HWCOM).
Responsible for data organization, maintenance of assessment database, statistical analysis, general interpretation and reporting of results to appropriate stakeholders.
Collects and analyzes data to support course revisions and curriculum planning.
Develops data collection and analysis methodology, including defining in detailed data requirements, data sources, and proper data collections procedures for statistical analysis.
Develops and implements data collection quality assurance procedures to ensure validity and reliability of results.
Collects data using appropriate methods (e.g.: checklists, global rating scales, surveys, forms, questionnaires,etc).
Generates reports, charts, tables, and presentations as appropriate for the reporting of data and outcomes to individuals, offices, and committees.
Builds structures as needed to capture data for longitudinal reporting.
Serves as a resource for faculty conducting medical education research regarding data issues such as appropriate collection and entry methods as well as data quality.
Collaborates with HWCOM IT to identify requirements and parameters for data delivery and specifications.
Serves as a key member of the Assessment Committee and the Program Evaluation Committee. Responsible for quality control of data compilation and analysis, results interpretation, visualization and reporting for the Assessment committee, a sub-committee of the Curriculum Committee that reviews all assessments for quality, effectiveness and consistency throughout period one, two, and three.
Leads the planning, development, and implementation of a data warehouse (in collaboration with the HWCOM IT department, Office of Medical Education, and the Office of Students Affairs) that will house student performance data as well as data across the Office of Academic Affairs and Office of Student Affairs that is integral to program evaluation and strategic planning, in order to improve tracking of performance metrics and ensure we are meeting outcomes.
Performs other related duties as required or directed. The omission of specific duties does not preclude the supervisor from assigning duties that are logically related to the position.


Minimum Qualifications

Bachelor's degree in an appropriate area of specialization and six (6) years of appropriate experience or a Master's degree in an appropriate area of specialization and four (4) years of appropriate experience.

Desired Qualifications

Bachelors and/or Master's degree in Education, Educational Psychology, Quantitative Psychology preferred.

Analytical and statistical expertise in predominantly clinical and performance-based assessment (ie: work-place based assessment, OSCEs), student outcomes, program reviews and teaching evaluations.

Working knowledge of common statistical variables, including but not limited to variable types, scale types, descriptive statistics, and basic statistical inferences (t-test, z-test, chi-square, regression) and statistical packages such as SPSS, and SAS that support these analyses.

Experience in assessment and performance-based assessment evaluation of programs required. Experience in assessing medical education programs preferred.

Demonstrated ability to communicate ideas and results effectively.

Experience with Qualtrics and BI Dashboarding

Description:
We are committed to connecting Canadians through unique partnerships, our world-class network and content Canadians love—and our innovative team is growing. We are looking for dedicated team members to join our Corporate team who have a genuine passion for making positive impacts on customers and the communities where we live and work. We have a variety of business units with exciting and meaningful work waiting for you, including Communications, HR, Legal and Corporate Affairs, Supply Chain, Finance, and Real Estate. If you are considering your next step, we have exciting opportunities waiting for you. Come build a rewarding career at Rogers and be a driving force behind our success story!

An exciting opportunity exists to join as a Senior Data Analyst in the Wireless Service & Equipment Finance team. This position will be responsible for creating and maintaining Tableau dashboard that including dashboard design, creation, master data file building, data mining and measuring service & equipment revenue /usage KPIs and be able to be as story teller. Candidates will work very closely with various teams to provide value-added analysis on Wireless Revenue.

The Sr. Data Analyst will be based in Toronto and will provide expert data management to Wireless Service & Equipment Finance.

What You'll Do


Design, develop, enhance and maintain Tableau and/or Power BI dashboards supporting Wireless Service & Equipment Finance reporting and performance management.
Develop and maintain master datasets and reporting data layers using Databricks, SQL and Python, including data extraction, transformation, integration and validation from multiple data sources.
Build and automate weekly and monthly financial scorecards, dashboards and management reports, providing clear insights into performance trends and key business drivers.
Analyze large and complex datasets across multiple source systems to evaluate wireless subscriber, revenue, equipment, usage and other financial/business KPIs.
Translate business and Finance requirements into scalable data models, queries, dashboards and reporting solutions.
Write and optimize SQL queries and Databricks workflows to extract, join, cleanse, transform and aggregate large datasets for financial reporting and business analysis.
Use Python and SQL to automate recurring data preparation, validation, reconciliation and reporting processes.
Develop visually effective dashboards that enable users to understand performance, identify trends and investigate key drivers.
Perform detailed data validation and reconciliation between source systems, master datasets, financial results and reporting outputs to ensure accuracy and consistency.
Investigate data discrepancies, data quality issues and potential data corruption; identify root causes and work with appropriate teams to implement solutions.
Support Financial Analysis, Pricing, Commercial Strategy, Marketing and Sales teams by providing reliable datasets, analytical insights and ad-hoc reporting.
Process and analyze data to support business cases, forecasting, performance measurement and ad-hoc analytical requests.
Define data requirements and business rules and ensure data extracts and reporting outputs are complete, accurate and fit for purpose.
Develop and automate financial and statistical analyses using tools such as Databricks, Python, SQL, Excel, Tableau and Power BI.
Partner with Data, Technology and IT teams to identify appropriate source systems, databases and tables and understand upstream/downstream data dependencies.
Present analytical findings to Finance and business stakeholders and translate complex data into clear business stories, key insights and actionable recommendations.


What You'll Bring


3+ years’ experience in data analytics/Business Intelligence, ideally within telecommunications.
Advanced Databricks and SQL skills working with large, complex datasets.
Strong Python and/or PySpark programming and data manipulation experience.
Advanced Tableau dashboard development; Power BI experience is an asset.
Strong knowledge of data modeling, transformation, quality, architecture, and data management.
Experience building master datasets, reusable reporting sources, and automated/scalable reporting solutions.
Strong Excel skills, including large datasets and financial analysis.
Experience with statistical, trend, variance, testing, and performance analysis.
University degree in Computer Science, Mathematics, or a related field.
Insights-driven, adaptable, collaborative, and customer-focused, with the ability to thrive in a fast-paced environment.


What's In It For You

We believe in investing in our people and helping them reach their potential as valuable members of our team. As part of our team, you’ll have access to a wide range of incredible resources, growth opportunities, discounts, and perks, including


Discounts Enjoy up to 50% off Rogers Services and Blue Jays Tickets, 25% off TSC items, and a 20% discount on all wireless accessories sold in Rogers stores.
Company matching contributions to charities you support


Growth & Development Opportunities


Self-driven career development programs
Rogers First priority in applying to internal roles of interest


Wellness Programs


Employee & family assistance program
Virtual Healthcare

Low or no-cost fitness membership

Title: Data Analyst
Description:
Overview




The Data Analyst is responsible for analyzing customer data, generating actionable insights, and contributing to improving customer experiences. Engage directly with customers, gather feedback, and use data to drive informed business decisions aimed at enhancing customer satisfaction and organizational success.




The position plays a critical role in presenting company performance to our customers and identifying data anomalies so that we can be proactive in customer retention and success.

 

Key Accountabilities
Collect and validate month-end reports.
Prepare standard reports for leadership, clients, and stakeholders.
Design and build custom reports and automate recurring reporting.
Ensure reports are accurate, consistent, and actionable.
Design and build product reporting and dashboards.
Support the QBR process with data and content.
Conduct analysis of assigned customers' performance to identify opportunities for increased loan volume.




Customer Data Analysis
Reconcile customer data against our data. 
Collect, clean, and analyze customer data using various tools and techniques to identify patterns, trends, and correlations. 
Interpret data and provide insights to assist in understanding customer behavior, preferences, and needs. 
Perform root cause analysis on data errors and fix recuring errors.




Customer Engagement and Feedback

Interact with customer success to gather feedback, understand their requirements, and identify pain points.




Data Visualization and Reporting

Create visually appealing and easy-to-understand dashboards, reports, and presentations to communicate insights and findings to both internal and external stakeholders. 
Provide regular updates and insights to the team and management based on the analysis of customer data. 




Leadership & Collaboration
Collaborate closely with Data Specialists, Customer Success, Professional Services, and Loan Accounting to ensure customer issues are routed appropriately, resolved efficiently, and communicated clearly.
Serve as a liaison between customers and internal teams, translating technical or data‑related findings into understandable, actionable explanations.




Qualifications
Minimum of 2+ years of experience in PowerBI and SQL.
Bachelor’s degree in Data Science, Statistics, Mathematics, Business Analytics, Computer Science, or a related field.
Strong analytical skills and proficiency in data analytics tools to interpret complex datasets and identify trends.
Experience with data modeling and database querying (e.g., SQL, relational databases) for building reliable data structures and reports.
Experience working with ticketing systems, queues, and structured support workflows.
Excellent written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to explain data results to non‑technical audiences.
Proficiency with Microsoft Excel and basic reporting tools.

Compliance and Information Security
Always protect company data
Complete company mandated training regarding security measures to protect company property (e.g. shoulder surfing, phishing attacks, etc.)
Be aware of all potential threats and surroundings
Never write down information from your computer monitor
Do not share any company information unless you have confirmed that person’s identity
Maintains knowledge of the Bank Secrecy Act (BSA) and the ClearBalance policies that support compliance with BSA
Performs all duties in a manner that fully supports compliance with all laws and ClearBalance policies




Core Values

·        Own the Outcome: Takes full accountability for results, closes loops, and drives issues through resolution rather than just identifying problems.

·        Do the Right Thing: Makes ethical, compliant decisions and speaks up early, even when the easier path would be faster or more convenient.

·        Be a Self-Starter: Acts with urgency and initiative, identifies opportunities, and takes action without waiting for direction.

·        Be Naturally Curious: Asks why, digs into data and processes, and looks beyond surface-level answers to deliver better outcomes.

·        Strive to Make Things Better: Continuously improves processes, reduces friction, and leaves things better than they were found.




Measures of Success

·        Timely and effective ticket management - Tier 1 support tickets are acknowledged, triaged, and resolved within established SLAs, with minimal aging and clear prioritization.

·        High‑quality communication and client experience - Customers and internal teams receive clear, accurate, and timely updates on ticket status, resolution, and next steps.

·        Correct escalation and handoff to Tier 2 - Issues requiring reconciliation or advanced investigation are escalated promptly with complete context and documentation, enabling efficient Tier 2 resolution.

·        Reduction in repeat and avoidable tickets - Common issues are identified, documented, and addressed through process improvements, resulting in fewer repeat Tier 1 support items.

·        Operational reliability and trust - Internal stakeholders and clients view the role as dependable, responsive, and accountable, contributing to stable client relationships and confidence in data support.

Title: Data Analyst
Description:
Our Mission: Hospital-Quality Care, Everywhere.

The healthcare industry still relies on faxes and phone tags to coordinate critical care for patients at home. We think patients and the clinicians who serve them deserve better than a system stuck in 1995.

Verse Medical is building the modern software infrastructure to make it happen. We're a well-funded Series C company (backed by General Catalyst, SignalFire, and Sapphire Ventures) on a mission to heal a fragmented system. Our platform connects the dots between providers, payors, and patients, ensuring people get the high-quality care they need, reliably and right where they live. We’re growing fast and looking for people who are driven by this mission to join us!

Our Values: The Principles That Guide Us

Our values are the operating system for how we work together and with our partners. They aren't just words on a wall; they are the principles we bring to every decision, every day.


We are transparent, upfront and direct. We operate with honesty and clarity. We share information openly, the good and the bad, and believe that direct, respectful feedback is the foundation of trust and progress.
We value speed of iteration. We are building something new, which means we learn by doing. We prioritize rapid iteration and getting solutions into the hands of users, believing that progress is more valuable than perfection.
We give 110% effort, 30% of the time. We are passionate about our mission, and there are moments that require us to go the extra mile. We believe in focused intensity when it counts, balanced by a sustainable pace that keeps our team energized for the long run.
We empathize with customers to a fault. When our users face a problem, we own it. Instead of asking them to change, we ask ourselves, "How can we make this better?" We believe true innovation comes from deep empathy and a relentless focus on solving the real-world challenges of healthcare.


We’re hiring a Data Analyst to turn Verse's data into decisions. This is a high-impact, high-visibility role where you'll partner directly with functional leaders to build the metrics, dashboards, and analyses that drive how the business operates. Not only are you offering the “what,” but also the “why” and the “what now,” translating messy, ambiguous business questions into clear, defensible, self-serve analytical assets.

If you enjoy high ownership, solving open-ended business problems with data, and having direct influence on a mission-driven company’s trajectory, this role is for you.

What You'll Achieve: A Glimpse into Your Contributions


Spearhead end-to-end analytics across business domains.
Understand trends in operational and customer data to influence how teams prioritize their own roadmaps
Partner with cross-functional stakeholders (Sales, Ops, Product, Leadership) to define new metrics, standardize reporting, and surface insights proactively.
Automate recurring reporting and manual data-quality checks using Python and SQL, reducing turnaround time on regular audits and deliverables.
Design and build algorithms/models (e.g., scoring, classification, similarity, or risk-adjustment models) that solve specific business problems, from provider mapping to fraud detection to cost-of-care scoring.


What You'll Bring: The Skills and Experience You’ll Leverage

We believe that diverse experiences and backgrounds lead to better solutions. While we have an idea of what will help someone succeed in this role, we are open to being convinced by your unique story and skills. If you believe you can achieve the outcomes above, we encourage you to apply.

Core Skills & Experience:


3+ years of experience in data analysis, business intelligence, or analytics engineering, with experience owning reporting and metrics end-to-end.
Strong experience writing SQL and Python for analysis, automation, and lightweight modeling
Experience building and driving adoption of dashboards (Metabase, Looker Tableau, PowerBI, or similar)
Experience developing custom metrics, scoring algorithms, or classification models to solve specific business problems.
Experience performing exploratory analysis with minimal direction on ambiguous, open-ended business questions
Proactive communicator with experience working with stakeholders
Preferred: Experience with dbt modeling.
Preferred: Experience with Snowflake.
Preferred: Familiarity with healthcare or other regulated data (HIPAA compliance).
Preferred: Experience working closely with engineers to triage and resolve issues.


Benefits:


Competitive compensation.
Opportunities for rapid career advancement in a growing company.
100% premium coverage for health insurance.
401(k) with no matching at this time.


This is a hybrid role based in our New York office and will require you to be in the office 4x in a week.

Our Pledge for an Equitable Future

At Verse Medical, our mission is to deliver equitable, hospital-quality care to everyone, regardless of their background or where they live. We can only achieve this if our own team reflects the diversity of the patients we serve. We are committed to building a workplace where everyone feels a sense of belonging, where their contributions are valued, and where they can do their best work. We embrace diversity of all kinds: race, gender, age, religion, identity, experience. We are actively working to build a more inclusive and equitable world, starting from within our own walls. We are an equal opportunity employer.

We are also committed to providing a positive and accessible interview experience. If you require any accommodations to participate in our process, please contact us at recruiting@versemedical.com.

Compensation Range: $85K - $130K

Working knowledge of SQL and familiarity with relational databases.
Exceptional analytical skills, strong attention to detail, and strong verbal and written communication skills.

Statistical analysis and modeling.
Natural language processing.

Python and/or R.
Tableau.
Palantir.
Data entry.

Title: Data Analyst Looker
Description:
¡Hola! 🙋




¿Todavía no conoces hiberus? Somos una empresa de #tecnología construida con un ingrediente diferencial, la HIPERESPECIALIZACIÓN.




Formar parte de hiberus significa crecimiento, pasión por la tecnología, interés por la innovación, ambiente laboral flexible y colaborativo, compañerismo, aprendizaje, formación continua, motivación y superación ante nuevos retos... y esto es solo el principio.




Contamos con un equipo de más de 4.500 profesionales, 46 áreas de especialización y 35 hubs de desarrollo en España, Europa, Latinoamérica, Estados Unidos y África. Somos la primera empresa tecnológica española de capital privado. En los últimos cuatro años, hemos experimentado un crecimiento exponencial, duplicando nuestro volumen de negocio año tras año. Esto nos ha permitido consolidarnos como un actor clave en el ecosistema tecnológico español y mantenernos competitivos frente a los líderes internacionales ¡Estamos redefiniendo el mapa tecnológico mundial! 🌐💻




Trabajamos muy duro, para transformar nuestra vida a través de la tecnología y queremos contar contigo para seguir creciendo. Si lo tuyo es el mundo IT, te gusta estar al día en las últimas tecnologías y quieres asumir un nuevo reto profesional ¡Sigue leyendo, te estamos buscando!




🔎¿Qué estamos buscando?

Buscamos un/a Data Analyst Senior con experiencia en Looker y Power BI, capaz de transformar necesidades de negocio en modelos analíticos, métricas y cuadros de mando de alto impacto. Queremos una persona con una sólida base en modelado de datos, orientación al cliente y capacidad para convertir información compleja en insights accionables para la toma de decisiones.

Buscamos una persona que nos ayude a seguir creciendo, con ganas de aportar y seguir evolucionando de la mano de los mejores profesionales, pero, sobre todo... ¡en hiberus buscamos buena gente! 😉




💻Algunas de tus funciones

Diseñar y mantener modelos de datos analíticos orientados a negocio.
Definir métricas, KPIs y estructuras de reporting junto a equipos de negocio.
Desarrollar, evolucionar y optimizar dashboards en Looker y Power BI.
Traducir requerimientos de negocio en soluciones analíticas escalables.
Participar en la recogida de requisitos, validación funcional y presentación de resultados a clientes.
Analizar datos y generar insights que aporten valor real al negocio.
Colaborar con equipos de Data Engineering, Arquitectura y Negocio para garantizar la calidad y consistencia del dato.
Proponer mejoras funcionales, analíticas y técnicas de manera proactiva.
Utilizar herramientas de IA para acelerar procesos de desarrollo y análisis.




💻💪🏻Habilidades y requisitos

Experiencia mínima de 4-5 años como Data Analyst o roles similares.
Experiencia demostrable en modelado de datos (dimensional, analítico o reporting).

Al menos 1 año de experiencia con Power BI, incluyendo:

Diseño de dashboards.
Modelado semántico.
Definición de KPIs y métricas.
Desarrollo con DAX.

Al menos 1 año de experiencia con Looker, incluyendo:

Desarrollo y mantenimiento de modelos en LookML.
Creación de Explores y vistas.
Desarrollo de cuadros de mando y reporting.
Conocimientos sólidos de SQL para explotación y análisis de datos.
Experiencia trabajando directamente con clientes y stakeholders de negocio.
Capacidad para comunicar resultados y presentar soluciones analíticas.
Perfil autónomo, proactivo y orientado a la resolución de problemas.
Capacidad analítica y pensamiento estructurado.
Buenas habilidades de comunicación y trabajo en equipo.




🙌¿Qué te ofrecemos?

💼 Contrato indefinido en una compañía puramente tecnológica, que forma parte de un gran grupo, solvente y en crecimiento.

💰 Salario fijo competitivo

🏖️ Ambiente familiar, cercano, ¡como una gran familia!

⏰ Conciliación con nuestra vida personal y laboral mediante horario flexible, desconexión digital, jornada intensiva viernes y verano.

🤙 Cultura “techie”, nos gusta estar en contacto con la tecnología, herramientas, y últimas novedades!

📚 ¡Formación! Siempre que quieras, disfrutarás de un amplio catálogo de cursos formativos, adaptados a tu perfil profesional, inquietudes y novedades del sector. Para ello, pondremos a tu disposición todo el potencial de nuestra Hiberus University y los acuerdos con los principales fabricantes.

💳 ¡Benefíciate! Programa de retribución flexible a medida: seguro médico, tarjeta de transporte público, cheques guardería, tarjeta restaurante, etc.




En hiberus estamos viviendo un crecimiento explosivo 💥 y queremos que formes parte de nuestro equipo.




Suena bien, ¿verdad? Si quieres saber más, ¡inscríbete y te contamos!




Si quieres saber más busca nuestros hashtag

#somoshiberus #lascosasocurrenaquí y conoce todo lo que hacemos.




Hablamos?




www.hiberus.com

Title: Analista de datos
Description:
Take your career to the next level with Amaris Consulting as a Data Analyst. Be part of an international team, thrive in a global group with a €800M turnover and over 1,000 clients worldwide, and an agile environment. You will join the Data team of one of our clients, working closely with business stakeholders to transform data into actionable insights. Spanish fluency is required as part of this role.




✍️ WHAT WOULD YOU NEED? ✍️

2-5 years of experience as a Data Analyst, BI Analyst, or similar role.
Strong proficiency with SQL for data extraction, transformation, and analysis.
Experience with data visualization tools such as Power BI, Tableau, or similar.
Solid knowledge of relational databases, data modelling, and version control tools such as Git.
Familiarity with Python for data analysis and automation.
Proven experience working with reporting solutions, dashboards, and business intelligence tools.
Advanced proficiency in Spanish (written and spoken).
Intermediate level of English.
Strong problem-solving skills and ability to work both independently and as part of a team.




👉 WHAT WILL YOU BE DOING?

Develop and maintain reports, dashboards, and analytical solutions to support business decision-making.
Collaborate with business stakeholders to gather requirements and translate them into data solutions.
Design, optimize, and maintain database structures to ensure data integrity and performance.
Analyse large datasets to identify trends, patterns, and opportunities for improvement.
Participate in data quality, governance, and continuous improvement initiatives.
Implement reporting and monitoring solutions that provide meaningful business insights.
Stay current with the latest industry trends and emerging technologies in Data Analytics and Business Intelligence.




🚀 WHY US? 🚀

Join our dynamic team of talented people and discover a world full of growth and opportunity. Here's what we offer:

Rapid growth through a personalised career path and salary assessment. 70% of our senior leaders started in entry-level positions.
Improve your skills through our Technology Academy catalogue, Udemy platform, language classes, webinars and workshops.
Take control of your training with a personal annual budget and company-paid certifications.
Enjoy flexible policies, remote work options and excellent social benefits such as transport and restaurant tickets, childcare support and private health insurance.
Benefit from our WeCare programme, which supports employees in critical situations.
Unlock your full potential, both professionally and personally.




Amaris Consulting prides itself on being an equal opportunity employer. We are committed to promoting diversity within the workforce and creating an inclusive work environment. To this end, we welcome applications from all qualified candidates, regardless of gender, sexual orientation, race, ethnicity, creed, age, marital status, disability, or other characteristics.

As a Senior Data Analyst, you will be part of the Science & Analytics team focused on Acquisition (5+ people), inside the Data department (40+ people).

  • You will proactively use data to identify opportunities to grow our business or improve our processes.
  • You will be a real sparring partner for Sales & Operation leaders, feed their strategy by anticipating the most important business questions, and leverage your data & statistical skills to answer them.
  • You will steer decision‑making in your business area through rigorous analyses, navigating ambiguity and collaborating across domains when needed.
  • You will drive our self-service approach to analytics, by understanding our colleague’s needs in their use of data, and promoting a data driven culture. The Science & Analytics team is also fully in charge of creating data models in the Data Warehouse (using dbt).
  • You will contribute to shaping the Data Engineering roadmap to deliver the best experience for your colleagues on the data platform.

WHAT You Can Expect From Your Life At Pennylane

Within one month:

  • You will learn everything about our company, our teams, and our vision during the first onboarding week.
  • You will get familiar with our stack, and have delivered a few small projects which will give you a concrete taste of our tools & processes.
  • You will be given time to meet your future stakeholders, and gain a deep knowledge of our product and operations.

Within 3 months:

  • You will be fully in charge of supporting your area of the business, prioritizing your tasks with decision makers.
  • You will be confortable with our technical stack (Python, Redshift, DBT).
  • You will contribute to larger cross-company projects.

Within 6 months:

  • You will proactively contribute to the team’s roadmap.
  • You will work with engineers and data practitioners on improving our stack and data platform.
  • You will share your learnings and best practices within the team.

And beyond: the data team will continue growing with the company

Which means:

  • Opportunities to recruit and mentor new team members
  • Increased accountability in project leadership
  • Responsibilities to design and implement new processes, tools and best practices to make sure that your team works even more efficiently.

Who are we looking for?

You’re the right candidate if you:

  • Have had previous experiences as Data Analyst, ideally in scale-up environments (5-6 years)
  • Are seasoned working with SQL, DBT and data visualization tools
  • Are comfortable collaborating with cross-functional stakeholders beyond the data team
  • You have a strong business acumen and are seen as a trusted partner by your business stakeholders
  • Have strong communication skills and are capable of articulating your ideas clearly
  • Are Fluent in French & English

What does the recruitment process look like?

  • A first interview with our Talent Acquisition Manager
  • A case study interview to discuss a topic closely related to one of our priorities (60 min)
  • A past project interview to hear about your experience (60 min)
  • An interview with our Tech & Product leaders to discuss our company culture (45 min)

What do we do to make your work life easier

🌴 Wherever you are based, you will get 25 vacations days paid by Pennylane

💵 You’ll have a competitive compensation package

📈 You'll get company shares to enjoy a piece of the success story you're building with us

🏡 You’ll have a budget to turn your home into a more comfortable workspace, as well as a monthly allowance to work from a coworking space whenever you feel like it

⛹️ Through our partner Gymlib, you’ll have access to 8000 fitness spaces in Europe and more than 300 activities related to wellness

💻 You’ll get the latest Apple equipment

🏢 Depending on the teams and the requirements of the position - you'll be able to work remotely from your country of residence, as long as it is in Europe and within a maximum time difference of two hours from the CET time zone

🎉 We are committed to regularly coming together for company events such as Tech Days (which bring remote Pennylaners together every 3 months) or our annual company seminar, fostering significant moments of cohesion for everyone.

If you are based in France, you will have a French contract following French regulation on top of the additional perks : 6 to 12 RTT, 5 weeks PTOs, lunch credits (Swile), Alan Blue healthcare cover and regular events in cities where Pennylaners are mostly presents (Lyon, Bordeaux, Nantes…)

We're working on providing those last advantages to our people based outside of France as well, but it can be quite more complex depending on different countries.

Who are we looking for ?

To thrive at Pennylane, you need :

  • To speak English (level is assessed and appreciated according to the department you’re applying to)
  • To be energized by an ever-shifting work environment
  • To be highly collaborative (within your team or other stakeholders)
  • Sufficiently experienced to prioritize business-led actions on your day to day activity

We know that some people are less likely to apply than others, if they don’t feel like they meet the full list of criteria.

If you’re hesitating, we encourage you to apply : who knows, it might be the start of a meaningful and long-lasting collaboration.

Important information for candidates

Recruitment scam attempts are on the rise. We invite you to remain vigilant during your exchanges.

Applications through official channels only : apply exclusively through our job postings published on our official platforms (career site, official partner pages).

Always verify the sender's email address: our communications are sent from professional email addresses with the domains @pennylane.com or @pennylane-partners.com

We will never ask you for payment or financial information

(bank details, payment for an interview, equipment purchases, etc.) as part of the recruitment process. If such a request is made to you, it is fraudulent. We invite you to not respond and to report it to us immediately.

We also want to emphasize that we fully embrace diversity, equity and inclusion and that we’re doing our best to create a safe and inclusive environment.

We are committed to providing an equal employment opportunity regardless of gender, sexual orientation, origin, disabilities, or any other traits that make you who you are. If anything, diversity makes us a more fun place to work at.

🇫🇷 Données personnelles

Pennylane traite vos données pour gérer votre candidature et évaluer votre adéquation au poste. Si votre candidature n’aboutit pas, vos données peuvent être conservées 2 ans à compter de notre dernier échange ou de la clôture du recrutement afin de constituer & gérer un vivier de candidats. Vous pouvez vous opposer à tout moment et demander la suppression de vos données en écrivant à : dpo@pennylane.com.

Title: Senior Data Analist Kruidvat
Description:
Dit ga je doen

In de rol van Senior Data Analist bij AS Watson ben je onderdeel van het Decision Analytics‑team binnen Data, Insights & Analytics voor onze merken Kruidvat en Trekpleister. Samen met andere collega's uit het analytics team (Data Engineer, Data Scientist) werk je aan uiteenlopende projecten en analyses die meerdere businessdomeinen raken, van commercie tot HR en supply chain tot winkels.

Als grootste Health en Beauty retailer in de Benelux hebben we een schat aan data die we kunnen gebruiken. Elke week worden we bezocht door 4 MILJOEN klanten in onze ruim 1500 winkels én webshops. Zowel in de Benelux als internationaal hebben we de focus op data analytics. Dit zie je onder andere terug in de centrale rol van onze afdeling en investeringen in moderne data en Cloud technologieën. Met jouw analytische blik vertaal je als Senior Data Analist complexe vraagstukken naar heldere inzichten en data‑producten die het datagedreven werken in onze online en offlineorganisatie versterken, of het nu gaat om klantgedrag, voorraadstromen, winkelperformance of operationele efficiëntie. Ben jij nieuwsgierig naar patronen in data en wil je met jouw analyses echte impact maken in een grote retailorganisatie?

Wat ga je doen als Data Analist bij AS Watson?


Je ondersteunt verschillende business- en klantteams met analyses en dataproducten die processen, klantreizen en operationele performance verbeteren.
Je vertaalt de (interne) klantvragen naar technische requirements of een helder analysevraagstuk.
Je voert zelfstandig (ad hoc) statistische analyses uit en brengt complexe inzichten terug tot heldere, begrijpelijke kernpunten.
Je doet concrete, praktische aanbevelingen aan stakeholders en ondersteunt teams actief bij datagedreven besluitvorming.
Je stimuleert en borgt de adoptie van nieuwe dataproducten binnen de organisatie.


Dit krijg je ervoor terug


Een snelle omgeving waarin je veel kunt leren. En werkplezier door verantwoordelijkheid, vrijheid en de ruimte om jezelf te ontplooien. 
Best belangrijk: een goed salaris! Afhankelijk van jouw ervaring start je tussen de € 4.580,- en € 6.500,- bruto per maand bij een 40-urige werkweek. Plus personeelskorting bij Kruidvat, Trekpleister en ICI PARIS XL! 
24 vakantiedagen en een aantrekkelijke ATV-regeling met 19,5 dagen op fulltime basis. Liever meer vrije tijd of extra geld? Koop of verkoop vakantiedagen of laat je ATV (deels) uitbetalen.
Volop ontwikkelings- en doorgroeimogelijkheden met onze eigen AS Watson Academy. Bij AS Watson sta je nooit stil.
Goede thuiswerkmogelijkheden. Hybride werken is bij ons heel gewoon en gaat altijd in goed overleg.


Dit ben jij


Je brengt minimaal 3 jaar ervaring als Data Analist of BI Consultant mee en beweegt je moeiteloos tussen verschillende businessdomeinen; je combineert analytische vaardigheden met een pragmatische, oplossingsgerichte aanpak om het datagedreven werken verder te versterken.
Je bent bedreven in het opstellen van meetplannen, het definiëren en het visualiseren van de juiste KPI’s en het is een pre als je zelf dashboards kan ontwerpen (Tableau, Power BI, Looker Studio of vergelijkbaar).
Je beheerst SQL uitstekend, kunt goed uit de voeten met statistische analyses en voelt je thuis in cloud‑based (analytics) platforms zoals Databricks, Google Cloud Console of Microsoft Azure. Kennis van Python is een pre.
Je bent van nature nieuwsgierig naar patronen in data en naar de onderliggende dynamiek van verschillende businessdomeinen (commercie, supply chain, operatie, HR, finance, enz.)
Je bent in staat om de inzichten van je analyses op een heldere en simpele manier over te brengen aan collega's. Wel zo handig als je in crossfunctionele teams werkt.


Wie jij bent, maakt ons buitengewoon! Waar wacht je nog op? Solliciteer snel en laat van je horen!

Bureaus leg de telefoon maar weer neer: wij werven zelf voor deze vacature.

Title: Data Analyst Confirmé F/H
Description:
Plongez au cœur de l'Innovation avec CRIT et rejoignez-nous en tant que Data Analyst Confirmé H/F !

Passionné(e) par la data, l’intelligence artificielle et la transformation des métiers par la donnée ? CRIT, acteur majeur du recrutement et du travail temporaire en France, recherche son/sa futur(e) Data Analyst Confirmé(e) pour accompagner l’accélération de sa stratégie Data & IA au sein de son pôle innovation.

Au sein d’une équipe Data en pleine structuration, vous jouerez un rôle central dans la valorisation des données de l’entreprise. À la croisée des enjeux techniques et métier, vous travaillerez main dans la main avec les différentes feature Teams, les product managers et les équipes métiers afin de transformer la donnée en levier de performance et d’innovation.

Votre Mission, Si Vous L'acceptez

En tant que Data Analyst Confirmé, vous serez responsable de l’analyse, de la structuration et de la valorisation des données afin d’accompagner la prise de décision stratégique de l’entreprise.

Vous interviendrez sur l’ensemble de la chaîne de valeur Data : de l’exploration des données jusqu’à la production d’insights exploitables, en passant par la conception de modèles analytiques et l'accompagnement des métiers.

Dans le cadre de notre ambition autour de la Data et de l’Intelligence Artificielle, vous participerez également à l’identification et au développement de nouveaux cas d’usage exploitant les agents IA et l'IA générative afin d'améliorer la productivité, la connaissance client et l'efficacité opérationnelle.

Vos Super-Pouvoirs


Collecter, consolider et exploiter des données issues de multiples sources internes et externes.
Monitorer la qualité, la cohérence et la fiabilité des données utilisées par les équipes métiers.
Concevoir et maintenir des jeux de données et indicateurs de référence pour les différentes directions.
Travailler au sein de l'écosystème Databricks et contribuer à l'exploitation du Lakehouse de l'entreprise.
Rédiger des requêtes SQL performantes, analyses et traitements de données complexes.


Identifier des tendances, corrélations et opportunités d'amélioration business.


Produire des tableaux de bord, reportings et visualisations interactives à destination des équipes métiers et des instances de pilotage.
Accompagner les métiers dans l'interprétation des données et la prise de décision basée sur les faits.
Identifier les opportunités d'automatisation des analyses et des reportings.
Participer à la mise en place de bonnes pratiques de gouvernance, de documentation et de structuration de la donnée.
Concevoir et expérimenter des assistants et agents IA capables d'automatiser des tâches d'analyse, de recherche d'information ou de pilotage de la performance.
Évaluer la valeur métier des solutions IA, mesurer leur impact et accompagner leur adoption au sein des équipes.
Assurer une veille continue sur les évolutions de la Data, de l'Analytics et de l'Intelligence Artificielle.


Ce Que Nous Recherchons


Expériences significatives en tant que Data Analyst dans un environnement Data moderne.
Excellente maîtrise de SQL et bonne maîtrise de Python pour l'analyse et la transformation de données.
Expérience confirmée sur Databricks
Bonne connaissance des modèles de données, des problématiques de qualité, de gouvernance et de structuration de la donnée.
Solides compétences analytiques et statistiques permettant de transformer les données en recommandations opérationnelles.
Capacité à comprendre rapidement les enjeux métier et à dialoguer avec des interlocuteurs variés.
Appétence forte pour l'intelligence artificielle et les usages liés aux LLM, à l'IA générative et aux systèmes agentiques.
Expérience dans l'utilisation ou l'intégration de solutions IA au travers d'API ou de plateformes spécialisées.
Compréhension des enjeux liés à la qualité et la confidentialité ainsi que des notions sur la sécurité et la gouvernance des données.
Curiosité, esprit d'innovation et volonté de faire progresser les pratiques Data et IA de l'entreprise.
Excellentes capacités de communication, de vulgarisation et d'accompagnement au changement.


Pourquoi nous rejoindre ?

Impact et Innovation

Un rôle clé dans la structuration de la stratégie Data & IA du Groupe, avec une forte visibilité auprès des directions métiers et digitales.

Technologies modernes

Évoluez dans un environnement en pleine transformation s'appuyant sur Databricks, les architectures Data modernes et les solutions d'intelligence artificielle de nouvelle génération.

Flexibilité

Télétravail flexible pour favoriser l'équilibre entre vie professionnelle et personnelle.

Avantages sociaux

CSE (chèques cadeaux, CESU...), RTT, Action Logement, carte restaurant de 10 € avec prise en charge à 60 %.

Un projet stimulant

Rejoindre un projet innovant dès ses premières phases de structuration tout en bénéficiant de la solidité et des moyens d'un grand groupe.

Prêt(e) à construire les futurs usages Data & IA du Groupe CRIT ? Rejoignez-nous et participez à la transformation de nos métiers par la donnée et l'intelligence artificielle.

Groupe Crit, un acteur majeur du travail temporaire et de l’assistance aéroportuaire

Le Groupe Crit est l'un des leaders du travail temporaire et du recrutement en France et à l'international. Il est numéro 1 de l'assistance aéroportuaire en France. Il est également partenaire des projets de grandes industries en matière d'ingénierie et de maintenance.

Title: Data Analyst
Description:
Job title: DATA ANALYST

Location: Paris, France

Job reference #: 33732

Contract type: Permanent

Language requirements: Fluent in French and English




At Eni, we are looking for a Data Analyst to join Eni Plenitude France. In this role, you will work closely with cross-functional teams, including Marketing, Finance, Sales, Operations and Customer Service, to transform data into actionable insights that drive business performance. You will play a key role in analysing, interpreting and enhancing data to support commercial growth, optimise the customer experience, address business needs and enable strategic decision-making, ultimately contributing to the company’s operational efficiency and long-term success.




About Plenitude




Plenitude is an energy company that integrates the retail business and renewable generation with self-consumption and electric mobility solutions, providing energy and gas to more than 10 million homes and businesses across Europe, which offers a range of great professional opportunities for the whole team. Title: Analista de Datos
Place: Santa Cruz de Bezana, Cantabria, Spain
Description:
En LISDATA transformamos datos en conocimiento útil para las empresas. Somos una ingeniería especializada en analítica avanzada, Industria 4.0, Big Data e Inteligencia Artificial, y trabajamos codo con codo con nuestros clientes para impulsar la evolución de su negocio.




Creemos que los mejores resultados llegan cuando las personas están en el centro. Por eso fomentamos un entorno cercano, donde el talento, el bienestar y el crecimiento profesional son una prioridad, algo que nos valió el Premio a la Calidad en el Empleo en Cantabria en 2022.




Buscamos incorporar Analistas de Datos con curiosidad, visión de negocio y ganas de seguir aprendiendo. Formarás parte de nuestro equipo ubicado en Cantabria, donde participarás en proyectos a medida de análisis de datos e Inteligencia Artificial.




¿Qué harás en LIS?




Colaborarás con el equipo de proyectos y con cliente para entender sus necesidades y traducirlas en preguntas que los datos puedan responder.
Extraerás, depurarás y prepararás datos de distintas fuentes mediante SQL y Python.
Realizarás análisis exploratorios y estadísticos para identificar tendencias, patrones y oportunidades de mejora.
Diseñarás y desarrollarás dashboards e informes que faciliten la toma de decisiones.
Definirás y harás seguimiento de indicadores clave (KPIs) de los proyectos.
Comunicarás los resultados de forma clara a perfiles técnicos y no técnicos.




¿Qué valoramos de ti?




Imprescindible:

Conocimientos de SQL en bases de datos como SQL Server o PostgreSQL.
Programación en Python para análisis de datos (NumPy, Pandas) y visualización (Matplotlib, Seaborn).
Experiencia con herramientas de Business Intelligence como Power BI, Qlik Sense o Tableau.




Valorable:

Conocimientos de bases de datos NoSQL (MongoDB).
Experiencia en el tratamiento de datos en cloud con Azure (Blob Storage, Synapse), PySpark y Databricks.
Conocimientos de Data Mining y Machine Learning con librerías como Scikit-learn, TensorFlow o PyTorch, y Azure ML.
Conocimientos de Java/Spring o FastAPI.
Familiaridad con Git u otros sistemas de control de versiones.
Proactividad, compromiso y capacidad de resolución de problemas.
Buenas habilidades de comunicación y trabajo en equipo, también en entornos con cliente.




¿Qué te ofrecemos?




Plan de carrera personalizado, orientado a tu desarrollo profesional.
Contrato indefinido a jornada completa.
Flexibilidad horaria.
23 días hábiles de vacaciones.
Jornada intensiva los viernes, en verano y durante la Navidad.
Gimnasio gratuito.




Si te gusta hacer las preguntas correctas y encontrar las respuestas en los datos, en LIS tienes mucho por descubrir. ¡Te esperamos!
