Title: Senior Data Analyst
Description:
SHAPE THE FUTURE OF PRIVACY WITH USERCENTRICS 


Usercentrics is a global leader in the field of consent management platforms (CMP). We follow our company vision to build a world where user privacy enables a thriving digital ecosystem. Our mission is to provide privacy solutions that empower organizations to embrace data privacy while building trust with their users through freedom of choice. With our product, businesses can collect, manage and document user consents on websites and apps, and achieve full compliance in accordance with global privacy regulations while facilitating high consent rates and building trust with their customers.


We are looking for a self driven, curious, and analytical individual to join as a Senior Data Analyst. You will work with cross functional teams to help solve complex business problems and draw relevant insights by leveraging data, building scalable processes, and compelling visualization. Your interventions are backed by compelling storytelling capabilities that are built on the back of a deep understanding of our commercial insights.


YOUR TASKS

Partner with our business stakeholders, product and tech teams to define complex and ambiguous problems and solve them with data
Develop innovative analytical methodologies to answer strategic business questions across the organization that helps us become more data-driven
Relentlessly challenge the status quo and uncover business patterns in our processes to drive efficiency, speed, quality, and cost savings
Demonstrated success working with executives at the most senior levels, developing an analytics roadmap, and providing recommendations that direct business strategy  and achieve high impact results


Requirements



YOU BRING

Bachelor's degree or equivalent experience ideally in a quantitative field (Mathematics, Economics, Statistics, etc.) 
Background in strategy consulting and/or tech scale ups, SaaS
5+ years of work experience in SQL/Python and data visualization & business intelligence tools (ideally PowerBI, Looker or Omni analytics) to communicate business insights using data
2+ years in SaaS B2B preferred
Familiarity with AI tools such as Claude to support data exploration, drafting analyses, and speeding up day-to-day analytical tasks
Intellectually curious, high energy, and strong work ethic; passionate about working with, normalizing, and synthesizing large amounts of data into actionable insights
Process-oriented with strong organizational and communication skills
Ability to identify and succinctly summarize roadblocks and constraints, propose potential solutions, and drive towards resolution
Fluency in English with strong verbal and written communication skills 


Don't meet every single requirement? Studies have shown that women and people of colour are less likely to apply to jobs unless they meet every single qualification. At Usercentrics we are dedicated to building a diverse, inclusive and authentic workplace, so if you're excited about this role but your past experience doesn't align perfectly with every qualification in the job description, we encourage you to apply anyway. You may be just the right candidate for this or other roles.



Benefits



WHY JOIN USERCENTRICS?

Joining Usercentrics means becoming part of a fast-growing, diverse and international team of tech enthusiasts and entrepreneurially-minded who build our success story together

En tant que Data Analyst Senior, vous justifiez d’une expérience réussie sur des projets data & analytics à fort enjeu, alliant transformation de données et restitution décisionnelle.



Formation & expérience



Titulaire d’un Bac +5 (école d’ingénieur, université) ou équivalent
Minimum 7 ans d’expérience en data analyse dont une expérience significative combinant data visualisation et proposition d’insights.

Data Visualisation & Analytics



Maîtrise avancée de Power BI : modélisation sémantique, DAX, Power Query, conception de tableaux de bord interactifs et optimisation des performances
Excellente capacité à explorer, analyser et interpréter les données afin d'identifier des tendances, opportunités, risques et leviers de performance

Data Management & Exploitation de la donnée



Solide maîtrise du SQL pour l'exploration, l'analyse et la préparation des données
Usage des outils de data préparation (DBT, Dataiku, Alteryx)
Bonne compréhension des modèles de données et des architectures analytiques modernes
Sensibilité aux enjeux de qualité, de fiabilité et de gouvernance des données
Capacité à exploiter des sources de données variées et à croiser des informations multiples pour construire des analyses à forte valeur ajoutée

IA appliquée à l'analyse de données



Maîtrise des usages de l'IA et de l'IA générative pour accélérer l'exploration des données, la recherche d'insights et la production de livrables analytiques
Capacité à utiliser les assistants IA pour enrichir les analyses, automatiser certaines investigations et améliorer l'expérience décisionnelle
Sensibilité aux notions de traçabilité, qualité, sécurité et gouvernance de la donnée





Cloud & Environnements Data



Expérience des environnements analytiques modernes : Databricks, Snowflake, BigQuery, Microsoft Fabric ou plateformes équivalentes
Compréhension des principes de stockage, de transformation et d'exposition de la donnée dans les plateformes analytiques modernes
La connaissance du versioning (Git) et des pratiques collaboratives de développement constitue un plus





Méthode & outils



Expérience du travail en mode agile (Scrum, Kanban, SAFE)
Capacité à communiquer avec des interlocuteurs variés : métiers, équipes techniques et directions
Maîtrise des outils collaboratifs et de gestion de projet (Jira, Confluence, Azure DevOps, Microsoft Teams...)
Bon niveau d'anglais professionnel (oral et écrit) – B2 minium

Certifications (un plus)



Microsoft Power BI Data Analyst (PL-300)
Microsoft Fabric Analytics Engineer (DP-600)
Databricks Data Analyst Associate
Certifications IA appliquées à la data et à la Business Intelligence

Qualités personnelles attendues



Esprit analytique développé et forte capacité de résolution de problèmes
Curiosité intellectuelle et goût pour l'exploration des données
Capacité à formuler des recommandations concrètes à partir des analyses
Excellentes qualités de communication et sens de la pédagogie
Autonomie, esprit d'initiative et force de proposition
Orientation résultats et impact métier
Capacité à vulgariser des sujets complexes auprès d'interlocuteurs non techniques
Esprit d'équipe et sens du service client

Votre souhait d’évolution



Si vous avez les compétences requises et souhaitez faire partie d’une équipe à taille humaine en pleine expansion, alliant expertise technique et proximité, vous êtes certainement le/la Data Analyst que nous recherchons !



Quelques références



Client du secteur de l’industrie : Modernisation de la plateforme décisionnelle - cadrage des besoins métier, construction des flux de transformation dbt sur Snowflake, modélisation des data marts, développement et déploiement des tableaux de bord Power BI.
Client du secteur du luxe : Mise en place d’une architecture analytics - industrialisation des pipelines ELT (dbt) sur Databricks, définition des règles de gouvernance et de qualité des données, développement des rapports Power BI et déploiement continu intégré à Git.

Description:
💡 OVENTI Consulting, cabinet de conseil en Data et Intelligence Artificielle qui allie expertise technique de pointe, vision stratégique et accompagnement sur mesure. Nous couvrons tout le cycle de vie des projets Data/IA, de la stratégie à l'implémentation de solutions personnalisées (ML, BI, automatisation intelligente).

Nos équipes, issues des meilleures écoles, s'intègrent chez nos clients ou opèrent depuis notre LAB interne, véritable foyer d’innovation. Chez Oventi, nous privilégions le "sur mesure" et l'innovation concrète. Chaque collaborateur est accompagné, formé et suivi pour garantir une culture d'excellence et un impact réel.




🧑 💻 Pourquoi ce rôle est clé ?

En tant que Data Analyst, vous occuperez un rôle stratégique au niveau de la data, de la business intelligence et de l'intelligence artificielle. Votre mission principale sera de transformer la donnée en leviers d'action concrets pour les équipes métiers, en consolidant le pilotage analytique et en intégrant des solutions d'IA pour affiner la prise de décision.




🎯 Vos missions au quotidien :

Pilotage de la performance :

Assurer un rôle de pilotage data et analytique complet, en définissant et en suivant les indicateurs de performance clés (KPI) pour le business.




Définition de stratégies :

Contribuer activement à la définition des stratégies, notamment en matière de merchandising et de négociation, en fournissant des analyses et des recommandations basées sur les données.




Optimisation de l'écosystème de reporting :

Gérer et rationaliser l'ensemble des tableaux de bord existants. L'objectif est de réduire le nombre de dashboards pour aboutir à une constellation d'outils plus efficaces et pertinents.




Développement d'outils analytiques :

Concevoir et mettre en place des outils de reporting stratégiques, tels qu'un Revenue Performance Dashboard, pour offrir une vision claire et consolidée de la performance financière.




Analyse avancée assistée par l'IA :

Mener des analyses complexes et des raisonnements "au cas d'usage" en exploitant des technologies d'Intelligence Artificielle. Utiliser l'IA comme un levier pour explorer les données et formuler des hypothèses d'action.




🧩 Stack technique :

Langages : Python, SQL
Bases de données : BigQuery
Outils de Business Intelligence & Visualisation : Looker, Tableau
Formats de données : CSV, JSON, Avro
Outils de gestion projet : Jira, Confluence




🧩 Vous êtes la personne idéale si :

5 ans d'expérience en tant que Data Analyst.
Diplômé d'un master ou d'une école d'ingénieur avec une spécialisation en Data Analyse, intelligence artificielle ou data science.
Aisance relationnelle, esprit collaboratif et appétence pour l'amélioration continue.




🌟 Pourquoi rejoindre OVENTI ?

Rejoindre Oventi, c'est choisir une aventure professionnelle unique :

Title: Senior Data Analyst
Description:
Department

WDTech - R&D

We are Walker & Dunlop. We are one of the largest providers of capital to the commercial real estate industry, enabling real estate owners and operators to bring their visions of communities — where people live, work, shop, and play — to life. We are committed to creating meaningful social, environmental, and economic change in our communities.

Department Overview

WDTech is W&D’s in-house technology team – a group of collaborative and highly skilled technology professionals, all of whom are leading experts in real estate data, data science, and technology.

WDTech Engineering builds solutions that impact not only our products but also the people and processes across our organization. A commitment to innovation and a passion for disrupting the old-fashioned real estate industry are our highest priorities.

The Impact You Will Have

As a Senior Data Analyst, you will play a key role in delivering trusted data insights and analytics that support business and product decision-making across the organization. This role is responsible for analyzing complex datasets, developing reporting solutions and dashboards, and translating data into actionable insights that improve operational effectiveness and support strategic initiatives.

Working closely with Data Analysts, BI Analysts, Data Engineers, Data QA Engineers, Data Scientists, and Product Managers, you will help ensure data products are accurate, scalable, and aligned with evolving business needs as Walker & Dunlop continues to grow as a data-driven organization.

Primary Responsibilities


Analyze and curate data sources to support business and product stakeholders in making informed decisions.
Lead key components of the analytical lifecycle, including data exploration, analysis, reporting, and insight delivery.
Translate complex data into clear, actionable insights for technical and non-technical audiences.
Develop and maintain Power BI dashboards, reports, and analytical solutions.
Perform data wrangling, transformation, and analysis using SQL and enterprise analytical databases.
Define and document datasets, business logic, and reporting definitions to support consistent data usage.
Partner with data and product teams to support data governance, data quality, and data management processes.
Analyze user engagement, operational, and product data to identify trends and opportunities for improvement.
Mentor junior analysts and promote best practices in analytics, visualization, and stakeholder collaboration.
Perform other duties as assigned


Education And Experience


Bachelor’s degree preferred, preferably in Computer Science, Data Analytics, Information Systems, Mathematics, or a related field.
6+ years of experience in data analysis, business intelligence, or analytics roles with demonstrated ownership of end-to-end analytical projects.
Strong experience working with enterprise analytical databases such as Snowflake, Redshift, BigQuery, or similar technologies.
Experience developing dashboards and reporting solutions using Power BI, Tableau, or similar visualization tools.
Experience with SQL, data transformation, and analytical reporting workflows.
Experience with Python and geospatial analysis preferred.
Real estate, financial services, or related industry experience preferred.


Knowledge, Skills And Abilities


Deep expertise in SQL and data analysis techniques.
Strong proficiency with data visualization and reporting tools such as Power BI or Tableau.
Understanding of data modeling, ETL processes, and analytical best practices.
Ability to communicate technical concepts and analytical findings clearly to business and technical audiences.
Strong analytical, organizational, and problem-solving skills.
Ability to work collaboratively across technical and business teams in a fast-paced environment.
Familiarity with AI-enabled tools that support reporting, documentation, and analysis workflows preferred.
High level of accountability, attention to detail, and commitment to continuous improvement.
Ability to show ownership of your work, take on challenges and acknowledge growth opportunities, and demonstrate patience when learning new processes
Courtesy, respect, and thoughtfulness in teaming with colleagues and other stakeholders


What We Offer 


You will have the opportunity to accelerate in our rapidly growing organization.
Agile working environment with flexible working hours and location, career advancement, and competitive compensation package.
We are a family friendly company.
We arrange social activities to help our employees and families become familiar with each other and our culture.
In addition to other benefits, we offer a pension scheme and 100% complimentary and confidential mental health services.


Equal Employment Opportunity Statement

We are committed to equity in all steps of the recruitment and employment experience. We believe in equal access to opportunities in our workplace. We do not tolerate discrimination, including harassment, based on any characteristic protected by applicable law, such as race, color, national origin, religion, gender identity, sexual orientation, sex, age, disability, veteran or military status, and genetic information, or any other characteristic protected by applicable law. We strive to be a safe place to ask questions, build professional relationships, and develop careers.

Title: Senior Data Analyst
Description:
SHAPE THE FUTURE OF PRIVACY WITH USERCENTRICS 


Usercentrics is a global leader in the field of consent management platforms (CMP). We follow our company vision to build a world where user privacy enables a thriving digital ecosystem. Our mission is to provide privacy solutions that empower organizations to embrace data privacy while building trust with their users through freedom of choice. With our product, businesses can collect, manage and document user consents on websites and apps, and achieve full compliance in accordance with global privacy regulations while facilitating high consent rates and building trust with their customers.


We are looking for a self driven, curious, and analytical individual to join as a Senior Data Analyst. You will work with cross functional teams to help solve complex business problems and draw relevant insights by leveraging data, building scalable processes, and compelling visualization. Your interventions are backed by compelling storytelling capabilities that are built on the back of a deep understanding of our commercial insights.


YOUR TASKS

Partner with our business stakeholders, product and tech teams to define complex and ambiguous problems and solve them with data
Develop innovative analytical methodologies to answer strategic business questions across the organization that helps us become more data-driven
Relentlessly challenge the status quo and uncover business patterns in our processes to drive efficiency, speed, quality, and cost savings
Demonstrated success working with executives at the most senior levels, developing an analytics roadmap, and providing recommendations that direct business strategy  and achieve high impact results


Requirements



YOU BRING

Bachelor's degree or equivalent experience ideally in a quantitative field (Mathematics, Economics, Statistics, etc.) 
Background in strategy consulting and/or tech scale ups, SaaS
5+ years of work experience in SQL/Python and data visualization & business intelligence tools (ideally PowerBI, Looker or Omni analytics) to communicate business insights using data
2+ years in SaaS B2B preferred
Familiarity with AI tools such as Claude to support data exploration, drafting analyses, and speeding up day-to-day analytical tasks
Intellectually curious, high energy, and strong work ethic; passionate about working with, normalizing, and synthesizing large amounts of data into actionable insights
Process-oriented with strong organizational and communication skills
Ability to identify and succinctly summarize roadblocks and constraints, propose potential solutions, and drive towards resolution
Fluency in English with strong verbal and written communication skills 


Don't meet every single requirement? Studies have shown that women and people of colour are less likely to apply to jobs unless they meet every single qualification. At Usercentrics we are dedicated to building a diverse, inclusive and authentic workplace, so if you're excited about this role but your past experience doesn't align perfectly with every qualification in the job description, we encourage you to apply anyway. You may be just the right candidate for this or other roles.



Benefits



WHY JOIN USERCENTRICS?

Joining Usercentrics means becoming part of a fast-growing, diverse and international team of tech enthusiasts and entrepreneurially-minded who build our success story together
Company culture is important to us - we strive to continuously develop a positive, vibrant and inspiring environment that enables everyone to thrive both personally and professionally
Get involved! We have plenty of initiatives and love to see people from all department enthusiastically participating and shaping our future together in different cross-department projects
Your work-life balance is important to us too - we offer flexible working hours, hybrid working and the possibility of workcations (in accordance with our company policy)
We always remember to have fun along the way, both in our day-to-day work and at our regular team events on site in our offices in Munich, Copenhagen, Odense, Lisbon and Prague, Buenos aires and New York
You are the most valuable asset to our company which is why we're happy to offer awesome benefits like our personal development budget, job-related language courses and a lot more (depending on your location) to focus on your well being




ABOUT US

We are driven by our values #BeBrave, #BetterTogether, #LeadbyExample, #InnovateWithPurpose, #PassionForPrivacy, #GiveBack and #ComeAsYouAre. They show what we believe in and how we work. They help make our team special and guide us in everything we do. They're the heart of our company and inspire us to do our best every day.

We strive to create a diverse, equitable, and inclusive environment (DEI) where everyone feels valued, respected, and empowered to reach their full potential. We believe that our different backgrounds, experiences, and perspectives are our greatest strengths — so we are committed to building with them as we foster innovation and drive our success.

We recognize that this is an ongoing journey. We commit to listening and to continuous learning, growth, and improvement. By embracing DEI principles, we will create a more just and equitable society, and we are proud to play our part in making this vision a reality.

We are #BetterTogether.

Description:
We’re Hiring!

Senior Data Analyst




At Envu, we partner with our customers to design world-class, forward-thinking innovations that protect and enhance the health of environments around the world. We offer dedicated services in: Professional Pest Management, Forestry, Ornamentals, Golf, Industrial Vegetation Management, Lawn & Landscape, Mosquito Management, and Range & Pasture.




Envu brings together a broad range of perspectives to look beyond chemistry and dare to explore new paths forward. Guided by our inclusive culture, we embrace change and flexibility, tackling our customers’ toughest challenges proactively, passionately and with an entrepreneurial spirit.




We pursue our ambitions collaboratively because we know that a unified and empowered team is an unstoppable force, allowing us to achieve our vision of healthy environments for everyone, everywhere. Join Us.




Envu is proud to be certified as a Top Employer 2026 in France and the United States




FUNCTION: CFO

LOCATION: Lyon, France

JOB TYPE: Permanent

JOB GRADE: 6




GET TO KNOW YOUR AREA:

Join the Finance Data Analytics team to enhance data analysis and visualization tools to drive financial strategy, enhance forecasting accuracy, and provide critical insights that support key business decisions.
Focus on leveraging the capabilities of our Azure Data lake, Databricks and the Microsoft Power Platform (Power BI, PowerApps, and Power Automate) to enhance our reports, process automation, and custom business applications.
Provide dedicated support to the Marketing team by developing and maintaining reporting solutions, translating business needs into data-driven insights, and acting as a strategic business partner to support decision-making and performance management.




YOUR MISSION WILL BE TO:

Design, develop and maintain complex Power BI dashboards for decision-making while taking into account the needs from the different stakeholders (Finance, Business, Marketing…).
Build and maintain data pipelines and transformation workflows using Python, SQL and Databricks (notebooks, workflows, applications…) to industrialize data processing.
Perform data modeling, transformation and analytics using Python, SQL and DAX.
Continuously evaluate and improve existing processes and systems using insights derived from data analysis and automation projects.
Develop custom business applications using Databricks, integrating with various data sources and APIs to fulfill unique business requirements.
Actively contributing to the expertise level and competencies of the Finance Data & Analytics team
Collaborate with other departments to identify opportunities for process improvement and automation in reporting workflows.




ARE YOU READY FOR THE ROLE?

Main requirements:

Master's degree in a relevant field such as Computer Science, Statistics, or Data Analytics. Experience in Finance or Marketing is a strong plus.
Minimum of 5 years of experience in a data analyst role, with a proven experience in data modelling and data visualization.
Experience in writing scripts, and queries using Python and SQL.
Expertise in Databricks is a strong plus.
Experience leveraging GenAI tools (e.g., Microsoft Copilot in Fabric/Power BI, Databricks AI/BI Genie, Claude) to accelerate data exploration and reporting is a plus
Excellent analytical and problem-solving skills, with the ability to translate complex data into actionable insights.

Envu is committed to creating an inclusive environment for all employees and applicants, regardless of ethnicity, color, race, religion, origin, age, gender, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, or other conditions. And all opportunities are open to people with disabilities.

Under close guidance or supervision, updates and analyses less complicated databases ensuring that data is correct.

Title: Senior Data Analyst
Description:
As a Senior Data Analyst on our Growth team, you will play a pivotal role in driving our marketing performance to new heights. You will collaborate closely with User Acquisition and Growth partners to analyze data, find opportunities, and deliver actionable insights. Your work will empower strategic business decisions and improve player experiences.

What You'll Do
Partner closely with UA and Growth collaborators to understand performance, investigate business questions, and provide actionable recommendations.
Lead analytical projects end-to-end, from problem definition and data exploration through to insights and collaborator communication.
Own and evolve the business logic and analytical requirements of Growth data models, ensuring they accurately represent how the business measures performance.
Act as a key collaborator with Data Engineering, translating business and analytical needs into clear data requirements and validating delivered solutions.
Proactively identify and investigate data quality issues, inconsistencies, and gaps across Growth reporting and underlying data models.
Build and maintain scalable reporting and analytical solutions, reducing repetitive manual analysis where possible.
Define and maintain key Growth metrics and measurement logic across areas such as spend, acquisition, revenue, attribution, and marketing performance.
Perform deep-dive analyses to understand performance drivers, find opportunities, and support investment decisions.
Communicate complex findings clearly to both technical and non-technical collaborators, including senior leadership.
Provide technical mentorship and share standard methodologies with other analysts while contributing to consistent analytical standards across the team.
Work closely with Data Scientists on measurement, experimentation, and modeling projects by offering solid analytical and data foundations.


What We're Looking For

We are seeking an ambitious and seasoned Senior Data Analyst with a proven track record of delivering outstanding results. You should have:
4+ years of professional experience in Data Analytics, Business Intelligence, Analytics Engineering, or a related role.
Strong experience independently delivering analytical projects and working directly with business collaborators.
Experience owning or contributing significantly to analytical data models, metric definitions, or reporting foundations.
Advanced SQL skills and strong experience working with large and complex datasets.
Proficiency in Python for data analysis, automation and analytical workflows.
Strong understanding of data modeling, data quality, and analytical data structures.
Experience converting business requirements into data requirements and collaborating closely with Data Engineering teams.
Proficiency in a data visualization/BI tool such as Looker, Tableau, or similar.
Good understanding of statistical analysis and experimentation.
Familiarity with digital marketing data, attribution, and acquisition metrics is a strong plus.
A strong ownership approach, comfortable independently driving work through to completion.
A curious and analytical nature, always looking to investigate unexpected results and challenge assumptions.
Realistic and dedicated to identifying ways forward.
Strong attention to detail and a high standard for data accuracy and reliability.
Comfortable working with ambiguity and changing priorities in a fast paced business environment.
Strong collaboration skills, capable of working effectively across Analytics, Data Science, Data Engineering, and business teams.
Excellent communication skills, able to challenge constructively and build trust with technical and non-technical collaborators.
Willingness to assist in the technical growth of other analysts and help maintain high analytical standards throughout the team.


This job description may have been reviewed and enhanced using AI-assisted tools to improve clarity, consistency, and inclusivity. All final content, role requirements and hiring decisions remain subject to human review and approval by Aristocrat.

Compensation Philosophy

We offer a comprehensive pay and benefits package designed to stay competitive in the market, support your wellbeing, and recognise your contribution to our success. Our approach is underpinned by a pay-for-performance belief in rewarding individual impact. Your specific compensation package will be determined by factors such as your skills, experience, qualifications, and location.

Depending on your role and location, you may be eligible for annual bonuses and incentives, health and wellbeing benefits, paid time off, retirement plans, insurance coverage, and other local or statutory benefits.

Specific details about compensation and benefits for this position will be discussed during the recruitment process.

Title: Senior Data Analyst / Data Analyst
Description:
About Euromonitor

Euromonitor International leads the world in data analytics and research into markets, industries, economies and consumers. We provide truly global insight and data on thousands of products and services; we are the first destination for organisations seeking growth. With our guidance, our clients can make bold, strategic decisions with confidence. Overview of the role.

Overview Of The Role

We build the demographic, socio-economic and macroeconomic datasets that Euromonitor clients around the world rely on to make decisions. We are looking for a Data Analyst or Senior Data Analyst to help standardise, model and forecast that data - turning messy, inconsistent source statistics into figures people can actually compare and trust.

It is a role for someone who likes solving problems with data: sharpening our modelling and forecasting techniques, and finding new ways to improve data quality and comparability rather than just maintaining the status quo.

Requirements

What you'll do


Analyze and manipulate datasets, carrying out calculations and numerical analysis using R.
Standardize raw statistical data to ensure cross-source comparability.
Extrapolate and interpolate data using both quantitative and qualitative methods to develop modelling and forecasting techniques.
Monitor, review, and enhance data quality.
Document all work processes to ensure team alignment and best practices.
Liaise with sales and marketing departments and handle client queries.


What We're Looking For


Background in mathematics, econometrics, data science, statistics or similar fields.
Proficiency in R. Knowledge of Python is a plus.
Proficiency with Git.
Experience in data manipulation, statistical analysis and time series forecasting.
Good coding habits: proper documentation, styling, reproducibility.
Excellent communications skills and fluency in English (both oral & written).

Title: Senior Data Analyst
Description:
About BizAway

Here at BizAway, we Deliver the Future of Travel. 😎

We are a solid international company with strong ambitions and great expertise. With a focus on sustainability 🌱, on a daily basis we support companies enabling them to improve their travel management through our constantly evolving services and solutions, always characterized by our tech attitude and smart and innovative processes. 🚀

We know that success comes from People and deserves to be recognized.👫Proactivity and

Reliability, Kind collaboration, and communication are the core values of our Solution Culture.

If you like challenges and would love to be part of one of the fastest-growing B2B scale-ups, then BizAway is the company you have been looking for. 🤩

We are looking for

We are looking for a driven and enthusiastic Senior Data Analyst (m/w/d) , who desires to contribute to the growth and success of our Data & Analytics Team.

Your role in BizAway


You tackle complex business problems end to end, translating ambiguous questions into analysis, and analysis into recommendations the business can act on.
You deliver data products rather than one-off reports, reusable models and tools that keep delivering value over time.
You own our semantic layer, the metric definitions, business logic and data models that make sure there is one trusted answer to any business question, for people and for AI.
You own the implementation and evolution of our self-service analytics tools, so internal stakeholders can answer their own recurring questions.
You learn all aspects of the travel industry covering Finance, Product, Sales and Operations perspective, and engage with Business stakeholders to define KPIs, including how data is captured, shared and leveraged across departments.


Your Basic Qualifications


Data analysis, presentation, and visualization experience
Strong communication skills, with the ability to influence senior non-technical stakeholders
Ability to work autonomously with high ambiguity, alone or in a team as required
Advanced SQL, Python and strong data modeling fundamentals
Experience defining and maintaining shared metric definitions across an organisation
Demonstrated experience with Product Analytics tools (eg: Amplitude, Mixpanel, Pendo, Google Analytics)
Demonstrated experience with BI Data Visualization tools (Qlik preferred)
Master degree in Statistics, Engineering, Economics or a related field is preferred
Previously worked in a Tech Company
English proficiency (written and spoken level B2)


We are also interested in


Understanding of AI/ML concepts
Experience making data available to LLMs or AI agents
Previous experience in the travel industry or similar sectors


Our offer

📄 Contract type: Permanent

🕓 Working hours: Full-time – 40h/week, from Monday to Friday

🏢 Hybrid setting, flexible working policy, and great offices in Europe

💰 Salary: Attractive compensation, including equity in the company

💼 Equity in the company (stock options plan)

✈️ A seat on a scale-up with skyrocketing growth

📈 Development of your entrepreneurial spirit, having the chance to implement real-impact business decision

🌍Multicultural and international team

🙌Collaborative and smart environment to work and learn

🍻Free coffee to kick-start your day and free beers to celebrate together

BizAway avoids any discrimination based on age, gender, sexual orientation, health status, nationality, political opinions, and religious beliefs in all decisions affecting personnel selection.

Title: Data Analyst H/F
Description:
Descriptif du poste

Dans le cadre de projets de transformation data, nous recherchons un·e Data Analyst capable de transformer les données en informations actionnables pour les équipes métiers et les équipes de pilotage.

Vous interviendrez sur des missions longues, au sein d’environnements structurés, pour analyser, fiabiliser et valoriser les données. Vous contribuerez à la production d’indicateurs, de reportings et de tableaux de bord destinés à accompagner la prise de décision et l’amélioration des parcours, outils et processus internes.

Vos missions


Recueillir, comprendre et challenger les besoins des équipes métiers.
Extraire, nettoyer, contrôler et analyser les données issues de différentes sources.
Concevoir et faire évoluer des tableaux de bord et reportings décisionnels.
Définir et suivre les KPI nécessaires au pilotage de l’activité.
Produire des analyses ad hoc afin d’identifier des tendances, anomalies, opportunités ou axes d’amélioration.
Participer à la fiabilisation et à la documentation des données et des indicateurs.
Collaborer avec les équipes Data Engineering, BI, produit et métier.
Restituer les résultats de manière claire, synthétique et adaptée à des interlocuteurs variés.
Contribuer à la diffusion d’une culture data au sein des équipes.


Profil recherché


Formation supérieure en data, statistiques, informatique, école d’ingénieur ou équivalent.
Expérience significative en analyse de données, BI ou pilotage de la performance.
Très bonne maîtrise de SQL et des outils de visualisation de données.
Maîtrise de Power BI, Tableau, Qlik Sense ou d’un outil équivalent.
Connaissance de Python ou R pour l’analyse et la préparation des données.
Capacité à comprendre les enjeux métier et à les traduire en indicateurs pertinents.
Rigueur, esprit analytique, autonomie et excellentes capacités de communication.
Maîtrise du français ; un anglais professionnel est apprécié.


Les plus


Connaissance de Dataiku pour la préparation, l’analyse ou l’industrialisation des traitements data.
Connaissance de Talend ou d’un outil ETL équivalent.
Expérience sur des données complexes et volumineuses.
Expérience auprès de grands comptes de l’assurance, des mutuelles ou de la protection sociale.
Sensibilité aux enjeux de gouvernance, de confidentialité et de conformité des données.


Déroulement des entretiens


Un premier échange avec Aurélie, à la suite duquel vous saurez tout (ou presque) d’eXalt Ouest,
Un entretien technique avec l’un de nos experts Data
Un entretien final avec le Directeur d’Agence, pour finir de vous convaincre de nous rejoindre 😊


Qui sont-ils ?

En entreprise, comme en musique, tout est une question de tempo. Depuis 2018, nous réunissons des consultant·e·s passionné·e·s, curieux·ses et ambitieux·ses, uni·e·s par une même conviction : mettre leur expertise au service des défis numériques, sectoriels et industriels de nos clients.

Notre mission ? Accélérer les transformations en combinant excellence opérationnelle, curiosité et audace. Nous accompagnons des acteurs majeurs du luxe, du retail, de l’énergie, du transport, du tourisme, de la banque ou encore de l’assurance — partout où la technologie rencontre l’humain.

Nous aimons la tech quand elle connecte et libère les potentiels. Nos consultant·e·s ne se contentent pas de conseiller : ils construisent, testent, mettent en production, mesurent, ajustent et recommencent. Avec nos clients, nous faisons partie du jeu, du début à la fin.

Notre organisation repose sur une culture de la confiance, de l’apprentissage et de la collaboration. Nous avons conçu un cadre unique qui accompagne chaque eXalté·e à chaque étape de sa carrière, avec des rôles clairs, des communautés actives et des rituels qui renforcent le collectif.

Nos eXaltemps trimestriels, notre eXalt Academy et nos projets internes sont autant d’occasions d’apprendre, de partager et de grandir ensemble.

Aujourd’hui présents en France, au Canada, aux États-Unis, au Royaume-Uni, en Belgique, en Espagne, au Portugal et à Monaco, nous sommes portés par un engagement fort et une énergie contagieuse.

Parce qu’apprendre est notre discipline, agir notre obsession et réussir ensemble notre plus belle victoire.

Pulse. Make. Learn.

Trois mots qui rythment notre quotidien. Et peut-être bientôt le tien?

Title: Data Analyst - European Agency

We are looking for a Data Analyst to analyse, transform, and visualise complex datasets while contributing to enterprise data platforms and Business Intelligence solutions within an international environment.

🔹Who We Are🔹

Altia is a high-value digital transformation services company that has undertaken, changed, and reformulated international projects for nearly a thousand clients, leaders in their sectors, who have understood that their businesses can be revolutionized through digitalization. Over its 30 years of experience, it has proven to be a robust company with a future, a capacity for innovation, and adaptability.

You will join an international strategic project centered on advanced analytical support for Critical Raw Materials (CRMs). Working within a multicultural and multidisciplinary environment, you will turn complex raw data into actionable insights and strategic indicators that drive policy decisions and technological development on a European scale.

Programming & Analytics: Python, R, STATA

Data Management: Relational Databases, SQL, ETL / Data Cleaning Techniques

Title: Data analyst BI
Description:
Data Analyst BI – Secteur bancaire (H/F)

Localisation : Montpellier

Nous recherchons un Data Analyst BI pour renforcer une équipe Data et accompagner plusieurs squads dans leurs projets d’analyse et de valorisation des données.

Vous évoluerez dans un environnement agile, en collaboration avec les Product Owners, Business Analysts et équipes de développement, sur un environnement MicroStrategy / Teradata.

Votre rôle : comprendre les problématiques métiers, challenger les besoins et transformer les données en indicateurs et recommandations utiles à la prise de décision.

Vos missions

Collaborer avec les Business Analysts pour identifier les besoins métiers et définir les indicateurs clés de performance.
Explorer et analyser les données afin de répondre aux problématiques opérationnelles et business.
Concevoir des analyses descriptives, rapports et tableaux de bord, notamment sur MicroStrategy.
Rédiger et optimiser des requêtes SQL pour extraire et exploiter les données.
Présenter les résultats aux utilisateurs, expliquer les analyses et formuler des recommandations concrètes.
Maintenir et améliorer les rapports existants, les dashboards et les processus analytiques.
Documenter les analyses, les méthodologies et les guides utilisateurs.
Contribuer à la qualité, à la traçabilité et au catalogage des données.
Accompagner les métiers dans l’application des principes de gouvernance et de protection des données.

Profil recherché

Vous disposez d’une expérience solide en Data Analyse et BI, avec une forte sensibilité aux enjeux métiers, idéalement dans le secteur bancaire.

Compétences attendues :

Maîtrise experte de SQL et des bases de données relationnelles.
Expertise d’un outil de datavisualisation : MicroStrategy apprécié, ou maîtrise de Power BI ou Tableau.
Une connaissance de Teradata constitue un atout.
Capacité à traduire un besoin métier en solution analytique adaptée.
Connaissance des principes de gouvernance Data, de qualité des données et de conformité RGPD.
Connaissance du data lineage et du catalogage.
Maîtrise de GitHub Copilot dans les activités BI attendue.

Au-delà des compétences techniques, nous recherchons une personne autonome, pédagogue et force de proposition, capable de challenger les demandes, de prendre le lead sur ses sujets et de communiquer avec des interlocuteurs variés.

Une connaissance fonctionnelle du domaine bancaire est particulièrement appréciée pour interpréter les données et apporter un regard critique sur les analyses.

Pour postuler, transmettez votre CV directement via cette annonce.

Title: Senior Data Analyst - Fraud
Description:
Who We Are

Moniepoint Inc. is Africa’s all-in-one financial platform, helping 20 million businesses and individuals access seamless payments, banking, credit, cross-border, and business management tools each month.

As Nigeria’s largest merchant acquirer, we power most of the country’s point-of-sale (POS) transactions. Through our subsidiaries, Moniepoint Inc. processes over $250 billion in digital payment transaction value annually.

Curious about what makes Moniepoint an incredible place to work? Check out posts on how we cultivate a culture of innovation, teamwork, and growth.

What you will get to do


Investigate fraud attacks, quantify their impact, and present clear findings that drive prioritisation and response
Propose and refine rule-based mitigations, working with fraud operations and engineering to see them through to implementation
Build and maintain reporting and dashboards to monitor fraud trends, rule performance, and key operational metrics
Work closely with fraud operations, data scientists, engineers, and product managers to ensure analytical insights translate into action
Proactively identify emerging patterns and flag risks before they escalate


To succeed in this role, you should have


Proven experience as a Data Analyst (Fraud), or a similar role (4+ years, can be made up for with accomplishments)
Strong problem solving skills
Advanced proficiency with SQL. you're comfortable writing complex queries to investigate and slice data across large datasets
Experience in fraud, risk, or financial services; you understand how fraud attacks work and how to think about mitigation trade-offs
A proactive mindset — you don't wait to be asked; you spot something unusual and you dig in
Some exposure to Python or scripting for data manipulation and analysis
Proficiency with a BI tool (PowerBI, Looker, Tableau, Superset, Redash, or any other alternative)
Strong stakeholder management skills; you can communicate findings clearly to fraud operations, product managers, engineers, and senior leadership — and you know how to influence decisions with data across all of them.
Comfort working in fast-paced, cross-functional teams where priorities shift quickly.
Proficiency with a spreadsheet tool (Microsoft Excel or Google Sheets, or any other alternative)
Enjoy autonomy and a flat structure: we have millions of customers and a flat hierarchy so any individual can have an outsized impact
Excellent written and verbal communication skills
A drive to learn and master new technologies and techniques
A bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Statistics, Mathematics, Engineering, or any other related field


Experience with the following would be a plus


Data governance
Python or any other scripting language
Git or any other version control tool


What we can offer you


Culture - We put our people first and prioritise the well-being of every team member. We have built a company where all opinions carry weight and where all voices are heard. We value and respect each other and always look out for one another. Above all, we are human.
Learning - We have a learning and development-focused environment with an emphasis on knowledge sharing, training, and regular internal technical talks.
Compensation - You’ll receive an attractive salary, pension, health insurance, annual bonus, plus other benefits.


What to expect in the hiring process


A preliminary phone call with the recruiter.
Technical take-home task (SQL test).
Technical Interview with hiring manager.
A behavioural interview with the Head of Data Analytics/Science and Fraud Team.


Moniepoint is an equal opportunity employer. We celebrate diversity and are committed to creating an inclusive environment for all employees and candidates.

Title: Senior Data Analyst
Description:
We’re Hiring!

Senior Data Analyst




At Envu, we partner with our customers to design world-class, forward-thinking innovations that protect and enhance the health of environments around the world. We offer dedicated services in: Professional Pest Management, Forestry, Ornamentals, Golf, Industrial Vegetation Management, Lawn & Landscape, Mosquito Management, and Range & Pasture.




Envu brings together a broad range of perspectives to look beyond chemistry and dare to explore new paths forward. Guided by our inclusive culture, we embrace change and flexibility, tackling our customers’ toughest challenges proactively, passionately and with an entrepreneurial spirit.




We pursue our ambitions collaboratively because we know that a unified and empowered team is an unstoppable force, allowing us to achieve our vision of healthy environments for everyone, everywhere. Join Us.




Envu is proud to be certified as a Top Employer 2026 in France and the United States




FUNCTION: CFO

LOCATION: Lyon, France

JOB TYPE: Permanent

JOB GRADE: 6




GET TO KNOW YOUR AREA:

Join the Finance Data Analytics team to enhance data analysis and visualization tools to drive financial strategy, enhance forecasting accuracy, and provide critical insights that support key business decisions.
Focus on leveraging the capabilities of our Azure Data lake, Databricks and the Microsoft Power Platform (Power BI, PowerApps, and Power Automate) to enhance our reports, process automation, and custom business applications.
Provide dedicated support to the Marketing team by developing and maintaining reporting solutions, translating business needs into data-driven insights, and acting as a strategic business partner to support decision-making and performance management.




YOUR MISSION WILL BE TO:

Design, develop and maintain complex Power BI dashboards for decision-making while taking into account the needs from the different stakeholders (Finance, Business, Marketing…).
Build and maintain data pipelines and transformation workflows using Python, SQL and Databricks (notebooks, workflows, applications…) to industrialize data processing.
Perform data modeling, transformation and analytics using Python, SQL and DAX.
Continuously evaluate and improve existing processes and systems using insights derived from data analysis and automation projects.
Develop custom business applications using Databricks, integrating with various data sources and APIs to fulfill unique business requirements.
Actively contributing to the expertise level and competencies of the Finance Data & Analytics team
Collaborate with other departments to identify opportunities for process improvement and automation in reporting workflows.




ARE YOU READY FOR THE ROLE?

Main requirements:

Master's degree in a relevant field such as Computer Science, Statistics, or Data Analytics. Experience in Finance or Marketing is a strong plus.
Minimum of 5 years of experience in a data analyst role, with a proven experience in data modelling and data visualization.
Experience in writing scripts, and queries using Python and SQL.
Expertise in Databricks is a strong plus.
Experience leveraging GenAI tools (e.g., Microsoft Copilot in Fabric/Power BI, Databricks AI/BI Genie, Claude) to accelerate data exploration and reporting is a plus
Excellent analytical and problem-solving skills, with the ability to translate complex data into actionable insights.

Envu is committed to creating an inclusive environment for all employees and applicants, regardless of ethnicity, color, race, religion, origin, age, gender, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, or other conditions. And all opportunities are open to people with disabilities.

💡 OVENTI Consulting, cabinet de conseil en Data et Intelligence Artificielle qui allie expertise technique de pointe, vision stratégique et accompagnement sur mesure. Nous couvrons tout le cycle de vie des projets Data/IA, de la stratégie à l'implémentation de solutions personnalisées (ML, BI, automatisation intelligente).

Nos équipes, issues des meilleures écoles, s'intègrent chez nos clients ou opèrent depuis notre LAB interne, véritable foyer d’innovation. Chez Oventi, nous privilégions le "sur mesure" et l'innovation concrète. Chaque collaborateur est accompagné, formé et suivi pour garantir une culture d'excellence et un impact réel.




🧑 💻 Pourquoi ce rôle est clé ?

En tant que Data Analyst, vous occuperez un rôle stratégique au niveau de la data, de la business intelligence et de l'intelligence artificielle. Votre mission principale sera de transformer la donnée en leviers d'action concrets pour les équipes métiers, en consolidant le pilotage analytique et en intégrant des solutions d'IA pour affiner la prise de décision.




🎯 Vos missions au quotidien :

Pilotage de la performance :

Assurer un rôle de pilotage data et analytique complet, en définissant et en suivant les indicateurs de performance clés (KPI) pour le business.




Définition de stratégies :

Contribuer activement à la définition des stratégies, notamment en matière de merchandising et de négociation, en fournissant des analyses et des recommandations basées sur les données.




Optimisation de l'écosystème de reporting :

Gérer et rationaliser l'ensemble des tableaux de bord existants. L'objectif est de réduire le nombre de dashboards pour aboutir à une constellation d'outils plus efficaces et pertinents.




Développement d'outils analytiques :

Concevoir et mettre en place des outils de reporting stratégiques, tels qu'un Revenue Performance Dashboard, pour offrir une vision claire et consolidée de la performance financière.




Analyse avancée assistée par l'IA :

Mener des analyses complexes et des raisonnements "au cas d'usage" en exploitant des technologies d'Intelligence Artificielle. Utiliser l'IA comme un levier pour explorer les données et formuler des hypothèses d'action.




🧩 Stack technique :

Langages : Python, SQL
Bases de données : BigQuery
Outils de Business Intelligence & Visualisation : Looker, Tableau
Formats de données : CSV, JSON, Avro
Outils de gestion projet : Jira, Confluence




🧩 Vous êtes la personne idéale si :

5 ans d'expérience en tant que Data Analyst.
Diplômé d'un master ou d'une école d'ingénieur avec une spécialisation en Data Analyse, intelligence artificielle ou data science.
Aisance relationnelle, esprit collaboratif et appétence pour l'amélioration continue.




🌟 Pourquoi rejoindre OVENTI ?

Rejoindre Oventi, c'est choisir une aventure professionnelle unique :




✔️Une structure à taille humaine : Favorisant l'échange, l'autonomie et l'innovation, où votre impact est direct et visible.

✔️Des missions à forte valeur ajoutée : Dans des secteurs variés, avec une approche "sur mesure" où nos solutions ont des impacts importants chez nos clients.

✔️Une culture d’excellence technique : Avec un réel accompagnement de carrière et un suivi personnalisé.

✔️Une équipe passionnée et engagée : Des ingénieurs recrutés avec soin, formés en continu, et investis sur le long terme.

✔️L’agilité d’une startup, la rigueur d’un cabinet expert : Le meilleur des deux mondes pour une expérience enrichissante.

💶 Rémunération : A discuter selon vos prétentions

Title: Senior Data Analyst (m/f/d)
Description:
Engineered in Berlin. Driving the Future of Europe.



At AUTODOC, we are proud to be a homegrown European success story. Founded in Berlin in 2008 and still headquartered in the heart of the continent today, we have evolved from a local specialist into Europe’s leading online platform for the automotive aftermarket.

Our strength lies in our unique identity: we are a digital-first, e-commerce powerhouse with strong German roots and an expansive reach across 27 European countries. This continental focus allows us to blend our heritage with high-tech innovation, staying agile and closely connected to the markets we serve.



Today, our team of more than 5,500 professionals from over 50 different countries is redefining mobility through cutting-edge technology. Bring your talent and expertise to a company that is building a sustainable, tech-driven future for drivers everywhere.



Come join us and impact the future of AUTODOC!





Job Description



We are looking for a Senior Data Analyst who will be responsible for identifying opportunities for growth and improvement, as well as gathering, analyzing, and interpreting data to help the organization make better decisions. The Data Analyst will also work closely with cross-functional teams to ensure that we meet customer needs and drive sales and profitability.



Responsibilities:



Gather and understand business needs and objectives.
Identify and interpret patterns, trends, insights, business metrics from data
Create data-complex dashboards with an optimized data structure and scaling perspective
Assist in planning, forecasting and AB testing processes.
Work with various product and business stakeholders to develop data-driven insights.
Partner with the Data Engineering team to define and build reliable data sources.
Identify new opportunities for the use of data across the company.


Qualifications


Proficiency in SQL, Python/R, Power BI / Tableau, and other data analysis tools
4+ years of experience in data, product analytics, data science or business intelligence, e-commerce experience is a plus
University degree in Data Analytics, Data Science, Mathematics, Statistics, Finance, Economics, or a related field
Proficiency in statistical analysis methods, data modeling, hypothesis testing, AB testing
Strong analytical and problem-solving skills
Fluent English
Good communication skills, ability to communicate to both technical and non-technical audiences
Applying expertise in analysis to see beyond the numbers and provide clear insights


Additional Information



What do we offer?



Competitive salaries based on your professional experience
Fast growing international company with stable employment
Annual vacation of 25 working days and 1 additional day off on your birthday
Day off on Municipality day and Carnaval
Meal Allowance (8 euros per working day)
Fidelidade Healthcare Plan (Comprehensive health coverage with the option to include your partner and children at discounted rates).
Mental Wellbeing Program through the OpenUp platform
AUTODOC corporate discount for purchasing car parts at special rates for personal use
Exclusive retail discounts via our ‘Benefits at Work’ portal
Learning & Development (over 650 courses on soft and hard skills on our e-learning platform)
Free English and German language classes (after probation period)
Flexible working hours and hybrid work





The position is available for candidates based in Portugal, Poland, the Czech Republic, Moldova or Kazakhstan.



Join us today and let’s create a success story together!





This job was posted on 02/07/2026, and is considering applications up to 6 weeks from this date.

Title: Senior Data Analyst / Data Analyst
Description:
About Euromonitor

Euromonitor International leads the world in data analytics and research into markets, industries, economies and consumers. We provide truly global insight and data on thousands of products and services; we are the first destination for organisations seeking growth. With our guidance, our clients can make bold, strategic decisions with confidence. Overview of the role.

Overview Of The Role

We build the demographic, socio-economic and macroeconomic datasets that Euromonitor clients around the world rely on to make decisions. We are looking for a Data Analyst or Senior Data Analyst to help standardise, model and forecast that data - turning messy, inconsistent source statistics into figures people can actually compare and trust.

It is a role for someone who likes solving problems with data: sharpening our modelling and forecasting techniques, and finding new ways to improve data quality and comparability rather than just maintaining the status quo.

Requirements

What you'll do


Analyze and manipulate datasets, carrying out calculations and numerical analysis using R.
Standardize raw statistical data to ensure cross-source comparability.
Extrapolate and interpolate data using both quantitative and qualitative methods to develop modelling and forecasting techniques.
Monitor, review, and enhance data quality.
Document all work processes to ensure team alignment and best practices.
Liaise with sales and marketing departments and handle client queries.


What We're Looking For


Background in mathematics, econometrics, data science, statistics or similar fields.
Proficiency in R. Knowledge of Python is a plus.
Proficiency with Git.
Experience in data manipulation, statistical analysis and time series forecasting.
Good coding habits: proper documentation, styling, reproducibility.
Excellent communications skills and fluency in English (both oral & written).
Strong organizational skills, creativity and attention to detail.
Ability to work on own initiative.


The role has a monthly gross salary of €2,416 - €3,083, dependent on experience.

Benefits

Professional Development: Grow your career with opportunities within a consultative and professional environment

Flexible Work Schedule: Achieve a healthy work-life balance with our flexible work schedule options, including remote work opportunities and flexible hours

Positive Work Environment: Join a collaborative and inclusive workplace culture where your ideas are valued, diversity is celebrated, and teamwork is encouraged

Community Involvement: Make a positive impact in the community through our volunteer programs, charitable initiatives, and corporate social responsibility efforts

(and more....!)

Our Values

We act with integrity

We are curious about the world

We are stronger together

We seek to empower

We find strength in diversity

Here at BizAway, we Deliver the Future of Travel. 😎

We are looking for a driven and enthusiastic Senior Data Analyst (m/w/d) , who desires to contribute to the growth and success of our Data & Analytics Team.

Data analysis, presentation, and visualization experience
Strong communication skills, with the ability to influence senior non-technical stakeholders
Ability to work autonomously with high ambiguity, alone or in a team as required
Advanced SQL, Python and strong data modeling fundamentals
Experience defining and maintaining shared metric definitions across an organisation
Demonstrated experience with Product Analytics tools (eg: Amplitude, Mixpanel, Pendo, Google Analytics)
Demonstrated experience with BI Data Visualization tools (Qlik preferred)
Master degree in Statistics, Engineering, Economics or a related field is preferred
Previously worked in a Tech Company
English proficiency (written and spoken level B2)

Understanding of AI/ML concepts
Experience making data available to LLMs or AI agents
Previous experience in the travel industry or similar sectors

📄 Contract type: Permanent

✈️ A seat on a scale-up with skyrocketing growth

📈 Development of your entrepreneurial spirit, having the chance to implement real-impact business decision

Title: Data analyst BI
Description:
Data Analyst BI – Secteur bancaire (H/F)

Localisation : Montpellier

Nous recherchons un Data Analyst BI pour renforcer une équipe Data et accompagner plusieurs squads dans leurs projets d’analyse et de valorisation des données.

Vous évoluerez dans un environnement agile, en collaboration avec les Product Owners, Business Analysts et équipes de développement, sur un environnement MicroStrategy / Teradata.

Votre rôle : comprendre les problématiques métiers, challenger les besoins et transformer les données en indicateurs et recommandations utiles à la prise de décision.

Vos missions

Collaborer avec les Business Analysts pour identifier les besoins métiers et définir les indicateurs clés de performance.
Explorer et analyser les données afin de répondre aux problématiques opérationnelles et business.
Concevoir des analyses descriptives, rapports et tableaux de bord, notamment sur MicroStrategy.
Rédiger et optimiser des requêtes SQL pour extraire et exploiter les données.
Présenter les résultats aux utilisateurs, expliquer les analyses et formuler des recommandations concrètes.
Maintenir et améliorer les rapports existants, les dashboards et les processus analytiques.
Documenter les analyses, les méthodologies et les guides utilisateurs.
Contribuer à la qualité, à la traçabilité et au catalogage des données.
Accompagner les métiers dans l’application des principes de gouvernance et de protection des données.

Profil recherché

Vous disposez d’une expérience solide en Data Analyse et BI, avec une forte sensibilité aux enjeux métiers, idéalement dans le secteur bancaire.

Compétences attendues :

Maîtrise experte de SQL et des bases de données relationnelles.
Expertise d’un outil de datavisualisation : MicroStrategy apprécié, ou maîtrise de Power BI ou Tableau.
Une connaissance de Teradata constitue un atout.
Capacité à traduire un besoin métier en solution analytique adaptée.
Connaissance des principes de gouvernance Data, de qualité des données et de conformité RGPD.
Connaissance du data lineage et du catalogage.
Maîtrise de GitHub Copilot dans les activités BI attendue.

Au-delà des compétences techniques, nous recherchons une personne autonome, pédagogue et force de proposition, capable de challenger les demandes, de prendre le lead sur ses sujets et de communiquer avec des interlocuteurs variés.

Une connaissance fonctionnelle du domaine bancaire est particulièrement appréciée pour interpréter les données et apporter un regard critique sur les analyses.

Pour postuler, transmettez votre CV directement via cette annonce.

Title: Data Analyst
Description:
My client based in Westmeath is seeking a Data Analyst to join an established and expanding data team. This is a perm role. The position will focus on using data to answer key business questions, improve performance and support better commercial and operational decisions. You'll work with a broad range of datasets and collaborate with teams across data, technology and the wider business.




The role offers plenty of scope to go beyond standard reporting, with an emphasis on investigating data, spotting patterns and providing recommendations that can make a measurable difference. You'll take ownership of analytical requirements from initial investigation through to presenting findings and recommendations.




Key responsibilities will include:

Interrogate and analyse large, complex datasets to answer business questions and uncover useful insights.
Identify patterns, emerging trends, potential risks and opportunities for performance improvement.
Develop analysis that supports commercial, operational and strategic decision-making.
Work alongside Data Engineers to understand data availability, quality and structure.
Collaborate with reporting and visualisation specialists to improve dashboards and management information.
Add context and interpretation to reporting, helping stakeholders understand what the data means and what actions should be considered.
Communicate findings in a straightforward and engaging way to stakeholders with varying levels of technical knowledge.
Help improve data quality, governance and analytical processes.
Investigate opportunities to introduce more advanced analytics, including machine learning and AI techniques.
Contribute ideas and best practices as the organisation continues to develop its data and analytics capabilities.




The successful candidate will have:

5+ years' professional experience working in data analysis, analytics or reporting.
A relevant third-level qualification in areas such as Data Analytics, Computer Science, Statistics, Mathematics, Information Systems or a similar discipline.
Strong hands-on SQL experience and confidence working with large datasets.
Experience with data extraction, transformation, manipulation and segmentation.
Strong analytical and problem-solving skills with the ability to turn raw data into useful business conclusions.
2+ years' experience using Python or R for data analysis.
A solid understanding of databases, data models and data structures.
Good knowledge of Business Intelligence concepts and reporting practices.
Practical experience with at least one major BI platform such as Power BI, Tableau or Qlik.




Nice to Have

Experience in any of the following would be beneficial:

Financial services or another highly data-driven sector.
Predictive modelling or advanced analytics.
Machine learning or AI-related analytical projects.




You'll be comfortable taking ownership of your workload and working through analytical problems with limited supervision. You'll have the curiosity to dig deeper into the data rather than simply producing reports based on predefined requirements.

You'll also need strong stakeholder skills. The role involves working with people across technical and business functions, so being able to explain analytical concepts and recommendations clearly is essential.

Title: Senior Data Analyst
Description:
Senior Data Analyst- Join Our Growing Team

Location: Stockholm or Remote Sweden




Natlink builds technology for coordination and response. A hunting team spread across several kilometres of forest. A dog working a scent line out of sight of its handler. Someone collapsing from cardiac arrest in a Swedish town, and the nearest trained volunteer needing to reach them before the ambulance can.

Underneath, it's the same problem: get the right people to the right place quickly, usually outdoors, often where the network barely works. Our services are used by close to a million Europeans, through WeHunt, Tracker GPS devices, Burrel cameras and Heartrunner.




Why this role exists

We spent the past 6-months building the data platform: BigQuery, dbt and Lightdash. It's live and the company runs on it. What we don't have yet is the layer between that platform and the people who need to use it.

Right now, most teams still have to come to us. That's the constraint. The job is to close it, in two directions at once: build the things in Lightdash that let support, marketing, product, commercial and finance answer their own questions, and do the deep analytical work that nobody in those teams could do for themselves.

You'd be the most senior analyst here, working across the whole business rather than inside one function.




The team

Four people, reporting to the Head of Data. A data engineer on the platform, an analytics engineer on the model layer and the definitions behind Lightdash, and you on everything the business actually touches. Natlink is around a hundred people and backed by Verdane, so the data function is small, visible and expected to matter.




What you'll work on

Making teams self-sufficient. This is the larger half of the job.

Building the explores, dashboards and self-serve surfaces in Lightdash that teams use daily without asking you first
Sitting with support, marketing, product, commercial and finance often enough to know how they actually think, what they're deciding, and where they get stuck
Working out which questions each team asks repeatedly, and making those answerable without you
Feeding definitions and gaps back to the analytics engineer, so the model layer grows toward what the business needs




Deep analysis nobody else can do.

Retention and subscription behaviour, including predictive work
Customer value across hardware and subscription together, which is harder than either alone
How teams and communities use the products, which is social data rather than individual data
Marketing effectiveness across markets
What support conversations reveal about churn before it appears in the numbers




The data

Most analyst roles offer clicks and transactions. You get those, and a good deal more.

Continuous positioning telemetry from devices working in real terrain. Behaviour from groups coordinating together rather than individuals using an app alone. Hardware and subscription revenue inside a single customer relationship. Trail camera data from remote sites. Emergency response data where the outcome variable is how quickly someone reached a person in cardiac arrest. Support and marketing across several markets with different cultures, seasons and regulations, and demand that swings hard enough each year to break most off-the-shelf models.

It's an unusually varied set for a company this size, and very little of it has been properly analysed. That's the opportunity.




What you'd grow into

Raising the analytical standard as the team grows. The formal data literacy work across the company sits with the Head of Data for now, and you'd take an increasing share of it over time as the self-serve foundation you're building makes it possible.




How we work

Priorities are set with the leadership team through our data steering group, led by the Head of Data. You work on what the company has agreed matters, and you're expected to argue when you think it has that wrong. This is not a ticket queue.

Numbers that leave the building come from the data platform, not from source systems. We don't publish figures we can't reconcile or trust.

We're deliberately AI native. Claude Code and Cursor daily, conventions files in every repo, agents and automated flows in production. It's why a team this size can support a company this size. Title: Data analyst H/F/NB
Description:
Pourquoi rejoindre Keyrus aujourd'hui ?

Keyrus est un groupe international de 2 800 consultants et experts présents dans 28 pays, porté par une conviction forte : ce n'est pas l'intelligence artificielle qui transforme les entreprises, mais l'intelligence conçue, structurée et intégrée à leur fonctionnement.

Depuis plus de 30 ans, nous construisons les fondations data qui permettent aux systèmes intelligents de créer de la valeur. Nous concevons le système d'exploitation de l'entreprise intelligente, où la donnée, l'IA et l'expertise humaine s'intègrent au cœur des processus métiers pour générer une performance durable. Chez Keyrus, nous donnons vie à l'intelligence opérationnelle.

L'intelligence artificielle ne remplace pas l'humain. Elle lui permet de se concentrer sur ce qu'aucun système ne peut reproduire : comprendre, décider, concevoir et innover. Rejoindre Keyrus, c'est construire son jugement, son expertise et sa capacité à résoudre des problématiques complexes.

La technologie est un accélérateur. La culture Keyrus fait la différence. L'excellence opérationnelle permet de relier les deux.

Data Analyst

Le Data Analyst fait le lien entre la donnée, les enjeux métiers et la prise de décision. Il transforme des données complexes en analyses claires, fiables et directement exploitables pour aider les organisations à mieux comprendre leur activité, mesurer leur performance et identifier de nouvelles opportunités.

Chez Keyrus, le Data Analyst ne se limite pas à produire des reportings : il cherche à comprendre les problématiques derrière les données, challenge les besoins et contribue à transformer l’information en actions concrètes et créatrices de valeur.

Ce qui vous attend


Analyser des données complexes afin de produire des indicateurs fiables et exploitables par les équipes métier.
Concevoir et faire évoluer des tableaux de bord interactifs répondant aux besoins opérationnels et stratégiques.
Préparer, transformer et modéliser les données afin de garantir leur qualité, leur cohérence et leur exploitabilité.
Accompagner les métiers dans la définition de leurs besoins analytiques et les conseiller sur les indicateurs les plus pertinents.
Traduire les analyses en recommandations concrètes et adaptées aux enjeux des utilisateurs.
Contribuer à l’amélioration continue des reportings existants en recherchant performance, simplicité et valeur métier.
Automatiser les traitements de données lorsque cela est pertinent afin de fiabiliser et d’optimiser les analyses.
Collaborer étroitement avec les équipes Data Engineering, AI Engineering et les métiers afin de garantir la disponibilité, la qualité et la bonne compréhension de la donnée.
Participer à la diffusion d’une culture Data et accompagner les utilisateurs dans l’appropriation des outils et des analyses.
Identifier de nouveaux usages de la donnée et proposer des pistes d’amélioration en fonction des besoins métier et des évolutions technologiques.


Ce que vous apportez

Chez Keyrus, nous recherchons des profils capables de conjuguer expertise Data, compréhension métier et capacité à transformer les analyses en actions concrètes.

Notre approche Architect of Intelligence repose sur une conviction : la donnée prend toute sa valeur lorsqu’elle est comprise, partagée et mise au service de décisions et de transformations concrètes.

Dans Ce Rôle, Nous Valorisons Notamment

Expérience et parcours


Une expérience significative en Data Analytics, Business Intelligence ou Data Visualisation.
Une expérience dans la conception de tableaux de bord et d’indicateurs décisionnels.
Une expérience de collaboration avec les équipes métier afin de transformer un besoin fonctionnel en solution analytique.
Une expérience dans des environnements Data modernes constitue un véritable atout.


Posture et savoir-être


Une forte capacité d’analyse permettant de transformer des données complexes en recommandations concrètes.
De la curiosité pour comprendre les enjeux métiers derrière les données et les indicateurs.
De la créativité et une capacité à explorer de nouvelles approches pour répondre aux problématiques rencontrées.
Une capacité à communiquer, vulgariser et raconter les données auprès d’interlocuteurs techniques comme non techniques.
Une conscience professionnelle et une attention particulière portée à la qualité et à la fiabilité des analyses.
Une autonomie dans la conduite des analyses tout en appréciant le travail collaboratif.
Une capacité à passer de l’analyse à l’action et à formuler des recommandations pragmatiques.
Une volonté de documenter, partager et transmettre les analyses et les bonnes pratiques.


Compétences techniques indispensables


Maîtrise avancée de SQL.
Maîtrise d’au moins un outil de Data Visualisation tel que Power BI, Tableau ou équivalent.
Bonne maîtrise de la modélisation de données décisionnelles.
Expérience des outils de préparation de données : Alteryx, Dataiku, Power Query ou équivalent.
Compréhension des enjeux de qualité, de gouvernance et de fiabilité des données.
Connaissances en Python ou R appréciées pour l’automatisation et l’analyse avancée.
Capacité à concevoir des KPI pertinents et à produire des tableaux de bord orientés décision.
Compréhension des environnements Cloud Data : Snowflake, BigQuery, Databricks, Microsoft Fabric ou équivalent.
Expérience des méthodes Agile.
Anglais professionnel courant, à l’écrit comme à l’oral, indispensable quel que soit le niveau d’expérience.


Ce qui nous anime

Intelligence Collective

La collaboration entre expertises, métiers et géographies nous permet de combiner les savoir-faire et d'apporter des réponses plus complètes aux défis de nos clients.

Fiabilité

Notre capacité à délivrer des projets complexes avec rigueur et exigence constitue l'un des fondements de la relation de confiance que nous construisons avec nos clients.

Pragmatisme

Nous privilégions l'impact concret et la création de valeur mesurable plutôt que les discours technologiques abstraits.

Esprit Entrepreneurial

La curiosité, l'énergie et l'autonomie sont au cœur de notre culture. Elles favorisent l'initiative, l'innovation et le développement continu de nos expertises.

À propos de Keyrus

Chez Keyrus, nous accompagnons les organisations dans leur passage d'une IA expérimentale à une IA industrialisée, d'agents isolés à des systèmes orchestrés, et de l'analyse à l'exécution. C'est cette expertise que nous appelons l'Architecture de l'Intelligence.

Grâce à notre modèle propriétaire Human Orchestrated Model™ (HOM), nous concevons des environnements intelligents reposant sur trois piliers fondamentaux : des fondations data et intelligence robustes et fiables ; une gouvernance garantissant que l'humain reste au cœur de la décision ; des mécanismes de pilotage de la performance permettant une amélioration continue.

Fort de plus de 30 ans d'expertise et de 2 800 collaborateurs répartis dans 28 pays, Keyrus accompagne les entreprises bien au-delà de leur transformation.

Keyrus est coté sur Euronext Growth Paris (ALKEY – Code ISIN : FR0004029411).
