Description:
Senior Analyst, BI & Insights

Reporting, Analytics & Development | Work location: Framingham

Staples is business to business. You’re what binds us together.

Our Customer Success organization is looking for a strategic analytics partner who can move beyond traditional reporting to identify opportunities, surface operational risks, clarify performance trends, and help leaders turn data into action. In this role, you will shape what should be measured, explain why it matters, and provide insights that strengthen organizational effectiveness.

Our world class sales and sales support teams work directly with businesses of all sizes to offer products and services to meet our customers’ unique needs. We are committed to understanding our customers and use best-in-class sales tools and technology to find the best solutions. We’re constantly discovering new ways to reach our goals, taking time to develop our skills and investing in our career growth, so we can enjoy lucrative opportunities and grow our careers both within and beyond sales.

The Reporting, Analytics & Development (RAD) team partners with Customer Success leaders to establish meaningful performance measures and deliver reporting solutions that support operational planning and informed decision-making. The team combines business consulting, analytics, KPI strategy, data governance, and visualization expertise to create clear and actionable performance narratives.

The Senior Analyst, BI & Insights serves as a strategic analytics partner to Customer Success leadership. Working with limited direction, this role proactively identifies business opportunities, operational risks, performance trends, and performance gaps; develops KPI recommendations; and helps leaders answer questions they may not yet know to ask. The Senior Analyst translates complex business objectives into measurable outcomes, executive-ready insights, and clear recommendations that drive action. This individual contributor role does not have direct people management responsibilities.

What you’ll be doing:


Identify emerging trends, risks, opportunities, and performance gaps across Customer Success functions.
Conduct deep-dive analyses, root cause analyses, and trend investigations to uncover actionable business insights.
Define KPI frameworks, metric definitions, business rules, calculations, governance standards, and ownership.
Facilitate discovery sessions and translate business questions into measurable outcomes.
Develop executive insight summaries, performance narratives, presentations, and recommendations for leadership.
Define dashboard objectives, audiences, measures, wireframes, mockups, and visualization requirements.
Partner with RAD visualization colleagues to design, build, enhance, and maintain Power BI dashboards, scorecards, and visualizations.
Identify leading indicators, thresholds, exception-reporting requirements, and proactive alerting strategies.
Validate that reporting solutions clearly communicate trends, risks, opportunities, and recommended actions.
Recommend new performance measures, dashboard enhancements, and monitoring approaches when existing metrics are inadequate.
Provide analytical guidance, consulting, and subject-matter expertise to leaders, stakeholders, and RAD partners.
What you bring to the table:
Strong analytical, problem-solving, consulting, and business process analysis skills.
The ability to translate complex data into clear business narratives and actionable recommendations for non-technical audiences.
The ability to work directly with senior leaders and influence decision-making through data-driven insights.
Knowledge of KPI strategy, performance measurement, data visualization, and data governance.
Independent judgment in determining analytical approaches, priorities, and recommendations.
The ability to collaborate effectively across business and technical teams, including when stakeholders have competing objectives.


What’s needed- Basic Qualifications:


Bachelor’s degree in Business Analytics, Information Systems, Finance, Statistics, Economics, or equivalent work experience.
3+ years of experience supporting analytics, strategy, business intelligence, operations, or consulting functions; defining KPIs; working with senior leaders; and translating business objectives into analytical solutions.
Experience with AI-enabled analytical solutions.
Advanced knowledge of Power BI and dashboard design principles.
Experience with SQL and analytical data exploration.
Experience developing KPI frameworks and performance measurement strategies.
Knowledge of data visualization best practices, Microsoft Excel, data governance concepts, and business process analysis.


What’s needed- Preferred Qualifications:


Experience with Snowflake.
Experience with Salesforce Analytics.
Experience with Power Automate.
Knowledge of statistical analysis techniques.
Understanding of predictive analytics concepts.


We Offer:


Inclusive culture with associate-led Business Resource Groups
22 days of PTO and Holiday Schedule (7 observed paid holidays + 1 floating holiday)
Online and Retail Discounts, Company Match 401(k), Physical and Mental Health Wellness programs, and more!


The salary range represents the expected compensation for this role at the time of posting. The specific base pay may be influenced by a variety of factors to include the candidate's experience, skill set, education, geography, business considerations, and internal equity. In addition to base pay, this role may be eligible for bonuses, or other forms of variable compensation.

Title: Senior Health Data Operations Analyst - Compass
Description:
Veeva Systems is a mission-driven organization and pioneer in industry cloud, helping life sciences companies bring therapies to patients faster. As one of the fastest-growing SaaS companies in history, we surpassed $3B in revenue in our last fiscal year with extensive growth potential ahead.

At the heart of Veeva are our values: Do the Right Thing, Customer Success, Employee Success, and Speed. We're not just any public company – we made history in 2021 by becoming a public benefit corporation (PBC), legally bound to balancing the interests of customers, employees, society, and investors.

As a Work Anywhere company, we support your flexibility to work from home or in the office, so you can thrive in your ideal environment.

Join us in transforming the life sciences industry, committed to making a positive impact on its customers, employees, and communities.

The Role

As a Senior Health Data Analyst, you will focus on analyzing health data within the Veeva Compass product suite. Veeva Compass delivers record-level prescription and medical claims data to power longitudinal, de-identified patient analytics for commercial use cases—including patient journey, market landscape, and provider engagement.

You will be responsible for driving data quality, consistency, and standardization within the Terminology Reference Library (TRL) by managing reference data for key attributes found across prescription and medical claims—including drug information, ICD-10 diagnosis codes, procedure and lab codes, as well as payer and plan data. In this role, you will query prescription and medical claims datasets to support the evaluation and integration of new inbound data sources into core schemas. Additionally, you will define and track key quality metrics via interactive dashboards, contributing to technical documentation and validation reports to ensure our reference data remains accurate, scalable, and seamlessly integrated across all Veeva products.

What You’ll Do


Drive TRL Governance: Maintain and expand the Terminology Reference Library (TRL), managing core reference datasets across prescription and medical claims (including drug information, ICD-10 codes, procedure/lab codes, and payer/plan data).
Evaluate & Integrate New Data: Conduct deep-dive data querying, field mapping, and structural analysis on potential new data sources to evaluate fit and integrate them into existing core schemas.
Execute Quality & Cleansing Workflows: Perform exploratory data analysis to identify discrepancies, handle missing values, execute deduplication, and ensure data completeness, accuracy, and timeliness.
Continuous Product Improvement: Investigate data anomalies within the Veeva Compass product suite, testing both planned and unplanned data changes to assess downstream customer impact.
Build Metrics & Documentation: Develop interactive dashboards to track key data quality metrics, contributing to technical documentation, validation reports, and team process improvements.
Cross-Functional Collaboration: Partner closely with Data Scientists, Product Managers, and Developers to articulate data quality nuances, uncover root causes, and build robust data pipelines.


Requirements


4+ years of experience analyzing record-level prescription and medical claims datasets.
4+ years of experience in health data quality analysis, data profiling, and data governance principles.
Advanced SQL proficiency, with extensive experience querying, manipulating, and aggregating large-scale relational databases.
Deep working knowledge of healthcare code sets and industry standards, including NDC, ICD-10, CPT/HCPCS, LOINC, and payer/plan reference data.
Proven track record in data storytelling: Experience analyzing, visualizing, and demonstrating data quality findings to stakeholders using Excel, BI tools (e.g., Tableau, Power BI, Sigma), or interactive dashboards.
Strong problem-solving mindset: Eagerness to dive deep into complex, unstructured healthcare data issues, identify root causes, and propose innovative solutions.
Bachelor’s degree in a STEM, quantitative, or healthcare informatics field, or equivalent practical experience


Nice to Have


Experience in Python
Experience with the BI tool Sigma
Experience in life science industry


Interviewing with Veeva

We value your time and believe in a transparent hiring process. Here is the process you can expect.


Follow the application process and submit your resume.
Within 3 days, you will receive a link to a personality assessment administered by a third party.
Once you complete the assessment, our team will review your full application package and follow up via email with our decision.
If moving to the interview stage, the process is as follows:
A conversation with the hiring manager
A practical case exercise
A final conversation with our group's Senior Leader.
Once all interviews are complete, the manager will be in touch with a final decision.
Perks & Benefits


Medical, dental, vision, and basic life insurance
Flexible PTO and company paid holidays
Retirement programs
1% charitable giving program


Compensation


Base pay: $80,000 - $125,000
The salary range listed here has been provided to comply with local regulations and represents a potential base salary range for this role. Please note that actual salaries may vary within the range above or below, depending on experience and location. We look at compensation for each individual and base our offer on your unique qualifications, experience, and expected contributions. This position may also be eligible for other types of compensation in addition to base salary, such as variable bonus and/or stock bonus.


Veeva’s headquarters is located in the San Francisco Bay Area with offices in more than 15 countries around the world.

Title: Principal Business Insights Analyst
Description:
Description

The Principal Business Insights Analyst is a highly analytical and influential business partner responsible for turning complex performance data into clear insights and actionable recommendations that improve sales performance, productivity, and execution across the retail branch network. Reporting to the Principal Business Insights Director, this role works closely with Sales Leadership, Product teams, Field Execution leaders, and enterprise data and analytics partners to identify opportunities, diagnose performance gaps, and help leaders make informed business decisions.

This individual will connect data to business outcomes, moving beyond reporting what happened to helping the organization understand why it happened, where opportunities exist, and what actions can improve performance. Through analysis of branch, regional, and national performance, the Principal Business Insights Analyst will provide recommendations that strengthen sales effectiveness, lead conversion, product penetration, and colleague productivity.

The role requires strong analytical capability, business acumen, and the ability to translate complex information into clear, compelling insights for both senior leaders and frontline business partners. The analyst will also help establish meaningful performance measures, evaluate the effectiveness of business initiatives, and continuously improve how insights are used to drive decisions and execution.

Primary Responsibilities Include

Performance Insights and Opportunity Identification


Analyze branch, regional, and national performance across key sales, conversion, productivity, and related business metrics to identify trends, opportunities, and performance gaps.
Diagnose underlying drivers and root causes behind performance results and translate findings into clear, actionable recommendations.
Identify opportunities to improve sales effectiveness, including sales per lead, conversion rates, product penetration, and colleague productivity.
Proactively surface emerging trends and performance opportunities to help leaders focus resources and actions where they can have the greatest business impact.


Sales and Initiative Effectiveness


Evaluate the effectiveness of sales initiatives, campaigns, and lead-management strategies and identify opportunities to strengthen performance.
Establish and monitor key performance indicators for priority initiatives, assessing results and recommending adjustments or optimizations based on performance.
Connect business results with underlying activities and execution to help leaders understand what is driving performance and where changes may be needed.


Executive Insights and Decision Support


Develop executive-level reporting, presentations, and data stories that translate complex analysis into clear business implications and recommended actions.
Communicate insights in a concise and compelling manner that enables both technical and non-technical audiences to understand the business opportunity and determine appropriate action.
Serve as a trusted analytical partner to business leaders, bringing an informed, data-driven perspective to strategic and frontline decisions.


Reporting, Dashboards and Data Integrity


Build, maintain, and enhance dashboards and reporting tools that support timely decision-making by field and senior leadership.
Ensure the accuracy, consistency, and integrity of data used in reporting, analysis, and performance measurement.
Partner with enterprise data and analytics teams to strengthen reporting capabilities, improve data quality, and evolve the tools and insights available to business leaders.


Cross-Functional Partnership


Partner closely with Sales Leadership, Product teams, Field Execution leaders, and enterprise data and analytics partners to align analytical work with key business priorities.
Translate business questions and emerging performance challenges into meaningful analysis that supports decision-making and execution.
Influence decisions through fact-based recommendations while building strong relationships across a highly collaborative, cross-functional environment.


Required Qualifications

Qualifications, Education, Certifications and/or Other Professional Credentials


Demonstrated experience analyzing complex business and performance data and translating findings into actionable recommendations.
Strong business acumen with the ability to connect data, performance trends, and business activity to measurable outcomes.
Experience analyzing sales, conversion, productivity, customer, or related performance metrics in a business environment.
Demonstrated ability to identify trends, performance gaps, and root causes and communicate the business implications of those findings.
Experience developing dashboards, reporting, executive presentations, or other analytical tools that support business decision-making.
Strong communication and data-storytelling skills, with the ability to translate complex analysis into clear insights for non-technical and senior audiences.
Demonstrated ability to partner effectively across business, sales, product, field, and data or analytics teams.
Strong attention to data quality, accuracy, and consistency.
Ability to work independently, manage multiple priorities, and proactively identify opportunities where analytics can improve business performance.


Preferred Qualifications


Experience supporting Retail Banking, Consumer Financial Services, branch distribution, sales performance, or another large-scale customer-facing business.
Experience evaluating sales initiatives, campaigns, lead-management strategies, or other programs tied to measurable business outcomes.
Experience establishing KPIs and measuring the effectiveness of strategic or operational initiatives.
Experience developing insights for a geographically distributed frontline organization.
Advanced experience with business intelligence, visualization, reporting, or analytical tools.


Hours & Work Schedule


Hours per Week: 40
Work Schedule: 8 AM – 5 PM


Pay Transparency


The salary range for this position is $139,000 - $182,000 per year, plus an opportunity to earn an annual discretionary bonus. Actual pay is based on various factors including but not limited to the budget, work location, and relevant skills and experience.

Title: Senior Data Analyst (Hybrid)
Description:
When you join the growing BILH team, you're not just taking a job, you’re making a difference in people’s lives.

Seeking an experienced Senior Project Manager & Data Analyst to support grants management operations and reporting across Beth Israel Lahey Health (BILH). The Senior Project Manager & Data Analyst will serve as a liaison between grants management stakeholders, technical teams, and system business analysts ensuring the accuracy and integrity of data within the grants management system and related applications. This role will manage data elements, system interactions, and reporting requirements while developing dashboards, management reports, and analytics for leadership and other stakeholders. The position will define and oversee the reporting pipeline for the various grants operations groups, including the selection, validation, and integration of data elements from the grants management system into the enterprise data warehouse to support consistent reporting and analytics. The role will collaborate closely with Grants Administration, Finance, Compliance, Information Systems, and other ancillary groups to support informed decision-making, process improvement, and the effective use of grants management and compliance data. Successful candidates will have demonstrated experience with enterprise data lake queries (like SnowFlake), familiarily with ELT processes, report and dashboard design, and ad hoc reporting using SQL tools and PowerBI.

Leverages software applications to design solutions, performs detailed data mapping and analysis and reviews all data for accuracy and reasonableness prior to distribution. Produces business, research or clinical intelligence.

Job Description

Essential Responsibilities:


Manages one or more complex data projects. Utilizes hospital systems and database applications to update and analyze data. Prepares and distributes various reports to key stakeholders. Meets with departmental leadership to review reports or requests for data.
Maintains integrity and quality of data and assures data conformity meets operational requirements and goals. Acts as a central resource and integral member of data collection team. Assists in planning, establishing and monitoring criteria for data collection. Trains department staff on data acquisition methods. Extracts data from multiple sources. Audits and resolves all issues.
Ensures application access is in compliance with all regulatory and medical center practices. Acts as gatekeeper for application. Sets and defines user access and determines level of access. Reports all security risks to the application.
Collaborates with IS to obtain and maintain applications used for data collection and reporting. Recommends tools, upgrades and alternatives. Assists in the development of application security and back-up plans. Coordinates interface solution with multiple applications.
Designs and develops reporting and analysis tools. Interprets data and refines analysis. Prepares and presents comprehensive reports. Develops forms, tables and other data tools in the applications that capture, report and consolidate data. Provides application data collection, analytics and reporting expertise. Completes analytics in a timely and efficient manner.
Prepares weekly, monthly, and quarterly reports/dashboards and/or data submissions department.


Required Qualifications


Bachelor's degree required in Computer Science, Allied Health, or related field.
3-5 years related work experience required.
1-3 years of multiple application maintenance with relational databases.
Advanced technical computer skills as required for technical support specific to functional area and related systems.


Preferred Qualifications


Application Certification for one of the applications used in the department.


Competencies

Written Communications:

Ability to summarize and communicate in English moderately complex information in varied written formats to internal and external customers.

Oral Communications

Ability to comprehend and communicate complex verbal information in English to medical center staff, patients, families and external customers.

Knowledge

Ability to demonstrate in-depth knowledge of concepts, practices and policies with the ability to use them in complex varied situations.

Teamwork

Ability to act as a team leader for small projects or work groups, creating a collaborative and respectful team environment and improving workflows. Results may impact the operations of one or more departments.

Customer Service

Ability to provide a high level of customer service to patients, visitors, staff and external customers in a professional, service-oriented, respectful manner using skills in active listening and problem solving. Ability to remain calm in stressful situations.

Physical Nature Of The Job

Sedentary work: Exerting up to 10 pounds of force occasionally in carrying, lifting, pushing, pulling objects. Sitting most of the time, with walking and standing required only occasionally.

Pay Range

$74,880.00 USD - $124,800.00 USD

The pay range listed for this position is the annual base salary range the organization reasonably and in good faith expects to pay for this position at this time. Actual compensation is determined based on several factors, that may include seniority, education, training, relevant experience, relevant certifications, geography of work location, job responsibilities, or other applicable factors permissible by law.

Title: Principal People Data Analyst
Description:
Our world is transforming, and PTC is leading the way. Our software brings the physical and digital worlds together, enabling companies to improve operations, create better products, and empower people in all aspects of their business.

Our people make all the difference in our success. Today, we are a global team of nearly 7,000 and our main objective is to create opportunities for our team members to explore, learn, and grow – all while seeing their ideas come to life and celebrating the differences that make us who we are and the work we do possible.

Reporting to: SVP of People Operations

Location: Boston, MA office (hybrid)

We are seeking a highly experienced Principal People Data Analytics Analyst to lead advanced people analytics and workforce insights, with Workday serving as the backbone of our people data ecosystem.

This role will be responsible for turning Workday data into strategic insights that inform workforce planning, talent management, organizational effectiveness, employee retention, compensation, and broader People strategy. In this role, you will partner closely with the People Leadership Team, HR Technology, Finance, business leaders, and other stakeholders to ensure that Workday data is trusted, well-governed, accessible, and translated into meaningful business intelligence.

The ideal candidate combines deep expertise in People Analytics and Workday data with strong analytical, technical, and consulting capabilities. This individual will operate as a subject-matter expert, establish analytical standards and best practices, and serve as a strategic advisor to senior leaders.

Key Responsibilities


Serve as a subject-matter expert for Workday people data, including the underlying data structures, business processes, organizational hierarchies, worker data, job and position data, compensation, recruiting, talent, and other adjacent technologies.
Use Workday as the primary source and foundation for enterprise people analytics, ensuring that workforce insights are grounded in consistent and trusted data.
Develop and maintain sophisticated analytical datasets, metrics, dashboards, and reporting solutions leveraging Workday data.
Partner with HR Technology and HRIS teams to understand and optimize Workday configuration, data structures, integrations, and reporting capabilities.
Identify opportunities to improve Workday data quality, consistency, completeness, and usability for analytics.
Establish standardized definitions and methodologies for critical workforce metrics, using Workday as the system of record wherever appropriate.
Evaluate data flows between Workday and downstream data warehouses, business intelligence platforms, and other enterprise systems.


People Analytics & Strategic Insights


Lead high-impact analytics initiatives addressing complex workforce and business questions.
Analyze workforce data to identify trends, drivers, risks, and opportunities across the employee lifecycle.
Develop predictive and advanced analytics to support workforce planning, retention, talent management, organizational effectiveness, and employee experience.
Connect people metrics to business outcomes to help leaders understand the organizational implications of workforce trends.
Develop executive-level dashboards and data solutions that provide clear, actionable visibility into the workforce.
Translate complex analytical findings into compelling recommendations for senior People leaders and executives.


Strategic Partnership


Serve as a trusted analytics advisor to senior People leaders, HR Business Partners, Finance, and business executives.
Partner with HR Technology, HRIS, Compensation, Talent, Recruiting, Finance, and other teams to develop integrated workforce insights.
Proactively identify important workforce trends and analytical opportunities rather than relying solely on reporting requests.
Influence strategic decisions through data-driven recommendations and clear executive storytelling.
Lead analytical projects from problem definition through analysis, recommendation, and implementation.


Data Governance & Analytics Architecture


Help establish and maintain a trusted People data foundation centered on Workday.
Define and document enterprise people metrics, data definitions, calculation methodologies, and reporting standards.
Partner with HR Technology and Data teams to establish appropriate data governance, lineage, quality controls, and access practices.
Identify gaps between Workday data and other enterprise data sources and develop approaches for reconciling and integrating information.
Promote responsible use of employee data, including appropriate privacy, confidentiality, security, and access controls.
Help shape the evolution of the People Analytics data architecture and technology roadmap.


Technical & Analytical Leadership


Leverage Workday reporting and analytics capabilities, including Workday Report Writer, calculated fields, composite reports, dashboards, and other relevant Workday reporting technologies.
Develop visualizations and analytical products using tools such as Visier, Tableau, Power BI, Looker, or similar platforms.
Evaluate opportunities to use predictive analytics, machine learning, experimentation, and other advanced methodologies to improve workforce decision-making.
Mentor analysts and provide analytical and technical guidance across the People Analytics organization.


Qualifications


Bachelor's degree in Statistics, Mathematics, Economics, Data Science, Business Analytics, Human Resources, Computer Science, or a related field; advanced degree preferred.
8+ years of experience in People Analytics, HR Analytics, Workforce Analytics, Business Intelligence, Data Analytics, or a related field.
Deep experience working with Workday as a primary source of people data, including strong understanding of its data model, reporting capabilities, business processes, and organizational structures.
Strong understanding of workforce metrics, HR processes, and the employee lifecycle.
Experience translating Workday data into executive dashboards, analytical models, and strategic insights.
Experience with Workday reporting technologies such as Report Writer, calculated fields, dashboards, and/or advanced reporting capabilities.
Experience working with downstream data warehouses, BI platforms, or enterprise data environments connected to Workday.
Strong statistical, analytical, and problem-solving skills.
Demonstrated ability to communicate complex findings to executive and non-technical audiences.
Strong business acumen and demonstrated ability to influence senior stakeholders.
High degree of discretion and understanding of employee data privacy, confidentiality, and governance.


Preferred Qualifications


Workday certification or significant hands-on Workday reporting experience.
Experience with Workday Prism Analytics or other Workday analytics capabilities.
Experience with Workday integrations and downstream data pipelines.
Experience integrating Workday data with Finance, Finance Planning, Recruiting, Talent, Compensation, or other enterprise systems.
Experience with predictive workforce analytics, attrition modeling, workforce planning, or organizational network analysis.
Experience establishing enterprise People Analytics data governance and metric frameworks.
Experience in a complex, global, or rapidly scaling organization.


What Success Looks Like

Success in this role means creating a trusted, Workday-centered people data foundation that enables leaders to make faster, more informed workforce decisions.

The Principal People Analytics Analyst will ensure that Workday data is not simply reported—it is understood, connected, analyzed, and translated into strategic insight. Leaders should be able to trust the underlying data, understand what the metrics mean, and confidently use the resulting insights to make decisions about people, talent, organization, and business performance.

Core Competencies


Workday & People Data Expertise
Advanced People Analytics
Strategic Thinking
Data Architecture & Governance
Statistical & Quantitative Analysis
Executive Data Storytelling
Business Acumen
Stakeholder Influence
Data Visualization
Problem Solving
Innovation
Collaboration & Mentorship
Judgment & Discretion

This individual will operate as a subject-matter expert, establish analytical standards and best practices, and serve as a strategic advisor to senior leaders.

Key Responsibilities

  • Serve as a subject-matter expert for Workday people data, including the underlying data structures, business processes, organizational hierarchies, worker data, job and position data, compensation, recruiting, talent, and other adjacent technologies.
  • Use Workday as the primary source and foundation for enterprise people analytics, ensuring that workforce insights are grounded in consistent and trusted data.
  • Develop and maintain sophisticated analytical datasets, metrics, dashboards, and reporting solutions leveraging Workday data.
  • Partner with HR Technology and HRIS teams to understand and optimize Workday configuration, data structures, integrations, and reporting capabilities.
  • Identify opportunities to improve Workday data quality, consistency, completeness, and usability for analytics.
  • Establish standardized definitions and methodologies for critical workforce metrics, using Workday as the system of record wherever appropriate.
  • Evaluate data flows between Workday and downstream data warehouses, business intelligence platforms, and other enterprise systems.

People Analytics & Strategic Insights

  • Lead high-impact analytics initiatives addressing complex workforce and business questions.
  • Analyze workforce data to identify trends, drivers, risks, and opportunities across the employee lifecycle.
  • Develop predictive and advanced analytics to support workforce planning, retention, talent management, organizational effectiveness, and employee experience.
  • Connect people metrics to business outcomes to help leaders understand the organizational implications of workforce trends.
  • Develop executive-level dashboards and data solutions that provide clear, actionable visibility into the workforce.
  • Translate complex analytical findings into compelling recommendations for senior People leaders and executives.

Strategic Partnership

  • Serve as a trusted analytics advisor to senior People leaders, HR Business Partners, Finance, and business executives.
  • Partner with HR Technology, HRIS, Compensation, Talent, Recruiting, Finance, and other teams to develop integrated workforce insights.
  • Proactively identify important workforce trends and analytical opportunities rather than relying solely on reporting requests.
  • Influence strategic decisions through data-driven recommendations and clear executive storytelling.
  • Lead analytical projects from problem definition through analysis, recommendation, and implementation.

Data Governance & Analytics Architecture

  • Help establish and maintain a trusted People data foundation centered on Workday.
  • Define and document enterprise people metrics, data definitions, calculation methodologies, and reporting standards.
  • Partner with HR Technology and Data teams to establish appropriate data governance, lineage, quality controls, and access practices.
  • Identify gaps between Workday data and other enterprise data sources and develop approaches for reconciling and integrating information.
  • Promote responsible use of employee data, including appropriate privacy, confidentiality, security, and access controls.
  • Help shape the evolution of the People Analytics data architecture and technology roadmap.

Technical & Analytical Leadership

  • Leverage Workday reporting and analytics capabilities, including Workday Report Writer, calculated fields, composite reports, dashboards, and other relevant Workday reporting technologies.
  • Develop visualizations and analytical products using tools such as Visier, Tableau, Power BI, Looker, or similar platforms.
  • Evaluate opportunities to use predictive analytics, machine learning, experimentation, and other advanced methodologies to improve workforce decision-making.
  • Mentor analysts and provide analytical and technical guidance across the People Analytics organization.

Qualifications

  • Bachelor's degree in Statistics, Mathematics, Economics, Data Science, Business Analytics, Human Resources, Computer Science, or a related field; advanced degree preferred.
  • 8+ years of experience in People Analytics, HR Analytics, Workforce Analytics, Business Intelligence, Data Analytics, or a related field.
  • Deep experience working with Workday as a primary source of people data, including strong understanding of its data model, reporting capabilities, business processes, and organizational structures.
  • Strong understanding of workforce metrics, HR processes, and the employee lifecycle.
  • Experience translating Workday data into executive dashboards, analytical models, and strategic insights.
  • Experience with Workday reporting technologies such as Report Writer, calculated fields, dashboards, and/or advanced reporting capabilities.
  • Experience working with downstream data warehouses, BI platforms, or enterprise data environments connected to Workday.
  • Strong statistical, analytical, and problem-solving skills.
  • Demonstrated ability to communicate complex findings to executive and non-technical audiences.
  • Strong business acumen and demonstrated ability to influence senior stakeholders.
  • High degree of discretion and understanding of employee data privacy, confidentiality, and governance.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Workday certification or significant hands-on Workday reporting experience.
  • Experience with Workday Prism Analytics or other Workday analytics capabilities.
  • Experience with Workday integrations and downstream data pipelines.
  • Experience integrating Workday data with Finance, Finance Planning, Recruiting, Talent, Compensation, or other enterprise systems.
  • Experience with predictive workforce analytics, attrition modeling, workforce planning, or organizational network analysis.
  • Experience establishing enterprise People Analytics data governance and metric frameworks.
  • Experience in a complex, global, or rapidly scaling organization.

What Success Looks Like

Success in this role means creating a trusted, Workday-centered people data foundation that enables leaders to make faster, more informed workforce decisions.

The Principal People Analytics Analyst will ensure that Workday data is not simply reported—it is understood, connected, analyzed, and translated into strategic insight. Leaders should be able to trust the underlying data, understand what the metrics mean, and confidently use the resulting insights to make decisions about people, talent, organization, and business performance.

Core Competencies

  • Workday & People Data Expertise
  • Advanced People Analytics
  • Strategic Thinking
  • Data Architecture & Governance
  • Statistical & Quantitative Analysis
  • Executive Data Storytelling
  • Business Acumen
  • Stakeholder Influence
  • Data Visualization

  • Collaboration & Mentorship
  • Judgment & Discretion

Title: Senior Analyst, Procurement Data & Analytics
Description:
Acute Care Technology

At ZOLL, we're passionate about improving patient outcomes and helping save lives. We provide innovative technologies that make a meaningful difference in people's lives. Our medical devices, software and related services are used worldwide to diagnose and treat patients suffering from serious cardiopulmonary and respiratory conditions.

The Acute Care Technology division of ZOLL Medical Corporation develops and delivers innovative lifesaving products and software solutions to EMS, hospital, public safety, and military customers globally. Products include AEDs, trauma kits, ventilators, temperature management solutions, and more. Our dedicated employees take pride in their commitment to improving patient outcomes while delivering world-class customer service.

At ZOLL, you won’t just have a job. You'll have a career—and a purpose.

Join our team. It’s a great time to be a part of ZOLL!

ZOLL Medical does not provide immigration-related sponsorship for this role. Do not apply for this role if you will need ZOLL immigration sponsorship (e.g. H1B, TN, STEM, OPT, etc.) either now or in the future.

The Opportunity

Procurement has stood up a new Data & Analytics team inside our Center of Excellence, and this is one of its first hires. The team is chartered to build the analytical backbone for the entire Procurement organization — Direct and Indirect Sourcing, Purchasing, Supplier Quality Engineering, and Cost Reduction. As the team's Senior Analyst, you won't inherit legacy reports; you'll build the function's first spend cube, its first live Oracle Fusion Analytics dashboards, and the automated data pipelines behind them.

Your work will be highly visible: the dashboards and insights you build will be the reporting foundation that Procurement and executive leadership rely on to steer cost reduction, supplier performance, and supply continuity decisions across a global medical device business. You'll be a part of a small team, by design, where we push each other to be innovative, forward-thinking and high performing.

What You'll Build In Year One


Spend Cube: Partner with the Data & Analytics Manager to design and deliver Procurement's first spend cube (supplier × commodity × cost center) in Oracle Fusion Analytics
Live Dashboards: Replace manual, ad-hoc reporting processes with live, self-service dashboards for spend, supplier performance, and category views
Product Analytics: Build repeatable product-line dashboards covering forecasting, supplier quality, and supply risk — then automate the data pipelines behind them
Data Quality Foundation: Help establish data ownership, validation, and a "clean in, clean out" standard across Oracle Cloud, Workday Sourcing, and connected systems
Predictive Readiness: Contribute to exception-based reporting and the roadmap toward predictive analytics and AI-readiness


Essential Functions


Develop, maintain, and improve procurement dashboards, reports, and KPI frameworks across all ZOLL ACT sites
Analyze procurement spend across suppliers, commodities, and sites to surface savings opportunities and support cost reduction initiatives
Translate complex, multi-system data into clear, actionable insights for Purchasing, Sourcing, SQE, and leadership stakeholders
Design and automate recurring reporting processes, reducing manual effort and improving data reliability
Develop and maintain supplier performance reporting and scorecards
Support cost and price variance analysis and procurement-related financial metrics
Maintain and validate key procurement and planning data within Oracle Cloud; champion data quality at the source
Analyze demand, supply, and inventory trends to identify material risks and operational impacts
Provide analytical support to buyers and purchasing teams, balancing strategic build work with operational needs


Required Qualifications


Bachelor's degree in Analytics, Supply Chain, Business, Finance, Engineering, Operations, or a related field
4–6+ years of experience in data analytics, business intelligence, procurement, supply chain, or related analytical functions
Proficiency in SQL and structuring large, multi-source datasets for analysis
Hands-on experience building dashboards in a modern BI platform (Oracle Fusion Analytics, Power BI, or Tableau)
Advanced Microsoft Excel skills, including Power Query and data modeling
Proven ability to convert findings into actionable business insights and communicate them to non-technical stakeholders


Preferred Qualifications


Experience with procurement, sourcing, planning, or inventory data in a manufacturing environment
Experience working within ERP systems, preferably Oracle Cloud
Experience with spend analysis, supplier performance reporting, or KPI development
Exposure to data pipeline automation, exception-based reporting, or predictive analytics


Deep procurement domain expertise is not required — we will teach you procurement. We're prioritizing analytical horsepower, curiosity, and the ability to build.

How We'll Invest In You

This team develops people deliberately. You'll join with a structured 30/60/90-day onboarding plan, a competency framework spanning five priority areas (data modeling, insights generation, visualization, business acumen, and financial acumen), an individual development plan built in your first quarter, and a clear progression path within a growing analytics function. By the end of year one, you'll independently own multiple reporting workstreams.

Location & Work Arrangement

This role is open to remote candidates across the U.S., with periodic onsite collaboration at our Chelmsford, MA site (approximately quarterly, plus onboarding). Candidates local to the Boston area who prefer a hybrid arrangement are equally welcome.

ZOLL is a fast-growing company that operates in more than 140 countries around the world. Our employees are inspired by a commitment to make a difference in patients' lives, and our culture values innovation, self-motivation and an entrepreneurial spirit. Join us in our efforts to improve outcomes for underserved patients suffering from critical cardiopulmonary conditions and help save more lives.

The Annual Salary For This Position Is

$90,000.00 to $120,000.00

Factors which may affect starting salary include geography, skills, education, experience, and other qualifications of the successful candidate. Details of ZOLL's comprehensive benefits plans can be found at www.zollbenefits.com.

Applications will be accepted on an ongoing basis until this position is filled. For fully remote positions, compensation will comply with all applicable federal, state, and local wage laws, including minimum wage requirements, based on the employee’s primary work location.

All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, disability, or status as a protected veteran.

Our world class sales and sales support teams work directly with businesses of all sizes to offer products and services to meet our customers’ unique needs. We are committed to understanding our customers and use best-in-class sales tools and technology to find the best solutions. We’re constantly discovering new ways to reach our goals, taking time to develop our skills and investing in our career growth, so we can enjoy lucrative opportunities and grow our careers both within and beyond sales.

The Senior Analyst, Sales Operations is responsible for designing, building, and maintaining analytical tools, dashboards, scorecards, and reporting solutions that support data-driven decision-making across the sales organization. Partnering closely with Sales, Finance, Operations, Marketing, and IT teams, this role helps define performance metrics, uncover business insights, and identify opportunities to improve efficiency, profitability, and execution. The ideal candidate combines strong technical capabilities with business acumen and a passion for turning data into impactful recommendations.

What You’ll Be Doing:


Develop, automate, and maintain dashboards, scorecards, and reports that provide visibility into sales performance, pipeline health, revenue trends, and operational effectiveness.
Build and optimize data models and SQL queries to ensure accurate, scalable, and efficient reporting.
Create meaningful visualizations using Power BI, Tableau, MicroStrategy, or similar business intelligence tools.
Partner with business leaders to define key performance indicators (KPIs) and measurement frameworks for strategic initiatives.
Conduct deep-dive analyses to identify trends, root causes, risks, and opportunities for improvement.
Leverage automation and data preparation tools such as Alteryx to streamline reporting and analytics workflows.
Drive continuous improvement initiatives focused on reporting standardization, process optimization, and self-service analytics capabilities.
Collaborate with IT and data governance teams to ensure data quality, integrity, compliance, and security.
Present insights and recommendations to stakeholders and leadership teams to support business decision-making.
Stay current on emerging analytics technologies and recommend innovative solutions that improve business outcomes.


What You Bring To The Table:


Strong analytical, critical thinking, and problem-solving skills.
Excellent communication and presentation skills with the ability to simplify complex information.
Ability to manage multiple priorities and deliver results in a fast-paced environment.
Exceptional attention to detail and commitment to data accuracy.
Collaborative, relationship-focused approach with strong cross-functional partnership skills.
Intellectual curiosity and a passion for leveraging data, technology, and automation to solve business challenges.
Ability to translate data into actionable insights that drive measurable business impact.


What’s Needed- Basic Qualifications:


Bachelor’s degree in Finance, Economics, Mathematics, Engineering, Business Analytics, related analytical discipline, or equivalent work experience.
2+ years of experience in analytics, business intelligence, sales operations, or a related field.
Advanced SQL skills for data extraction, analysis, and reporting.
Experience developing dashboards and reporting solutions using Power BI, Tableau, MicroStrategy, or similar platforms.
Strong Microsoft Excel skills, including pivot tables, advanced formulas, and data modeling.
Demonstrated experience defining business metrics and translating business requirements into analytical solutions.
Proven ability to build and maintain scalable reporting processes and frameworks.
Strong written and verbal communication skills.


What’s Needed - Preferred Qualifications:


Experience with Alteryx or similar workflow automation and data preparation tools.
Familiarity with Snowflake, Salesforce, enterprise data warehouses, or comparable technologies.
Understanding of sales performance measurement, forecasting, territory planning, and pipeline analytics.
Experience supporting data governance initiatives or self-service analytics programs.
Exposure to project management or continuous improvement methodologies such as Lean, Six Sigma, or Agile.
Experience working in a cross-functional environment supporting sales and business operations teams.

Inclusive culture with associate-led Business Resource Groups
Flexible PTO (22 days) and Holiday Schedule (7 observed paid holidays + 1 floating holiday)

Title: Sr. Marketing Analyst
Description:
About Us

Founded in 1992 in Dover, NH, Planet Fitness is one of the largest and fastest-growing franchisors and operators of fitness centers in the world by number of members and locations. As of March 31, 2026, Planet Fitness had approximately 21.5 million members and 2,909 clubs in all 50 states, the District of Columbia, Puerto Rico, Canada, Panama, Mexico, Australia and Spain.

The Company’s mission is to enhance people’s lives by providing a high-quality fitness experience in a welcoming, non-intimidating environment, which we call the Judgement Free Zone®. Approximately 90% of Planet Fitness clubs are owned and operated by independent business owners.

At Planet Fitness, our purpose is to create a more connected and Judgement Free™ planet, where fitness and wellbeing are within reach for all. That commitment extends to our team members and how we work together.

Breaking Boundaries Together is how we bring our employee experience to life, creating a place where people can show up as themselves, explore what’s possible, continue to grow and achieve more together than they can alone. Guided by our PLANET Principles, we put people first, lead with authenticity and integrity, embrace change and thrive together.

For the past 30 years, we’ve helped millions of people in their fitness journey and revolutionized the industry along the way. And we’re just getting started!

Overview

Reporting to the Director, Marketing Analytics & Data Science, the Senior Marketing Analyst is responsible for supporting marketing strategy and business decision-making through data analysis, performance measurement, experimentation, and reporting.

This role partners with Marketing, Finance, Operations, and Technology to evaluate marketing performance, measure campaign effectiveness, and deliver actionable insights that drive member growth, engagement, and marketing effectiveness.

The Senior Marketing Analyst will analyze marketing and member performance, develop insights that drive strategic marketing decisions, build/support dashboards and KPI reporting, design and support experimentation and measurement initiatives, and provide senior leaders with clear insights through skilled data-driven story telling.

The ideal candidate combines strong analytical capabilities, marketing business acumen, intellectual curiosity, and a passion for translating complex data into compelling, actionable insights and strategies.

This role follows a hybrid schedule and requires regular, in-person work at our Boston, MA or Hampton, NH office. Our hybrid model is M/T/W in office and TH/F are optional work-from-home. Candidates must reside within commuting distance of one of these locations. Fully remote work is not available for this role.

Responsibilities

Marketing Analytics & Performance Measurement



Analyzes marketing performance across acquisition, retention, digital channels, campaigns, and member engagement initiatives
Drives measurement of marketing initiatives through KPI development, reporting, trend analysis, and performance insights
Develops analytical recommendations that identify opportunities to improve marketing effectiveness and business outcomes
Supports testing and measurement initiatives including campaign analysis, segmentation, and performance evaluations
Develops and maintains dashboards, scorecards, KPI reporting, and analytical tools that provide visibility into marketing performance
Monitors key performance indicators, identify trends, and communicate insights to business stakeholders
Ensures data accuracy, consistency, and integrity across reporting and analysis.



Cross-Functional Partnership



Co-owns the design, development, and execution of marketing insights and measurement strategy with Marketing Team counterparts
Partners with Strategy, Finance, Operations, and Technology teams to support business initiatives through data analysis
Translates analytical findings into clear, actionable recommendations for technical and non-technical audiences
Supports ad hoc analyses and business requests related to marketing performance, member growth, and strategic initiatives.

Title: Senior Analyst, Commercial Analytics (Digital Commerce)
Description:
At WHOOP, we're on a mission to unlock and inspire performance for life.

WHOOP is hiring a Senior Analyst to join the Commercial Analytics team and serve as a key analytics partner to our Digital Commerce business. In this role, you will own analysis and reporting across our direct-to-consumer and marketplace channels, translating data into insights that inform pricing, promotions, merchandising, and product strategy. You will help us understand what drives bookings, conversion, and margin across our digital storefronts and partner closely with Marketing Analytics to connect acquisition and traffic trends to downstream commercial performance.

Responsibilities


Serve as a key analytics partner to the Digital Commerce team, analyzing performance across direct-to-consumer and marketplace channels to identify opportunities that drive bookings, conversion, and margin growth.
Own analysis of digital pricing and promotions, including incrementality, cannibalization, discount depth, and pull-forward, to inform promotional strategy and investment decisions.
Analyze funnel and conversion performance, merchandising, product mix, attach rate, and average order value to understand the drivers of digital commerce performance and identify opportunities for growth.
Own marketplace performance analysis, evaluating channel economics, assortment, pricing, and customer behavior across marketplaces and our direct-to-consumer business.
Build scalable reporting and analytical tools that give Digital Commerce leadership visibility into channel performance, partnering with Analytics Engineering to ensure data is accurate, consistent, and trusted.
Support commercial planning and forecasting by developing Digital Commerce inputs and channel-level drivers, and partner with Marketing Analytics to connect acquisition and traffic trends to downstream commercial outcomes.


Qualifications


4+ years of experience in analytics, business intelligence, or a related discipline, ideally within e-commerce, direct-to-consumer, marketplace, subscription, or consumer products businesses.
Strong SQL skills and experience working with large-scale transactional and behavioral data, with the ability to independently move from a business question to analysis, insight, and recommendation.
Demonstrated experience building reporting and analytical tools that enable stakeholders to understand performance and make informed business decisions.
Strong business acumen and experience partnering with e-commerce, commercial, merchandising, or other business stakeholders, with the ability to synthesize complex data into clear recommendations and actions.
Experience with digital commerce analytics, including funnel and conversion analysis, pricing and promotional measurement, merchandising, product mix, or marketplace performance.
Familiarity with experimentation and incrementality measurement, digital analytics or clickstream data, and business intelligence tools such as Sigma is a plus.
Strong commitment to embracing and leveraging AI tools in day-to-day tasks, ensuring AI-assisted work aligns with the same high-quality standards as personal contributions.


This role is based in the WHOOP office located in Boston, MA. The successful candidate must be prepared to relocate if necessary to work out of the Boston, MA office.

Interested in the role, but don’t meet every qualification? We encourage you to still apply! At WHOOP, we believe there is much more to a candidate than what is written on paper, and we value character as much as experience. As we continue to build a diverse and inclusive environment, we encourage anyone who is interested in this role to apply.

WHOOP is an Equal Opportunity Employer and participates in E-verify to determine employment eligibility

The WHOOP compensation philosophy is designed to attract, motivate, and retain exceptional talent by offering competitive base salaries, meaningful equity, and consistent pay practices that reflect our mission and core values.

At WHOOP, we view total compensation as the combination of base salary, equity, and benefits, with equity serving as a key differentiator that aligns our employees with the long-term success of the company and allows every member of our corporate team to own part of WHOOP and share in the company’s long-term growth and success.

The U.S. base salary range for this full-time position is $120,000 - $155,000. Salary ranges are determined by role, level, and location. Within each range, individual pay is based on factors such as job-related skills, experience, performance, and relevant education or training.

In addition to the base salary, the successful candidate will also receive benefits and a generous equity package.

These ranges may be modified in the future to reflect evolving market conditions and organizational needs. While most offers will typically fall toward the starting point of the range, total compensation will depend on the candidate’s specific qualifications, expertise, and alignment with the role’s requirements.

Title: Analyst
Description:
At Affirm, we exist for the moments that matter—giving people a clear, predictable way to pay over time, with no hidden fees, no surprises, and no tradeoffs on what matters most.

About The Risk & Analytics Team

The Risk & Analytics (R&A) team makes crucial decisions that direct Affirm’s business strategy. We partner with Machine Learning, Product, Engineering, Capital Markets, and Commercial teams to grow Affirm responsibly by optimizing approval, conversion, losses, and profitability.

Operating across the entire customer and merchant lifecycle, we tackle a diverse array of challenges, from optimizing checkout conversion and mitigating fraud risk to building scalable data foundations and enabling international growth. We analyze performance not just to report on it, but to determine where to invest resources for maximum impact through building tools, scalable data infrastructure, and analytical frameworks.

We improve the analytics experience across Affirm by streamlining workflows and fostering a culture of learning and documentation. By taking ownership of the entire analytical lifecycle, from initial question to final business decision, we turn complex data and systems into clear, actionable signals that ensure Affirm grows efficiently and intelligently.

One Role, Multiple Teams

We are hiring multiple Analyst I roles across Affirm's Risk & Analytics organization through this single job posting. Rather than interviewing for one specific team, candidates will go through a shared interview process designed to assess the core skills we look for across R&A.

If selected, we will work with you to determine the best team match based on your interests, experience, strengths, and current business needs. You will have the opportunity to learn more about our teams and share your preferences as you move through the process.

Potential Team Placements Include


Point of Sale (POS): Optimize merchant and checkout performance to improve conversion, approvals, and unit economics across the purchase funnel.
Direct to Consumer (DTC) / Card: Drive engagement, repeat usage, and lifecycle health across Affirm's app, web, and card experiences.
Fraud: Prevent and reduce fraud losses across the customer journey while maintaining a frictionless user experience.
Core Analytics: Build the quantitative research, machine learning models, performance monitoring, and scalable data foundations that enable fast, economically sound decisions.
Servicing: Enhance the post-origination customer experience by analyzing repayment behavior, collections strategies, and operational efficiency.
International Expansion: Build the measurement and decision foundations needed to sustainably launch and scale Affirm in new global markets.


About The Role

As an Analyst I in Affirm's Risk & Analytics organization, you will join one of several analytical teams working across the customer and merchant lifecycle. While the specific problems you tackle will depend on your eventual team placement, all Analyst I roles share a common foundation: using data to understand business performance, identify opportunities, and help Affirm make better decisions.

You will learn the fundamentals of consumer lending while executing scoped analytical work under the guidance of senior analysts and managers. You will leverage SQL, Python, and modern analytical tools to help optimize business strategies, monitor performance, and turn complex data into actionable insights.

You are a thoughtful, driven individual eager to build a strong technical foundation, learn how to navigate exogenous market changes, and integrate modern AI tooling to solve hard problems efficiently.

What You Will Do


Derive Insights & Support Strategy: Leverage data analytics to uncover insights that help optimize product, risk, or growth strategies across geographies.
Monitor Portfolio Health: Assist in tracking performance metrics, user behavior, and macroeconomic trends that impact business outcomes, flagging risks and anomalies to senior team members.
Technical Execution: Write clean, working SQL and Python to build scalable reporting and partner with Engineering to support the deployment of machine learning and risk models.
Cross-Functional Collaboration: Work closely with Product, Legal, and Compliance to understand evolving consumer lending regulations and market requirements, assisting in translating them into foundational data models and operational policies.
Drive Launch Alignment: Support cross-functional discussions to ensure new product launches and market entries align with our operational capabilities and risk appetite.
AI Fluency & Efficiency: Integrate AI tools such as Cursor, Claude Code, and copilots into your daily workflows to accelerate data mining and routine tasks, while carefully verifying outputs.


What We Look For


1–3 years of experience in an analytically driven role. Relevant internships or prior experience in consumer lending, fintech, or the broader financial services industry are highly valued.
Degree in Data Science, Computer Science, Engineering, Economics, or a related quantitative field.
Solid working knowledge of SQL, Python, or other scripting languages.
Familiarity with data mining, data visualization, and foundational statistical modeling.
Basic understanding of, or deep curiosity about, consumer lending regulations, fair lending principles, and how machine learning techniques apply to real-world business problems.
Exceptional communication skills, humility, and the ability to collaborate effectively with cross-functional peers.


Pay Grade - I

Equity Grade - 5

Employees new to Affirm typically come in at the start of the pay range. Affirm focuses on providing a simple and transparent pay structure which is based on a variety of factors, including location, experience and job-related skills.

Base pay is part of a total compensation package that may include monthly stipends for health, wellness and tech spending, and benefits (including 100% subsidized medical coverage, dental and vision for you and your dependents). In addition, the employees may be eligible for equity rewards offered by Affirm Holdings, Inc. (parent company).

USA base pay range (CA, WA, NY, NJ, CT) per year: $115,000 - $165,000

USA base pay range (all other U.S. states) per year: $101,000 - $151,000

Remote-first with flexibility built in

Affirm is proud to be a remote-first company. Most roles can be done from almost anywhere within the country of employment. Some positions may occasionally require in-person work at an Affirm office, and a few are office-based due to the nature of the work. All new hires will be invited to attend an in-person onboarding experience.

Benefits Designed For You

Our benefits reflect our commitment to care, transparency, and flexibility. Here are a few highlights:


Health coverage at no cost: We cover 100% of premiums for employees and their dependents.
Spending stipends: Monthly stipends support your tech setup, and the ability to choose health and wellness options that are right for you.
Time off to recharge: Flexible time off and generous holiday calendars help you rest when you need to.
Own a piece of what you build: Our employee stock purchase plan (ESPP) lets you buy Affirm stock at a discount.


We’re committed to providing an inclusive interview process, including accommodations for candidates with disabilities. If you need support, we’re happy to help.

For positions based in San Francisco or Los Angeles: Affirm considers qualified applicants with arrest and conviction records, as required by law.

By clicking "Submit Application," you acknowledge that you have read Affirm's Global Candidate Privacy Notice and consent to the use of your personal information as described.

Title: Sr Digital & Marketing Analyst
Description:
Overview

The Senior Digital & Marketing Analyst is a key member of the Commercial Analytics team responsible for transforming digital, marketing, customer, and commercial data into actionable insights that drive revenue growth and improve customer engagement. This role partners closely with Marketing, E-commerce, and Commercial Excellence to analyze customer behavior across the end-to-end customer journey, evaluate marketing effectiveness, optimize digital experiences, and support strategic business decisions.

The ideal candidate combines strong analytical and technical expertise with business acumen, leveraging data from digital channels, CRM platforms, marketing systems, and commercial operations to identify opportunities, measure performance, and recommend improvements. This role goes beyond reporting by delivering meaningful insights, supporting experimentation, and influencing business strategy through data-driven storytelling.

Responsibilities


Analyze digital and marketing performance across web, e-commerce, self-service, assisted channels, and marketing campaigns, including traffic, conversion, funnel performance, customer engagement, and revenue contribution.
Develop insights into customer behavior throughout the end-to-end customer journey, identifying opportunities to improve acquisition, engagement, conversion, retention, and customer lifetime value.
Partner with Marketing, E-commerce, Commercial Excellence, and Revenue Operations teams to evaluate campaign performance, channel effectiveness, attribution, marketing mix, and return on investment (ROI), recommending optimization strategies.
Translate complex analytical findings into clear, actionable recommendations through compelling data storytelling and executive-level presentations.
Support experimentation initiatives, including A/B testing and conversion optimization, by defining success metrics, analyzing results, and providing recommendations.
Identify trends, patterns, and business opportunities through analysis of internal and external data sources.
Build Power BI dashboards, reports, and visualizations to automate insight.
Integrate digital analytics, CRM, marketing automation, and commercial data to provide a comprehensive view of customer and revenue performance.
Develop scalable analytical frameworks, performance metrics, KPIs, benchmarks, and data pipelines to support ongoing business decision-making.
Perform advanced statistical and quantitative analyses, including regression analysis, significance testing, segmentation, attribution modeling, marketing mix analysis, and predictive modeling where appropriate.
Coordinate analytics activities across multiple projects while collaborating with cross-functional and global stakeholders.
Support strategic initiatives by providing analytical expertise that informs commercial and marketing priorities.


Qualifications

Required Education & Experience


Bachelor's degree in Analytics, Data Science, Statistics, Economics, Business, Marketing, Computer Science, or a related field.
5+ years of experience in digital analytics, marketing analytics, e-commerce analytics, consulting, or a related analytical role.
Strong experience analyzing digital funnels, customer journeys, campaign performance, web analytics, conversion rates, attribution, marketing effectiveness, and ROI.
Experience working with large datasets and translating analysis into actionable business insights.
Hands-on experience with digital analytics platforms such as Google Analytics, Adobe Analytics, Adobe Marketing Cloud, or similar platforms.
Strong analytical, quantitative, and problem-solving skills.
Experience with Power BI, SQL, Excel, and at least one analytical programming language such as Python.
Experience working with marketing technology platforms, CRM systems, and marketing automation tools.
Excellent communication and presentation skills, with the ability to explain complex analyses to technical and non-technical audiences.
Proven ability to collaborate effectively across cross-functional and matrixed organizations.


Preferred Qualifications


Experience in technology, life sciences, SaaS, e-commerce, or other data-driven organizations.
Experience with Salesforce CRM, Marketo, or similar marketing automation platforms.
Experience with business intelligence and visualization tools such as Power BI, Tableau, or Looker.
Knowledge of experimentation frameworks, A/B testing methodologies, and conversion rate optimization.
Experience with statistical modeling, predictive analytics, machine learning techniques, customer segmentation, clustering, and classification models.
Experience integrating digital analytics with downstream commercial, sales, and revenue data.
Familiarity with customer lifetime value modeling, marketing attribution, and marketing mix modeling.


Company Description

Waters Corporation (NYSE:WAT) is a global leader in life sciences and diagnostics, dedicated to accelerating the benefits of pioneering science through analytical technologies, informatics, and service. With a focus on regulated, high-volume testing environments, our innovative portfolio harnesses deep scientific expertise across chemistry, physics, and biology. We collaborate with customers around the world to advance the release of effective, high-quality medicines, ensure the safety of food and water, and drive better patient outcomes by detecting diseases earlier, managing routine infections, and combating antibiotic resistance. Through a shared culture of relentless innovation, our passionate team of ~16,000 colleagues turn scientific challenges into breakthroughs that improve lives worldwide.

Diversity and inclusion are fundamental to our core values at Waters Corporation. It benefits our employees, our products, our customers and our community. Title: Senior Data Analyst (Remote)
Description:
The Senior Data Analyst will help build trusted Finance data products and expand self-service analytics across FP&A. Working within the enterprise architecture and standards established by Shared Data Services, this role will translate Finance needs into scalable data solutions, validate and operationalize delivered assets, and directly build data models, transformations, pipelines, and dashboards when needed.

This is a highly technical individual-contributor role combining hands-on SQL and Python development, advanced analytics, data quality, business intelligence, and stakeholder partnership. The role will help Finance move from manual and fragmented analysis toward reusable data products that support driver-based forecasting, portfolio performance analysis, ad hoc decision support, and executive reporting.

Primary Responsibilities

Build Trusted Finance Data Products


Build, enhance, and maintain Finance tables, views, transformations, pipelines, and analytical models within established enterprise architecture, security, development, and governance standards.
Develop reusable data products supporting bookings, customers, billing, revenue, operational activity, and portfolio performance.
Use SQL and Python to automate data preparation, validation, and analytical workflows, and convert repeatable analyses into scalable assets.
Apply appropriate source control, testing, deployment, monitoring, and documentation practices to Finance data products.


Partner, Validate, and Operationalize


Translate FP&A and Portfolio Analytics needs into clear source requirements, data grain, business rules, transformation logic, quality controls, and acceptance criteria.
Own Finance requirements, prioritization, validation, and acceptance for data products delivered in partnership with onshore and offshore Shared Data Services teams.
Reconcile outputs to source systems, financial reporting, operational reporting, and approved methodologies; identify and resolve data quality issues, logic gaps, hierarchy problems, and incomplete coverage.
Maintain documentation for metric definitions, data lineage, business rules, assumptions, and known limitations, and coordinate issue resolution through Finance sign-off.


Deliver Advanced Analytics and Self-Service


Use SQL, Python, and appropriate analytical methods to solve complex customer, revenue, pricing, forecasting, portfolio, and operational questions.
Build semantic models, dashboards, and analytical tools using Power BI or a comparable enterprise business intelligence platform.
Enable FP&A users to independently answer recurring business questions with trusted data, reducing manual extracts, spreadsheet-based preparation, and one-off reporting.
Use approved AI-assisted development tools to improve coding, testing, documentation, and analytical productivity while validating outputs and protecting confidential data.


Education and Experience


Bachelor's degree in a technical, quantitative, analytical, Finance, or business discipline; equivalent relevant professional experience may be considered.
Five or more years of relevant experience in data analytics, analytics engineering, data engineering, business intelligence, or a related field.
Demonstrated experience independently delivering complex data and analytical solutions. Finance, FP&A, commercial analytics, or executive reporting experience is helpful but not required.


Required Qualifications


Advanced SQL and strong dimensional and analytical data-modeling skills.
Proficiency in Python for data processing, automation, and advanced analytics.
Experience developing or supporting ETL/ELT pipelines and reusable analytical datasets.
Hands-on experience with a modern cloud data warehouse or lakehouse environment.
Experience with data reconciliation, quality assurance, troubleshooting, and documentation.
Experience developing semantic models, dashboards, or business intelligence solutions.
Ability to translate ambiguous business requirements into scalable analytical and technical solutions.
Familiarity with source control, testing, deployment, and production support practices.


Preferred Qualifications


Experience with Microsoft Fabric and Azure data services, including lakehouses, warehouses, notebooks, pipelines, or related analytical workloads.
Power BI experience, including semantic modeling and DAX.
Experience with Git, CI/CD, orchestration, monitoring, or production support.
Experience supporting Finance, FP&A, commercial analytics, or executive reporting.
Familiarity with forecasting, customer analytics, revenue analytics, or portfolio analytics.
Experience working with centralized or shared enterprise data teams.


Knowledge, Skills, And Abilities


Strong technical problem-solving skills and the ability to execute independently.
Consultative approach and the ability to communicate effectively with technical and nontechnical stakeholders.
Strong attention to data accuracy, controls, validation, and methodological consistency.
Ability to manage multiple priorities, dependencies, and deliverables with clear follow-through.
Curiosity, sound judgment, and a bias toward action and iterative delivery.
Ability to learn new technologies, data sources, and business concepts quickly.


Equal Employment Opportunity

All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment.EEO/AA/Minorities/Females/Disabled/Vets.
