Title: Senior Analyst, Workforce Analytics
Description:
Galderma is the emerging pure-play dermatology category leader, present in approximately 90 countries. We deliver an innovative, science-based portfolio of premium flagship brands and services that span the full spectrum of the fast-growing dermatology market through Injectable Aesthetics, Dermatological Skincare and Therapeutic Dermatology. Since our foundation in 1981, we have dedicated our focus and passion to the human body's largest organ - the skin - meeting individual consumer and patient needs with superior outcomes in partnership with healthcare professionals. Because we understand that the skin, we are in shapes our lives, we are advancing dermatology for every skin story.

We look for people who focus on getting results, embrace learning and bring a positive energy. They must combine initiative with a sense of teamwork and collaboration. Above all, they must be passionate about doing something meaningful for consumers, patients, and the healthcare professionals we serve every day. We aim to empower each employee and promote their personal growth while ensuring business needs are met now and into the future. Across our company, we embrace diversity and respect the dignity, privacy, and personal rights of every employee.

At Galderma, we actively give our teams reasons to believe in our bold ambition to become the leading dermatology company in the world. With us, you have the ultimate opportunity to gain new and challenging work experiences and create an unparalleled, direct impact.

We are seeking a highly skilled and motivated Senior Workforce Analytics Analyst to provide advanced analytical support for our Contact Center Workforce Management (WFM) function.

This role will leverage workforce data, analytics, and technology to optimize staffing strategies, strengthen workforce planning, improve operational efficiency, and enable data-driven decision-making. The Senior Workforce Analytics Analyst will partner closely with HRBPs, business leaders, and cross-functional teams to translate complex workforce and operational data into meaningful insights and actionable recommendations.

The ideal candidate brings strong analytical and technical capabilities, an understanding of contact center and workforce management operations, and the ability to connect workforce insights with business needs.

Key Responsibilities

Workforce Analytics & Insights


Collect, analyze, and interpret workforce and contact center operational data to identify trends, patterns, risks, and opportunities.
Translate complex datasets into actionable insights that support workforce and operational decisions.
Conduct root cause analyses related to service levels, staffing, capacity, productivity, and workforce performance.
Identify emerging workforce trends and proactively recommend actions to improve operational effectiveness.
Partner with stakeholders to develop and enhance predictive models that improve workforce forecasting and planning.


Workforce Planning & Forecasting


Partner with WFM leaders to develop data-driven staffing and capacity models aligned with business objectives and operational requirements.
Provide analytical support for short- and long-term workforce planning, forecasting, scheduling, and intraday management.
Perform scenario modeling to evaluate the workforce implications of changes in demand, staffing, productivity, and business requirements.
Identify opportunities to improve staffing efficiency, capacity utilization, productivity, and cost management.
Support workforce forecasts and provide insights into potential staffing gaps, risks, and opportunities.


Reporting & Visualization


Develop and maintain workforce reports, dashboards, and analytical tools using SQL, Power BI, Excel, PowerPoint, Workday, and other relevant technologies.
Establish and maintain accurate, consistent, and reliable workforce metrics across reporting processes and data sources.
Translate analytical findings into clear recommendations and executive-ready insights.
Present complex information in a concise and understandable format for both technical and non-technical audiences.
Identify opportunities to automate and improve workforce reporting and analytics.


Performance & Optimization


Define, track, and analyze key performance indicators (KPIs) related to workforce efficiency, service levels, productivity, capacity, and operational effectiveness.
Monitor performance trends and proactively identify risks, opportunities, and areas requiring intervention.
Benchmark performance against internal targets and relevant industry standards to inform workforce strategies.
Recommend process improvements that strengthen WFM operations and overall organizational effectiveness.
Measure the impact of workforce initiatives and provide recommendations for continuous improvement.


Technology & Data Enablement


Leverage Workday and workforce management/contact center platforms, including AWS Connect, NICE, Alvaria, or similar technologies, to support workforce analytics, forecasting, scheduling, reporting, and decision-making.
Utilize Workday workforce and organizational data alongside operational data sources to develop integrated workforce insights and reporting.
Utilize advanced analytics tools and enterprise data platforms to improve the accuracy, accessibility, and usability of workforce information.
Support the implementation and integration of new tools, technologies, and processes that strengthen workforce analytics capabilities.
Partner with HR, HRBPs, Technology, Operations, and business teams to improve data quality, reporting efficiency, and system capabilities.
Identify opportunities to automate manual processes and increase the scalability of workforce analytics.


Qualifications

Education & Experience


Bachelor’s degree in Data Analytics, Business Analytics, Workforce Management, Business Administration, Statistics, or a related field.
Minimum of 4 years of relevant experience in workforce analytics, workforce management, contact center operations, business intelligence, or a related analytical role.
Demonstrated experience using workforce data and analytics to support operational and business decision-making.
Experience working within a complex, cross-functional organization preferred.


Technical Skills


Strong proficiency in SQL, Power BI, and Excel, with experience developing dashboards, reports, and analytical models.
Experience working with Workday, including workforce, organizational, and employee data for reporting and analytics.
Experience with workforce management or contact center technologies such as AWS Connect, NICE, Alvaria, or comparable platforms.
Working knowledge of forecasting methodologies, predictive modeling, statistical analysis, and data mining.
Demonstrated ability to integrate and analyze data from multiple sources and translate complex datasets into meaningful business insights.
Experience with data visualization, reporting automation, and analytical storytelling.


Core Capabilities


Strong analytical, critical-thinking, and problem-solving skills.
Ability to independently identify issues, analyze alternatives, and recommend solutions.
Strong business acumen and ability to connect workforce analytics with broader business and operational priorities.
Excellent written and verbal communication skills, including the ability to explain complex analytical concepts to diverse audiences.
Strong stakeholder management and collaboration skills.
Ability to influence decisions through data, insights, and fact-based recommendations.
Proactive and detail-oriented, with the ability to manage multiple priorities in a fast-paced and evolving environment.


Physical Requirements And Work Environment

This role requires the ability to perform standard office activities, including extended periods of computer use, participation in virtual and in-person meetings, and collaboration across teams. Depending on business needs, occasional travel may be required. Work environments and physical requirements may vary based on the requirements of the role. Reasonable accommodations may be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform the essential functions of the role.

This job description describes the general nature and level of work performed and is not intended to be an exhaustive list of all responsibilities. Duties and responsibilities may be modified, added, or removed as necessary to meet business and organizational needs.

Compensation

The target base salary range for this role is $90,000-$130,000 per year. This range reflects the anticipated compensation for the role. Where pay falls withing the range may vary based on many factors, including, but not limited to, job responsibilities, skills, experience, education, certifications, location and applicable geographic pay zones, market conditions, internal equity and business considerations. Compensation decisions are made based on an assessment of the candidate’s qualifications and the totality of relevant factors.

In addition to base salary, this role is eligible to participate in an annual short-term incentive program, subject to plan terms and eligibility requirements.

Benefits

Galderma offers a competitive and comprehensive benefits program, including medical, dental, and vision coverage, a 401(k) plan with employer match, paid time off, and other benefits, subject to eligibility and applicable plan terms.

Work Authorization

This role does not offer sponsorship for work authorization. External applicants must be eligible to work in the United States.

What We Offer

At Galderma, you’ll be part of a purpose-driven organization committed to advancing dermatology and improving patient outcomes worldwide. We offer competitive compensation, annual incentive opportunities, and comprehensive benefits, along with meaningful opportunities for growth, development, and collaboration in an inclusive and innovative environment.

Next Steps


If your profile is a match, we will invite you for a first virtual conversation with the recruiter.
The next step is a virtual conversation with the hiring manager
The final step is a panel conversation with the extended team


Don't meet every single requirement? At Galderma, we are dedicated to building a diverse, inclusive, and innovative workplace. If you're excited about this role, but your experience doesn't align perfectly with the qualifications listed, we encourage you to apply anyway!

If you are considering employment at Galderma, review our job postings at www.galderma.com/us/careers. Please be aware of fraudulent job offers and individuals falsely claiming to represent our Human Resources department. Our company will never request or offer payment, personal financial information, or sensitive data (such as Social Security numbers or bank details) during the early stages of recruitment. All legitimate communications from our HR team will come from official company email domains and follow our established hiring process.

Our Data Science & Analytics team has been a force multiplier and accelerant to our business that has helped us reach these pivotal milestones in spite of headwinds and within a highly competitive market. Why You Will (Or Won't) Like Working Here


No slides: If you've worked in consulting, you know what it feels like to be up at 3am reformatting a deck. That doesn't exist here. The only work that gets done at Jerry is work that will materially change the trajectory of our business — an important product, a new growth channel, a key metric, a critical partner relationship, etc.
No corporate fluff: The Data Science & Analytics team is 14 insatiable learners who care deeply about solving difficult problems and making a tangible impact. Every person owns a critical domain. There is no bloat, unnecessary meetings, or waiting for approvals.
Hands-on: This is not a pure strategy role, you will also own execution. Your day-to-day will be surfacing analytical insights, driving decisions, and seeing them through end-to-end.


What You'll Own

You'll sit on our central Data Science & Analytics team but you’ll be embedded in one of Jerry's core business areas — growth, product, AI and automation, strategic partnerships — and own the analytical function for that business unit end-to-end.


Define the right problems: Before any analysis, understand what business question it's answering and what decision it will inform. Push back if the question is flawed.
Data and insights: Define metrics, build reports, run analyses, design experiments, and surface data insights that move your team's key metrics.
Drive outcomes: Bring recommendations to your counterparts in product, growth, finance or operations, tell them what's happening and why, and what next steps should be.


Who You Are


First principles thinker: You break ambiguous problems into clear hypotheses before touching data. You're analytically strong (comfortable with SQL or Python) but your instinct is to ask "what are we trying to solve here?" before jumping to "what should I build?"
Direct communicator: You can walk a skeptical stakeholder through a complex finding and get buy-in quickly. You write clearly, speak precisely, and don't bury the lede.
Owner: You act like your name is on the door. If something is broken, you feel responsible for fixing it, even if it’s outside of your swim lane.


What You'll Bring


2+ years of experience at a consulting firm, investment bank, or high-growth technology company.
Strong analytical skills; ability to pull, structure, and interpret data independently.
Track record of owning ambiguous problems and delivering impact.
Clear, persuasive communicator who can influence decisions at the leadership level.

SQL (Clickhouse), Metabase, Python, Jupyter Hub, GitHub.

Title: Biomedical Data Analyst
Description:
About LifeCanvas Technologies




LifeCanvas Technologies, an MIT spinoff venture, is revolutionizing the way we see and study biological systems. LifeCanvas offers cutting-edge technologies and end-to-end solutions that enable holistic molecular imaging of biological systems, accelerating breakthrough discoveries in science and the development of new therapeutic strategies. As a key partner in this global effort, our computational team works on enabling scientific innovation and directly collaborates with global researchers in bioengineering, neuroscience, and oncology.




Job Summary

We are seeking an ambitious and motivated Biomedical Data Analyst to join our dynamic team. The ideal candidate will have hands-on experience with biomedical data analysis, machine learning, or scientific computing, and a strong interest in building scalable software solutions for both research and industrial applications in a fast-paced start-up environment. In this role, you will support the analysis of large-scale 3D fluorescence microscopy datasets generated by LifeCanvas Technologies. You will work closely with our tissue processing, image acquisition, and Contract Research teams to run analyses, validate outputs, troubleshoot issues, and help generate high-quality quantitative results for internal teams and external scientific partners.




Key Responsibilities:

Run, validate, and troubleshoot analyses for Contract Research projects, ensuring accurate results and timely project completion.
Perform quality control on analysis outputs to validate results.
Collaborate with cross-functional teams to ensure smooth data acquisition, integration, and downstream analysis.
Communicate analytical findings clearly to internal teams and external scientific partners.
Assist with maintaining and improving components of LifeCanvas image-analysis pipelines for large-scale 3D fluorescence microscopy datasets.
Support the development of data engineering workflows, including database management, ETL processes, and handling of large imaging datasets.




Qualifications:

Bachelor’s degree in computer science, bioengineering, computational biology, electrical engineering, or a relevant field.
Experience with image processing for biological and/or biomedical applications
Experience using Python for data science, scientific computing, automation, and image analysis.
Strong problem-solving skills with a self-motivated and detail-oriented mindset and the ability to work in a team environment.
Adaptable and proactive in a fast-paced environment, comfortable working across multiple concurrent projects and evolving requirements.
Excellent communication skills and the ability to work collaboratively with cross-functional teams.




Preferred Qualifications:

Familiarity with light microscopy, neuroscience, and immunohistochemistry
Familiarity with best practices for software engineering.
Exposure to machine learning or deep learning frameworks such as PyTorch or TensorFlow.
Experience in working with data engineering/analysis pipelines.




Benefits:

Competitive salary.
Full insurance package for full-time employees.
Flexible time off.
401(k) benefits.

Title: Operations & Analytics Associate
Description:
Company Overview

KKR is a leading global investment firm that offers alternative asset management as well as capital markets and insurance solutions. KKR aims to generate attractive investment returns by following a patient and disciplined investment approach, employing world-class people, and supporting growth in its portfolio companies and communities. KKR sponsors investment funds that invest in private equity, credit and real assets and has strategic partners that manage hedge funds. KKR’s insurance subsidiaries offer retirement, life and reinsurance products under the management of Global Atlantic Financial Group. References to KKR’s investments may include the activities of its sponsored funds and insurance subsidiaries.

Position Summary

KKR is hiring for an enterprise Data Operations group to collect, manage, and harness the power of data across our diverse business activities. The Data Operations Center of Excellence (CoE) is a cross-functional team dedicated to formulating and driving KKR's enterprise data strategy while also providing the operating leverage required to bring these strategies and frameworks to life.

The Data Operations CoE is seeking to hire an Associate / Senior Analyst to support Analytics efforts across Private Markets and Credit. The candidate will work closely with business stakeholders and technology partners to build analytical models, data products, and lightweight tools that go beyond static reporting, translating complex data into clear, actionable insight for investment and operational decision-makers. This is a hands-on role where the candidate should expect to be writing SQL and Python, building and testing models, and developing tools directly.

The ideal candidate would have the unique combination of strong data analysis and data science skills, genuine comfort building tools and applications, and the interpersonal polish to engage confidently with senior leadership. The candidate should have a passion/interest in private markets and credit investing, an interest in embracing new technologies (AI), strong verbal/written communication skills, and be a good cultural fit with an emphasis on collaboration, excellence, and action-oriented results.

Responsibilities


Design, build, and maintain analytical models, data products, and lightweight tools that support Private Markets and Credit investment teams, going beyond static reporting to surface original, actionable insight
Serve as a key liaison between business stakeholders and technology teams, gathering requirements, defining analytical use cases, and ensuring delivered solutions meet business needs
Write and optimize complex SQL queries and Python-based scripts to extract, transform, model, and analyze data across multiple sources and platforms, ensuring data quality and consistency
Partner closely with data engineering, technology, and operations teams to design and implement scalable data pipelines, integrations, and infrastructure that underpin analytics, modeling, and tool development
Develop domain expertise in private markets and credit data, including deal, portfolio, fund, and investor data, and apply that knowledge to improve data coverage, quality, and analytical depth
Identify opportunities to streamline manual workflows, automate repetitive tasks, and improve the efficiency and reliability of data processes across the team
Explore and apply AI tools, large language models, and emerging technologies to build new analytical capabilities and unlock new insight for the business
Collaborate with team members across offices and time zones in support of these initiatives


Qualifications


4+ years of hands-on experience in data analytics, data science, or a related field, ideally within financial services, private equity, credit, or a comparable institutional environment
Strong proficiency in SQL and Python, with demonstrated ability to independently build data models, analytical pipelines, and tools
Hands-on experience with Snowflake (or equivalent cloud data warehouse) and BI/reporting tools (e.g., Power BI, Sigma, Tableau) as part of a broader analytical toolkit
Demonstrated ability to work in business-facing roles, translating stakeholder needs into analytical frameworks & tools
Excellent verbal and written communication skills, with the ability to distill complex data into insight for both technical and non-technical audiences
Intellectual curiosity and interest in private markets, credit, and alternative investments
Strong cultural fit – collaborative, intellectually curious, action-oriented, and committed to high standards of excellence and accountability
Ability to thrive in a fast-paced environment, with a proactive, self-starter mindset and high attention to detail


Preferred Qualifications


Direct experience in private markets, credit, or alternative investment data and analytics or background in financial services, asset management, or fintech
Experience building internal applications or tools (e.g., Python-based apps, low-code platforms, or AI-assisted development) to deliver data products beyond dashboards
Hands-on experience applying AI, machine learning, or large language models to improve business workflows and data processes
Working understanding of dbt for managing data transformations, building modular analytics pipelines, and maintaining well-tested, version-controlled data models
Experience with version control systems (e.g., Git) and collaborative development workflows


This is the expected annual base salary range for this Boston-based position. Actual salaries may vary based on factors, such as skill, experience, and qualification for the role. Employees may be eligible for a discretionary bonus, based on factors such as individual and team performance.

Base Salary Range

$100,000—$130,000 USD

Title: Data Analytics Specialist
Description:
Job Description Summary

Reporting to the Associate Director of Data Analytics and Insights on the Data Engineering and Operations team, the Data Analytics Specialist supports Bentley University’s enterprise data and analytics ecosystem by translating business needs into well-defined data requirements, building and maintaining trusted reporting and dashboard solutions, and partnering with data engineering and business teams to deliver scalable data products. The role combines business analysis, BI development, data modeling, testing, and hands-on engineering support across the analytics delivery lifecycle. The position may apply statistical, predictive, or machine learning techniques when they are appropriate to the business need, while maintaining a primary focus on reliable data, actionable analysis, and decision-ready reporting.

Essential Duties & Responsibilities

Business Analysis & Data Requirements


Collaborate with business partners, cross-functional teams, and IT units to gather, clarify, and document detailed business, data, and reporting requirements.
Translate business needs into technical specifications, user stories, acceptance criteria, data mappings, semantic model requirements, and analytics deliverables.
Lead or support stakeholder interviews, discovery sessions, process mapping, workflow analysis, and use-case development.
Conduct data discovery and profiling to understand source systems, data structures, data quality, lineage, and end-to-end data movement.
Research and work with the data governance manager to resolve complex questions related to enterprise reporting, data definitions, business rules, and data usage across systems.
Partner with data governance stakeholders to define shared terminology, document data definitions, and promote consistent and responsible data use.


Reporting, Dashboards & BI Development


Analyze, define, design, build, test, deploy, and maintain reports and interactive dashboards across BI platforms, including Power BI and SQL-based outputs.
Develop and maintain semantic models, relationships, calculations, queries, and measures using Power BI, DAX, Power Query (M), and SQL.
Create intuitive data visualizations that communicate insights clearly to technical and non-technical audiences and support data-informed decision-making.
Perform exploratory and statistical analysis to identify trends, patterns, relationships, and actionable insights.
Apply predictive analytics, machine learning, or other advanced analytical methods selectively when they add clear value; evaluate results and communicate limitations appropriately.
Provide dashboard prototyping, iterative refinement, performance optimization, release support, and ongoing maintenance across the full BI development lifecycle.
Provide training, documentation, and ongoing support to report consumers and business users.
Identify opportunities for business process optimization, reporting consolidation, self-service enablement, and data quality improvement.
Support continuous improvement of dashboard standards, naming conventions, documentation expectations, accessibility practices, and BI development best practices.


Data Engineering & Analytics Enablement


Collaborate with data engineers to design, refine, test, and monitor data pipelines and curated datasets that support enterprise analytics.
Develop and maintain data transformations, reusable queries, data models, and analytics-ready structures across structured, semi-structured, and unstructured sources.
Validate data completeness, accuracy, timeliness, and consistency across source systems, pipelines, semantic models, and reports; document and help resolve data quality issues.
Support ETL/ELT workflows, data integration requirements, source-to-target mappings, and troubleshooting of data movement across the Azure data ecosystem.
Contribute to scalable, maintainable analytics solutions through sound development practices, technical documentation, version control, deployment discipline, and monitoring.


System Testing & Project Delivery


Coordinate and perform testing to confirm that documented requirements and quality expectations are met.
Develop test plans, test cases, expected results, reconciliation approaches, and supporting evidence for data and BI solutions.
Manage and facilitate User Acceptance Testing (UAT), track issues through resolution, validate corrections, and obtain end-user approval.
Support project delivery lifecycle activities, including estimation, design review, backlog refinement, documentation, release readiness, and training.
Communicate status, risks, dependencies, decisions, and data issues to project stakeholders and delivery partners.
Balance multiple concurrent priorities while meeting agreed-upon delivery commitments and maintaining solution quality.


Documentation, Governance & Continuous Improvement


Create and maintain business requirements documents, technical requirements documents, data dictionaries, process flows, source-to-target mappings, test documentation, release notes, and user guides.
Ensure solutions align with confidentiality, privacy, security, accessibility, and data governance expectations.
Provide recommendations and actionable insights based on analytical findings and assist in the development of data-informed strategies and initiatives.
Stay current on developments in business intelligence, data engineering, analytics, artificial intelligence, and responsible data practices; recommend practical improvements when appropriate.


Minimum Qualifications


Bachelor’s degree in data analytics, information systems, computer science, statistics, mathematics, economics, or a related field.
Two or more years of progressive experience in data analytics, business systems analysis, enterprise reporting, business intelligence, or a related discipline.
Demonstrated expertise in requirements-gathering methodologies, including stakeholder interviews, process mapping, use-case development, and workflow analysis, and in translating business requirements into detailed technical specifications for reporting, dashboards, data models, and data solutions.
Two or more years of hands-on experience with Power BI or other similar tools, including data modeling, DAX, Power Query (M), semantic model design, dashboard prototyping, iteration, deployment, and ongoing optimization across the full BI development lifecycle.
Two or more years of experience with data modeling and the design of efficient, analytics-ready data structures.
Proficiency with SQL and experience extracting, transforming, validating, and analyzing structured and semi-structured data; familiarity with unstructured data is beneficial.
Strong understanding of data warehousing concepts, relational and dimensional data models, ETL/ELT frameworks, and cloud data platform concepts, preferably within the Azure ecosystem, such as Data Lake, Synapse, Fabric, or comparable technologies.
Proven experience collaborating with data engineering teams to refine data pipelines, validate data quality, support data governance, troubleshoot data flow issues, and deliver scalable analytics solutions.
Experience planning and executing system, data, integration, and User Acceptance Testing, including issue tracking and resolution validation.
Ability to create high-quality business and technical requirements, data dictionaries, process documentation, test plans, source-to-target mappings, and user guides, with strong attention to detail and version control.
Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, with the ability to transform complex datasets into clear findings and actionable insights for technical and non-technical audiences.
Excellent communication, facilitation, and collaboration skills, with the ability to lead cross-functional discovery sessions, build alignment, and support decision-making.
Ability to manage multiple projects and priorities, work independently and collaboratively, and adapt in a dynamic environment.


Preferred Qualifications


Experience in higher education and familiarity with academic or administrative data domains.
Experience with Python or R for data preparation, automation, statistical analysis, or selective advanced analytics use cases.
Experience with Azure data services, Microsoft Fabric, data lakehouse or warehouse platforms, Git-based version control, and deployment workflows.
Familiarity with data privacy, security, governance, and compliance requirements associated with institutional or student data.
Experience applying predictive analytics or machine learning techniques to well-defined business problems, including evaluation and communication of model limitations.
Relevant certifications in Power BI, Microsoft Fabric, Azure, data engineering, data analytics, or related technologies.


Work Environment


This position requires working on-site several days a month and is not available as a fully remote role.
Typical office setting with extensive computer-based work.
May require occasional travel across campus for meetings and other work-related events.


Pay Transparency

At Bentley we offer a “total rewards” package designed to attract, motivate, retain, and reward our employees. This includes competitive compensation, robust benefits, career development and opportunities, generous paid time off, workplace flexibility and a positive, engaging employee experience. In alignment with the Massachusetts Pay Transparency Act and our commitment to equity and transparency, we’re sharing the salary grade range for this role. The grade range is based on market data and the scope of responsibilities. Final pay will depend on your experience, education, and other relevant qualifications.

Salary Grade Range

Do strategic analytics excite you?

Join our team

Partner with the best

Automating reporting and enabling self-serve functionalities to provide visibility into key metrics

Communicating insights to stakeholders through visualizations and reports


Do What You Love

Have 5 years of relevant experience in business intelligence, data engineering, or data analytics and a Bachelor's degree or its equivalent
Possess solid working knowledge of SQL with experience querying and analyzing large datasets
Be proficient in Excel and/or Google Sheets for basic analysis and QA tasks and have experience with data and system integrations
Be knowledgeable about creating dashboards in data visualization tools, like Tableau
Have experience using AI Developer tools, like Copilot or Claude, in your day-to-day operations
Demonstrate solid communication skills to translate requirements and share findings with technical and non-technical stakeholders
Have some experience with cloud data warehouses (e.g., Snowflake, BigQuery, Redshift) or willingness to learn

Title: Senior Marketing Data Analyst
Description:
About Datalily

At Datalily, we bring data stories to life through strategic market research and powerful content campaigns. Leading B2B SaaS brands like HubSpot, DoorDash, and Klaviyo rely on our expertise and the content we create to engage key audiences and drive their businesses forward.




We're a small team of hardworking creatives and data scientists who pride ourselves on delivering exceptional content campaigns and becoming key members of our client partners' marketing teams.

We're women-owned and led, and committed to supporting talented individuals in growing their skills and becoming part of our leadership team.




About the role

The Senior Marketing Data Analyst will help us conduct quantitative and qualitative research and tell compelling stories for our clients to position them as thought leaders and experts in their industries. You’ll be responsible for the entire market research process, from survey design, to survey administration or data collection, to data analysis, to marketing-ready insights. 




We’re looking for a curious person who enjoys finding the story in large datasets, feels comfortable pulling cross-tabs and digging into data to see what’s most compelling, and who knows how to build a narrative with data visualizations. 




You’ll also have the opportunity to help us build and grow Flowerplot, our own data analysis and visualization platform for data storytelling.




The ideal candidate will be skilled in market research and data analysis and understand marketing objectives and goals, particularly in the B2B SaaS space. You will be part of a fast-growing startup team and have the opportunity to shape the future of our business.




Location: Hybrid role based in Framingham, MA (2-3 days per week in our office)




Key responsibilities

Survey design: Write and design quantitative and qualitative surveys for various audiences (professionals and consumers), including choosing question types, implementing logic, and ensuring the survey meets the client’s needs, prevents bias, yields statistically meaningful results, and aligns with the goals for the research.
Survey administration and management: Manage end-to-end survey execution across panel providers (Centiment, Pollfish, Alchemer, CleverX, QuestionPro, and others). Upload the survey to our data partners’ survey platforms, launch the survey, review soft launch results, and retrieve the data for analysis. Conduct interviews or focus groups where needed.
Data manipulation and cleanup: Clean and validate raw survey exports, detect outliers, remove low-quality responses, and reshape datasets for analysis.
Survey data analysis: Using CSVs or XLSX files, extract key insights and data visualizations using either pivot tables or our own data analysis platform, maintaining high data quality standards. Translate complex findings into plain-language key takeaways for non-technical clients and content teams.
Raw data analysis: Retrieve and manipulate data from client dashboards and data warehouses to create visualizations and pull insights for the content marketing team.
Client communication and project management: Manage timelines and deliverables, and communicate professionally with clients throughout the project.
Ideation and brainstorming: Come up with ideas for new research projects, working with content marketing and PR/media teams to suggest topics based on industry research gaps and opportunities.
Content support: Support the creation and editing of various thought leadership assets (blog posts, executive bylines, reports, articles) by ensuring data accuracy and strategic alignment.




Qualifications

Required:

Market research experience: 3–6+ years of experience in market research, survey research. Able to extract clear, compelling narratives from data. 
Survey design and management proficiency: Proven ability to design and execute quantitative surveys from scratch, including questionnaire writing, sampling strategy, and field management.
Data analysis experience: Strong proficiency in data cleaning, analysis, and visualization.
B2B SaaS marketing experience: Proven track record pulling insights for B2B SaaS marketing teams, with deep understanding of the industry and team needs.
Project management capabilities: Experience managing 10+ concurrent projects with competing deadlines while maintaining quality standards.
Client-facing communication: Strong presentation and communication skills with experience managing client relationships and expectations.




Preferred:

Familiarity with statistical methods beyond basic cross-tabs: regression, clustering, MaxDiff, conjoint, or similar
Exposure to data visualization tools (Flourish, Datawrapper, or similar)
Background or coursework in quantitative social science, behavioral economics, or a related field




Personal attributes:

Critical thinker: Questions assumptions, identifies gaps in logic, and brings fresh perspectives to client challenges rather than defaulting to generic marketing advice
Self-directed: Takes ownership of projects from strategy through execution with minimal hand-holding; proactively identifies problems and solutions
Detail-oriented: Maintains high standards for accuracy, especially with data citations, statistics, and factual claims
Collaborative: Works well with strategists, designers, and writers to bring campaigns to life; receptive to feedback and contributes to team improvement
Adaptable: Quickly learns new industries, products, and brand voices; comfortable pivoting based on client needs or market changes
Continuous learner: Stays current on marketing research trends, AI's impact on the industry, and evolving best practices; always looking for ways to improve processes
Authentic voice: Values human-crafted narratives over exclusively AI-generated material




Compensation & benefitsSalary Range: $120,000-$130,000 annually, commensurate with experience




Benefits:

Hybrid work model: 2-3 days per week in our Framingham, MA office, 2-3 days per week remote
Open and transparent company culture with direct access to leadership
Generous paid vacation time
Paid US federal holidays
401(k) retirement plan with competitive company matching
Annual bonus
Company laptop
Comprehensive medical, dental, and vision insurance
Professional development opportunities
Collaborative, supportive team environment




Equal Employment Opportunity

Datalily is an equal opportunity employer committed to building a diverse and inclusive team. We welcome applications from candidates of all backgrounds and do not discriminate on the basis of race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, age, disability, veteran status, or any other legally protected characteristic. We encourage women, people of color, LGBTQ+ individuals, and members of other underrepresented communities to apply.




How to apply

Please submit your resume, portfolio or work samples, and a brief cover letter explaining your interest in the role and relevant experience to hello@datalily.com. We look forward to hearing from you!

Title: Business Analyst II (Commercial, Wholesale)
Description:
At WHOOP, we're on a mission to unlock and inspire performance for life.

WHOOP is hiring an Analyst II to join the Commercial Analytics team, with a primary focus on supporting our growing omni-channel business. In this role, you will own reporting and analysis that help explain performance across retail partners, products, and markets, partnering directly with commercial stakeholders to identify opportunities for growth and inform decision-making. You will also contribute to cross-functional analyses spanning Wholesale, Digital Commerce, and Marketing, connecting channel-level insights to the broader commercial picture.

This role is based in the WHOOP office located in Boston, MA. The successful candidate must be prepared to relocate if necessary to work out of the Boston, MA office.

Responsibilities


Own recurring reporting and analysis of wholesale performance across partners, products, and regions, including the metric definitions that support consistent and trusted decision-making.
Analyze retailer and partner performance, including sell-through trends, inventory position, pricing, and promotions, proactively surfacing trends, risks, and growth opportunities to commercial stakeholders.
Develop and maintain the datasets and data models that power wholesale reporting, validating data against source systems and resolving discrepancies to ensure accuracy and reliability.
Lead analyses end to end, from framing business questions with stakeholders and identifying the right analytical approach to translating findings into clear recommendations.
Contribute to cross-functional analyses spanning Wholesale, Digital Commerce, and Marketing, bringing the wholesale perspective and connecting channel performance to broader commercial trends.
Build and improve dashboards and automated reporting that reduce manual analysis, increase visibility into business performance, and enable stakeholders to access recurring insights independently.


Qualifications


Bachelor's degree in Statistics, Economics, Business, Data Science, Mathematics, or a related quantitative field, or equivalent relevant experience.
2+ years of experience in business analytics or a similar analytical role; experience with retail, wholesale, e-commerce, consumer products, or related commercial data is a plus.
Strong SQL skills, including experience working with large transactional datasets and translating business questions into rigorous analyses and actionable insights.
Experience building and maintaining dashboards and reporting using business intelligence tools such as Sigma or similar platforms.
Demonstrated ability to distill complex data into clear, actionable insights and communicate findings effectively to both technical and non-technical stakeholders.
Self-starting and collaborative approach, with the ability to independently drive analytical work in a fast-moving environment.
High attention to detail and a commitment to producing accurate, reliable, and trusted analysis.
Strong commitment to embracing and leveraging AI tools in day-to-day tasks, ensuring AI-assisted work aligns with the same high-quality standards as personal contributions.


This role is based in the WHOOP office located in Boston, MA. The successful candidate must be prepared to relocate if necessary to work out of the Boston, MA office.

Interested in the role, but don’t meet every qualification? We encourage you to still apply! At WHOOP, we believe there is much more to a candidate than what is written on paper, and we value character as much as experience. As we continue to build a diverse and inclusive environment, we encourage anyone who is interested in this role to apply.

WHOOP is an Equal Opportunity Employer and participates in E-verify to determine employment eligibility

The WHOOP compensation philosophy is designed to attract, motivate, and retain exceptional talent by offering competitive base salaries, meaningful equity, and consistent pay practices that reflect our mission and core values.

At WHOOP, we view total compensation as the combination of base salary, equity, and benefits, with equity serving as a key differentiator that aligns our employees with the long-term success of the company and allows every member of our corporate team to own part of WHOOP and share in the company’s long-term growth and success.

The U.S. base salary range for this full-time position is $100,000 - $125,000. Salary ranges are determined by role, level, and location. Within each range, individual pay is based on factors such as job-related skills, experience, performance, and relevant education or training.

In addition to the base salary, the successful candidate will also receive benefits and a generous equity package.

These ranges may be modified in the future to reflect evolving market conditions and organizational needs. While most offers will typically fall toward the starting point of the range, total compensation will depend on the candidate’s specific qualifications, expertise, and alignment with the role’s requirements.

Title: Data Analyst
Description:
This position can be based in the Washington D.C or Chicago, IL office.




Position Summary

NAR is seeking a Data Analyst to help deliver data-driven insights, analytics solutions, and AI-enabled products that support decision-making across the organization. This role focuses on working directly with business stakeholders to understand analytical requirements, transform complex and fragmented data into actionable information, and build scalable solutions that provide measurable business value.




The Data Analyst will design and implement data preparation processes, perform advanced analysis, and develop applications and visualizations. They will make data and analysis accessible to non-technical audiences. The role works extensively within the Microsoft Azure and Microsoft Fabric ecosystems and involves close collaboration with data scientists, and business stakeholders in different parts of the organization.




The successful candidate will contribute to data quality initiatives, AI-assisted analytics workflows, and the development of new solutions that leverage both traditional analytics and AI technologies. The ideal candidate is comfortable working across analytics, visualization, and application development disciplines, with a practical focus on delivering solutions that are reliable, scalable, and widely adopted by the business.




Duties And Responsibilities

Partner with business stakeholders and non-technical teams to gather requirements, identify opportunities, and deliver data-driven solutions
Extract, transform, clean, and validate data from multiple internal and external sources to support analytics, reporting, and operational decision-making
Develop and maintain Python notebooks using SQL, Spark, and related technologies for data analysis, exploration, and reporting
Create dashboards that effectively communicate insights to business audiences using technologies such as Power BI, Streamlit, Django, and other frameworks
Collaborate with Data Scientists on data quality initiatives, statistical analyses, AI-assisted testing frameworks, and machine learning-related projects
Participate in source control, deployment, and project management processes using tools such as Git and Jira
Other duties, as assigned




Qualifications

Bachelor's degree in Computer Science or a closely related field.
Minimum of 2+ years of professional experience in data analytics or a related technical role.
Strong proficiency in SQL, including experience writing complex queries.
Strong Python development skills, including working with notebooks, expertise with data analysis libraries (e.g., Pandas, NumPy, SciPy), and use of visualization libraries (e.g., Plotly, Matplotlib).
Experience building dashboards using tools such as Power BI, Streamlit, or Django.
Experience working with cloud-based platforms and services; Microsoft Azure and Microsoft Fabric experience preferred.
Use of Git and use of project management systems such as Jira.
Good grasp of basic statistical concepts.
Ability to communicate complex technical concepts clearly and effectively to non-technical audiences.
Ability to work independently with minimal supervision while managing multiple priorities and deadlines.
Experience with AI, such as the use of AI-code generation, is a positive.
Advanced Microsoft Excel skills for data analysis and reporting are preferred




Compensation: $75,000 - $95,000 depending on office location

NAR provides comprehensive benefits including health/dental/vision insurance.

NAR is on a hybrid schedule and in the office 3 days a week.

Title: Senior Data Analyst
Description:
About Clutch

Clutch is Canada's largest online used car retailer, delivering a seamless, hassle-free car-buying experience to drivers everywhere. Customers can browse hundreds of cars from the comfort of their home, get the right one delivered to their door, and enjoy peace of mind with our 10-Day Money-Back Guarantee… and that's just the beginning.

Named one of Canada's top growing Companies two years in a row and also awarded a spot on LinkedIn's Top Canadian Startups list, we're looking to add curious, hard-working, and driven individuals to our growing team.

Headquartered in Toronto, Clutch was founded in 2017. Clutch is backed by a number of world-class investors, including Canaan, BrandProject, Real Ventures, D1 Capital, and Upper90. To learn more, visit clutch.ca.

About The Role

At Clutch, we believe advances in AI are fundamentally changing how great products are built. Traditional handoffs between product, design, and engineering are giving way to smaller, faster teams where builders can take ideas from concept to production in days instead of months.

As a Senior Data Analyst, you'll join our data team and take on some of the most important and complex questions facing the business. That means understanding how we buy and price vehicles, how customers move through our funnel, how we recondition and deliver cars, and how customers finance their purchases. You'll be the person leaders turn to when they need to know what's really happening and what to do about it.

This is a role for someone who thrives on ownership. You'll scope ambiguous problems, build the data models and pipelines needed to answer them, and turn your findings into clear recommendations that drive decisions. If you're energized by messy, high-stakes problems and want to bring modern engineering practices (including AI-powered tooling) into your analytics workflow, you'll thrive at Clutch.

What You'll Do


Own deep-dive analyses on Clutch's highest-priority problems across acquisitions, inventory, retail conversion, operations, and financing.
Build models and frameworks to size opportunities, forecast outcomes, and evaluate trade-offs before decisions are made.
Define and own core business metrics so teams across Clutch work from a single source of truth.
Design and analyze experiments to measure the impact of product, marketing, and operational changes.
Build, maintain, and improve the production dashboards and data models that stakeholders rely on every day.
Build reliable, well-tested, production-ready pipelines using tools like dbt, Airflow, and Snowflake, in partnership with data engineering.
Partner with stakeholders across Marketing, Product, Operations, and Finance to translate business questions into clear, trustworthy analysis.
Use AI tooling as part of your everyday workflow to accelerate analysis, pipeline development, and iteration.
Communicate findings and recommendations clearly to both technical and non-technical audiences, including senior leadership.
Own your projects end-to-end, from scoping through delivery.
Contribute to data documentation and governance practices as our data infrastructure matures.


What We're Looking For

Must Haves


5+ years of experience in data analytics, analytics engineering, or a closely related field (6–7 years is ideal).
Strong SQL expertise, with comfort working across large or complex datasets.
A track record of analysis that changed business decisions, not just reporting on them.
Ability to take a vague business question, structure it, and deliver a clear recommendation.
Solid grounding in statistics and experimentation.
Hands-on experience with a BI tool, such as Tableau or Power BI.
A proven ability to explain technical concepts clearly to non-technical stakeholders.
A track record of owning and delivering projects end-to-end, ideally with some project management experience.
A collaborative, energetic communicator who works well within a close-knit team.


Nice to Have


Experience in e-commerce, marketplaces, automotive, or financial services.
Experience with dbt, Airflow, and Snowflake.
Python or another coding language.
Experience integrating AI tools into your day-to-day workflow.


Why You'll Love It At Clutch


Autonomy & ownership: the opportunity to build your process and influence the company at every level.
Help shape the future of car buying and selling in Canada by tackling the problems that matter most to the business.
Broad and direct ownership over data analytics during a phase of rapid growth.
We are dedicated to attracting and retaining top talent with top-of-market compensation packages.
Above market health & dental benefits.


Employment Type


New, Permanent Full-Time
Hybrid, Downtown Toronto three days a week


Compensation & Benefits


Salary range: $100,000 - $125,000
Benefits: Comprehensive benefits plans include healthcare, dental care, vision care, prescriptions, life insurance and dependent coverage; start from day 1. (Applicable for Permanent Full-Time)
Pay decisions reflect objective criteria: skills, performance, market benchmarking, responsibilities and working conditions.

Title: Data Analyst (Nutricia + Kate Farms)
Description:
About The Job

Job Summary

The Data Analyst on the Enterprise Data Intelligence team turns data from across North America Medical Nutrition into trusted, actionable insights. In this role, you will partner with Commercial, Supply Chain, Finance, Marketing, Patient Services, and Medical/Regulatory teams to build reporting, analyze performance, and answer business questions that shape decisions. You will help make data accessible, consistent, and easier to use across the organization.

Key Responsibilities

As a key member of our team, you will play an important role in driving our mission forward. The following responsibilities outline the core expectations and contributions for this position


Develop, maintain, and enhance dashboards and reports in tools such as Power BI or Tableau, giving stakeholders clear visibility into sales, demand, patient and channel trends, and operational performance.
Analyze large, multi-source datasets, including sales, claims, syndicated, CRM, supply chain, and patient services data, to identify trends, drivers, risks, and opportunities.
Translate business questions into clear analytical requirements and communicate findings in concise, non-technical language.
Write and optimize SQL queries to extract, transform, and validate data from enterprise data platforms such as Snowflake or Databricks.
Partner with data engineers and data stewards to improve data pipelines, data models, and data quality.
Perform data validation, reconciliation, and root-cause analysis to improve accuracy and consistency across reports.
Support data governance practices, including metric definitions, documentation, data lineage, and a single source of truth for key performance indicators.
Handle sensitive data responsibly and follow applicable privacy, security, and compliance requirements.
Support ad hoc analysis and executive requests, prioritizing work based on business impact and urgency.
Identify opportunities to automate manual reporting and contribute to team documentation, best practices, and continuous improvement.


Physical Demands & Work Environment


This role is primarily performed in a remote office setting and requires the ability to remain in a stationary position (e.g., seated or standing) for extended periods.
The employee may be required to travel to Danone corporate offices as needed.


The salary range for this position is $76,000-133,000K USD. The exact salary offered will depend on several factors, including the candidate’s relevant experience, geographic location, internal equity, and market conditions. Danone USA additionally offers a performance-based bonus and has a strong benefits package including Medical, Dental, Vision, Prescription Drug Coverage, 401k Plan, Wellness Program, Life Insurance, Tuition Reimbursement, Flexible Time Off, and Paid Parental Bonding Leave, among other benefit plan options. To give our employees flexibility, Danone is a hybrid work environment.

About You

The ideal candidate will bring a combination of education, experience, and skills that enable them to excel in this position. The following qualifications outline what we’re looking for, including both required and preferred criteria

Education & Experience


Bachelor’s degree in Data Science, Statistics, Mathematics, Economics, Business Analytics, Information Systems, or related field/equivalent experience.
2–4 years of experience in a data analyst, business intelligence, or analytics role.
Experience in healthcare, pharmaceutical, medical nutrition, consumer packaged goods, or another regulated industry is preferred.
Experience with healthcare or commercial data sources, such as claims, syndicated data, CRM, specialty pharmacy, or distributor data, is preferred.


Knowledge, Skills & Abilities


Strong SQL skills, including joins, window functions, data validation, and query optimization.
Hands-on experience with a business intelligence or visualization tool such as Power BI or Tableau.
Experience with cloud data platforms such as Snowflake, Databricks, or a comparable platform.
Strong analytical and problem-solving skills with close attention to detail.
Ability to explain complex findings clearly to technical and non-technical audiences.
Ability to manage multiple priorities and work effectively with cross-functional partners.
Working knowledge of Python or R for analysis and automation is preferred.
Understanding data modeling, ETL/ELT concepts, data governance, and advanced Excel is preferred.
Demonstrates curiosity and ownership, business partnership, collaboration, clear communication, and integrity with data.


About us

Danone North America Medical Nutrition brings together a growing portfolio of mission-driven brands, including Kate Farms, Nutricia, Neocate, Pepticate, Functional Formularies, and Real Food Blends. Together, we deliver science-backed nutrition solutions for infants, children, and adults with complex nutritional needs, whether they consume nutrition orally or through a feeding tube.

Our ambition is clear to improve health outcomes, expand access to high-quality nutrition, help reduce healthcare costs, and build sustainable growth. We combine trusted, consumer-loved brands with strong scientific and medical expertise to create nutrition solutions that make a meaningful difference in people’s lives.

By joining our approximately 450-person North America Medical Nutrition organization, you will become part of Danone’s broader North American and global network. You will have the opportunity to contribute to a growing business, collaborate across brands and functions, and help shape the future of medical nutrition in the US.

You will also join one of the world’s largest Certified B Corporations, working for a company committed to creating lasting value for people and the planet.

It is our policy to give equal employment opportunities to all qualified persons without regard to legally protected characteristics, or any other consideration made unlawful by applicable federal, state/provincial and/or local law. Title: Senior Data Analyst, GTM Operations
Description:
7shifts is an HR platform designed to help restaurant teams thrive. With an easy-to-use app and industry-specific solutions, 7shifts saves time, reduces errors, and helps keep costs in check for over 55,000 restaurants. Our mission is to simplify team management and improve performance for restaurants, with a long-term vision of creating a thriving restaurant industry through the power of connected & engaged teams.

As the Senior Data Analyst at 7shifts, you’ll be the analytical partner to our Go-to-Market and Finance teams. Reporting to our Manager, Data & Analytics, you’ll work alongside analysts, data engineers, and analytics engineers, partnering closely with GTM Operations and Finance. Your role is to ensure the teams driving revenue and managing our finances have data they can trust and the insight to act on it. Most of your time will go toward strategic projects that improve how GTM and Finance operate - reducing manual work, creating clearer definitions, and making it faster to get answers. You’ll also build and maintain the data assets these teams rely on and help them self-serve, so simple questions don’t become tickets. You’re a consultant to the business, not a request queue: you bring the context, recommend the approach, and drive cross-functional work forward.

What You'll Do


Own GTM and Finance analytics end-to-end, from scoping the question to pulling data from Snowflake, Stripe, Salesforce, and FinQore, and landing on a recommendation leaders can act on
Lead strategic projects that improve how GTM and Finance operate, coordinating across analysts, engineers, and business partners
Build and maintain the dashboards, reports, and metric definitions teams rely on as a source of truth, ensuring data stays consistent across the company
Enable self-serve by making data and tooling easier for GTM and Finance to use independently
Use AI as part of your daily workflow to accelerate analysis, leverage the semantic layer for faster insights, and find new ways to make the team more efficient
Mentor teammates and contribute to shared standards for how the team scopes, builds, and validates its work
Help shape the analytics roadmap by bringing GTM and Finance needs back to the Data team


What You Bring


5+ years in data analytics or business intelligence, with strong experience in financial or go-to-market reporting
Experience owning complex, ambiguous analysis end to end and translating it into business decisions
Strong SQL in a modern warehouse (Snowflake or equivalent) and comfort with a BI tool (ThoughtSpot or equivalent); able to work across multiple systems and learn new ones quickly
Experience working with the systems behind the numbers, such as Stripe, Salesforce, FinQore, or equivalent platforms
Fluency in SaaS metrics like ARR, retention, and pipeline, with the judgment to connect analysis to revenue, cost, and operating outcomes
Active use of AI in analytical work, with a clear understanding of where it adds value and where its output needs to be checked
Strong cross-functional skills and the ability to influence decisions without owning them; people come to you for the recommendation, not just the query
Experience mentoring other analysts on analytical methods, SQL, or AI, formally or informally


It'd be even cooler if you had


Experience building AI agents or enabling AI adoption at a previous company
Experience in the restaurant or hospitality industry
An interest in growing into people leadership


Our Commitment To Our Shifties


Opportunity: Our product is evolving in exciting ways, and we’re focused on delivering even more value to restaurants. This momentum creates real opportunities to learn and grow. Whether you’re honing your craft or exploring new paths, you’ll be supported and empowered to own your growth and impact a product shaping the future of the restaurant industry.
Challenge: We’re tackling real problems in a fast-moving, complex industry. The work is scrappy and ambiguous, but meaningful. You’ll think critically, act with intention, and shape solutions that make a real difference for restaurant teams.
Culture: We’re proud to be recognized among the best workplaces in North America. Guided by our mission and values, we move fast to solve meaningful problems and celebrate wins together. Whether through in-office and remote events, team offsites like Sparks, or everyday moments of connection, we create space for shared growth, collaboration, and fun.
Equity: We’re a Series C, VC-backed SaaS company, and we believe everyone should share in the success they help create. When we build together, we grow together.
Health and Wellness: We support Shifties in and outside of work, knowing that what people need can change over time. From day one, you’ll have access to benefits like health and dental, lifestyle spending accounts to a parental leave program built with flexibility in mind, to help you bring your best self to work.
Flexibility: Our team is intentional around how and where we work, whether remotely, in person, or a mix of both. We prioritize candidates who thrive in a hybrid work environment with offices in Saskatoon and Toronto, ensuring in-person collaboration and connection when possible. Plus, we offer a flexible vacation policy to encourage everyone to recharge when needed. Oh, and our ‘90 Day Shift’ program lets Shift work from (almost) anywhere because who wouldn’t want to trade their desk for a beach view once in a while?
Support: We set Shifties up for success with the tools they need, like the latest Apple tech, a home office setup, and some 7shifts swag to make it official. But support goes beyond day one. We’re serious about professional growth, offering coaching, feedback, development planning, and opportunities to grow from within.


We know you might not check every box, and that’s okay. If you’re excited about this role, inspired to contribute to a meaningful product, and eager to share ideas that drive real change, we’d love to hear from you. We’re building an inclusive team that reflects the diverse industry we serve, and we welcome applicants from all backgrounds.

We thank you for your interest in joining the 7shifts team!

Our privacy policy can be found here.

Compensation Range: CA$100K - CA$150K

Connect. Grow. Thrive Together.

A critical part of this role is protecting and strengthening our core data offerings. You will also contribute to revenue growth by supporting custom data solutions, enabling product initiatives, and providing analytical input into new data-driven offerings.




What You’ll Be Doing




This role focuses on analysis, data delivery, mentorship, and stakeholder collaboration across both ongoing operations and new initiatives. You will…

Analyze data to generate insights that support product, client, and business decisions
Translate business needs into analytical approaches (requirements, use cases, impacts)
Design and deliver data solutions (queries, datasets, reports - recurring and ad hoc)
Own outputs end-to-end, ensuring accuracy, quality, and usability
Maintain and improve recurring data deliverables, protecting core revenue streams
Partner with Product and Sales on custom data solutions, business cases, and new offerings
Support research and analysis that informs product strategy and market insights
Collaborate across Product, Sales, Technology, and clients to align on priorities and outcomes
Communicate insights clearly through presentations, dashboards, and reports
Improve and optimize workflows using modern tools, automation, and AI-assisted approaches
Provide ongoing guidance, mentorship, and quality oversight to junior team members, helping elevate team output and consistency




About You




You are an experienced analyst who brings together strong technical skills, sound business judgment, and clear communication.




Technical Qualifications:

Bachelor’s degree in quantitative fields (E.g., Statistics, Mathematics, Computer Science, Engineering)
5+ years of experience in data, analytics, or business/data roles
Experience working with both business and technical stakeholders
Strong proficiency in SQL, Python, and Excel is required.
Experience with visualization tools (Tableau, Power BI)
Experience working with large datasets and data modelling
Familiarity with modern data platforms and tools
Experience using automation or AI-assisted tools to improve workflows, efficiency, and output quality
Understanding of real estate and mortgage lending data, land registration concepts, and property-related datasets is considered an asset.
Knowledge of GIS concepts and experience using spatial analysis tools such as ArcGIS is considered an asset.

Strong analytical thinking across data, business, and product problems
Ability to break down problems, gather requirements, and assess impacts
Hands-on experience delivering end-to-end data solutions
Clear communication of insights and recommendations
Ability to manage priorities and deliver high-quality work independently
Strong problem-solving and critical thinking, with a solution-oriented mindset
Demonstrates ownership, accountability, and initiative in driving outcomes
A natural inclination to mentor and support others, taking responsibility for team quality and development without needing direction
Curiosity and willingness to explore and adopt new tools and approaches, including AI-assisted capabilities.




What Success Looks Like




You bring clarity and structure to complex problems
You ask the right questions and help refine requirements
You deliver high-quality, reliable outputs that are clear, accurate, and ready for use
You maintain momentum and alignment across stakeholders
You translate data into clear, actionable insights
You build trust with both internal teams and clients
You take ownership of recurring and ad hoc data deliverables, ensuring consistency and continuous improvement
You actively support and mentor junior team members, helping raise the quality and consistency of team outputs
You are proactive and self-directed, taking initiative to move work forward without needing close guidance or constant follow-up
You are comfortable taking ownership of problems and moving them forward, even when there isn’t a clearly defined path and the work involves ambiguity




Let’s Talk Pay




We believe in being upfront about pay and helping you make informed decisions about your career. The annual pay range for this role is $106,040 - $114,400 CAD, inclusive of base salary and target incentive pay. We understand that great talent comes in many forms, each with unique skills, experience, and potential. Your salary will be tailored to reflect the experience you bring and the impact you’re ready to have on this role.




At Teranet, we also know that compensation extends far beyond a pay cheque. Along with your cash compensation, we offer a comprehensive package which includes the following:




100% Employer Paid Health Benefit Plan
Employer Matching Retirement Savings Plan
Paid Vacation, Floater Days & Sick Leaves
Maternity, Parental and/or Adoption Leave Top-Up Programs
Corporate Discounts & GoodLife Group Rate Membership
Employee Assistance Program – for you and your loved ones!




Our Human Approach to Hiring




At Teranet, we use smart technology to make hiring faster and more efficient. Artificial Intelligence (AI) tools help us review applications and identify strong matches—but the real decisions? Those are made by our awesome people.




Every interaction you’ll have, and every decision we make, is led by humans. AI may support us, but it’s human connection that drives every hire.




At Teranet, we are committed to fostering an inclusive, accessible environment, where all employees and customers feel valued, respected, and supported. We are dedicated to building a workforce that reflects the diversity of our customers and the communities in which we live and serve. If you require accommodation during the recruitment and selection process, please let us know and we will work with you to meet your needs.

Title: Senior Data Analyst
Description:
Welcome!

‎

We are seeking a highly skilled Senior Data Analyst with at least 2 years of hands‑on analytics experience supported by a Master’s degree in Analytics, Data Science, Statistics, or a related quantitative discipline to join our team.

This role sits at the intersection of data, strategy, and business performance. The Senior Analyst will partner closely with business leaders to interpret data, track performance, and tell clear stories that support strategic decision-making.

The ideal candidate can analyze complex business problems, identify meaningful trends and performance drivers, and translate analytical findings into practical recommendations that support business decision-making.

‎

Key Responsibilities

Advanced Analytics (~60% of Time)


Strategy & Insight Generation: Apply advanced analytical methodologies to evaluate business performance, identify risks and opportunities, uncover root causes, and provide actionable recommendations that support operational and strategic objectives.
Business Consulting & Strategic Partnership: Partner with business leaders to define key business questions, evaluate strategic initiatives, and prioritize analytical opportunities.
Data Discovery & Innovation: Evaluate and recommend enhancements to data assets, metrics, and analytical capabilities that strengthen business insights, decision-making, and organizational performance.
Analytics Enablement: Define KPI frameworks, reporting requirements, and dashboard design to enable consistent, data-driven decision-making.
Analytical Review & Validation: Apply a high level of attention to detail to evaluate analytical outputs, identify discrepancies, validate data integrity, assess calculation logic, and recommend corrective actions to improve reliability.


Communication & Influence (~40% of Time)


Communication & Storytelling: Develop compelling presentations, reports, and narrative documents that translate complex analytical results and model outputs into clear, actionable business stories for diverse audiences from frontline teams to executive leadership.
Organizational Influence: Drive adoption of data-driven decision-making across the organization, advocating for best practices in model consumption, insights application, and analytical rigor.
Collaboration: Work closely with the Data Operations team to translate business needs into reporting solutions, providing guidance on metric definitions, data requirements, dashboard functionality, and user adoption.


Technical Skills


Advanced proficiency in SQL for data querying, transformation, and manipulation.
Proficiency in Python for data analysis.
Proficiency in Excel and PowerBI for reporting/visualization.
Experience with Databricks or similar distributed computing/cloud platform.


Analytical Skills


Deep expertise in statistical analysis, trend and variance analysis, segmentation, and translating data into actionable business recommendations.


Communication


Excellent verbal and written communication skills with the ability to present complex data and model concepts clearly to executive leadership.


Meticulousness


Ability to thoroughly validate data, analyses, and reporting outputs; identify discrepancies and gaps; and ensure accurate, reliable business insights.


Stakeholder Management


Demonstrated ability to manage relationships with multiple stakeholders, navigate competing priorities, and align analytical work to business objectives.


‎


Minimum Experience: 4+ years of professional experience in advanced data analysis, machine learning, or a related analytics role.
Minimum Education: Master's Degree in Data Science, Analytics, Statistics, or a related quantitative field required.

Bachelor’s degree from an accredited university

Experience in using databases and/or visualizations

Strong analytical skills and understanding of system databases, data elements and application software solutions to optimize data gathering and analysis
Experience developing scripts/workflows that embed AI/ML into business processes (Python automation, Power Automate).
